tafsir.text: And they also say ‘What is it with this Messenger that he eats food and walks about in the marketplaces? Why has an angel not been sent down to him so as to be a warner along with him? and confirm his truthfulness.

verses.ar: أَوْ يُلْقَىٰٓ إِلَيْهِ كَنزٌ أَوْ تَكُونُ لَهُۥ جَنَّةٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهَا ۚ وَقَالَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ إِن تَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا رَجُلًا مَّسْحُورًا
verses.en: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?" And the wrongdoers say, "You follow not but a man affected by magic."

tafsir.text: Or a treasure thrown down to him from the heaven for him to spend from so as not to be in need of walking through the marketplaces in order to earn his livelihood.

verses.ar: ٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ ضَرَبُوا۟ لَكَ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ فَضَلُّوا۟ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.

tafsir.text: See how they strike similitudes for you of the fact that the Prophet is a person bewitched and one in need of something to expend from and of an angel to help him carry out the task of delivering the Message so that they go astray thereby from guidance and are unable to find a way a means thereto to guidance.

verses.ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِن شَآءَ جَعَلَ لَكَ خَيْرًا مِّن ذَٰلِكَ جَنَّـٰتٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ وَيَجْعَل لَّكَ قُصُورًۢا
verses.en: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.

tafsir.text: Blessed is He abundant is the good of God Who if He will will give you better than that treasure or orchard which they mentioned — gardens underneath which rivers flow in this world for He has already willed to give him such things in the Hereafter and will give read apocopated form wa-yaj‘al you palaces as well a

verses.ar: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
verses.en: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.

tafsir.text: Nay but they deny the coming of the Hour the Resurrection and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a blaze sa‘īr a fire that has been set ablaze musa‘‘ara in other words an intense fire.

verses.ar: إِذَا رَأَتْهُم مِّن مَّكَانٍۭ بَعِيدٍ سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا تَغَيُّظًا وَزَفِيرًا
verses.en: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.

tafsir.text: When it sees them from a distant place they will hear it raging boiling like an enraged person when his heart boils with anger and roaring producing a powerful noise. Alternatively what is meant by their ‘hearing it raging’ is their vision of it and awareness of it.

verses.ar: وَإِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ مِنْهَا مَكَانًا ضَيِّقًا مُّقَرَّنِينَ دَعَوْا۟ هُنَالِكَ ثُبُورًا
verses.en: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.

tafsir.text: And when they are flung into a narrow place thereof read dayyiqan or dayqan ‘narrow’ such that it constricts them; minhā ‘thereof’ is a circumstantial qualifier referring to makānan ‘place’ because it is actually an adjectival qualification of it bound together shackled with their hands bound to their necks in chains

verses.ar: لَّا تَدْعُوا۟ ٱلْيَوْمَ ثُبُورًا وَٰحِدًا وَٱدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا كَثِيرًا
verses.en: [They will be told], "Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction."

tafsir.text: ‘Do not pray for a single annihilation on this day but pray for many annihilations!’ which will be the nature of your chastisement.

verses.ar: قُلْ أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ أَمْ جَنَّةُ ٱلْخُلْدِ ٱلَّتِى وُعِدَ ٱلْمُتَّقُونَ ۚ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَزَآءً وَمَصِيرًا
verses.en: Say, "Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.

tafsir.text: Say ‘Is that which is mentioned of the threat of chastisement and the description of the Fire better or the Garden of Immortality which has been promised to the God-fearing which will be in God’s knowledge exalted be He their requital their reward and journey’s end?’ their place of return.

verses.ar: لَّهُمْ فِيهَا مَا يَشَآءُونَ خَـٰلِدِينَ ۚ كَانَ عَلَىٰ رَبِّكَ وَعْدًا مَّسْـُٔولًا
verses.en: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.

tafsir.text: In it they shall have what they wish abiding therein — an irrevocable state — it the promise to them of what is mentioned is a promise binding on your Lord a promise much besought requested by those who have been promised it as is clear from the following Our Lord grant us what You have promised us through Your

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ وَمَا يَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ فَيَقُولُ ءَأَنتُمْ أَضْلَلْتُمْ عِبَادِى هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ أَمْ هُمْ ضَلُّوا۟ ٱلسَّبِيلَ
verses.en: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides Allāh and will say, "Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?"

tafsir.text: And on the day when He will assemble them yahshuruhum; a variant reading has nahshuruhum ‘We assemble them’ and that which they worship besides God that is other than Him such as the angels Jesus Ezra and the jinn and will say exalted be He fa-yaqūlu;

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَكَ مَا كَانَ يَنۢبَغِى لَنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ مِن دُونِكَ مِنْ أَوْلِيَآءَ وَلَـٰكِن مَّتَّعْتَهُمْ وَءَابَآءَهُمْ حَتَّىٰ نَسُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَكَانُوا۟ قَوْمًۢا بُورًا
verses.en: They will say, "Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the message and became a people ruined."

tafsir.text: They will say ‘Glory be to You — exalted be You above what does not befit You! It was not it would not have been right for us to take any guardians besides You that is other than You min awliyā’a the first direct object the min being extra added to emphasise the negation;

verses.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوكُم بِمَا تَقُولُونَ فَمَا تَسْتَطِيعُونَ صَرْفًا وَلَا نَصْرًا ۚ وَمَن يَظْلِم مِّنكُمْ نُذِقْهُ عَذَابًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.

tafsir.text: Thus they will deny you that is the ones who were worshipped denied those who worshipped them in what you allege namely that they are gods and they will neither be able to read yastatī‘ūna or second person plural tastatī‘ūna in other words neither they nor you will be able to circumvent ward off the chastisement from

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ إِلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ لَيَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَيَمْشُونَ فِى ٱلْأَسْوَاقِ ۗ وَجَعَلْنَا بَعْضَكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ فِتْنَةً أَتَصْبِرُونَ ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ بَصِيرًا
verses.en: And We did not send before you, [O Muḥammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.

tafsir.text: And We did not send before you any messengers but that they ate food and walked in the marketplaces and so you are like them in this respect and truly what was said to them is being said to you.

verses.ar: ۞ وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرْجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ أَوْ نَرَىٰ رَبَّنَا ۗ لَقَدِ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ وَعَتَوْ عُتُوًّا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, "Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?" They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.

tafsir.text: And those who do not expect to encounter Us those who have no fear of the Resurrection say ‘Why have the angels not been sent down to us to act as messengers to us or why do we not see our Lord?’ so that we might be informed by Him that Muhammad (s) is truly His Messenger? God exalted be He says Assuredly they are

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ لَا بُشْرَىٰ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُجْرِمِينَ وَيَقُولُونَ حِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
verses.en: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, "Prevented and inaccessible."

tafsir.text: The day when they see the angels while they stand together with the rest of creation namely on the Day of Resurrection yawma is in the accusative because of an implied preceding udhkur ‘mention’ there will be no good tidings on that day for the guilty that is the disbelievers in contrast to the believers for whom

verses.ar: وَقَدِمْنَآ إِلَىٰ مَا عَمِلُوا۟ مِنْ عَمَلٍ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هَبَآءً مَّنثُورًا
verses.en: And We will approach [i.e., regard] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.

tafsir.text: And We shall attend to We shall turn to the works they did that were good such as voluntary alms or kindness to kin a hospitable reception of a guest or the succour of a troubled person in this world and turn them into scattered dust habā’an manthūran namely as those individual particles of dust which one might

verses.ar: أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَنَّةِ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَيْرٌ مُّسْتَقَرًّا وَأَحْسَنُ مَقِيلًا
verses.en: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.

tafsir.text: Those who will be the inhabitants of Paradise on that day the Day of Resurrection will be in a far better abode than are the disbelievers in this world and a far better resting place than theirs the latter’s; in other words a better place for qā’ila which is a rest taken during midday during hot days.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلْغَمَـٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
verses.en: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.

tafsir.text: And on the day when the heaven each of the seven heavens will be split asunder with the clouds in other words split asunder together with them the clouds al-ghamām is white cloud and the angels will be sent down from every heaven in a majestic descent and this is the Day of Resurrection it yawma ‘on the day’ is in the

verses.ar: ٱلْمُلْكُ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْحَقُّ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ وَكَانَ يَوْمًا عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَسِيرًا
verses.en: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.

tafsir.text: true Sovereignty on that day will belong to the Compassionate One with no one else sharing it with Him and it that day will be a hard day for the disbelievers in contrast to the believers.

verses.ar: وَيَوْمَ يَعَضُّ ٱلظَّالِمُ عَلَىٰ يَدَيْهِ يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى ٱتَّخَذْتُ مَعَ ٱلرَّسُولِ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, "Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.

tafsir.text: And it will be a day when the wrongdoer the idolater ‘Uqba b. Abī Mu‘ayt — who had uttered the two-part profession ‘there is no god but God Muhammad (s) is His Messenger’ but retracted it in order to please Ubayy b.

verses.ar: يَـٰوَيْلَتَىٰ لَيْتَنِى لَمْ أَتَّخِذْ فُلَانًا خَلِيلًا
verses.en: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.

tafsir.text: O woe to me! yā waylatā the final alif stands in place of the first person singular possessive yā’ yā waylatī meaning ‘alas for my destruction!’ Would that I had not taken so and so in other words that Ubayy as friend!

verses.ar: لَّقَدْ أَضَلَّنِى عَنِ ٱلذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ جَآءَنِى ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ خَذُولًا
verses.en: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."

tafsir.text: Verily he has led me astray from the Remembrance namely the Qur’ān after it had come to me by causing me to recant my belief in it. God exalted be He says And Satan is ever a deserter of the disbelieving man’ abandoning him and dissociating from him in times of tribulation.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَـٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ هَـٰذَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ مَهْجُورًا
verses.en: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned."

tafsir.text: And the Messenger Muhammad (s) says ‘O my Lord lo! my people the tribe of Quraysh consider this Qur’ān as something to be shunned’ to be disregarded.

verses.ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ جَعَلْنَا لِكُلِّ نَبِىٍّ عَدُوًّا مِّنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ ۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِرَبِّكَ هَادِيًا وَنَصِيرًا
verses.en: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says So just as We have appointed for you enemies from among the idolaters of your people We have appointed to every prophet before you an enemy from among the guilty the idolaters — so be steadfast as they were;

verses.ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَا نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ جُمْلَةً وَٰحِدَةً ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ لِنُثَبِّتَ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَ ۖ وَرَتَّلْنَـٰهُ تَرْتِيلًا
verses.en: And those who disbelieve say, "Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?" Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.

tafsir.text: And those who disbelieve say ‘Why has the Qur’ān not been revealed to him all at once?’ as the Torah the Gospel and the Book of Psalms were. God exalted be He says We have revealed it thus in parts it is that We may strengthen your inner-heart with it and We have arranged it in a specific order that is to say We

verses.ar: وَلَا يَأْتُونَكَ بِمَثَلٍ إِلَّا جِئْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَأَحْسَنَ تَفْسِيرًا
verses.en: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.

tafsir.text: And they do not bring you any similitude to invalidate your mission but that We bring you the truth that refutes it and what is better as exposition explanation.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُحْشَرُونَ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ شَرٌّ مَّكَانًا وَأَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.

tafsir.text: They are those who will be gathered on their faces that is those who will be driven as cattle toward Hell they will be in the worst place namely Hell and furthest astray from the way they will be on a path of error worse than that of others; and this path is their disbelief.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًا
verses.en: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.

tafsir.text: And verily We gave Moses the Scripture the Torah and made Aaron his brother go with him as a minister an assistant.

verses.ar: فَقُلْنَا ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَدَمَّرْنَـٰهُمْ تَدْمِيرًا
verses.en: And We said, "Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs." Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.

tafsir.text: Then We said ‘Go both of you to the people who have denied Our signs’ that is to the Egyptians — Pharaoh and his folk. So they went to them with the Message but they the Egyptians denied both of them. Then We destroyed them utterly.

verses.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ لَّمَّا كَذَّبُوا۟ ٱلرُّسُلَ أَغْرَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ ءَايَةً ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لِلظَّـٰلِمِينَ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.

tafsir.text: And mention the people of Noah when they denied the messengers in denying Noah — it is as though he were many messengers given the length of time he remained among them;

verses.ar: وَعَادًا وَثَمُودَا۟ وَأَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلرَّسِّ وَقُرُونًۢا بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.en: And [We destroyed] ʿAad and Thamūd and the companions of the well and many generations between them.

tafsir.text: And mention ‘Ād the people of Hūd and Thamūd the people of Sālih and the dwellers at al-Rass al-rass — the name of a ‘well’; their prophet is said to have been Shu‘ayb; although some say it was someone else.

verses.ar: وَكُلًّا ضَرَبْنَا لَهُ ٱلْأَمْثَـٰلَ ۖ وَكُلًّا تَبَّرْنَا تَتْبِيرًا
verses.en: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.

tafsir.text: For each of them We struck similitudes when establishing arguments against them and We destroyed them only after warning them and each of them We ruined utterly We destroyed utterly because of their denial of the prophets sent to them.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَتَوْا۟ عَلَى ٱلْقَرْيَةِ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُمْطِرَتْ مَطَرَ ٱلسَّوْءِ ۚ أَفَلَمْ يَكُونُوا۟ يَرَوْنَهَا ۚ بَلْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ نُشُورًا
verses.en: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.

tafsir.text: And verily they namely the disbelievers of Mecca will have passed by the town on which an evil shower was rained al-saw’ ‘evil’ is the verbal noun from sā’a ‘was evil’ that is it was showered with stones. This was the principal town of the towns inhabited by the people of Lot;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْكَ إِن يَتَّخِذُونَكَ إِلَّا هُزُوًا أَهَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى بَعَثَ ٱللَّهُ رَسُولًا
verses.en: And when they see you, [O Muḥammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], "Is this the one whom Allāh has sent as a messenger?

tafsir.text: And when they see you they take you in mockery only as an object of derision saying ‘Is this the one whom God has sent as a messenger? as he is wont to claim? — contemptuously of him as one not worthy of being a messenger.

verses.ar: إِن كَادَ لَيُضِلُّنَا عَنْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لَوْلَآ أَن صَبَرْنَا عَلَيْهَا ۚ وَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ حِينَ يَرَوْنَ ٱلْعَذَابَ مَنْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them." But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.

tafsir.text: Indeed in softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted namely innahu he was about to lead us astray turn us away from our gods had we not stood by them’ he would have turned us away from them.

verses.ar: أَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَـٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ أَفَأَنتَ تَكُونُ عَلَيْهِ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?

tafsir.text: Have you seen — inform Me about — him who has taken as his god his own desire? that is as something that will be bring about his ruin the indirect object ilāhahu ‘as his god’ precedes the direct object because it is more important;

verses.ar: أَمْ تَحْسَبُ أَنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ يَسْمَعُونَ أَوْ يَعْقِلُونَ ۚ إِنْ هُمْ إِلَّا كَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ۖ بَلْ هُمْ أَضَلُّ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.

tafsir.text: Or do you suppose that most of them listen listening so as to understand or comprehend? what you say to them? They are but as the cattle — nay but they are further astray from the way further from these cattle upon the path of misguidance for at least they cattle yield to the person who looks after them whereas these

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَيْفَ مَدَّ ٱلظِّلَّ وَلَوْ شَآءَ لَجَعَلَهُۥ سَاكِنًا ثُمَّ جَعَلْنَا ٱلشَّمْسَ عَلَيْهِ دَلِيلًا
verses.en: Have you not considered your Lord - how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.

tafsir.text: Have you not seen contemplated the work of your Lord how He extends the twilight shadow? from the point of daybreak to the point of sunrise. For had He your Lord willed He would have made it still ever-present so that it does not disappear with the rising of the sun.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَبَضْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْنَا قَبْضًا يَسِيرًا
verses.en: Then We [retract and] hold it with Us for a brief grasp.

tafsir.text: Then We retract it the extended shadow to Us by gentle retraction subtle retraction through the rising of the sun.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا وَٱلنَّوْمَ سُبَاتًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلنَّهَارَ نُشُورًا
verses.en: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.

tafsir.text: And He it is Who made for you the night as a garment veiling you like a garment and sleep for repose rest for bodies through the temporary cessation of labour and He made the day for rising a time in which all rise to seek their livelihood and so on.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَرْسَلَ ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ بُشْرًۢا بَيْنَ يَدَىْ رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً طَهُورًا
verses.en: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water

tafsir.text: And He it is Who sends forth the winds al-riyāha; a variant has al-rīha ‘the wind’ dispersing before His mercy nushuran ‘dispersing’ scattered before the coming of the rain a variant reading has nushran the singular of which is nashūr similar in pattern to rasūl ‘messenger’ plural rusul;

verses.ar: لِّنُحْـِۧىَ بِهِۦ بَلْدَةً مَّيْتًا وَنُسْقِيَهُۥ مِمَّا خَلَقْنَآ أَنْعَـٰمًا وَأَنَاسِىَّ كَثِيرًا
verses.en: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.

tafsir.text: with which We revive a dead land read maytan in the softened form equally valid for the masculine and the feminine but in the masculine here because of the masculine noun indicating ‘place’ implicit therein and We give it the water as drink to the many cattle camels cows and sheep and humans We have created anāsiyy is

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَرَّفْنَـٰهُ بَيْنَهُمْ لِيَذَّكَّرُوا۟ فَأَبَىٰٓ أَكْثَرُ ٱلنَّاسِ إِلَّا كُفُورًا
verses.en: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.

tafsir.text: And verily We have distributed it the water among them so that they may remember li-yadhdhakkarū should actually be li-yatadhakkarū but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dhāl; a variant reading has li-yadhkurū that is to say so that they may remember therewith the grace of God.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَبَعَثْنَا فِى كُلِّ قَرْيَةٍ نَّذِيرًا
verses.en: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.

tafsir.text: And had We willed We could have sent forth in every town a warner to threaten its inhabitants with God’s chastisement; instead We have sent you to the inhabitants of all towns as a warner for your reward to be a great one.

verses.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ وَجَـٰهِدْهُم بِهِۦ جِهَادًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.

tafsir.text: So do not obey the disbelievers in their desires but struggle against them therewith that is through adherence to the Qur’ān with a great endeavour.

verses.ar: ۞ وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ هَـٰذَا عَذْبٌ فُرَاتٌ وَهَـٰذَا مِلْحٌ أُجَاجٌ وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخًا وَحِجْرًا مَّحْجُورًا
verses.en: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.

tafsir.text: And He it is Who merged the two seas letting them flow one adjacent to the other this one palatable sweet and the other saltish bitter; and He set between the two an isthmus so that the one does not mix with the other and a forbidding ban a shield that prevents the two from becoming mixed.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ بَشَرًا فَجَعَلَهُۥ نَسَبًا وَصِهْرًا ۗ وَكَانَ رَبُّكَ قَدِيرًا
verses.en: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].

tafsir.text: And He it is Who created man from water He created from a sperm-drop a human being and made for him ties of blood and ties of marriage whether it be a male or a female they marry for the purposes of procreation. For your Lord is ever Powerful with the power to do whatever He will.

verses.ar: وَيَعْبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَنفَعُهُمْ وَلَا يَضُرُّهُمْ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱلْكَافِرُ عَلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ ظَهِيرًا
verses.en: But they worship rather than Allāh that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].

tafsir.text: And they the disbelievers worship besides God that which neither benefits them when they worship it nor harms them should they refrain therefrom — and these are idols; and the disbeliever is ever a partisan against his Lord an assistant to Satan through his obedience to him.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَـٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرًا وَنَذِيرًا
verses.en: And We have not sent you, [O Muḥammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.

tafsir.text: And We have not sent you except as a bearer of good tidings of Paradise and as a warner a threatener of people with the chastisement of the Fire.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ إِلَّا مَن شَآءَ أَن يَتَّخِذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Say, "I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way."

tafsir.text: Say ‘I do not ask of you in return for this that is for delivering that Message with which I have been sent any reward except that whoever wishes to follow a way to his Lord should do so’ by expending his wealth for the sake of attaining God’s pleasure exalted be He;

verses.ar: وَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلْحَىِّ ٱلَّذِى لَا يَمُوتُ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِهِۦ ۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِهِۦ بِذُنُوبِ عِبَادِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
verses.en: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [Allāh] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, [fully] Aware -

tafsir.text: And put your trust in the Living One Who does not die and make glorifications ensconced in His praise in other words say subhāna’Llāhi wa’l-hamdu li’Llāh ‘Glory be to God and praise be to God’.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَسْـَٔلْ بِهِۦ خَبِيرًا
verses.en: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)].

tafsir.text: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days of the length of the days of this world since there was no sun at that point — had He willed He could have created them in an instant but His not having done so is because He will to teach His creatures to be circumspect — then

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ قَالُوا۟ وَمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ أَنَسْجُدُ لِمَا تَأْمُرُنَا وَزَادَهُمْ نُفُورًا ۩
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Prostrate to the Most Merciful," they say, "And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?" And it increases them in aversion.

tafsir.text: And when it is said to them to the disbelievers of Mecca ‘Prostrate yourselves before the Compassionate One’ they say ‘And what is the Compassionate One? Should we prostrate ourselves to whatever you bid us’ ta’murunā;

verses.ar: تَبَارَكَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَجَعَلَ فِيهَا سِرَٰجًا وَقَمَرًا مُّنِيرًا
verses.en: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says Blessed magnified is He Who has placed in the heaven constellations twelve of them Aries Taurus Gemini Cancer Leo Virgo al-sunbula Libra Scorpio Sagittarius Capricorn Aquarius and Pisces.

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ خِلْفَةً لِّمَنْ أَرَادَ أَن يَذَّكَّرَ أَوْ أَرَادَ شُكُورًا
verses.en: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.

tafsir.text: And He it is Who made the night and day to appear in succession that is one succeeding the other for him who desires to remember read yadhdhakkara or yadhkura as before Q. 2550 — so that if he misses the opportunity to do some good during the one he can do it during the other;

verses.ar: وَعِبَادُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلَّذِينَ يَمْشُونَ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ هَوْنًا وَإِذَا خَاطَبَهُمُ ٱلْجَـٰهِلُونَ قَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا
verses.en: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,

tafsir.text: And the true servants of the Compassionate One ‘ibādu’l-rahmāni is the subject and what comes after it all the way up to ūlā’ika yujzawna ‘they will be rewarded’ of verse 75 below are adjectival qualifiers of this subject with the exception of the parenthetical statements are those who walk upon the earth modestly

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّدًا وَقِيَـٰمًا
verses.en: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]

tafsir.text: and who spend the night before their Lord prostrating sujjad is the plural of sājid and standing in worship in other words they spend the night performing prayers;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا ٱصْرِفْ عَنَّا عَذَابَ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ إِنَّ عَذَابَهَا كَانَ غَرَامًا
verses.en: And those who say, "Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;

tafsir.text: and who say ‘Our Lord avert from us from the chastisement of Hell. Truly its chastisement is abiding that is irrevocable.

verses.ar: إِنَّهَا سَآءَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
verses.en: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence."

tafsir.text: It is truly a wretched abode and residence!’ in other words it is truly wretched as a place in which to abide and reside.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَآ أَنفَقُوا۟ لَمْ يُسْرِفُوا۟ وَلَمْ يَقْتُرُوا۟ وَكَانَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ قَوَامًا
verses.en: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate

tafsir.text: And who when they expend upon their dependants are neither prodigal nor parsimonious read yaqturū or yuqtirū; but between such prodigality and parsimony lies — between the two their expenditure is in — moderation;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَدْعُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ وَلَا يَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّفْسَ ٱلَّتِى حَرَّمَ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَزْنُونَ ۚ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ يَلْقَ أَثَامًا
verses.en: And those who do not invoke with Allāh another deity or kill the soul which Allāh has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.

tafsir.text: and those who do not call on another god along with God nor slay the soul which God has forbidden that it be slain except with due cause and who do not commit fornication — for whoever does that namely whoever does one of these three things shall meet with retribution;

verses.ar: يُضَـٰعَفْ لَهُ ٱلْعَذَابُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَيَخْلُدْ فِيهِۦ مُهَانًا
verses.en: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -

tafsir.text: doubled yudā‘af a variant reading has yuda‘‘af will be the chastisement for him on the Day of Resurrection and he will abide therein both verbs may be read in the imperfect apocopated form yudā‘af ‘it will be doubled’ and yakhlud ‘he will abide’ as substitutions or with the indicative damma inflection yudā‘afu and

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ عَمَلًا صَـٰلِحًا فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُبَدِّلُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِهِمْ حَسَنَـٰتٍ ۗ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ غَفُورًا رَّحِيمًا
verses.en: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them Allāh will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is Allāh Forgiving and Merciful.

tafsir.text: except for him who repents and believes and acts righteously from among them for such God will replace their mentioned evil deeds with good deeds in the Hereafter for God is ever Forgiving Merciful that is He is ever possessed of such attributes;

verses.ar: وَمَن تَابَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا فَإِنَّهُۥ يَتُوبُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ مَتَابًا
verses.en: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to Allāh with [accepted] repentance.

tafsir.text: and whoever repents of his sins from among other than those mentioned and acts righteously indeed turns to God with due repentance that is he returns to God a sincere return and God will requite him with good;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَشْهَدُونَ ٱلزُّورَ وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِٱللَّغْوِ مَرُّوا۟ كِرَامًا
verses.en: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.

tafsir.text: and those who do not give false testimony that is testimony containing mendacity and falsehood and when they come across senseless talk in the way of vile speech and otherwise they pass by with dignity shunning such vanity;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَمْ يَخِرُّوا۟ عَلَيْهَا صُمًّا وَعُمْيَانًا
verses.en: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.

tafsir.text: and those who when they are reminded when they are admonished of the revelations of their Lord that is reminded of the Qur’ān do not fall on them deaf and blind but fall on them listening contemplating benefiting and obedient;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَا هَبْ لَنَا مِنْ أَزْوَٰجِنَا وَذُرِّيَّـٰتِنَا قُرَّةَ أَعْيُنٍ وَٱجْعَلْنَا لِلْمُتَّقِينَ إِمَامًا
verses.en: And those who say, "Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous."

tafsir.text: and those who say ‘Our Lord! Grant us in our spouses and our offspring read plural dhurriyyātinā or singular dhurriyyatinā a joyful sight for us so that we see them obedient to You and make us paragons of virtue for the God-fearing’.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ يُجْزَوْنَ ٱلْغُرْفَةَ بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ وَيُلَقَّوْنَ فِيهَا تَحِيَّةً وَسَلَـٰمًا
verses.en: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,

tafsir.text: Those they will be rewarded with the sublime abode the highest degree in Paradise forasmuch as they were steadfast in obedience to God and they will be met read yulaqqawna or yalqawna therein in this sublime abode with a greeting and words of peace from the angels;

verses.ar: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ حَسُنَتْ مُسْتَقَرًّا وَمُقَامًا
verses.en: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.

tafsir.text: abiding therein. Excellent is it as an abode and station as a place of residence for them ūlā’ika ‘those they …’ and what comes after it constitute the predicate to the subject ‘ibādu’l-rahmāni ‘the servants of the Compassionate One’.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَا يَعْبَؤُا۟ بِكُمْ رَبِّى لَوْلَا دُعَآؤُكُمْ ۖ فَقَدْ كَذَّبْتُمْ فَسَوْفَ يَكُونُ لِزَامًۢا
verses.en: Say, "What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?" For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.

tafsir.text: Say O Muhammad (s) to the people of Mecca ‘My Lord would not be concerned with you mā is for negation were it not for your supplications to Him when you are in adversity which He then removes.

verses.ar: طسٓمٓ
verses.en: Ṭā, Seen, Meem.

tafsir.text: Tā sīn mīm God knows best what He means by these letters.

verses.ar: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: These are the verses of the clear Book.

tafsir.text: Those namely these signs are the signs of the Manifest Book the Qur’ān the genitive annexation āyātu’l-kitābi conveys the partitive meaning of min the Manifest meaning the one that manifests what is truth from what is falsehood.

verses.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Perhaps, [O Muḥammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.

tafsir.text: Perhaps O Muhammad (s) you might kill yourself out of distress for the reason that they namely the people of Mecca will not become believers la‘alla here expresses sympathy in other words what is meant is ‘have pity on it your self by alleviating the burden of this distress’.

verses.ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ
verses.en: If We willed, We could send down to them from the sky a sign for which their necks would remain humbled.

tafsir.text: If We will We will send down to them a sign from the heaven before which their necks will remain fa-zallat although grammatically in the past tense is being used in the sense of the imperfect tense bowed in humility and they will believe since ‘necks’ are described as ‘bowed in humility’ a status which in fact refers

verses.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.en: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.

tafsir.text: And there would never come to them from the Compassionate One any remembrance any revelation from the Qur’ān that is new muhdathin is an explicative adjective but that they used to disregard it.

verses.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
verses.en: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.

tafsir.text: Verily then they have denied it; but soon there will come to them the news the consequences of that which they used to deride.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?

tafsir.text: Have they not contemplated observed the earth how many We have caused to grow therein in other words We have caused to grow therein many of every splendid kind of vegetation of every fair species.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

tafsir.text: Surely in that there is a sign an indication of the perfection of His power exalted be He; but most of them in God’s knowledge are not believers kāna here according to Sībawayhi is extra.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tafsir.text: And surely your Lord He is the Mighty One Who will exact vengeance from the disbelievers the Merciful Who shows mercy to believers.

verses.ar: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], "Go to the wrongdoing people -

tafsir.text: And mention O Muhammad (s) to your people when your Lord called to Moses on the night he saw the fire and the bush saying ‘Go to the wrongdoing folk as a messenger

verses.ar: قَوْمَ فِرْعَوْنَ ۚ أَلَا يَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear Allāh?"

tafsir.text: Pharaoh’s folk to them as well as him — they wronged their souls by disbelieving in God and wronged the Children of Israel by enslaving them — Will they not a-lā the hamza indicates a negation meant as a rebuke show fear?’ of God by being obedient to Him and affirm His Oneness?

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me

tafsir.text: He Moses said ‘My Lord I fear they will deny me

verses.ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.

tafsir.text: and that anguish will constrain my breast because of their denial of me and that my tongue will not utter clearly to deliver the Message because of the knot in it. So give the Mission to my brother Aaron alongside me.

verses.ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ
verses.en: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me."

tafsir.text: And I have sinned against them by my slaying of the Egyptian man and I fear they will slay me’ for this.

verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.

tafsir.text: Said He exalted be He ‘Certainly not! they shall not slay you. Go both of you you and your brother — this address although in the dual form is predominantly for the person present as opposed to the absent one — with Our signs.

verses.ar: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Go to Pharaoh and say, 'We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,

tafsir.text: So the two of you approach Pharaoh and say “Indeed We are — indeed each of the two of us is the Messenger of the Lord of the Worlds to you

verses.ar: أَنْ أَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: [Commanded to say], "Send with us the Children of Israel."'"

tafsir.text: that you should let go forth with us to Syria the Children of Israel” ’. So they approached him and said to him that which has been mentioned.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?

tafsir.text: He Pharaoh said to Moses ‘Did we not rear you among us in our homes as a child? as an infant only recently born but weaned and did you not stay with us for years of your life? for thirty years — he would dress from Pharaoh’s clothes and ride chariots of his and was referred to as Pharaoh’s son.

verses.ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."

tafsir.text: And you committed that deed of yours — namely his slaying of the Egyptian — being an ingrate’ a denier of my favours to you in having reared you among us and not enslaved you.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].

tafsir.text: He Moses said ‘I did that then when I was astray from the knowledge and the Message which God would later give me.

verses.ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophet hood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.

tafsir.text: So I fled from you as I was afraid of you. Then my Lord gave me judgement knowledge and made me one of the messengers.

verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"

tafsir.text: That is a favour with which you now reproach me that you have enslaved the Children of Israel’ an ‘abbadta banī Isrā’īl is explicative of tilka ‘that’ in other words you have enslaved them but not me there is no favour in that for your enslavement of them is wrong some scholars have reckoned there to be an

verses.ar: قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَا رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Said Pharaoh, "And what is the Lord of the worlds?"

tafsir.text: Pharaoh said to Moses ‘And what is “the Lord of the Worlds” ’ the One Whose Messenger you say you indeed are? In other words what exactly is He? And since there is no way for creation to know the true nature of God but only to know Him through an articulation of His attributes Moses blessings and peace be upon him

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced."

tafsir.text: He said ‘The Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in other words the Creator of all that — should you have conviction’ that He exalted be He is their Creator then believe in Him alone.

verses.ar: قَالَ لِمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥٓ أَلَا تَسْتَمِعُونَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, "Do you not hear?"

tafsir.text: He Pharaoh said to those noblemen among his folk who were around him ‘Did you not hear?!’ his response how it does not correspond to the question I asked?

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّكُمْ وَرَبُّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers."

tafsir.text: He Moses said ‘Your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers’. Now even though this fact is comprised by what was said before it enrages Pharaoh and therefore

verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Indeed, your 'messenger' who has been sent to you is mad."

tafsir.text: He said ‘Verily this messenger of yours sent to you is a madman!’

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason."

tafsir.text: He Moses said ‘The Lord of the east and the west and all that is between them — should you comprehend’ that He is such a Lord then believe in Him alone.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "If you take a god other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned."

tafsir.text: He Pharaoh said to Moses ‘If you choose any god other than me I will surely make you a prisoner!’. His Pharaoh’s prison was very harsh for a person would be shut up in a dungeon underground alone where he could neither see nor hear anyone else.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَوَلَوْ جِئْتُكَ بِشَىْءٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "Even if I brought you something [i.e., proof] manifest?"

tafsir.text: He Moses said to him ‘What would you do this even if I bring you something manifest?’ patent proof of my Mission?

verses.ar: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful."

tafsir.text: He Pharaoh said to him ‘Then bring it if you are truthful’ in this.

verses.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.

tafsir.text: So he threw down his staff and lo! it was a manifest serpent a great snake.

verses.ar: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
verses.en: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.

tafsir.text: Then he drew out his hand he brought it out of his pocket and lo! it was white glowing before the onlookers and not its usual skin colour.

verses.ar: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, "Indeed, this is a learned magician.

tafsir.text: He Pharaoh said to the council around him ‘Surely this man is a cunning sorcerer an expert in the art of magic

verses.ar: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ
verses.en: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?"

tafsir.text: who seeks to expel you from your land by his sorcery. So what do you advise?’

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers

tafsir.text: They said ‘Put him and his brother off for a while postpone judgement of their affair and send musterers into the cities

verses.ar: يَأْتُوكَ بِكُلِّ سَحَّارٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician."

tafsir.text: to bring you every cunning sorcerer’ to surpass Moses in the art of magic.

verses.ar: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.

tafsir.text: So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time of a known day which was the morning of the Festival Day.

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ لِلنَّاسِ هَلْ أَنتُم مُّجْتَمِعُونَ
verses.en: And it was said to the people, "Will you congregate.

tafsir.text: And it was said to the people ‘Will you assemble!’

verses.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.en: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"

tafsir.text: Maybe we will follow the sorcerers should they be the victors’ the interrogative of the previous verse is an incitement to assemble and the optative sense implicit in la‘alla is due to their anticipation of victory and hence their continued adherence to their religion and rejection of Moses.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.en: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, "Is there indeed for us a reward if we are the predominant?"

tafsir.text: So when the sorcerers came they said to Pharaoh ‘Shall we indeed read a-inna either by pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second but in both cases inserting an alif have a reward if we were to be the victors?’

verses.ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.en: He said, "Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me]."

tafsir.text: He said ‘Yes of course! And you shall then be among those closest to me’.

verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ
verses.en: Moses said to them, "Throw whatever you will throw."

tafsir.text: Moses said to them after they had said to him Either you cast or we shall be the casters Q. 7115 ‘Cast what you have to cast’ — the command to do this signifies an authorisation for them to cast and a means whereby the truth will be made to prevail.

verses.ar: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.en: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, "By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are predominant."

tafsir.text: So they cast their ropes and their staffs and said ‘By the power of Pharaoh we shall surely be the victors!’

verses.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ
verses.en: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.

tafsir.text: Thereat Moses cast his staff and lo! it was swallowing talqafu one of the original two tā’ letters of taltaqifu has been assimilated what they had faked what they had transformed through illusion making their ropes and staffs appear to be moving serpents.

verses.ar: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to Allāh].

tafsir.text: So the sorcerers fell down prostrating.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,

tafsir.text: They said ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds

verses.ar: رَبِّ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: The Lord of Moses and Aaron."

tafsir.text: the Lord of Moses and Aaron’ for they realised that what they had witnessed in the case of the staff could not have been the result of mere sorcery.

verses.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [Pharaoh] said, "You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all."

tafsir.text: Pharaoh said ‘Do you believe a-āmantum read pronouncing both hamzas or replacing the second one with an alif him Moses though I have not given you leave? He is indeed your chief the one who has taught you sorcery — so that he only taught you some tricks and then surpassed you with others.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ
verses.en: They said, "No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.

tafsir.text: They said ‘There is no harm in that no damage will be done to us thereby. Surely to our Lord after we die whichever way that may be we shall return in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the believers."

tafsir.text: Indeed We hope our Lord will forgive us our iniquities for being the first to believe’ in our time.

verses.ar: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
verses.en: And We inspired to Moses, "Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued."

tafsir.text: And We revealed to Moses after many years which he spent among them calling them to the truth with God’s signs but all of which only increased them in insolence saying ‘Journey with My servants the Children of Israel by night a variant reading for an asri is an isr from the verb sarā one form of asrā go with them by

verses.ar: فَأَرْسَلَ فِرْعَوْنُ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ
verses.en: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers

tafsir.text: Then Pharaoh having been informed of their night departure sent to the cities — it is said that he ruled a thousand cities and twelve thousand villages — musterers to assemble the army saying

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَشِرْذِمَةٌ قَلِيلُونَ
verses.en: [And said], "Indeed, those are but a small band,

tafsir.text: ‘Lo! these are but a small gang. It is said that they the Children of Israel numbered 670000 while his Pharaoh’s vanguard alone numbered 700000 and so he deemed their number insignificant in comparison to his huge army.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ لَنَا لَغَآئِظُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, they are enraging us,

tafsir.text: And indeed they have enraged us their actions infuriate us

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَجَمِيعٌ حَـٰذِرُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, we are a cautious society..."

tafsir.text: and indeed we are all on our guard’ ready a variant reading for hadhirūna has hādhirūn meaning ‘alert’.

verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَـٰهُم مِّن جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: So We removed them from gardens and springs

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says So We made them Pharaoh and his folk go forth out of Egypt in order to pursue Moses and his people from gardens orchards on either side of the Nile and springs streams running from the Nile through their dwellings

verses.ar: وَكُنُوزٍ وَمَقَامٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: And treasures and honorable station -

tafsir.text: and treasures visible riches of gold and silver — these riches are called kunūz as opposed to amwāl ‘riches’ because that portion which is always due to God exalted be He from them had not been paid — and splendid places exquisite residences for princes and ministers surrounded by their retinues.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ وَأَوْرَثْنَـٰهَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
verses.en: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.

tafsir.text: So it was that is Our expulsion of them was as We have described and We made the Children of Israel to inherit these after drowning Pharaoh and his folk.

verses.ar: فَأَتْبَعُوهُم مُّشْرِقِينَ
verses.en: So they pursued them at sunrise.

tafsir.text: Then they pursued them they caught them up at sunrise.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ
verses.en: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, "Indeed, we are to be overtaken!"

tafsir.text: And when the two hosts sighted each other the companions of Moses said ‘We have been caught!’ Pharaoh’s hosts have caught us up and we have no power against them.

verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.en: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."

tafsir.text: He Moses said ‘Certainly not! they shall not catch us up; indeed I have my Lord with me to provide assistance. He will guide me’ to the route of deliverance.

verses.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: Then We inspired to Moses, "Strike with your staff the sea," and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says Thereupon We revealed to Moses ‘Strike the sea with your staff’ and he struck it whereupon it parted it split into twelve parts and each part was as a mighty mountain between each of these parts were paths which they followed such that not even the saddles or the felts of the riders were touched

verses.ar: وَأَزْلَفْنَا ثَمَّ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].

tafsir.text: And there We brought near the others Pharaoh and his folk until they followed them across the same paths.

verses.ar: وَأَنجَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.

tafsir.text: And We delivered Moses and all those who were with him by bringing them out of the sea while it was in the state mentioned above.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We drowned the others.

tafsir.text: Then We drowned the others Pharaoh and his folk by closing the sea on them after they had entered the sea and the Children of Israel had exited therefrom.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

tafsir.text: Surely in that drowning of Pharaoh and his folk there is a sign a lesson for those generations who would come after them; but most of them are not believers in God.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tafsir.text: And surely your Lord He is the Mighty for He wrought vengeance upon the disbelievers by drowning them the Merciful to believers delivering them from drowning.

verses.ar: وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.en: And recite to them the news of Abraham,

tafsir.text: And recite to them the disbelievers of Mecca the tiding the tale of Abraham Ibrāhīma is substituted by the following idh qāla ‘when he said’

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: When he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?"

tafsir.text: when he said to his father and his people ‘What do you worship?’

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ
verses.en: They said, "We worship idols and remain to them devoted."

tafsir.text: They said ‘We worship idols — they reiterate the verb in the response in order to supplement it with the following remark — and remain cleaving to them’ we remain worshipping them all day; they give a longer response to indicate their misplaced pride in such an act.

verses.ar: قَالَ هَلْ يَسْمَعُونَكُمْ إِذْ تَدْعُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Do they hear you when you supplicate?

tafsir.text: He said ‘Do they hear you when you supplicate?

verses.ar: أَوْ يَنفَعُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَضُرُّونَ
verses.en: Or do they benefit you, or do they harm?"

tafsir.text: Or do they bring you benefit when you worship them or harm? to you if you do not?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: They said, "But we found our fathers doing thus."

tafsir.text: They said ‘Rather we found our fathers so doing’ that is doing the same as we do.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Then do you see what you have been worshipping,

tafsir.text: He said ‘Have you considered what you have been worshipping

verses.ar: أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُمُ ٱلْأَقْدَمُونَ
verses.en: You and your ancient forefathers?

tafsir.text: you and your ancestors?

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,

tafsir.text: They are indeed hateful to me I do not worship them; but the Lord of the Worlds I do worship Him

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَنِى فَهُوَ يَهْدِينِ
verses.en: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.

tafsir.text: He Who created me it is He Who guides me to the proper religion

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى هُوَ يُطْعِمُنِى وَيَسْقِينِ
verses.en: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.

tafsir.text: and provides me with food and drink

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَرِضْتُ فَهُوَ يَشْفِينِ
verses.en: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me

tafsir.text: and when I am sick it is He Who cures me;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى يُمِيتُنِى ثُمَّ يُحْيِينِ
verses.en: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life

tafsir.text: and Who will make me die then give me life

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense."

tafsir.text: and Who I hope will forgive me my iniquity on the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital.

verses.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.

tafsir.text: My Lord! Grant me unerring judgement knowledge and unite me with the righteous the prophets.

verses.ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honor among later generations.

tafsir.text: And confer on me a worthy repute excellent praise among posterity those who will come after me up to the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: وَٱجْعَلْنِى مِن وَرَثَةِ جَنَّةِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.

tafsir.text: And make me among the inheritors of the Garden of Bliss among those who will be given it.

verses.ar: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.

tafsir.text: And forgive my father for indeed he is one of those who are astray by Your relenting to him and forgiving him this was before it became clear to him Abraham that he his father was an enemy of God as mentioned in sūrat Barā’a Q. 9114.

verses.ar: وَلَا تُخْزِنِى يَوْمَ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -

tafsir.text: And do not disgrace me do not expose me on the day when they mankind are resurrected;

verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ
verses.en: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children

tafsir.text: of which day God exalted be He says the following the day when neither wealth nor children will avail anyone

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
verses.en: But only one who comes to Allāh with a sound heart."

tafsir.text: except him who comes to God with a heart that is sound free from idolatry and hypocrisy — and this is the heart of the believer whom such things will avail.

verses.ar: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.

tafsir.text: And Paradise will be brought near for the God-fearing and they will be able to see it

verses.ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِلْغَاوِينَ
verses.en: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,

tafsir.text: and Hell will be revealed plainly for the perverse the disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: And it will be said to them, "Where are those you used to worship

tafsir.text: And it will be said to them ‘Where is that which you used to worship

verses.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ
verses.en: Other than Allāh? Can they help you or help themselves?"

tafsir.text: besides God? that is other than Him in the way of idols. Do they help you by averting from you the chastisement or do they help one another?’ by averting it from themselves? No neither!

verses.ar: فَكُبْكِبُوا۟ فِيهَا هُمْ وَٱلْغَاوُۥنَ
verses.en: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators

tafsir.text: Then they will be hurled cast into it they and the perverse

verses.ar: وَجُنُودُ إِبْلِيسَ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.en: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.

tafsir.text: and the hosts of Iblīs his followers and those jinn and humans who were obedient to him all together.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ وَهُمْ فِيهَا يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.en: They will say while they dispute therein,

tafsir.text: They the perverse shall say as they wrangle therein with those whom they used to worship

verses.ar: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: "By Allāh, we were indeed in manifest error

tafsir.text: ‘By God we had indeed in softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted in other words it would usually be innahu been in manifest error

verses.ar: إِذْ نُسَوِّيكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.

tafsir.text: when we equated you in worship with the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَضَلَّنَآ إِلَّا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: And no one misguided us except the criminals.

tafsir.text: And it was none other than the sinners the devils or our predecessors whose example we were following that led us astray from guidance.

verses.ar: فَمَا لَنَا مِن شَـٰفِعِينَ
verses.en: So now we have no intercessors

tafsir.text: So now we have no intercessors as the believers have in the way of angels prophets and other believers

verses.ar: وَلَا صَدِيقٍ حَمِيمٍ
verses.en: And not a devoted friend.

tafsir.text: nor any sympathetic friend who might be concerned for us.

verses.ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers..."

tafsir.text: If only we had another turn another return to this world we would have been among those who believe!’ law ‘if only’ here is for the conditional optative to which nakūna ‘we would have been’ constitutes the response.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

tafsir.text: Surely in that which is mentioned of the tale of Abraham and his people there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tafsir.text: And truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: The people of Noah denied the messengers

tafsir.text: The people of Noah denied the messengers by denying him for they all brought the same message affirming God’s Oneness; or it is because he stayed among them for so long that it was as though he was many messengers the feminine person of the verb kadhdhabat ‘denied’ governed by qawm ‘the people’ is on account of the

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When their brother Noah said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

tafsir.text: when Noah their brother — their brother only in terms of lineage — said to them ‘Will you not fear? God?

verses.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

tafsir.text: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you to deliver the Message with which I have been sent.

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tafsir.text: So fear God and obey me in what I enjoin you to of God’s Oneness and obedience to Him.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

tafsir.text: I do not ask of you any reward for it for delivering it; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me."

tafsir.text: So fear God and obey me’ — he repeats this statement for emphasis.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالُوٓا۟ أَنُؤْمِنُ لَكَ وَٱتَّبَعَكَ ٱلْأَرْذَلُونَ
verses.en: They said, "Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of people]?"

tafsir.text: They said ‘Shall we believe in you in your words when it is the lowliest people who follow you?’ wa’ttaba‘aka a variant reading has wa-atbā‘uka ‘when your followers’ plural of tābi‘ ‘follower’ as a subject the riffraff such as the weavers and the shoemakers.

verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: He said, "And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?

tafsir.text: He said ‘And what do I know of what they may have been doing?

verses.ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ
verses.en: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.

tafsir.text: Their reckoning is only my Lord’s concern and He will requite them if only you were aware — had you known this you would not have reviled them.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِطَارِدِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And I am not one to drive away the believers.

tafsir.text: And I am not about to drive away the believers.

verses.ar: إِنْ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: I am only a clear warner."

tafsir.text: I am just a plain warner’.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ
verses.en: They said, "If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned."

tafsir.text: They said ‘Lo! if you do not desist O Noah from what you say to us you will assuredly be among those assailed’ with stones or curses.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنَّ قَوْمِى كَذَّبُونِ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.

tafsir.text: He Noah said ‘My Lord my people have denied me

verses.ar: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the believers."

tafsir.text: so judge conclusively between me and them and deliver me and the believers who are with me’.

verses.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.en: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.

tafsir.text: He exalted be He says So We delivered him and those who were with him in the laden ark the ship filled with humans animals and birds.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا بَعْدُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
verses.en: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.

tafsir.text: Then afterwards after We delivered them We drowned the rest of his people.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

tafsir.text: Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tafsir.text: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: ʿAad denied the messengers

tafsir.text: ‘Ād denied the messengers

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When their brother Hūd said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

tafsir.text: when Hūd their brother said to them ‘Will you not fear God?

verses.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

tafsir.text: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tafsir.text: So fear God and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

tafsir.text: I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أَتَبْنُونَ بِكُلِّ رِيعٍ ءَايَةً تَعْبَثُونَ
verses.en: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,

tafsir.text: Do you build on every prominence every high place a monument an edifice as a signpost for passers-by so that you may hurl abuse? at those who pass by you and deride them ta‘bathūna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb tabnūna ‘you build’.

verses.ar: وَتَتَّخِذُونَ مَصَانِعَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَخْلُدُونَ
verses.en: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., palaces and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?

tafsir.text: And you set up structures for extracting water underground that perhaps you might as though you will last forever therein and not die.

verses.ar: وَإِذَا بَطَشْتُم بَطَشْتُمْ جَبَّارِينَ
verses.en: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.

tafsir.text: And when you assault to smite or slay you assault like tyrants mercilessly!

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tafsir.text: So fear God in this and obey me in what I have commanded you.

verses.ar: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,

tafsir.text: And fear Him Who has provided you Who has been gracious to you in a way that you know

verses.ar: أَمَدَّكُم بِأَنْعَـٰمٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.en: Provided you with grazing livestock and children

tafsir.text: provided you with cattle and sons

verses.ar: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: And gardens and springs.

tafsir.text: and gardens orchards and springs rivers.

verses.ar: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."

tafsir.text: Indeed I fear for you the chastisement of a tremendous day’ in this world and in the Hereafter should you disobey me.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ
verses.en: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.

tafsir.text: They said ‘It is the same to us whether you admonish us or are not one of those who admonish anyway. In other words we will not heed your admonition.

verses.ar: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا خُلُقُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,

tafsir.text: This that you threaten us with is merely the fabrication of the ancients that is their inventions and lies a variant reading for khalq ‘fabrication’ is khuluq ‘ethos’ in other words this denial of resurrection to which we adhere is merely ‘the ethos of the ancients’ in other words their nature and wont;

verses.ar: وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمُعَذَّبِينَ
verses.en: And we are not to be punished."

tafsir.text: and we will not be chastised’.

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.

tafsir.text: So they denied him concerning the chastisement whereupon We destroyed them in this world with the barren wind cf. Q. 5141. Surely in that there is a sign; but most of them are not believers.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.

tafsir.text: Truly your Lord He is the Mighty the Merciful.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: Thamūd denied the messengers

tafsir.text: Thamūd denied the messengers

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When their brother Ṣāliḥ said to them, "Will you not fear Allāh?

tafsir.text: when Sālih their brother said to them ‘Will you fear God?

verses.ar: إِنِّى لَكُمْ رَسُولٌ أَمِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.

tafsir.text: Truly I am a trusted messenger sent to you.

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tafsir.text: So fear God and obey me.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.

tafsir.text: I do not ask of you any reward for this; for my reward lies only with the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: أَتُتْرَكُونَ فِى مَا هَـٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
verses.en: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],

tafsir.text: Will you be left secure in that which is here of good things —

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Within gardens and springs

tafsir.text: amid gardens and springs

verses.ar: وَزُرُوعٍ وَنَخْلٍ طَلْعُهَا هَضِيمٌ
verses.en: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?

tafsir.text: and farms and date palms with slender delicate and tender spathes?

verses.ar: وَتَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا فَـٰرِهِينَ
verses.en: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.

tafsir.text: And you hew dwellings out of the mountains arrogantly a variant reading of farihīna ‘arrogant’ has fārihīn ‘skilfully’.

verses.ar: فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: So fear Allāh and obey me.

tafsir.text: So fear God and obey me in what I have commanded you

verses.ar: وَلَا تُطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,

tafsir.text: and do not obey the command of the prodigal

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ
verses.en: Who cause corruption in the land and do not amend."

tafsir.text: who cause corruption in the earth through acts of disobedience and act righteously’ by being obedient to God.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَحَّرِينَ
verses.en: They said, "You are only of those affected by magic.

tafsir.text: They said ‘You are indeed one of the bewitched those who have succumbed so many times to sorcery that their minds have been overcome.

verses.ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the truthful."

tafsir.text: And moreover you are just a human being like us. So bring us a sign if you are sincere’ in your Mission.

verses.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: He said, "This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.

tafsir.text: He said ‘This is a she-camel; she shall drink a share of the water and you shall drink each on a known day.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
