tafsir.text: And indeed they the disbelievers will eat of it despite its vileness because of the severity of their hunger and will fill their bellies from it.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ لَهُمْ عَلَيْهَا لَشَوْبًا مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
verses.en: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

tafsir.text: Then lo! on top of it they will have a brew of boiling water which they drink and which mixes with what they have eaten and becomes a brew thereof.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ مَرْجِعَهُمْ لَإِلَى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

tafsir.text: Then indeed their return shall be to Hell-fire — this suggests that they exit from it only to drink the boiling water which is located outside it.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ أَلْفَوْا۟ ءَابَآءَهُمْ ضَآلِّينَ
verses.en: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

tafsir.text: Lo! they found their fathers to be astray

verses.ar: فَهُمْ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِمْ يُهْرَعُونَ
verses.en: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

tafsir.text: and so they are also now hurrying in their footsteps they shall be prodded to follow them and they end up hurrying towards it Hell-fire.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ ضَلَّ قَبْلَهُمْ أَكْثَرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

tafsir.text: And verily most of the ancients of past communities went astray before them

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا فِيهِم مُّنذِرِينَ
verses.en: And We had already sent among them warners.

tafsir.text: and We certainly had sent among them warners in the way of messengers to threaten them.

verses.ar: فَٱنظُرْ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.en: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

tafsir.text: So behold how was the consequence for them who were warned namely the disbelievers in other words the sequel for them was that they ended up in the chastisement;

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

tafsir.text: all except God’s sincere servants namely the believers who are saved from chastisement because they were sincere in their worship mukhlisīna; or if one reads mukhlasīna because God has made them sincerely devoted to such worship.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ نَادَىٰنَا نُوحٌ فَلَنِعْمَ ٱلْمُجِيبُونَ
verses.en: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

tafsir.text: And verily Noah called to Us when he said ‘My Lord I have been overcome so help me Q. 5410 and how excellent were the Hearers of the prayer for him were We in other words he invoked Us against his people so We destroyed them by drowning them.

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

tafsir.text: And We delivered him and his family from the great distress which was the drowning

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥ هُمُ ٱلْبَاقِينَ
verses.en: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

tafsir.text: and made his descendants the survivors thus all human beings are descended from him peace be upon him. He had three sons Shem Sām the ancestor of the Arabs the Persians and the Byzantines; Ham Hām the ancestor of the Negroes;

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

tafsir.text: And We left We preserved for him fair praise among posterity among the prophets and communities after him until the Day of Resurrection which is

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ نُوحٍ فِى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: "Peace upon Noah among the worlds."

tafsir.text: ‘Peace from Us be to Noah among the worlds!’

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tafsir.text: Thus indeed in the way that We requited them We requite the virtuous.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

tafsir.text: He was indeed one of Our faithful servants.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَغْرَقْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

tafsir.text: Then We did drown the others the disbelievers from among his folk.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِنَّ مِن شِيعَتِهِۦ لَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.en: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

tafsir.text: And truly of his adherents that is of those who agreed with him on the fundaments of religion was Abraham despite the fact that there was a long interval between them 2640 years and between them came the prophets Hūd and Sālih.

verses.ar: إِذْ جَآءَ رَبَّهُۥ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
verses.en: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

tafsir.text: When he came to his Lord in other words he continued to follow Him upon coming to Him with a heart that was pure of any doubt or the like

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَاذَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

tafsir.text: when he said while still in this continuous state of his to his father and his folk in reproach ‘What do — what is it that — you worship?

verses.ar: أَئِفْكًا ءَالِهَةً دُونَ ٱللَّهِ تُرِيدُونَ
verses.en: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

tafsir.text: Is it a calumny a-ifkan as regards the two hamzas the same applies as mentioned before — gods other than God — that you desire? ifkan is an object denoting reason; ālihatan is the direct object of turīdūna ‘you desire’; ifk denotes the worst kind of lie. In other words do you worship any other than God?

verses.ar: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

tafsir.text: What then is your supposition regarding the Lord of the Worlds?’ having worshipped other than Him do you think that He will leave you without punishment? No! They were a people of astrologers.

verses.ar: فَنَظَرَ نَظْرَةً فِى ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.en: And he cast a look at the stars.

tafsir.text: And he cast a glance at the stars — to delude them into thinking that he relies on them so that they would then trust him —

verses.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّى سَقِيمٌ
verses.en: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

tafsir.text: and said ‘Indeed I feel I will be sick’ that is I will fall ill.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّوْا۟ عَنْهُ مُدْبِرِينَ
verses.en: So they turned away from him, departing.

tafsir.text: So they went away to their festival leaving him behind.

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِهِمْ فَقَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?

tafsir.text: Then he turned he stole away to their gods the idols in front of which the food had been placed and said mockingly ‘Will you not eat? — but they failed to utter a word.

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمْ لَا تَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?".

tafsir.text: He then said What is wrong with you that you do not speak?’ — but still he received no response.

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ عَلَيْهِمْ ضَرْبًۢا بِٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

tafsir.text: He then turned on them striking them with his right hand with might smashing them. Those who saw him reported this to the rest of his people.

verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ يَزِفُّونَ
verses.en: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

tafsir.text: So they came running towards him walking hurriedly and they said to him ‘We worship them while you smash them?!’

verses.ar: قَالَ أَتَعْبُدُونَ مَا تَنْحِتُونَ
verses.en: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

tafsir.text: He said to them in reproach ‘Do you worship what you yourselves have carved out of stone and other materials idols

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ خَلَقَكُمْ وَمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

tafsir.text: when God created you and whatever you make?’ whether it be your act of carving and that which you have carved? So worship Him alone! the mā in wa-mā ta‘malūna ‘and whatever you make’ is that of the verbal noun; but it is also said to introduce a relative clause or it is adjectivally qualified.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ ٱبْنُوا۟ لَهُۥ بُنْيَـٰنًا فَأَلْقُوهُ فِى ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

tafsir.text: They said amongst themselves ‘Build for him a structure then fill it with firewood and set it on fire and when it is ablaze then cast him into the fierce fire’.

verses.ar: فَأَرَادُوا۟ بِهِۦ كَيْدًا فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُمُ ٱلْأَسْفَلِينَ
verses.en: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

tafsir.text: So they sought to outwit him by flinging him into the fire so that it may destroy him but We made them the lowermost the vanquished as he came out of the fire unharmed.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ إِنِّى ذَاهِبٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ
verses.en: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

tafsir.text: And he said ‘I shall indeed depart to my Lord I shall emigrating to Him from the abode of disbelief — He will guide me to the place to which My Lord has commanded that I end up in and this was Syria. When he reached the Holy Land he said

verses.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

tafsir.text: My Lord! Grant me a child of the righteous’.

verses.ar: فَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ حَلِيمٍ
verses.en: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

tafsir.text: So We gave him the good tidings of a forbearing son.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا بَلَغَ مَعَهُ ٱلسَّعْىَ قَالَ يَـٰبُنَىَّ إِنِّىٓ أَرَىٰ فِى ٱلْمَنَامِ أَنِّىٓ أَذْبَحُكَ فَٱنظُرْ مَاذَا تَرَىٰ ۚ قَالَ يَـٰٓأَبَتِ ٱفْعَلْ مَا تُؤْمَرُ ۖ سَتَجِدُنِىٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."

tafsir.text: And when he was old enough to walk with him that is to go about with him and help him out — this is said to have been either at the age of seven or at the age of thirteen — he said ‘O my dear son I see that is I have seen in a dream that I shall sacrifice you — and the visions of prophets are always true and their

verses.ar: فَلَمَّآ أَسْلَمَا وَتَلَّهُۥ لِلْجَبِينِ
verses.en: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,

tafsir.text: And when they had both submitted when they had submitted to and were prepared to comply with God’s command exalted be He and he had laid him down on his forehead when he had pushed him down to the ground thereon — every human being has two brows jabīn between which is the forehead jabha; this was at Minā.

verses.ar: وَنَـٰدَيْنَـٰهُ أَن يَـٰٓإِبْرَٰهِيمُ
verses.en: We called to him, "O Abraham,

tafsir.text: We called to him ‘O Abraham!

verses.ar: قَدْ صَدَّقْتَ ٱلرُّءْيَآ ۚ إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tafsir.text: Verily you have fulfilled the vision’ by what you have done in that you were able to go through with the act of sacrifice. In other words that which you have done suffices for you as redemption the statement nādaynāhu ‘We called to him’ is the response to the lammā ‘when’ so that the wāw in wa-nādaynāhu ‘We called to

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْبَلَـٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

tafsir.text: Truly this sacrifice to which he was commanded was indeed a clear test’ that is to say the ultimate test of faith.

verses.ar: وَفَدَيْنَـٰهُ بِذِبْحٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,

tafsir.text: Then We ransomed him the one whom he had been commanded to sacrifice namely Ishmael or Isaac — two different opinions — with a mighty sacrifice a mighty ram from Paradise the same one that Abel had offered as as sacrifice Gabriel peace be upon him brought it and the lord Abraham sacrificed it as he cried Allāhu akbar

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

tafsir.text: And We left We preserved for him among posterity fair praise namely

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
verses.en: "Peace upon Abraham."

tafsir.text: ‘Peace from Us be to Abraham!’

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tafsir.text: So in way that We rewarded him do We reward those who are virtuous to their own souls.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

tafsir.text: Indeed he is one of Our faithful servants.

verses.ar: وَبَشَّرْنَـٰهُ بِإِسْحَـٰقَ نَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.

tafsir.text: And We gave him the good tidings of the birth of Isaac — some have argued that this proves that the one who was sacrificed was not him Isaac — a prophet nabiyyan is a future circumstantial qualifier that is to say ‘he will come to be with his prophethood decreed one of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَبَـٰرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسْحَـٰقَ ۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحْسِنٌ وَظَالِمٌ لِّنَفْسِهِۦ مُبِينٌ
verses.en: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

tafsir.text: And We blessed him by multiplying his descendants and Isaac his son We also blessed by appointing the majority of prophets from among his progeny. And among their descendants is he who is virtuous he who is a believer and he who plainly wrongs his soul he who is a disbeliever whose disbelief is manifest.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

tafsir.text: And verily We favoured Moses and Aaron with prophethood

verses.ar: وَنَجَّيْنَـٰهُمَا وَقَوْمَهُمَا مِنَ ٱلْكَرْبِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

tafsir.text: and We delivered them and their people the Children of Israel from the great distress namely Pharaoh’s enslavement of them.

verses.ar: وَنَصَرْنَـٰهُمْ فَكَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ
verses.en: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

tafsir.text: And We helped them against the Egyptians so that they became the victors.

verses.ar: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ٱلْمُسْتَبِينَ
verses.en: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

tafsir.text: And We gave them the enlightening scripture the one whose statements concerning prescribed punishments and rulings and otherwise are excellently expressed — this is the Torah.

verses.ar: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُمَا ٱلصِّرَٰطَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمَ
verses.en: And We guided them on the straight path.

tafsir.text: And We guided them to the straight path the straight way

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِمَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

tafsir.text: and We left We preserved for them among posterity fair praise namely

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰ مُوسَىٰ وَهَـٰرُونَ
verses.en: "Peace upon Moses and Aaron."

tafsir.text: ‘Peace from Us be to Moses and Aaron!’

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tafsir.text: So just as We rewarded them both do We reward the virtuous.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمَا مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

tafsir.text: Indeed both were among Our faithful servants.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ إِلْيَاسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

tafsir.text: And truly Elias read wa-inna Ilyās with the initial hamza or without wa-inna’l-yāsa was also one of the messengers. Some think that this Elias was the son of Aaron’s brother — Aaron the brother of Moses; but some say that this Elias was some other person who was sent to the people living in and around Baalbak.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِقَوْمِهِۦٓ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ
verses.en: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

tafsir.text: When idh is dependent because of an implicit verb udhkur ‘mention’ he said to his people ‘Will you not fear God?

verses.ar: أَتَدْعُونَ بَعْلًا وَتَذَرُونَ أَحْسَنَ ٱلْخَـٰلِقِينَ
verses.en: Do you call upon Baʿl and leave the best of creators -

tafsir.text: Do you call on Baal — this was the name of an idol of theirs which was made of gold from which the name of their city derives with the addition of the suffix bak — that is to say do you worship him and abandon the Best of Creators and not worship Him

verses.ar: ٱللَّهَ رَبَّكُمْ وَرَبَّ ءَابَآئِكُمُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

tafsir.text: God your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers?’ read as predicates allāhu rabbukum and rabbu in the nominative because of the implicit omitted huwa being the subject; or read allāha rabbakum and rabba in the accusative as supplements to ahsana ‘the best of’.

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَإِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

tafsir.text: But they denied him. So they will indeed be arraigned in the Fire

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

tafsir.text: — all except God’s delivered servants namely the believers who will be saved from it

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا عَلَيْهِ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

tafsir.text: and We left for him among posterity fair praise namely

verses.ar: سَلَـٰمٌ عَلَىٰٓ إِلْ يَاسِينَ
verses.en: "Peace upon Elias."

tafsir.text: ‘Peace from Us be to Elias!’. It is said that this ilyāsīn is the same Elias mentioned above; but it is also said that this denotes him together with all those who were believers with him and so they have been coupled under the same term with him being the predominant as when one might say al-Muhallabūn ‘the

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tafsir.text: Indeed so — just as We rewarded him — do We reward the virtuous.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

tafsir.text: Truly he is one of Our faithful servants.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لُوطًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

tafsir.text: And indeed Lot was one of the messengers;

verses.ar: إِذْ نَجَّيْنَـٰهُ وَأَهْلَهُۥٓ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

tafsir.text: mention when We delivered him together with all his family

verses.ar: إِلَّا عَجُوزًا فِى ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
verses.en: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

tafsir.text: except an old woman who was among those who stayed behind in other words those who stayed behind in the chastisement.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ دَمَّرْنَا ٱلْـَٔاخَرِينَ
verses.en: Then We destroyed the others.

tafsir.text: Then We destroyed all the others the disbelievers from among his people.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّكُمْ لَتَمُرُّونَ عَلَيْهِم مُّصْبِحِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

tafsir.text: And indeed you pass by them by their remains and the remains of their dwellings during your travels both in the morning that is during the daytime

verses.ar: وَبِٱلَّيْلِ ۗ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

tafsir.text: and at night will you O people of Mecca not then understand? what befell them and so take heed therefrom?

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ يُونُسَ لَمِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

tafsir.text: And indeed Jonah was one of the messengers;

verses.ar: إِذْ أَبَقَ إِلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ
verses.en: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

tafsir.text: when he fled to the laden ship — after he became furious with his people as the chastisement which he had promised them did not come down on them; so he boarded the ship which then stopped out in the deep sea.

verses.ar: فَسَاهَمَ فَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُدْحَضِينَ
verses.en: And he drew lots and was among the losers.

tafsir.text: Then he drew lots with the passengers on the ship and was of those rejected of the losers in the draw and so they threw him into the sea.

verses.ar: فَٱلْتَقَمَهُ ٱلْحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.en: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.

tafsir.text: Then the whale swallowed him while he was blameworthy that is while he was guilty of a blameworthy thing having gone to sea and embarked the ship without his Lord’s permission.

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَآ أَنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُسَبِّحِينَ
verses.en: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

tafsir.text: And had he not been one of those who glorify God that is to say those who make remembrance of God for inside the whale’s belly he was repeatedly saying the words ‘There is no god except You. Glory be to You! I have indeed been one of the wrongdoers’ Q. 2187

verses.ar: لَلَبِثَ فِى بَطْنِهِۦٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.

tafsir.text: he would have tarried in its belly until the day when they are raised in other words the whale’s belly would have been his tomb until the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: ۞ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ سَقِيمٌ
verses.en: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

tafsir.text: Then We cast him We flung him out of the belly of the whale onto the barren land onto the face of the earth that is onto the shore on that same day — or three or seven or twenty or forty days later — and he was sick ailing like a newly-born featherless chick.

verses.ar: وَأَنۢبَتْنَا عَلَيْهِ شَجَرَةً مِّن يَقْطِينٍ
verses.en: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.

tafsir.text: And We made a gourd plant to grow above him to provide shade for him with its stem which is not the case usually with gourds as a miracle for him; a mountain goat would come to him in the morning and in the evening and he would drink its milk until he finally regained his strength.

verses.ar: وَأَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ مِا۟ئَةِ أَلْفٍ أَوْ يَزِيدُونَ
verses.en: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

tafsir.text: And We sent him afterwards — as We had done before to a people in Nineveh in the region of Mosul — to a community of a hundred thousand or in fact more — a community of twenty thirty or seventy thousand.

verses.ar: فَـَٔامَنُوا۟ فَمَتَّعْنَـٰهُمْ إِلَىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

tafsir.text: And they believed after they saw with their own eyes the chastisement which they had been promised. So We gave them comfort We kept them alive to enjoy their wealth for a while until their terms of life would be concluded while they took comfort therein.

verses.ar: فَٱسْتَفْتِهِمْ أَلِرَبِّكَ ٱلْبَنَاتُ وَلَهُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.en: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?

tafsir.text: So ask them inquire of the Meccan disbelievers by way of reproach are daughters to be for your Lord after their claim that the angels were God’s daughters while sons are to be for them? so that the best becomes exclusively theirs?

verses.ar: أَمْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِنَـٰثًا وَهُمْ شَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.en: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

tafsir.text: Or did We create the angels females while they were witnesses? to Our act of creation that they might then say such a thing?

verses.ar: أَلَآ إِنَّهُم مِّنْ إِفْكِهِمْ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.en: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

tafsir.text: Lo! it is indeed out of their own mendacity their own lies that they say

verses.ar: وَلَدَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَكَـٰذِبُونَ
verses.en: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

tafsir.text: ‘God has begotten’ when they say that the angels are God’s daughters. And verily they are liars in this respect.

verses.ar: أَصْطَفَى ٱلْبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلْبَنِينَ
verses.en: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

tafsir.text: Has He preferred daughters to sons? read a’stafā ‘has He preferred’ indicating an interrogative hamza which stands in place of the omitted conjunctive hamza.

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

tafsir.text: What is wrong with you? How do you judge? how do you make such a depraved judgement?

verses.ar: أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Then will you not be reminded?

tafsir.text: Will you not then remember? tadhakkarūna the tā’ of tatadhakkarūna has been assimilated with the dhāl that He glory be to Him is exalted above having a child?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Or do you have a clear authority?

tafsir.text: Or do you have a clear warrant? plain definitive proof that God has a child?

verses.ar: فَأْتُوا۟ بِكِتَـٰبِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

tafsir.text: Then produce your scripture the Torah and show Me this as it is mentioned in it if you are being truthful about this statement of yours.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلُوا۟ بَيْنَهُۥ وَبَيْنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ نَسَبًا ۚ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمَتِ ٱلْجِنَّةُ إِنَّهُمْ لَمُحْضَرُونَ
verses.en: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].

tafsir.text: And they namely the idolaters have set up between Him exalted be He and the jinn namely the angels jinna they are so called because they are hidden ijtinān from vision a kinship by saying that they are God’s daughters while the jinn certainly know that they that is those who say this shall indeed be arraigned into the

verses.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,

tafsir.text: Glory be to God affirming that He is exalted above what they attribute to Him in the way of His having a child

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].

tafsir.text: — all except God’s devoted servants namely believers the exceptive clause here is discontinuous in other words that is because they declare that God transcends what such individuals attribute to Him.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّكُمْ وَمَا تَعْبُدُونَ
verses.en: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

tafsir.text: For indeed you and what you worship of idols

verses.ar: مَآ أَنتُمْ عَلَيْهِ بِفَـٰتِنِينَ
verses.en: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

tafsir.text: — you cannot tempt anyone thereto that is to incline to your worshipped idols ‘alayhi ‘thereto’ is semantically connected to His saying bi-fātinīna ‘you cannot tempt’

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ هُوَ صَالِ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.

tafsir.text: except him who will burn in Hell in God’s knowledge exalted be He.

verses.ar: وَمَا مِنَّآ إِلَّا لَهُۥ مَقَامٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.en: [The angels say], "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.

tafsir.text: Gabriel said to the Prophet s And there is not one of us us the company of angels but has a known station in the heavens in which he worships God and which he does not transgress.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلصَّآفُّونَ
verses.en: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

tafsir.text: And indeed it is we who are the rangers of our feet in prayer.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْمُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."

tafsir.text: And indeed it is we who give glory it is we who declare that God transcends what does not befit Him.

verses.ar: وَإِن كَانُوا۟ لَيَقُولُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,

tafsir.text: And indeed in is softened in place of the hardened one they the Meccan disbelievers used to say

verses.ar: لَوْ أَنَّ عِندَنَا ذِكْرًا مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,

tafsir.text: ‘If we had but a reminder a scripture from the ancients that is from among the scriptures of past communities

verses.ar: لَكُنَّا عِبَادَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."

tafsir.text: we would have surely been God’s devoted servants’ devoting worship purely to Him.

verses.ar: فَكَفَرُوا۟ بِهِۦ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says Yet they disbelieved in it in other words in the Book that came to them namely the Qur’ān more glorious than all those other scriptures; but they will come to know the consequences of their disbelief.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ سَبَقَتْ كَلِمَتُنَا لِعِبَادِنَا ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

tafsir.text: And verily Our Word containing the promise of victory has gone beforehand in favour of Our servants the messengers and that Word is I shall assuredly prevail I and My messengers Q. 5821 —

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ لَهُمُ ٱلْمَنصُورُونَ
verses.en: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

tafsir.text: or it is His following saying — assuredly they shall be helped

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ
verses.en: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.

tafsir.text: and assuredly Our hosts namely the believers they will indeed be the victors over the disbelievers by their being given the definitive proofs and assistance against them in this world. And if some of these believers are not victorious over them in this world then assuredly in the Hereafter they will be so.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.

tafsir.text: So leave them in other words shun the Meccan disbelievers for a while until such time as you are commanded to fight them;

verses.ar: وَأَبْصِرْهُمْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

tafsir.text: and watch them when the chastisement is sent down on them; for they will soon see the consequences of their disbelief.

verses.ar: أَفَبِعَذَابِنَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.en: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

tafsir.text: They then said in mockery ‘When will this chastisement be sent down?’ God exalted be He threatens them by saying Do they seek to hasten Our chastisement?

verses.ar: فَإِذَا نَزَلَ بِسَاحَتِهِمْ فَسَآءَ صَبَاحُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ
verses.en: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.

tafsir.text: But when it descends in their courtyard — al-Farrā’ said that the Arabs find it sufficient to refer to a people by referring to ‘their courtyard’ — how awful how terrible a morning will be the morning for those who were warned the overt noun al-mundharīn has replaced the third person pronominalisation in sāhatihim.

verses.ar: وَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: And leave them for a time.

tafsir.text: So leave them for a while

verses.ar: وَأَبْصِرْ فَسَوْفَ يُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And see, for they are going to see.

tafsir.text: and watch; for they will soon see — this statement is repeated in order to emphasise the threat made to them and to reassure the Prophet s.

verses.ar: سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّكَ رَبِّ ٱلْعِزَّةِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
verses.en: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

tafsir.text: Glory be to your Lord the Lord of Might of Triumph exalted is He above what they allege! in the way of His having a child.

verses.ar: وَسَلَـٰمٌ عَلَى ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
verses.en: And peace upon the messengers.

tafsir.text: And peace be to the messengers who convey from God the Message of the Oneness of God and His Laws.

verses.ar: وَٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.

tafsir.text: And praise be to God Lord of the Worlds for granting these messengers victory and destroying the disbelievers.

verses.ar: صٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ذِى ٱلذِّكْرِ
verses.en: Ṣād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...

tafsir.text: Sād God knows best what He means by this letter. By the Qur’ān bearing the Remembrance that is bearing the Pronouncement; or what is meant is that the Qur’ān is a Book of renown the response to this oath has been omitted in other words ‘It is not as the Meccan disbelievers say that there are many gods’.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى عِزَّةٍ وَشِقَاقٍ
verses.en: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.

tafsir.text: Nay but those who disbelieve from among the people of Mecca dwell in conceit in self-glory and in disdain of faith and defiance disagreement with and enmity towards the Prophet s.

verses.ar: كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن قَرْنٍ فَنَادَوا۟ وَّلَاتَ حِينَ مَنَاصٍ
verses.en: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.

tafsir.text: How many — in other words many — a generation a community of past communities We have destroyed before them and they cried out when the chastisement was sent down on them when it was no longer the time for escape that is to say the time was not one for fleeing the suffixed tā’ of wa-lāta is extra;

verses.ar: وَعَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌ مِّنْهُمْ ۖ وَقَالَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا سَـٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
verses.en: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ)] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, "This is a magician and a liar.

tafsir.text: And they marvel that a warner has come to them from among themselves a messenger from among their number to warn them and to threaten them with the punishment of the Fire after resurrection — and this warner is the Prophet s.

verses.ar: أَجَعَلَ ٱلْـَٔالِهَةَ إِلَـٰهًا وَٰحِدًا ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ عُجَابٌ
verses.en: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."

tafsir.text: Has he made the gods One God? — for he had said to them ‘Say there is no god except God’ — in other words they objected how could one god suffice for all of creation? Lo! that is indeed a curious thing’.

verses.ar: وَٱنطَلَقَ ٱلْمَلَأُ مِنْهُمْ أَنِ ٱمْشُوا۟ وَٱصْبِرُوا۟ عَلَىٰٓ ءَالِهَتِكُمْ ۖ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَشَىْءٌ يُرَادُ
verses.en: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], "Continue, and be patient over [the defense of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.

tafsir.text: And the council from among them go about from the place of their assembly at the house of Abū Tālib and the place where they heard the Prophet s say ‘Say there is no god except God’ saying ‘Go! they say to one another go and stand by your gods adhere firmly to worship of them;

verses.ar: مَا سَمِعْنَا بِهَـٰذَا فِى ٱلْمِلَّةِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخْتِلَـٰقٌ
verses.en: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.

tafsir.text: We never heard of this in the latter-day creed namely the creed of Jesus. This is surely nothing but an invention mere lies.

verses.ar: أَءُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّن ذِكْرِى ۖ بَل لَّمَّا يَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِ
verses.en: Has the message been revealed to him out of [all of] us?" Rather, they are in doubt about My message. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.

tafsir.text: Has the Remembrance the Qur’ān been revealed to him Muhammad (s) out of all of us’ when he is neither the elder nor the noblest among us? In other words it could not have been revealed to him read a-unzila pronouncing both hamzas or not pronouncing the second one but in both cases inserting an intervening alif or

verses.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَحْمَةِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْوَهَّابِ
verses.en: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?

tafsir.text: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord’s mercy the Mighty the Victor the Bestower? treasuries such as prophethood and otherwise so that they might give it to whomever they want?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُم مُّلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ۖ فَلْيَرْتَقُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَسْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.

tafsir.text: Or do they possess the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them? If this is what they claim Then let them ascend by the means of ascension that lead to the heaven and bring down some revelation wahy and then assign it exclusively to whomever they wish am in both verses represents the

verses.ar: جُندٌ مَّا هُنَالِكَ مَهْزُومٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
verses.en: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].

tafsir.text: A routed mahzūmun is an adjectival qualification of jundun ‘host’ host is all that they are in other words they are nothing but a despicable host nothing more — in their denial of you — from among the factions mina’l-ahzābi also an adjectival qualification of jundun in other words they are like those hosts of factions

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَعَادٌ وَفِرْعَوْنُ ذُو ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ʿAad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,

tafsir.text: Before them the people of Noah denied the inflection of the verb kadhdabat ‘denied’ that is governed by qawmu ‘people’ is in the feminine person because of the implicit sense and so did those of ‘Ād and Pharaoh he of the stakes — he used to fix four stakes for the person who incurred his wrath and tie to these stakes

verses.ar: وَثَمُودُ وَقَوْمُ لُوطٍ وَأَصْحَـٰبُ لْـَٔيْكَةِ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْأَحْزَابُ
verses.en: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.

tafsir.text: and Thamūd and the people of Lot and the dwellers in the wood a small forest namely the people of Shu‘ayb peace be upon him — those were the factions.

verses.ar: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
verses.en: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.

tafsir.text: Each one of the factions did not but deny the messengers for when they deny one they have in effect denied them all since their call to God is the same one namely the call to affirmation of His Oneness. So My retribution was justified it was necessary.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنظُرُ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ إِلَّا صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً مَّا لَهَا مِن فَوَاقٍ
verses.en: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.

tafsir.text: And these that is the disbelievers of Mecca do not await but a single Cry namely the Blast of the Resurrection that will herald chastisement for them for which there will be no revoking read fawāq or fuwāq.

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account."

tafsir.text: And they said — after the following verse was revealed As for him who is given his book in his right hand … to the end of the verse Q. 6919 — ‘Our Lord hasten on for us the record of our deeds before the Day of Reckoning’ — they said this mockingly.

verses.ar: ٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَا دَاوُۥدَ ذَا ٱلْأَيْدِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.en: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to Allāh].

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says Bear patiently what they say and remember Our servant David the one of fortitude that is to say the one of fortitude in worship he used to fast every other day and keep vigil for half the night sleep for a third and then keep vigil for the last sixth.

verses.ar: إِنَّا سَخَّرْنَا ٱلْجِبَالَ مَعَهُۥ يُسَبِّحْنَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِشْرَاقِ
verses.en: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [Allāh] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.

tafsir.text: Truly We disposed the mountains to glorify God with him with the same glorification at evening at the time of the night prayer and at sunrise at the time of the morning prayer which is when the sun has fully risen with its light extending everywhere.

verses.ar: وَٱلطَّيْرَ مَحْشُورَةً ۖ كُلٌّ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.en: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].

tafsir.text: And We disposed the birds mustered in flocks gathered before him glorifying with him; each of the mountains and birds turning to him reverting to obedience of him by glorifying God with him.

verses.ar: وَشَدَدْنَا مُلْكَهُۥ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.en: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.

tafsir.text: And We strengthened his Kingdom We reinforced it with guards and hosts every night there thirty thousand men would be standing guard at his sanctuary; and gave him wisdom prophethood and sound judgement in all matters and decisive speech the ability to formulate a satisfactory statement for a decision in any endeavour.

verses.ar: ۞ وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ نَبَؤُا۟ ٱلْخَصْمِ إِذْ تَسَوَّرُوا۟ ٱلْمِحْرَابَ
verses.en: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -

tafsir.text: And has there come to you O Muhammad (s) the purpose of the interrogative indicated by hal here is to provoke curiosity and a desire to listen to what will follow the tale of the disputants when they scaled the sanctuary? David’s sanctuary that is his place of prayer for they had been prohibited from entering by the

verses.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَىٰ دَاوُۥدَ فَفَزِعَ مِنْهُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ خَصْمَانِ بَغَىٰ بَعْضُنَا عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَنَا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تُشْطِطْ وَٱهْدِنَآ إِلَىٰ سَوَآءِ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ
verses.en: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, "Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.

tafsir.text: When they entered upon David and he was frightened by them. And they said ‘Do not fear; we are two disputants some say that this means ‘two groups’ in order to agree with the plural person of the verb dakhalū ‘they entered’; others say ‘two individuals’ with the plural person actually denoting these two;

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَآ أَخِى لَهُۥ تِسْعٌ وَتِسْعُونَ نَعْجَةً وَلِىَ نَعْجَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ فَقَالَ أَكْفِلْنِيهَا وَعَزَّنِى فِى ٱلْخِطَابِ
verses.en: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, 'Entrust her to me,' and he overpowered me in speech."

tafsir.text: ‘Behold this brother of mine in other words my fellow co-religionist has ninety-nine ewes — here used to represent the women — while I have a single ewe; yet he said “Entrust it to me” in other words make me in charge of it and he overcame me in speech’ in other words in the argument;

verses.ar: قَالَ لَقَدْ ظَلَمَكَ بِسُؤَالِ نَعْجَتِكَ إِلَىٰ نِعَاجِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ ٱلْخُلَطَآءِ لَيَبْغِى بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَقَلِيلٌ مَّا هُمْ ۗ وَظَنَّ دَاوُۥدُ أَنَّمَا فَتَنَّـٰهُ فَٱسْتَغْفَرَ رَبَّهُۥ وَخَرَّ رَاكِعًا وَأَنَابَ ۩
verses.en: [David] said, "He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they." And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to Allāh].

tafsir.text: He said ‘He has certainly wronged you by asking for your ewe that he may add it to his sheep. And indeed many associates infringe upon the rights of one another except such as believe and perform righteous deeds but few are they!’ mā emphasises the ‘fewness’.

verses.ar: فَغَفَرْنَا لَهُۥ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

tafsir.text: So We forgave him that and indeed he has a station of nearness with Us that is even more good things in this world and a fair return in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: يَـٰدَاوُۥدُ إِنَّا جَعَلْنَـٰكَ خَلِيفَةً فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱحْكُم بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا تَتَّبِعِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ فَيُضِلَّكَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَضِلُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌۢ بِمَا نَسُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: [We said], "O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of Allāh." Indeed, those who go astray from the way of Allāh will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.

tafsir.text: ‘O David! We have indeed made you a vicegerent on the earth managing the affairs of people; so judge justly between people and do not follow desire that is the desires of the soul that it then lead you astray from the way of God that is to say from the proofs that indicate the truth of His Oneness.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا بَـٰطِلًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ظَنُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them aimlessly. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.

tafsir.text: And We did not create the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in vain frivolously. That namely the creation of what has been mentioned as being for no particular purpose is the supposition of those who disbelieve from among the people of Mecca.

verses.ar: أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ نَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ كَٱلْفُجَّارِ
verses.en: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear Allāh like the wicked?

tafsir.text: Or shall We treat those who believe and perform righteous deeds like those who cause corruption in the earth; or shall We treat the God-fearing like the profligate? This was revealed when the Meccan disbelievers said to the believers ‘In the Hereafter we will receive the same reward as that which you will receive’ am

verses.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَيْكَ مُبَـٰرَكٌ لِّيَدَّبَّرُوٓا۟ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَلِيَتَذَكَّرَ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muḥammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.

tafsir.text: A Book kitābun the predicate of a missing subject namely hādhā ‘this is’ that We have revealed to you full of blessing that they may contemplate yaddabbarū is actually yatadabbarū but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dāl its signs that they may reflect upon its meanings and become believers and that they may

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لِدَاوُۥدَ سُلَيْمَـٰنَ ۚ نِعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.en: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].

tafsir.text: And We bestowed on David Solomon his son — what an excellent servant! that is Solomon. Truly he was a penitent soul always returning to God with glorification and remembrance at all times.

verses.ar: إِذْ عُرِضَ عَلَيْهِ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ ٱلصَّـٰفِنَـٰتُ ٱلْجِيَادُ
verses.en: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.

tafsir.text: When one evening — which is the period after midday — there were displayed before him the prancing steeds al-sāfināt ‘horses’ is the plural of sāfina which denotes a horse standing on three legs with the fourth supported on the edge of the hoof and derives from the verb safana yasfinu sufūnan;

verses.ar: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verses.en: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]."

tafsir.text: He said ‘Lo! I have loved I have desired the love of worldly good things that is of horses over the remembrance of my Lord’ that is over the afternoon prayer until it that is the sun disappeared behind the night’s veil until it was concealed by that which veils it from sight.

verses.ar: رُدُّوهَا عَلَىَّ ۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسْحًۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلْأَعْنَاقِ
verses.en: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.

tafsir.text: Bring them back to me! that is the horses that were displayed; and they so brought them back. Then he set about slashing with his sword their legs al-sūq is the plural of sāq and necks in other words he slaughtered them and cut off their legs as an offering of atonement to God exalted be He for having been distracted

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ فَتَنَّا سُلَيْمَـٰنَ وَأَلْقَيْنَا عَلَىٰ كُرْسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدًا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
verses.en: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.

tafsir.text: And We certainly tried Solomon We tested him by wresting his kingdom from him because he had married a woman solely out of his desire for her. She used to worship idols in his own home without his knowledge. Now control of his kingdom lay in his ring.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَهَبْ لِى مُلْكًا لَّا يَنۢبَغِى لِأَحَدٍ مِّنۢ بَعْدِىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower."

tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord! Forgive me and grant me a kingdom that shall not belong to anyone after me in other words other than me this use of min ba‘dī to mean ‘other than me’ is similar to Q. 4523 fa-man yahdīh min ba‘di’Llāh ‘who will guide him other than God?’. Truly You are the Bestower’.

verses.ar: فَسَخَّرْنَا لَهُ ٱلرِّيحَ تَجْرِى بِأَمْرِهِۦ رُخَآءً حَيْثُ أَصَابَ
verses.en: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,

tafsir.text: So We disposed for him the wind which blew softly gently at his command wherever he intended.

verses.ar: وَٱلشَّيَـٰطِينَ كُلَّ بَنَّآءٍ وَغَوَّاصٍ
verses.en: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver.

tafsir.text: And the devils also We disposed every builder building marvellous edifices and diver in the sea bringing up pearls

verses.ar: وَءَاخَرِينَ مُقَرَّنِينَ فِى ٱلْأَصْفَادِ
verses.en: And others bound together in irons.

tafsir.text: and others too from among them bounded together in fetters in shackles with their hands tied to their necks.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا عَطَآؤُنَا فَٱمْنُنْ أَوْ أَمْسِكْ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: [We said], "This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account."

tafsir.text: And We said to him ‘This is Our gift. So bestow grant thereof to whomever you wish or withhold from giving without any reckoning’ in other words without your being called to account for any of this.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لَهُۥ عِندَنَا لَزُلْفَىٰ وَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.

tafsir.text: And indeed he has a station of nearness with Us and a fair resort — a similar statement has already appeared in another verse above.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍ وَعَذَابٍ
verses.en: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment."

tafsir.text: And mention also Our servant Job when he called out to his Lord saying ‘Lo! Satan has afflicted me with hardship harm and suffering’ pain he attributes all this to Satan even though all things are from God to show reverence in his call to Him exalted be He.

verses.ar: ٱرْكُضْ بِرِجْلِكَ ۖ هَـٰذَا مُغْتَسَلٌۢ بَارِدٌ وَشَرَابٌ
verses.en: [So he was told], "Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink."

tafsir.text: And it was said to him ‘Stamp your foot on the ground — and he stamped it and a spring of water gushed forth and it was said This is a cool bath cool water for you to wash with and a drink’ for you to drink of.

verses.ar: وَوَهَبْنَا لَهُۥٓ أَهْلَهُۥ وَمِثْلَهُم مَّعَهُمْ رَحْمَةً مِّنَّا وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.

tafsir.text: And We gave him back his family along with others like them that is God brought back to life all the children of his that had died and provided him with as many in addition to them as a mercy a grace from us and a reminder an admonition to people of pith possessors of intellect.

verses.ar: وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَٱضْرِب بِّهِۦ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ ۗ إِنَّا وَجَدْنَـٰهُ صَابِرًا ۚ نِّعْمَ ٱلْعَبْدُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٌ
verses.en: [We said], "And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath." Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to Allāh].

tafsir.text: And We said to him ‘Take in your hand a bunch of twigs or some blades of grass and smite therewith your wife — for he had sworn to smite her a hundred times on one occasion when she was late in coming to him — and do not break your oath’ by not smiting her so he took a hundred rushes and smote her with them once and

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ عِبَـٰدَنَآ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ أُو۟لِى ٱلْأَيْدِى وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.en: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.

tafsir.text: And mention also Our servants Abraham and Isaac and Jacob — men of fortitude vigorous in their worship and insight deep understanding of religion a variant reading for ‘ibādanā ‘Our servants’ has singular ‘abdanā ‘Our servant’ with Ibrāhīma as the explication thereof and what follows as being a supplement to ‘abdanā

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَخْلَصْنَـٰهُم بِخَالِصَةٍ ذِكْرَى ٱلدَّارِ
verses.en: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].

tafsir.text: Assuredly We purified them with an exclusive thought namely the remembrance of the Abode of the Hereafter in other words to always remember it and to work for it a variant reading for bi-khālisatin dhikrā’l-dār has the genitive construction bi-khālisati dhikrā’l-dār making this dhikrā al-dār ‘remembrance of the Abode’

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُمْ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلْمُصْطَفَيْنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.en: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.

tafsir.text: And indeed in Our sight they are of the elect the excellent akhyār is the plural of khayyir.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرْ إِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَٱلْيَسَعَ وَذَا ٱلْكِفْلِ ۖ وَكُلٌّ مِّنَ ٱلْأَخْيَارِ
verses.en: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.

tafsir.text: And mention also Our servants Ishmael and Elisha who was a prophet the lām here in al-Yasa‘ is extra and Dhū’l-Kifl — there is disagreement over whether he was a prophet; it is said that he was so called because he looked after kafala a hundred prophets who had sought refuge with him from being killed.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا ذِكْرٌ ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ لَحُسْنَ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -

tafsir.text: This is a remembrance of them made by the mention of fair praise of them here; and indeed for the God-fearing who comprise them there will truly be a fair return in the Hereafter —

verses.ar: جَنَّـٰتِ عَدْنٍ مُّفَتَّحَةً لَّهُمُ ٱلْأَبْوَٰبُ
verses.en: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.

tafsir.text: Gardens of Eden jannāti ‘Adnin is either a substitution for or an explicative supplement to husna ma’ābin ‘a fair return’ whose gates are flung open for them;

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا يَدْعُونَ فِيهَا بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ وَشَرَابٍ
verses.en: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.

tafsir.text: reclining therein on couches; therein they call for plenteous fruit and drink.

verses.ar: ۞ وَعِندَهُمْ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ أَتْرَابٌ
verses.en: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.

tafsir.text: And with them there will be maidens of restrained glances restricting their eyes to their spouses of a like age of the same age girls who are thirty three years of age atrāb is the plural of tirb.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.en: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.

tafsir.text: ‘This that is mentioned is what you are promised by way of the unseen there is a shift in the address away from the third to the second person for the Day of Reckoning.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَرِزْقُنَا مَا لَهُۥ مِن نَّفَادٍ
verses.en: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.

tafsir.text: This is indeed Our provision which will never be exhausted’ in other words one which will never cease this last sentence mā lahu min nafādin is a circumstantial qualifier referring to rizqunā ‘Our provision’; or it is a second predicate of inna ‘indeed’ meaning that it will be ‘everlasting’.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا ۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّـٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٍ
verses.en: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -

tafsir.text: That which is mentioned will be the reward for the believers is so; but for the insolent this is a new sentence there will surely be an evil place of return —

verses.ar: جَهَنَّمَ يَصْلَوْنَهَا فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.en: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.

tafsir.text: Hell which they will enter — an evil resting place!

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا فَلْيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٌ وَغَسَّاقٌ
verses.en: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.

tafsir.text: This chastisement — inferred as so by what follows — let them then taste it burning hot water and pus read ghasāq or ghassāq the festering matter excreted by the inhabitants of the Fire;

verses.ar: وَءَاخَرُ مِن شَكْلِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجٌ
verses.en: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.

tafsir.text: and other ākhar may be plural or singular kinds of torment resembling it in other words like the boiling water and pus mentioned in pairs of all sorts in other words their chastisement will consist of various kinds.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا فَوْجٌ مُّقْتَحِمٌ مَّعَكُمْ ۖ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ صَالُوا۟ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: [Its inhabitants will say], "This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire."

tafsir.text: And it will be said to them as they enter the Fire with their followers ‘This is a horde about to plunge to enter with you into the Fire violently — at which point those who used to be followed say no welcome is there for them here! in other words they will find no comfort for them here.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ أَنتُمْ لَا مَرْحَبًۢا بِكُمْ ۖ أَنتُمْ قَدَّمْتُمُوهُ لَنَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْقَرَارُ
verses.en: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."

tafsir.text: They the followers say ‘Nay but for you there is no welcome! You prepared this that is disbelief for us. So what an evil abode!’ for us and for you is the Fire.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا مَن قَدَّمَ لَنَا هَـٰذَا فَزِدْهُ عَذَابًا ضِعْفًا فِى ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: They will say, "Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire."

tafsir.text: They also say ‘Our Lord whoever prepared this for us give him double his chastisement that is give him in addition the like of his chastisement for his disbelief in the Fire!’

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ مَا لَنَا لَا نَرَىٰ رِجَالًا كُنَّا نَعُدُّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ
verses.en: And they will say, "Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?

tafsir.text: And they the disbelievers of Mecca say while they are in the Fire ‘What is the matter with us that we do not see here men whom we used to count in the world among the wicked?

verses.ar: أَتَّخَذْنَـٰهُمْ سِخْرِيًّا أَمْ زَاغَتْ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرُ
verses.en: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?"

tafsir.text: Did we treat them mockingly? read sukhriyyan or sikhriyyan did we use to deride them in the life of the world the final yā’ in sikhriyyā is attributive. In other words are they missing? Or have our eyes missed them here?’ so that we have not caught sight of them. Such men were the poor among the Muslims like ‘Ammār b.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ لَحَقٌّ تَخَاصُمُ أَهْلِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarreling of the people of the Fire.

tafsir.text: Assuredly that is true such a scene will necessarily take place which is the wrangling of the inhabitants of the Fire — as shown above.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ مُنذِرٌ ۖ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except Allāh, the One, the Prevailing,

tafsir.text: Say O Muhammad (s) to the disbelievers of Mecca ‘I am only a warner to threaten disbelievers with punishment in the Fire. And there is no god except God the One the All-Compelling of all His creatures;

verses.ar: رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
verses.en: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver."

tafsir.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them the Mighty Whose way always prevails the ever Forgiving’ of His friends.

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ نَبَؤٌا۟ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: Say, "It is great news

tafsir.text: Say to them ‘It is a tremendous tiding

verses.ar: أَنتُمْ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضُونَ
verses.en: From which you turn away.

tafsir.text: from which you are turning away namely the Qur’ān of which I have informed you and in which I have brought you what can only be known by revelation and that is God’s saying

verses.ar: مَا كَانَ لِىَ مِنْ عِلْمٍۭ بِٱلْمَلَإِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰٓ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.en: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].

tafsir.text: I had no knowledge of the High Council that is to say of the angels when they disputed in the matter of Adam when God exalted be He said to them ‘I am appointing on earth a vicegerent’ to the end of the verse Q. 230.

verses.ar: إِن يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَىَّ إِلَّآ أَنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner."

tafsir.text: All that is revealed to me is that I am just a plain warner’ one whose warning is clear.

verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن طِينٍ
verses.en: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, "Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.

tafsir.text: Mention when your Lord said to the angels ‘Indeed I am about to create a human being out of clay and this was Adam.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
verses.en: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."

tafsir.text: So when I have proportioned him completed him and breathed in him when I have caused to flow therein My spirit so that he becomes a living being — the addition of ‘the spirit’ to Adam is an honour for him;

verses.ar: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
verses.en: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

tafsir.text: Thereat the angels prostrated all of them together there are two emphases here kulluhum and ajma‘ūn;

verses.ar: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ ٱسْتَكْبَرَ وَكَانَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.

tafsir.text: except Iblīs the father of the jinn who was among the audience of angels; he was disdainful and he was one of the disbelievers according to God’s knowledge exalted be He.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا مَنَعَكَ أَن تَسْجُدَ لِمَا خَلَقْتُ بِيَدَىَّ ۖ أَسْتَكْبَرْتَ أَمْ كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلْعَالِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?"

tafsir.text: He said ‘O Iblīs! What prevents you from prostrating before that which I have created with My own hands? in other words whose creation I Myself have undertaken. This in itself is an honour for Adam as God has Himself undertaken the unmediated creation of all creatures.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَنَا۠ خَيْرٌ مِّنْهُ ۖ خَلَقْتَنِى مِن نَّارٍ وَخَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن طِينٍ
verses.en: He said, "I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay."

tafsir.text: He said ‘I am better than him. You created me from fire and You created him from clay’.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.

tafsir.text: He said ‘Then begone hence that is from Paradise — or it is said begone from the heavens — for you are indeed accursed outcast.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ لَعْنَتِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."

tafsir.text: And indeed My curse shall be on you until the Day of Judgement’ the Day of Requital.

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord then reprieve me until the day when they mankind will be raised’.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

tafsir.text: He said ‘Then you will indeed be among the reprieved

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
verses.en: Until the Day of the time well-known."

tafsir.text: until the day of the known time’ the time of the First Blast.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [Iblees] said, "By Your might, I will surely mislead them all.

tafsir.text: He said ‘Now by Your might I shall surely pervert them all

verses.ar: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
verses.en: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

tafsir.text: except those servants of Yours among them who will be saved’ namely the believers.

verses.ar: قَالَ فَٱلْحَقُّ وَٱلْحَقَّ أَقُولُ
verses.en: [Allāh] said, "The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -

tafsir.text: He said ‘So the truth is — and the truth I always speak read both words in the accusative fa’l-haqqa wa’l-haqqa; or with the first in the nominative and the second in the accusative because of the verb aqūlu ‘I speak’ that follows.

verses.ar: لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنكَ وَمِمَّن تَبِعَكَ مِنْهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.en: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together."

tafsir.text: I shall assuredly fill Hell with you by way of filling it with your progeny and with whoever of them follows you that is of mankind all together’.

verses.ar: قُلْ مَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.

tafsir.text: Say ‘I do not ask of you in return for this for delivering the Message to you any reward any fee; nor am I an impostor so as to make up the Qur’ān myself.

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: It is but a reminder to the worlds.

tafsir.text: It is only in other words the Qur’ān is only a reminder an admonition for all worlds those of humans jinn and other rational beings but excluding the angels.

verses.ar: وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعْدَ حِينٍۭ
verses.en: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."

tafsir.text: And you will assuredly come to know O disbelievers of Mecca its tiding the news of its truth in due time’ that is to say on the Day of Resurrection ‘ilm ‘knowing’ is here being used in the sense of ‘urf ‘experience’;

verses.ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.en: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

tafsir.text: The revelation of the Book the Qur’ān tanzīlu’l-kitābi the subject is from God mina’Llāhi its predicate the Mighty in His kingdom the Wise in His handiwork.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَٱعْبُدِ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muḥammad], in truth. So worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

tafsir.text: Indeed We have revealed to you O Muhammad (s) the Book with the truth bi’l-haqqi is semantically connected to anzalnā ‘We have revealed’; so worship God devoting your religion purely to Him pure of any idolatry in other words affirming His Oneness.

verses.ar: أَلَا لِلَّهِ ٱلدِّينُ ٱلْخَالِصُ ۚ وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ مَا نَعْبُدُهُمْ إِلَّا لِيُقَرِّبُونَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ زُلْفَىٰٓ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ فِى مَا هُمْ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ كَـٰذِبٌ كَفَّارٌ
verses.en: Unquestionably, for Allāh is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], "We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to Allāh in position." Indeed, Allāh will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, Allāh does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.

tafsir.text: Surely to God belongs pure religion none other than Him being deserving of it. And those who take besides Him the idols as patrons and they are the disbelievers of Mecca — they say ‘We only worship them so that they may bring us near to God’ zulfā a verbal noun with the sense of taqrīban ‘for the sake of nearness’.

verses.ar: لَّوْ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ أَن يَتَّخِذَ وَلَدًا لَّٱصْطَفَىٰ مِمَّا يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَهُۥ ۖ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْوَٰحِدُ ٱلْقَهَّارُ
verses.en: If Allāh had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.

tafsir.text: Had God wanted to take a son — as they allege that He has ‘The Compassionate One has taken to Himself a son’ Q. 1988 He could have chosen from what He has created whatever He willed and taken it as a child instead of the angels whom they claim to be God’s daughters or their claim that ‘Ezra is the son of God’ or that

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ يُكَوِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ عَلَى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُكَوِّرُ ٱلنَّهَارَ عَلَى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَسَخَّرَ ٱلشَّمْسَ وَٱلْقَمَرَ ۖ كُلٌّ يَجْرِى لِأَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۗ أَلَا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفَّـٰرُ
verses.en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Unquestionably, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.

tafsir.text: He created the heavens and the earth with the truth bi’l-haqqi is semantically connected to khalaqa ‘He created’. He turns the night into day so that it grows and turns the day into night so that it grows and He has disposed the sun and the moon each running in its course for an appointed term until the Day of

verses.ar: خَلَقَكُم مِّن نَّفْسٍ وَٰحِدَةٍ ثُمَّ جَعَلَ مِنْهَا زَوْجَهَا وَأَنزَلَ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ ثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَزْوَٰجٍ ۚ يَخْلُقُكُمْ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ خَلْقًا مِّنۢ بَعْدِ خَلْقٍ فِى ظُلُمَـٰتٍ ثَلَـٰثٍ ۚ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ لَهُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ۖ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصْرَفُونَ
verses.en: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is Allāh, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?

tafsir.text: He created you from a single soul namely Adam then made from it its mate Eve; and He sent down for you of the cattle of camels cows small cattle sheep and goats eight kinds of each kind a male and a female — as He makes clear in sūrat al-An‘ām Q. 6143f..

verses.ar: إِن تَكْفُرُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنكُمْ ۖ وَلَا يَرْضَىٰ لِعِبَادِهِ ٱلْكُفْرَ ۖ وَإِن تَشْكُرُوا۟ يَرْضَهُ لَكُمْ ۗ وَلَا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ ۗ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُم مَّرْجِعُكُمْ فَيُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: If you disbelieve - indeed, Allāh is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

tafsir.text: If you are ungrateful indeed God is Independent of you though He does not approve of ingratitude for His servants even if He should will it to manifest itself in some of them.

verses.ar: ۞ وَإِذَا مَسَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ ضُرٌّ دَعَا رَبَّهُۥ مُنِيبًا إِلَيْهِ ثُمَّ إِذَا خَوَّلَهُۥ نِعْمَةً مِّنْهُ نَسِىَ مَا كَانَ يَدْعُوٓا۟ إِلَيْهِ مِن قَبْلُ وَجَعَلَ لِلَّهِ أَندَادًا لِّيُضِلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ ۚ قُلْ تَمَتَّعْ بِكُفْرِكَ قَلِيلًا ۖ إِنَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.en: And when adversity touches man, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favor from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to Allāh equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, "Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire."

tafsir.text: And when distress befalls a person that is the disbeliever he supplicates his Lord he implores turning returning to Him penitently. Then when He bestows on him a grace from Himself he forgets he neglects Him Whom he had supplicated implored before namely God in other words mā functions as min ‘whom’ and sets up equals

verses.ar: أَمَّنْ هُوَ قَـٰنِتٌ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ سَاجِدًا وَقَآئِمًا يَحْذَرُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ وَيَرْجُوا۟ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ هَلْ يَسْتَوِى ٱلَّذِينَ يَعْلَمُونَ وَٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ۗ إِنَّمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.en: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, "Are those who know equal to those who do not know?" Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.

tafsir.text: Or is he who read softened a-man devotes himself in worship observing duties of obedience in the watches of the night during its hours prostrating and standing in prayer apprehensive of the eventuality of the Hereafter in other words fearing its chastisement and hoping for the mercy the Paradise of his Lord … ? like

verses.ar: قُلْ يَـٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةٌ ۗ وَأَرْضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌ ۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّـٰبِرُونَ أَجْرَهُم بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.en: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allāh is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit]."

tafsir.text: Say ‘O servants of Mine who believe! Fear your Lord that is to say fear His chastisement by being obedient to Him. For those who are virtuous in this world through obedience there will be good and that is Paradise and God’s earth is vast so emigrate throughout it away from the company of disbelievers and the sight of

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أُمِرْتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion.

tafsir.text: Say ‘Indeed I have been commanded to worship God devoting my religion purely to Him pure of any idolatry

verses.ar: وَأُمِرْتُ لِأَنْ أَكُونَ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims."

tafsir.text: and I have been commanded to be the first of those who submit’ from this community.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ إِنْ عَصَيْتُ رَبِّى عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: Say, "Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day."

tafsir.text: Say ‘Indeed should I disobey my Lord I fear the chastisement of a tremendous day’.

verses.ar: قُلِ ٱللَّهَ أَعْبُدُ مُخْلِصًا لَّهُۥ دِينِى
verses.en: Say, "Allāh [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,

tafsir.text: Say ‘God alone I worship devoting my religion purely to Him pure of any idolatry.

verses.ar: فَٱعْبُدُوا۟ مَا شِئْتُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ ٱلَّذِينَ خَسِرُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَأَهْلِيهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۗ أَلَا ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْخُسْرَانُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
verses.en: So worship what you will besides Him." Say, "Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Unquestionably, that is the manifest loss."

tafsir.text: So worship whatever you wish besides Him’ other than Him — herein is a threat for them as well as a declaration of the fact that they do not worship God exalted be He.

verses.ar: لَهُم مِّن فَوْقِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ وَمِن تَحْتِهِمْ ظُلَلٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يُخَوِّفُ ٱللَّهُ بِهِۦ عِبَادَهُۥ ۚ يَـٰعِبَادِ فَٱتَّقُونِ
verses.en: They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that Allāh threatens [i.e., warns] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.

tafsir.text: Above them they will have canopies layers of fire and beneath them they will have similar canopies of fire. That is what God frightens His servants with that is the believing ones that they may have fear of Him — this sense of the verse is suggested by what follows “So O servants of Mine fear Me!”’

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ٱجْتَنَبُوا۟ ٱلطَّـٰغُوتَ أَن يَعْبُدُوهَا وَأَنَابُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ لَهُمُ ٱلْبُشْرَىٰ ۚ فَبَشِّرْ عِبَادِ
verses.en: But those who have avoided ṭāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to Allāh - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants

tafsir.text: As for those who steer clear of the worship of false deities graven images and turn penitently apply themselves to God there are good tidings for them of Paradise. So give such good tidings to My servants
