tafsir.text: It will also be said to the God-fearing ‘Enter it in peace! that is to say secure from every fear or it means enter it with a greeting that is to say greet yourselves and enter. That day in which this entry takes place is the day of immortality’ of everlastingness in Paradise.

verses.ar: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌ
verses.en: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

tafsir.text: Therein they will have whatever they wish; and with Us there is yet more as extra for what they did and for what they will request.

verses.ar: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
verses.en: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

tafsir.text: And how many a generation We destroyed before them that is before the disbelievers of Quraysh We destroyed many generations of disbelievers who were mightier than these in prowess and who then searched throughout the land wondering is there any escape? for them and others from death but they found none.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

tafsir.text: Assuredly there is in that which is mentioned a reminder an admonition for him who has a heart a mind or gives ear or listens to admonitions in full witness present in heart and mind.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍ
verses.en: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

tafsir.text: And verily We created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six days the first of which was Sunday and the last of which was Friday and no weariness no fatigue touched Us this was revealed as a refutation of the Jews’ claim that God rested on the Saturday and lay down upon the Throne.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ
verses.en: So be patient, [O Muḥammad], over what they say and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

tafsir.text: So endure patiently addressing the Prophet s what they the Jews and others say in the way of anthropomorphic comparisons and denials and glorify with praise of your Lord perform prayers with praise of Him before the rising of the sun in other words perform the morning prayer and before the sunset that is to say

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَـٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
verses.en: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].

tafsir.text: and glorify Him at some part of the night that is to say perform the two evening prayers and after prostrations read adbār as the plural of dubur or idbār as the verbal noun from adbara ‘to pass’ in other words perform supererogatory prayers as prescribed by the Sunna after the obligatory ones;

verses.ar: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍ قَرِيبٍ
verses.en: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -

tafsir.text: And listen — O addressee to My words — on the day when the caller namely the archangel Isrāfīl calls out from a place that is near to the heaven this is the Rock of the Holy House of Jerusalem the place on earth that is the nearest to the heaven.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ
verses.en: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

tafsir.text: On the day yawma substitutes for the previous yawma when they that is all creatures hear the Call of truth of the Resurrection — this will be Isrāfīl’s second blast and it may precede or follow his initial call — that day of the call and the hearing is the day of coming forth from the graves yawma ‘on the day is in

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

tafsir.text: Indeed it is We Who give life and bring death and to Us is the journey’s end.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌ
verses.en: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

tafsir.text: On the day when yawma substitutes for the previous yawma with the intervening statement being a parenthetical the earth is split asunder read tashaqqaqu or tashshaqqaqu where the original second tā’ of tatashaqqaqu has been assimilated with it the shīn from them they will come hastening forth sirā‘an sirā‘ the plural

verses.ar: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
verses.en: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.

tafsir.text: We know best what they the disbelievers of the Quraysh say and you are not to be a coercer of them so as to coerce them to embrace faith — but this was revealed before the command to struggle against these disbelievers. So admonish by the Qur’ān those who fear My threat namely believers.

verses.ar: وَٱلذَّٰرِيَـٰتِ ذَرْوًا
verses.en: By the [winds] scattering [dust], dispersing [it]

tafsir.text: By the scatterers the winds that scatter dust and other things that scatter dharwan is a verbal noun; one may also say tadhrīhi dharyan ‘it blows it sweeping it away’;

verses.ar: فَٱلْحَـٰمِلَـٰتِ وِقْرًا
verses.en: And the [clouds] carrying a load [of water]

tafsir.text: and those that bear the clouds that bear moisture as a burden wiqran is the direct object of al-hāmilat ‘those that bear’;

verses.ar: فَٱلْجَـٰرِيَـٰتِ يُسْرًا
verses.en: And the ships sailing with ease

tafsir.text: and those that run the ships that run upon the surface of the water with ease yusran is a verbal noun functioning as a circumstantial qualifier that is to say muyassaratan;

verses.ar: فَٱلْمُقَسِّمَـٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.en: And the [angels] apportioning [each] matter,

tafsir.text: and those that apportion by command the angels who distribute provisions and the rains and other things across the lands and to all servants

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَصَادِقٌ
verses.en: Indeed, what you are promised is true.

tafsir.text: assuredly what you are promised mā ‘what’ relates to the verbal action in other words the promise given to them of resurrection and other matters is true is indeed a true promise

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.en: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.

tafsir.text: and assuredly judgement requital after the reckoning will take place! without doubt.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْحُبُكِ
verses.en: By the heaven containing pathways,

tafsir.text: And by the heaven with all its tracks hubuk is the plural of habīka similar in pattern and meaning to turuq tarīqa ‘paths’ that is to say by the heaven that is created with tracks similar to tracks made in the sand

verses.ar: إِنَّكُمْ لَفِى قَوْلٍ مُّخْتَلِفٍ
verses.en: Indeed, you are in differing speech.

tafsir.text: indeed you O people of Mecca with regard to the matter of the Prophet s and the Qur’ān are of differing opinions some say of the Prophet that he is ‘a poet’ ‘a sorcerer’ or ‘a soothsayer’ and of the Qur’ān that it is ‘poetry’ ‘sorcery’ or ‘soothsaying’.

verses.ar: يُؤْفَكُ عَنْهُ مَنْ أُفِكَ
verses.en: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.

tafsir.text: He is turned away therefrom from the Prophet s and the Qur’ān that is turned away from believing therein who has deviated who has been turned away from guidance in God’s exalted be He.

verses.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْخَرَّٰصُونَ
verses.en: Destroyed are the misinformers

tafsir.text: Perish the conjecturers accursed be the liars those of differing opinions

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى غَمْرَةٍ سَاهُونَ
verses.en: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.

tafsir.text: who are in a stupor in ignorance that has stupefied them heedless oblivious of the matter of the Hereafter.

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"

tafsir.text: They ask the Prophet asking him derisively ‘When is the Day of Judgement?’ in other words ‘when will it come?’ and the response given to them is that it will come

verses.ar: يَوْمَ هُمْ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ يُفْتَنُونَ
verses.en: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire.

tafsir.text: on the day when they will be tormented in the Fire that is to say chastised in it and it will be said to them during the chastisement

verses.ar: ذُوقُوا۟ فِتْنَتَكُمْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَسْتَعْجِلُونَ
verses.en: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."

tafsir.text: ‘Taste this torment of yours this chastisement of yours. This chastisement is what you sought to hasten on!’ in the world in derision.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,

tafsir.text: Truly the God-fearing will be amid gardens orchards and springs flowing therein

verses.ar: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.

tafsir.text: receiving ākhidhīna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the person of the predicate of inna ‘truly’ what their Lord has given them of reward for indeed formerly before their entering Paradise they had been virtuous in the world.

verses.ar: كَانُوا۟ قَلِيلًا مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ مَا يَهْجَعُونَ
verses.en: They used to sleep but little of the night,

tafsir.text: Little of the night did they use to sleep mā is extra; yahja‘ūna is the predicate of kānū; qalīlan ‘little’ is an adverb in other words they used to sleep for a small portion of the night and perform prayers during most of it

verses.ar: وَبِٱلْأَسْحَارِ هُمْ يَسْتَغْفِرُونَ
verses.en: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,

tafsir.text: and at dawns they used to seek forgiveness they used say ‘Our Lord! Forgive us’

verses.ar: وَفِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.en: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.

tafsir.text: and there was a share in their wealth assigned for the beggar and the deprived the latter being the one who does not beg because of his self-restraint.

verses.ar: وَفِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ءَايَـٰتٌ لِّلْمُوقِنِينَ
verses.en: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]

tafsir.text: And in the earth in the way of mountains seas trees fruits plants and other things there are signs indications of God’s power glory be to Him exalted be He and of His Oneness for those who know with certainty

verses.ar: وَفِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۚ أَفَلَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?

tafsir.text: and in your souls there are also signs from the beginning of your creation to its end and in the marvelous aspects of your creation. Will you not then perceive? all that and thus infer therefrom the Creator of it and His power.

verses.ar: وَفِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقُكُمْ وَمَا تُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.

tafsir.text: And in the heaven is your provision that is the rain from which results the vegetation that is your provision and there is also what you are promised in the way of the ultimate return reward and punishment in other words all of this is foreordained in the heaven.

verses.ar: فَوَرَبِّ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ إِنَّهُۥ لَحَقٌّ مِّثْلَ مَآ أَنَّكُمْ تَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.

tafsir.text: So by the Lord of the heaven and the earth it that which you are promised is as assuredly true as the fact that you have power of speech read mithlu in the nominative as an adjective with the mā being extra;

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلْمُكْرَمِينَ
verses.en: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -

tafsir.text: Has the story reached you — addressing the Prophet s — of Abraham’s honoured guests? — these were said to be either twelve ten or three angels one of whom was Gabriel.

verses.ar: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا ۖ قَالَ سَلَـٰمٌ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
verses.en: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown."

tafsir.text: When idh is an adverbial qualifier of hadīthu dayfi ‘the story of the guests’ they entered upon him and said ‘Peace!’ — in other words they said these very words.

verses.ar: فَرَاغَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ فَجَآءَ بِعِجْلٍ سَمِينٍ
verses.en: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf.

tafsir.text: Then he went aside to his family secretly and brought a fat calf — in sūrat Hūd it is said a roasted calf Q. 1169 —

verses.ar: فَقَرَّبَهُۥٓ إِلَيْهِمْ قَالَ أَلَا تَأْكُلُونَ
verses.en: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"

tafsir.text: and he placed it near them saying ‘Will you not eat?’ he invited them to eat but they did not respond.

verses.ar: فَأَوْجَسَ مِنْهُمْ خِيفَةً ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَا تَخَفْ ۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
verses.en: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.

tafsir.text: Then he conceived he kept secret in himself a fear of them. They said ‘Do not be afraid!’ we are messengers from your Lord. And they gave him good tidings of the birth of a knowledgeable boy one endowed with much knowledge and this was Isaac as mentioned in sūrat Hūd Q. 1171.

verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُهُۥ فِى صَرَّةٍ فَصَكَّتْ وَجْهَهَا وَقَالَتْ عَجُوزٌ عَقِيمٌ
verses.en: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"

tafsir.text: Then his wife Sarah came forward clamouring shouting fī sarratin is a circumstantial qualifier that is to say she came shouting and smote slapped her face and said ‘A barren old woman!’ who has never given birth to a child aged ninety-nine with Abraham being one hundred years old;

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكِ قَالَ رَبُّكِ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْحَكِيمُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.en: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."

tafsir.text: They said ‘So just like what we have said with regard to the good tiding has your Lord said. Indeed He is the Wise in His actions the Knower’ of His creatures.

verses.ar: ۞ قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
verses.en: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

tafsir.text: He said ‘So what is your business O you who have been sent by God?’

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals

tafsir.text: They said ‘Lo! we have been sent to a guilty folk disbelievers — these were the people of Lot —

verses.ar: لِنُرْسِلَ عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن طِينٍ
verses.en: To send down upon them stones of clay,

tafsir.text: that we may unleash upon them stones of clay baked in fire

verses.ar: مُّسَوَّمَةً عِندَ رَبِّكَ لِلْمُسْرِفِينَ
verses.en: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."

tafsir.text: marked bearing the name of the person at whom it will be hurled by your Lord ‘inda rabbika is an adverbial qualifier of musawwamatan ‘marked’ for the destruction of the prodigal’ for coming unto males in addition to their disbelief.

verses.ar: فَأَخْرَجْنَا مَن كَانَ فِيهَا مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the believers.

tafsir.text: So We brought forth those in them that is in the towns of the people of Lot who were believers in order to destroy the disbelievers;

verses.ar: فَمَا وَجَدْنَا فِيهَا غَيْرَ بَيْتٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ
verses.en: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.

tafsir.text: but We did not find therein other than one house of those who had submitted to God these were Lot and his two daughters. They have been described here with the terms ‘belief’ and ‘submission’ because they had affirmed faith in their hearts and used their limbs to perform acts of obedience.

verses.ar: وَتَرَكْنَا فِيهَآ ءَايَةً لِّلَّذِينَ يَخَافُونَ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ
verses.en: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.

tafsir.text: And We left therein after destroying the disbelievers a sign an indication of their destruction for those who fear the painful chastisement so that they may not do what these sinners did.

verses.ar: وَفِى مُوسَىٰٓ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَـٰهُ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.

tafsir.text: And a sign too in Moses wa-fī Mūsā is a supplement to fīhā ‘therein’ that is to say We also left a sign in the story of Moses when We sent him to Pharaoh vested with a clear warrant with a manifest proof;

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّىٰ بِرُكْنِهِۦ وَقَالَ سَـٰحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: But he turned away with his supporters and said, "A magician or a madman."

tafsir.text: but he turned away he rejected belief to his supports bi-ruknihi his hosts so called because to him they are like a support rukn saying to Moses that he Moses was ‘A sorcerer or a madman!’

verses.ar: فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذْنَـٰهُمْ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٌ
verses.en: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.

tafsir.text: So We seized him and his hosts and cast flung them into the waters the sea and so they drowned for he that is Pharaoh was blameworthy guilty of what is blameworthy such as denying the messengers and claiming divinity.

verses.ar: وَفِى عَادٍ إِذْ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلرِّيحَ ٱلْعَقِيمَ
verses.en: And in ʿAad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.

tafsir.text: And also in the destruction of ‘Ād was a sign when We unleashed against them a barren wind a wind which brings nothing of good for it does not bear any rain and does not pollinate any trees; this wind was the west wind al-dabūr.

verses.ar: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَىْءٍ أَتَتْ عَلَيْهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتْهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
verses.en: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.

tafsir.text: It did not leave anything any soul or property that it came upon without making it like decayed bones like something that is withered and in scattered pieces.

verses.ar: وَفِى ثَمُودَ إِذْ قِيلَ لَهُمْ تَمَتَّعُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ حِينٍ
verses.en: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."

tafsir.text: And also in the destruction of Thamūd was a sign when it was said to them after the hamstringing of the she-camel ‘Enjoy yourselves for a while!’ until the end of your terms of life — as stated in the other verse ‘Enjoy yourselves in your dwellings for three days’ Q.1165.

verses.ar: فَعَتَوْا۟ عَنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّـٰعِقَةُ وَهُمْ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.

tafsir.text: Then they defied they scorned the command of their Lord refraining from implementing it; so the thunderbolt that is the destructive cry seized them after the three days had passed as they were looking around in other words it seized them in the daytime.

verses.ar: فَمَا ٱسْتَطَـٰعُوا۟ مِن قِيَامٍ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ مُنتَصِرِينَ
verses.en: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.

tafsir.text: So they were unable to rise up they could not get up upon the sending down of the chastisement nor were they victors over the One Who destroyed them.

verses.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَوْمًا فَـٰسِقِينَ
verses.en: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.

tafsir.text: And the people of Noah read wa qawmi Nūhin as a supplement to Thamūda in other words ‘in the destruction of these two peoples by what destructive power exists in the heavens and the earth there is also a sign’;

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بَنَيْنَـٰهَا بِأَيْي۟دٍ وَإِنَّا لَمُوسِعُونَ
verses.en: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.

tafsir.text: And the heaven We built it with might and indeed We are powerful one says āda’l-rajulu or ya’īdu to mean ‘he is strong’; and awsa‘a’l-rajulu to mean ‘he has become capable dhū sa‘a and strong’.

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ فَرَشْنَـٰهَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْمَـٰهِدُونَ
verses.en: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.

tafsir.text: And the earth We spread it out We made it level what excellent Spreaders then! We are.

verses.ar: وَمِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَا زَوْجَيْنِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.

tafsir.text: And of all things wa-min kulli shay’in is semantically connected to His following words khalaqnā We created pairs two kinds such as male and female heaven and earth sun and moon plain and mountain summer and winter sweet and bitter light and darkness that perhaps you might remember tadhakkarūna one of the two original

verses.ar: فَفِرُّوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: So flee to Allāh. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

tafsir.text: So flee unto God that is to say away from His punishment toward His reward by being obedient to Him and not disobeying Him. Truly I am a clear warner to you from Him.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَجْعَلُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۖ إِنِّى لَكُم مِّنْهُ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: And do not make [as equal] with Allāh another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.

tafsir.text: And do not set up another god alongside God. Truly I am a clear warner to you from Him before fa-firrū ‘so flee’ one may read an implicit preceding qul lahum ‘Say to them’.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُوا۟ سَاحِرٌ أَوْ مَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."

tafsir.text: Thus there did not come to those who were before them any messenger but they said that he was ‘A sorcerer or a madman!’ in other words their denial of you by saying that you are a sorcerer or a madman was like the denial of communities before them of their messengers by saying that same thing.

verses.ar: أَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِهِۦ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.en: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.

tafsir.text: Have they all enjoined this upon one another? an interrogative intended as a denial. Nay but they are an insolent folk a folk whose own proclivity to insolence has made them all say the same thing.

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِمَلُومٍ
verses.en: So leave them, [O Muḥammad], for you are not to be blamed.

tafsir.text: So shun them for you will not be reproached because you have conveyed the Message to them.

verses.ar: وَذَكِّرْ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.

tafsir.text: And remind admonish by the Qur’ān for reminding truly benefits believers these being those whom God knows that they will believe.

verses.ar: وَمَا خَلَقْتُ ٱلْجِنَّ وَٱلْإِنسَ إِلَّا لِيَعْبُدُونِ
verses.en: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.

tafsir.text: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except that they may worship Me the fact that disbelievers do not worship God does not contradict this statement since a purpose does not have to be realised in an act for it to be valid as when you may say ‘I sharpened this pencil in order to write with it’ even though you

verses.ar: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنْهُم مِّن رِّزْقٍ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطْعِمُونِ
verses.en: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.

tafsir.text: I do not desire from them any provision either for Myself for themselves or for others nor do I desire that they should feed Me or feed themselves or others.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلرَّزَّاقُ ذُو ٱلْقُوَّةِ ٱلْمَتِينُ
verses.en: Indeed, it is Allāh who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.

tafsir.text: Indeed it is God Who is the Provider the Lord of Strength the Firm the Stern.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ ذَنُوبًا مِّثْلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصْحَـٰبِهِمْ فَلَا يَسْتَعْجِلُونِ
verses.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not impatiently urge Me.

tafsir.text: And for those who have wronged their souls through disbelief from among the people of Mecca and others there will assuredly be a lot a share of chastisement like the lot the share of their counterparts who perished before them.

verses.ar: فَوَيْلٌ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ مِن يَوْمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.

tafsir.text: For woe a terrible chastisement will come to those who disbelieve from upon that day of theirs which they are promised that is the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: وَٱلطُّورِ
verses.en: By the mount

tafsir.text: By the Mount that is the name of the mountain on which God spoke to Moses

verses.ar: وَكِتَـٰبٍ مَّسْطُورٍ
verses.en: And [by] a Book inscribed

tafsir.text: and an inscribed Book

verses.ar: فِى رَقٍّ مَّنشُورٍ
verses.en: In parchment spread open

tafsir.text: on an unrolled parchment that is the Torah or the Qur’ān.

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَيْتِ ٱلْمَعْمُورِ
verses.en: And [by] the frequented House

tafsir.text: By the greatly frequented House — which is located in the third or the sixth or the seventh heaven directly above the Ka‘ba; it is visited every day by seventy thousand angels circumambulating it and performing prayers around it and never returning to it;

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّقْفِ ٱلْمَرْفُوعِ
verses.en: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high

tafsir.text: and the raised roof that is to say the heaven

verses.ar: وَٱلْبَحْرِ ٱلْمَسْجُورِ
verses.en: And [by] the sea set on fire,

tafsir.text: and the swarming sea that is to say the one that is filled

verses.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.en: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.

tafsir.text: lo! your Lord’s chastisement will assuredly take place it will assuredly come down on those who deserve it;

verses.ar: مَّا لَهُۥ مِن دَافِعٍ
verses.en: Of it there is no preventer.

tafsir.text: there is none that can avert it from such a deserving one.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَمُورُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ مَوْرًا
verses.en: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion

tafsir.text: On the day yawma is operated by la-wāqi‘un ‘will assuredly take place’ when the heaven will heave with a great heaving when it will move and spin

verses.ar: وَتَسِيرُ ٱلْجِبَالُ سَيْرًا
verses.en: And the mountains will pass on, departing -

tafsir.text: and the mountains move with a great motion becoming scattered dust this is the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: فَوَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,

tafsir.text: Woe then terrible chastisement will come on that day to the deniers of the messengers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ فِى خَوْضٍ يَلْعَبُونَ
verses.en: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.

tafsir.text: those who play around in vain talk in falsehood that is to say those who are busily engaged with their disbelief;

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُدَعُّونَ إِلَىٰ نَارِ جَهَنَّمَ دَعًّا
verses.en: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],

tafsir.text: the day when they will be thrust with a violent thrust into Hell when they will be pushed violently this last clause yawma yuda‘‘ūna ilā nāri jahannama da‘‘an is a substitution for yawma tamūru ‘the day when the heaven will heave’ and it will be said to them in reproach

verses.ar: هَـٰذِهِ ٱلنَّارُ ٱلَّتِى كُنتُم بِهَا تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: "This is the Fire which you used to deny.

tafsir.text: ‘This is the Fire which you used to deny!

verses.ar: أَفَسِحْرٌ هَـٰذَآ أَمْ أَنتُمْ لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: Then is this magic, or do you not see?

tafsir.text: Is this then sorcery this chastisement that you see — as you were wont to say about the revelation that it was sorcery — or is it that you do not see?

verses.ar: ٱصْلَوْهَا فَٱصْبِرُوٓا۟ أَوْ لَا تَصْبِرُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ إِنَّمَا تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."

tafsir.text: Burn in it! And whether you endure it or do not endure your endurance and your anguish will be the same for you because your endurance will be of no use to you. You are only being requited for what you used to do’ that is to say only the requital for it.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,

tafsir.text: Truly the God-fearing will be amid gardens and bliss

verses.ar: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.

tafsir.text: rejoicing delighting in what bi-mā relates to the verbal action their Lord has given them and that their Lord has shielded them from the chastisement of Hell-fire wa-waqāhum rabbuhum ‘adhāba’l-jahīmi is a supplement to ātāhum ‘what He has given them’ in other words rejoicing in their having been given this reward and

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

tafsir.text: And it will said to them ‘Eat and drink in full enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier that is to say muhanna’īna as a reward for what bi-mā the bi- is causative you used to do’.

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّصْفُوفَةٍ ۖ وَزَوَّجْنَـٰهُم بِحُورٍ عِينٍ
verses.en: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.

tafsir.text: They will be reclining muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the concealed subject of God’s words fī jannātin ‘amid gardens’ on ranged couches arranged one next to the other and We will wed them zawwajnāhum is a supplement to jannātin ‘gardens’ meaning ‘We will couple them’ to beautiful houris of wide

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعَتْهُمْ ذُرِّيَّتُهُم بِإِيمَـٰنٍ أَلْحَقْنَا بِهِمْ ذُرِّيَّتَهُمْ وَمَآ أَلَتْنَـٰهُم مِّنْ عَمَلِهِم مِّن شَىْءٍ ۚ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَ رَهِينٌ
verses.en: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.

tafsir.text: And those who believed wa’lladhīna āmanū the subject and whom We made to be followed wa-atba‘nāhum a variant reading has wa’ttaba‘athum ‘and there followed them’ as a supplement to āmanū ‘who believed’ by their descendants dhurrīyātihim a variant reading for this plural has dhurrīyatuhum young and old in faith on the

verses.ar: وَأَمْدَدْنَـٰهُم بِفَـٰكِهَةٍ وَلَحْمٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.en: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.

tafsir.text: And We will supply them We will enhance for them their provision from time to time with fruits and meat such as they desire even if they do not request it openly.

verses.ar: يَتَنَـٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا لَّا لَغْوٌ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأْثِيمٌ
verses.en: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.

tafsir.text: They will pass from one to another therein in Paradise a cup of wine wherein is neither vain talk which might come about between them as a result of drinking it nor cause for sin thereby that might befall them — in contrast to the case with the wine of this world.

verses.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ غِلْمَانٌ لَّهُمْ كَأَنَّهُمْ لُؤْلُؤٌ مَّكْنُونٌ
verses.en: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.

tafsir.text: And there will circulate from all around them for service youths delicate in demeanour of their own as if in terms of their beauty and immaculateness they were hidden pearls preserved inside shells because when it a pearl is inside it it is better than one that is not.

verses.ar: وَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

tafsir.text: And some among them will turn to one another questioning each other — they ask one another about how they were in the past and what they have now attained in their delight and acknowledgement of the grace of God to them.

verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا قَبْلُ فِىٓ أَهْلِنَا مُشْفِقِينَ
verses.en: They will say, "Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing Allāh].

tafsir.text: They say as an intimation of the reason for this attainment ‘Truly before amid our families in the world we used to be ever anxious afraid of God’s chastisement;

verses.ar: فَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْنَا وَوَقَىٰنَا عَذَابَ ٱلسَّمُومِ
verses.en: So Allāh conferred favor upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.

tafsir.text: but God showed us favour through His forgiveness and shielded us from the piercing chastisement al-samūm the Fire so called because it penetrates the pores al-masāmm; and they say also by way of intimation

verses.ar: إِنَّا كُنَّا مِن قَبْلُ نَدْعُوهُ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلْبَرُّ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
verses.en: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful."

tafsir.text: indeed before that is in the world we used to call on Him worship Him affirming His Oneness. Verily He is read innahu as the beginning of a new independent sentence even if it introduces the reason in terms of its import;

verses.ar: فَذَكِّرْ فَمَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَتِ رَبِّكَ بِكَاهِنٍ وَلَا مَجْنُونٍ
verses.en: So remind, [O Muḥammad], for you are not, by the favor of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.

tafsir.text: So remind persist in reminding the idolaters and do not desist from this even if they say to you that you are a soothsayer or a madman. For by the grace of your Lord by His bestowal of grace on you you are neither soothsayer bi-kāhinin is the predicate of mā nor madman wa-lā majnūnin a supplement to it.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ شَاعِرٌ نَّتَرَبَّصُ بِهِۦ رَيْبَ ٱلْمَنُونِ
verses.en: Or do they say [of you], "A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time"?

tafsir.text: Or am means bal do they say that he is ‘A poet for whom we may await the accidents of fate?’ the vicissitudes of time so that he will just die like other poets.

verses.ar: قُلْ تَرَبَّصُوا۟ فَإِنِّى مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْمُتَرَبِّصِينَ
verses.en: Say, "Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters."

tafsir.text: Say ‘Await! my death. For I too will be with you awaiting’ your death. They were then chastised with death by the sword on the day of Badr.

verses.ar: أَمْ تَأْمُرُهُمْ أَحْلَـٰمُهُم بِهَـٰذَآ ۚ أَمْ هُمْ قَوْمٌ طَاغُونَ
verses.en: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?

tafsir.text: Or do their faculties of understanding prompt them to say this? their saying to him you are either a sorcerer a poet a soothsayer or a madman in other words they do not in reality prompt them to say this. Or am in effect means bal ‘rather’ are they a rebellious lot? because of their obstinacy.

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ تَقَوَّلَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Or do they say, "He has made it up"? Rather, they do not believe.

tafsir.text: Or do they say ‘He has improvised it?’ he has concocted the Qur’ān. He has not concocted it; Rather they do not believe out of arrogance. If they continue to say that he has concocted it

verses.ar: فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِحَدِيثٍ مِّثْلِهِۦٓ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.

tafsir.text: Then let them bring a concocted discourse like it if they are truthful in what they say.

verses.ar: أَمْ خُلِقُوا۟ مِنْ غَيْرِ شَىْءٍ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
verses.en: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?

tafsir.text: Or were they created out of nothing? that is without a Creator. Or are they the creators? of themselves. It makes no sense for a created thing to have no creator nor can a thing that will cease to existent have the power to create.

verses.ar: أَمْ خَلَقُوا۟ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۚ بَل لَّا يُوقِنُونَ
verses.en: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.

tafsir.text: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Nor can any but God the Creator have created them so why do they not worship Him? Nay but they are not certain of Him for otherwise they would have believed in His Prophet.

verses.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمْ خَزَآئِنُ رَبِّكَ أَمْ هُمُ ٱلْمُصَۣيْطِرُونَ
verses.en: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?

tafsir.text: Or do they possess the treasuries of your Lord? in the way of prophethood provision and other matters so that they are able to assign what they will exclusively to whom they will? Or are they the ones in control? or are they the mighty ones who hold sway? the verb from musaytirūna is saytara similar in root form to

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ سُلَّمٌ يَسْتَمِعُونَ فِيهِ ۖ فَلْيَأْتِ مُسْتَمِعُهُم بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].

tafsir.text: Or do they have a ladder a means of ascension into the heaven whereby they eavesdrop? that is at the top of which they listen in on the conversations of the angels so that they are then able to dispute with the Prophet as they claim.

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُ ٱلْبَنَـٰتُ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْبَنُونَ
verses.en: Or has He daughters while you have sons?

tafsir.text: Or does He have daughters as you claim whereas you have sons? Exalted be God above what you claim!

verses.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.en: Or do you, [O Muḥammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

tafsir.text: Or are you asking them for a fee a wage in return for what you have brought them in the way of religion so that they are weighed down with debt? with the liability for this so that they are unable to submit to God.

verses.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

tafsir.text: Or do they have access to the Unseen that is the knowledge of it so that they can write it down? and are hence able to dispute with the Prophet s regarding the Resurrection and the matters relating to the Hereafter as they claim.

verses.ar: أَمْ يُرِيدُونَ كَيْدًا ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْمَكِيدُونَ
verses.en: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.

tafsir.text: Or do they desire to outmanoeuvre? you and have you killed at the Assembly Council. But those who disbelieve they are the outmanoeuvred ones! the vanquished and the ones destroyed. God preserved him from them and then destroyed them at Badr.

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ إِلَـٰهٌ غَيْرُ ٱللَّهِ ۚ سُبْحَـٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشْرِكُونَ
verses.en: Or have they a deity other than Allāh? Exalted is Allāh above whatever they associate with Him.

tafsir.text: Or do they have a god other than God? Glory be to God exalted is He above any partners that they may ascribe! to Him in the way of gods the succession of interrogatives with am ‘or’ are intended to express censure and rebuke.

verses.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ كِسْفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ سَاقِطًا يَقُولُوا۟ سَحَابٌ مَّرْكُومٌ
verses.en: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, "[It is merely] clouds heaped up."

tafsir.text: And if they were to see a fragment a portion of the heaven falling on them — as they say Then make fragments of the heaven fall upon us Q. 26187 as a chastisement for them — they would say this is ‘A heap of clouds!’ piled on top of one another that will bring us water; and so they do not believe.

verses.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى فِيهِ يُصْعَقُونَ
verses.en: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -

tafsir.text: So leave them until they encounter that day of theirs in which they will be thunderstruck in which they will die;

verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا هُمْ يُنصَرُونَ
verses.en: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.

tafsir.text: the day when their guile will avail them nothing yawma lā yughnī is a substitution for yawmahumu ‘that day of theirs’ and they will not be helped they will not be protected from the chastisement in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوا۟ عَذَابًا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ وَلَـٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.

tafsir.text: And assuredly for those who do wrong by their persistence in disbelief there is a chastisement beyond that in this world before their death — thus they were punished with famine and drought for seven years and with being killed on the day of Badr; but most of them do not know that the chastisement will befall them.

verses.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعْيُنِنَا ۖ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
verses.en: And be patient, [O Muḥammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord when you arise

tafsir.text: And submit patiently to the judgement of your Lord that they be reprieved and do not be grieved for surely you fare before Our eyes you are in Our sight We see you and preserve you.

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَإِدْبَـٰرَ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.en: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.

tafsir.text: and glorify Him at night — also in actual utterance — and at the receding of the stars idbāra is a verbal noun that is to say also glorify Him after these have set;

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّجْمِ إِذَا هَوَىٰ
verses.en: By the star when it descends,

tafsir.text: By the Star — the constellation Pleiades al-thurayya — when it sets when it disappears

verses.ar: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمْ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
verses.en: Your companion [i.e., Muḥammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,

tafsir.text: your companion Muhammad (s) may God bless him and grant him peace has neither gone astray from the path of guidance nor has he erred nor has he engaged in error al-ghayy is ignorance that results from a false belief;

verses.ar: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰٓ
verses.en: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.

tafsir.text: nor does he in regard to what he brings you speak out of his own desire out of the whims of his soul.

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا وَحْىٌ يُوحَىٰ
verses.en: It is not but a revelation revealed,

tafsir.text: It is but a revelation that is revealed to him

verses.ar: عَلَّمَهُۥ شَدِيدُ ٱلْقُوَىٰ
verses.en: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -

tafsir.text: it is taught to him by an angel one of awesome power

verses.ar: ذُو مِرَّةٍ فَٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.en: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form

tafsir.text: possessed of vigour of strength and might or alternatively it dhū mirratin means possessed of a beautiful appearance namely Gabriel peace be upon him; and he stood upright he settled

verses.ar: وَهُوَ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.en: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.

tafsir.text: when he was on the highest horizon the horizon of the sun that is to say at the place from which it rises in the form in which he Gabriel was created so that the Prophet s saw him; he the Prophet had been at Mount Hirā’ where Gabriel had obscured the entire horizon to the west.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ دَنَا فَتَدَلَّىٰ
verses.en: Then he approached and descended

tafsir.text: Then he drew near he came close to him and drew closer still

verses.ar: فَكَانَ قَابَ قَوْسَيْنِ أَوْ أَدْنَىٰ
verses.en: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.

tafsir.text: until he was from him the Prophet within the length of two bows away or even nearer than that until he the Prophet had regained consciousness and his fright had subsided

verses.ar: فَأَوْحَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦ مَآ أَوْحَىٰ
verses.en: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].

tafsir.text: whereat He God exalted be He revealed to His servant Gabriel what he Gabriel revealed to the Prophet s; the thing being revealed is not mentioned explicitly in exaltation of its great status.

verses.ar: مَا كَذَبَ ٱلْفُؤَادُ مَا رَأَىٰٓ
verses.en: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.

tafsir.text: The heart the heart of the Prophet did not deny read khadhaba or kadhdhaba what he saw with his own eyes of the image of Gabriel.

verses.ar: أَفَتُمَـٰرُونَهُۥ عَلَىٰ مَا يَرَىٰ
verses.en: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?

tafsir.text: Will you then dispute with him will you then argue with him and hope to overwhelm him concerning what he saw? — an address to the idolaters who denied the Prophet’s s vision of Gabriel.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ نَزْلَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: And he certainly saw him in another descent

tafsir.text: And verily he saw him in his true image another time

verses.ar: عِندَ سِدْرَةِ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.en: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -

tafsir.text: by the Lote-tree of the Ultimate Boundary when he was carried on the night journey up through the heavens — this lote-tree is a nabk thorn-tree that lies to the right of the Throne ‘arsh the tree beyond which no angel or any other being pass;

verses.ar: عِندَهَا جَنَّةُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰٓ
verses.en: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -

tafsir.text: near which is the Garden of the Retreat to which the angels the spirits of martyrs and the pious retreat;

verses.ar: إِذْ يَغْشَى ٱلسِّدْرَةَ مَا يَغْشَىٰ
verses.en: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].

tafsir.text: when there shrouded the Lote-tree that which shrouded it of flying creatures and other beings idh ‘when’ is operated by ra’āhu ‘he saw him’

verses.ar: مَا زَاغَ ٱلْبَصَرُ وَمَا طَغَىٰ
verses.en: The sight [of the Prophet (ﷺ)] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].

tafsir.text: The eye did not swerve on the part of the Prophet s nor did it go beyond the bounds that is to say his gaze did not turn away from the object of vision designated for it nor did it go beyond that object on that night.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ رَأَىٰ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰٓ
verses.en: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.

tafsir.text: Verily he saw in it some of the greatest signs of his Lord some of the most awesome of these signs. He thus saw from among the marvels of the Realm malakūt a green drape rafraf that obscured the entire horizon of the heaven and Gabriel with his six hundred wings.

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱللَّـٰتَ وَٱلْعُزَّىٰ
verses.en: So have you considered al-Lāt and al-ʿUzzā?

tafsir.text: Have you considered al-Lāt and al-‘Uzzā

verses.ar: وَمَنَوٰةَ ٱلثَّالِثَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.en: And Manāt, the third - the other one?

tafsir.text: and Manāt the third of the preceding two the other? al-ukhrā a derogatory qualification of the third one. These were stone idols which the idolaters worshipped and which they claimed interceded for them with God the first direct object of a-fa-ra’aytum ‘have you seen’ is al-Lāt and what has been supplemented thereto;

verses.ar: أَلَكُمُ ٱلذَّكَرُ وَلَهُ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.en: Is the male for you and for Him the female?

tafsir.text: Are you to have males and He females?

verses.ar: تِلْكَ إِذًا قِسْمَةٌ ضِيزَىٰٓ
verses.en: That, then, is an unjust division.

tafsir.text: That then would indeed be an unfair division! dīzān ‘unfair’ derives from dāzahu yadīzuhu to mean ‘he wronged him’ ‘he was unjust to him’.

verses.ar: إِنْ هِىَ إِلَّآ أَسْمَآءٌ سَمَّيْتُمُوهَآ أَنتُمْ وَءَابَآؤُكُم مَّآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَا مِن سُلْطَـٰنٍ ۚ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ وَمَا تَهْوَى ٱلْأَنفُسُ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّن رَّبِّهِمُ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.en: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which Allāh has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.

tafsir.text: These that is the mentioned deities are nothing but names which you have named by which you have named you and your fathers idols that you worship. God has not revealed any warrant any proof or evidence for them that is to say for the worship of them.

verses.ar: أَمْ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
verses.en: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?

tafsir.text: Or shall man that is shall every human being among them have whatever he wishes for? such as their wish that the idols intercede for them. No! It is not so.

verses.ar: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: Rather, to Allāh belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].

tafsir.text: Yet to God belong the Hereafter and the former life that is to say the life of the world and so nothing comes to pass in them except what He exalted wills.

verses.ar: ۞ وَكَم مِّن مَّلَكٍ فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ لَا تُغْنِى شَفَـٰعَتُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ أَن يَأْذَنَ ٱللَّهُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرْضَىٰٓ
verses.en: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after Allāh has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.

tafsir.text: And how many an angel that is to say many an angel there is in the heavens and how honoured they are in God’s sight but whose intercession cannot avail in any way except after God gives permission to them for this intercession for whomever He wills of His servants and with whom He is satisfied because of His saying

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ لَيُسَمُّونَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ تَسْمِيَةَ ٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,

tafsir.text: Truly those who do not believe in the Hereafter give the angels the names of females for they say ‘They are God’s daughters’.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَهُم بِهِۦ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۖ إِن يَتَّبِعُونَ إِلَّا ٱلظَّنَّ ۖ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّنَّ لَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ شَيْـًٔا
verses.en: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.

tafsir.text: But they do not have any knowledge thereof of this claim. They follow in this respect nothing but conjecture which they have conjured up and indeed conjecture can never substitute for the truth that is to say when it comes to acquiring knowledge of that which one is required to have knowledge of.

verses.ar: فَأَعْرِضْ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكْرِنَا وَلَمْ يُرِدْ إِلَّا ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.en: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.

tafsir.text: So shun him who turns away from Our Remembrance that is from the Qur’ān and desires nothing but the life of this world — this was revealed before the command to struggle against the disbelievers.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ مَبْلَغُهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.en: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.

tafsir.text: That namely the desire of this world is the full extent of their knowledge that is the limit of their knowledge namely that they have preferred this life to that of the Hereafter.

verses.ar: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ لِيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسَـٰٓـُٔوا۟ بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ وَيَجْزِىَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَحْسَنُوا۟ بِٱلْحُسْنَى
verses.en: And to Allāh belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth - that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who do good with the best [reward] -

tafsir.text: And to God belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth that is He owns all of that among which also are the misguided one and the rightly guided one leading astray whomever He will and guiding whomever He will that He may requite those who do evil for what they have done by way of idolatry and

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْتَنِبُونَ كَبَـٰٓئِرَ ٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْفَوَٰحِشَ إِلَّا ٱللَّمَمَ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ وَٰسِعُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ ۚ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِكُمْ إِذْ أَنشَأَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِذْ أَنتُمْ أَجِنَّةٌ فِى بُطُونِ أُمَّهَـٰتِكُمْ ۖ فَلَا تُزَكُّوٓا۟ أَنفُسَكُمْ ۖ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَنِ ٱتَّقَىٰٓ
verses.en: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.

tafsir.text: Those who avoid grave sins and abominations excepting lesser offences that is minor sins such as a look a kiss or a touch this constitutes a discontinuous exception in other words the meaning is but lesser offences are forgiven by the avoidance of grave sins.

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتَ ٱلَّذِى تَوَلَّىٰ
verses.en: Have you seen the one who turned away

tafsir.text: Did you see him who turned away from faith — that is the one who recanted when he was derided for it. He said ‘But I fear the punishment of God!’. But when the one deriding him guaranteed him that he would bear God’s chastisement for him provided that he reverted to his former idolatry and he then gave him a stated

verses.ar: وَأَعْطَىٰ قَلِيلًا وَأَكْدَىٰٓ
verses.en: And gave a little and [then] refrained?

tafsir.text: and gave a little of the stated sum of money and was then grudging? refrained from giving the remainder akdā derives from al-kudya earth that is hard as rock and which prevents the well-digger from digging through when he hits it.

verses.ar: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلْمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
verses.en: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?

tafsir.text: Does he possess knowledge of the Unseen so that he sees? and therefore from among such knowledge he is able to know that another person may bear the chastisement of the Hereafter for him? No! This was al-Walīd b.

verses.ar: أَمْ لَمْ يُنَبَّأْ بِمَا فِى صُحُفِ مُوسَىٰ
verses.en: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses

tafsir.text: Or am means bal has he not been informed of what is in the scrolls of Moses the books of the Torah or scrolls before it

verses.ar: وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ ٱلَّذِى وَفَّىٰٓ
verses.en: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -

tafsir.text: and the scrolls of Abraham who fulfilled his summons he who completed what he had been charged with as in And when his Lord tested Abraham with certain words and he fulfilled them Q. 2124 the explication of mā ‘what’ is the following

verses.ar: أَلَّا تَزِرُ وَازِرَةٌ وِزْرَ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another

tafsir.text: that no burdened soul shall bear the burden of another an ‘that’ has been softened in place of the hardened form in other words no soul shall bear responsibility for the sins of another;

verses.ar: وَأَن لَّيْسَ لِلْإِنسَـٰنِ إِلَّا مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.en: And that there is not for man except that [good] for which he strives

tafsir.text: and that wa-an to be understood as wa-annahu man shall have only what he himself strives for of good deeds and so he shall not have anything of the reward for good deeds striven for by another;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ سَعْيَهُۥ سَوْفَ يُرَىٰ
verses.en: And that his effort is going to be seen -

tafsir.text: and that his endeavour will be seen it will be inspected in the Hereafter

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُجْزَىٰهُ ٱلْجَزَآءَ ٱلْأَوْفَىٰ
verses.en: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense -

tafsir.text: then he will be rewarded for it with the fullest reward the most perfect reward one may say jazaytuhu sa‘yahu or jazaytuhu bi-sa‘yihi to mean the same thing

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ ٱلْمُنتَهَىٰ
verses.en: And that to your Lord is the finality

tafsir.text: and that read wa-anna as a supplement; it is also read wa-inna as the beginning of a new sentence; and the same applies to what comes after it in which case according to this second reading these inna statements no longer form part of the content of all that is ‘in the scrolls’ the ultimate end the return and the

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضْحَكَ وَأَبْكَىٰ
verses.en: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep

tafsir.text: and that it is He Who makes to laugh whomever He will He makes joyous and makes to weep whomever He will He makes him sorrowful

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَمَاتَ وَأَحْيَا
verses.en: And that it is He who causes death and gives life

tafsir.text: and that it is He Who brings death in this world and gives life for resurrection

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ خَلَقَ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰ
verses.en: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -

tafsir.text: and that He Himself creates the two spouses the two kinds the male and the female

verses.ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ إِذَا تُمْنَىٰ
verses.en: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted

tafsir.text: from a drop of semen once it is emitted once it is poured forth into the womb

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ عَلَيْهِ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُخْرَىٰ
verses.en: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation.

tafsir.text: and that with Him rests the second genesis read al-nashā’ata or al-nash’ata the other creation for the Resurrection after the first creation

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَغْنَىٰ وَأَقْنَىٰ
verses.en: And that it is He who enriches and suffices

tafsir.text: and that it is He Who enriches people by granting them sufficient wealth and grants possessions He Who gives that wealth that is enjoyed as property

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلشِّعْرَىٰ
verses.en: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius.

tafsir.text: and that it is He Who is the Lord of Sirius — this is a star lying beyond the constellation of Gemini which was worshipped in the time of pagandom jāhiliyya;

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥٓ أَهْلَكَ عَادًا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ʿAad.

tafsir.text: and that He destroyed former ‘Ād ‘Ādan al-ūlā a variant reading elides the nunation with the following lām sc. ‘Āda’l-ūlā; this former one refers to the people of ‘Ād while the second ‘Ād is that of the people of Sālih

verses.ar: وَثَمُودَا۟ فَمَآ أَبْقَىٰ
verses.en: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -

tafsir.text: and Thamūd wa-Thamūda may be declined as the name of their forefather or left as a diptote being the name of the tribe; it is a supplement to ‘Ādan sparing not a single one of them;

verses.ar: وَقَوْمَ نُوحٍ مِّن قَبْلُ ۖ إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَظْلَمَ وَأَطْغَىٰ
verses.en: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.

tafsir.text: and the people of Noah before that that is to say before ‘Ād and Thamūd We also destroyed them; indeed they were more unjust and more insolent than ‘Ād and Thamūd because of the long time that Noah remained among them and he remained among them a thousand-less-fifty years Q.

verses.ar: وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَةَ أَهْوَىٰ
verses.en: And the overturned towns He hurled down.

tafsir.text: and the Deviant cities namely the cities of the people of Lot He overturned He hurled them down to the earth after lifting them up to the heaven upside down by commanding Gabriel to do this;

verses.ar: فَغَشَّىٰهَا مَا غَشَّىٰ
verses.en: And covered them by that which He covered.

tafsir.text: so that there covered them of rocks afterwards that which covered them this is purposely left vague in order to inspire terror; in sūrat Hūd it is stated We made their uppermost the nethermost and We rained upon them stones of baked clay Q. 1182.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكَ تَتَمَارَىٰ
verses.en: Then which of the favors of your Lord do you doubt?

tafsir.text: Then which of the bounties of your Lord which of His graces graces which indicate His Oneness and power do you dispute? do you have doubt about O man or deny?

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا نَذِيرٌ مِّنَ ٱلنُّذُرِ ٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
verses.en: This [Prophet (ﷺ)] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.

tafsir.text: This Muhammad (s) is a warner in the tradition of the warners of old of their kind that is to say he is a messenger like messengers before him sent to you just as they were sent to their peoples.

verses.ar: أَزِفَتِ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةُ
verses.en: The Approaching Day has approached.

tafsir.text: The Impending Hour is imminent the Resurrection is near at hand.

verses.ar: لَيْسَ لَهَا مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ كَاشِفَةٌ
verses.en: Of it, [from those] besides Allāh, there is no remover.

tafsir.text: None no soul besides God can disclose it that is to say only He can disclose it and manifest it as where He says He alone shall reveal it at its proper time Q. 7187.

verses.ar: أَفَمِنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ تَعْجَبُونَ
verses.en: Then at this statement do you wonder?

tafsir.text: Do you then marvel in denial at this discourse the Qur’ān

verses.ar: وَتَضْحَكُونَ وَلَا تَبْكُونَ
verses.en: And you laugh and do not weep

tafsir.text: and laugh mockingly and not weep when you hear its Promise and Threat

verses.ar: وَأَنتُمْ سَـٰمِدُونَ
verses.en: While you are proudly sporting?

tafsir.text: while you remain oblivious? unmindful and heedless of what is required of you.

verses.ar: فَٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِلَّهِ وَٱعْبُدُوا۟ ۩
verses.en: So prostrate to Allāh and worship [Him].

tafsir.text: So prostrate to God Who created you and worship Him! and do not prostrate to idols nor worship them.

verses.ar: ٱقْتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.en: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].

tafsir.text: The Hour has drawn near the Resurrection is close at hand and the moon has split it broke in two at Mount Abū Qubays and Qu‘ayqa‘ān as a sign for the Prophet s for it had been demanded of him and when it took place he said ‘Bear witness now!’ — as reported by the two Shaykhs al-Bukhārī and Muslim.

verses.ar: وَإِن يَرَوْا۟ ءَايَةً يُعْرِضُوا۟ وَيَقُولُوا۟ سِحْرٌ مُّسْتَمِرٌّ
verses.en: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, "Passing magic."

tafsir.text: And if they the disbelievers among Quraysh see a sign a miracle of the Prophet s they turn away and say this is ‘A powerful sorcery!’ mustamirr ‘powerful’ derives from al-mirra meaning ‘strength’; or it mustamirr means ‘incessant’.

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓا۟ أَهْوَآءَهُمْ ۚ وَكُلُّ أَمْرٍ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.en: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.

tafsir.text: And they denied the Prophet s and followed their own desires as regards their falsehood; and every matter that is good or evil will be settled with that person who is responsible for it either by his ending up in Paradise or in the Fire.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَنۢبَآءِ مَا فِيهِ مُزْدَجَرٌ
verses.en: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence.

tafsir.text: And verily there has come to them such tidings stories about the destruction of communities which denied their messengers as contain a deterrent to them muzdajar is a verbal noun or a noun of place; the dāl of muzdajar replaces the tā’ of the 8th form ifta‘ala;

verses.ar: حِكْمَةٌۢ بَـٰلِغَةٌ ۖ فَمَا تُغْنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.en: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].

tafsir.text: wisdom hikmatun is the predicate of an omitted subject or a substitution for mā ‘such as’ or for muzdajar ‘deterrent’ that is far-reaching complete; but warnings nudhur is the plural of nadhīr functioning in the agent sense of mundhir ‘a warner’ that is to say ‘those matters which warn them’;

verses.ar: فَتَوَلَّ عَنْهُمْ ۘ يَوْمَ يَدْعُ ٱلدَّاعِ إِلَىٰ شَىْءٍ نُّكُرٍ
verses.en: So leave them, [O Muḥammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something forbidding,

tafsir.text: So turn away from them! this is the import of the preceding statement and it completes what is being said. On the day when the Summoner namely Isrāfīl yawma ‘the day’ is rendered accusative by yakhrujūna ‘they will emerge’ next verse summons to an awful thing read nukur or nukr in the sense of munkar ‘disagreeable’ a

verses.ar: خُشَّعًا أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمْ جَرَادٌ مُّنتَشِرٌ
verses.en: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,

tafsir.text: with their downcast khāshi‘an a variant reading has khushsha‘an humiliated looks absāruhum is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb yakhrujūna ‘they will emerge’ they that is mankind will emerge from the graves as though they were scattered locusts not knowing where to go out of fear and

verses.ar: مُّهْطِعِينَ إِلَى ٱلدَّاعِ ۖ يَقُولُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ هَـٰذَا يَوْمٌ عَسِرٌ
verses.en: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, "This is a difficult Day."

tafsir.text: scrambling hastening with their necks stretched out toward the Summoner. The disbelievers among them will say ‘This is a hard day!’ a difficult one for disbelievers — as is stated in sūrat al-Muddaththir a day of hardship for the disbelievers Q. 749-10.

verses.ar: ۞ كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ فَكَذَّبُوا۟ عَبْدَنَا وَقَالُوا۟ مَجْنُونٌ وَٱزْدُجِرَ
verses.en: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, "A madman," and he was repelled.

tafsir.text: The people of Noah denied kadhdhabat has feminine inflection on account of the import referring to a feminine noun qawm ‘tribe’ before them before Quraysh. Thus they denied Our servant Noah and said ‘A madman!’ and he was reviled they repulsed him with insults and in other ways.

verses.ar: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَغْلُوبٌ فَٱنتَصِرْ
verses.en: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."

tafsir.text: And so he invoked his Lord saying ‘I have been annī to be understood as bi-annī overcome so help me!’

verses.ar: فَفَتَحْنَآ أَبْوَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ بِمَآءٍ مُّنْهَمِرٍ
verses.en: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down

tafsir.text: Then We opened read fa-fatahnā or fa-fattahnā the gates of the heaven with torrential waters waters pouring down intensely

verses.ar: وَفَجَّرْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ عُيُونًا فَٱلْتَقَى ٱلْمَآءُ عَلَىٰٓ أَمْرٍ قَدْ قُدِرَ
verses.en: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.

tafsir.text: and We made the earth burst forth with springs that flowed forth and the waters the waters of the heaven and the earth met for a purpose a circumstance that was preordained a matter which had been decreed since pre-eternity namely their destruction by drowning.

verses.ar: وَحَمَلْنَـٰهُ عَلَىٰ ذَاتِ أَلْوَٰحٍ وَدُسُرٍ
verses.en: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,

tafsir.text: And We bore him that is Noah on one a ship made of planks and nails dusur is what boards are fastened down with of nails and the like; the singular is disār similar in pattern to kutub kitāb ‘book’

verses.ar: تَجْرِى بِأَعْيُنِنَا جَزَآءً لِّمَن كَانَ كُفِرَ
verses.en: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.

tafsir.text: sailing before Our eyes that is in Our sights in other words it was being protected as retaliation jazā’an is in the accusative because of the implied verbal clause that is to say ‘they were drowned by way of revenge’ for the sake of him who was rejected namely Noah peace be upon him a variant reading for passive

verses.ar: وَلَقَد تَّرَكْنَـٰهَآ ءَايَةً فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?

tafsir.text: And verily We left it We preserved this deed as a sign for whomever might be admonished by it in other words the news of this deed became widely-known and endured.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

tafsir.text: How dreadful then were My chastisement and My warnings? this is an interrogative meant as an affirmative; kayfa ‘how’ is the predicate of kāna ‘was’ and it is here being used to inquire about a ‘state’;

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

tafsir.text: And verily We have made the Qur’ān easy to remember We have facilitated its memorisation and disposed it to serve as a source of remembrance. So is there anyone who remember? anyone who will be admonished by it and memorise it? the interrogative here is intended as an imperative in other words memorise it and be

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ عَادٌ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: ʿAad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

tafsir.text: ‘Ād denied their prophet Hūd and so they were chastised. How then were My chastisement and My warnings? how then was My warning them of the chastisement before it was sent down? In other words it was justified and He explains this chastisement by saying

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ رِيحًا صَرْصَرًا فِى يَوْمِ نَحْسٍ مُّسْتَمِرٍّ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,

tafsir.text: Indeed We unleashed upon them a clamorous wind intensely noisy on a day of prolonged ill fortune nahsin mustamirr means either one of continuous ill fortune or one of severe ill fortune — and this was the last Wednesday of the month —

verses.ar: تَنزِعُ ٱلنَّاسَ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ مُّنقَعِرٍ
verses.en: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.

tafsir.text: tearing people away wrenching them from the holes in the ground in which they had been embedded and flinging them down to the ground head first thereby crushing their necks and severing their heads from their bodies as if they were while lying in this mentioned state trunks of uprooted palm-trees severed and thrown on

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

tafsir.text: How then were My chastisement and My warnings?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

tafsir.text: And verily We have made the Qur’ān easy to remember. So is there anyone who will remember?

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: Thamūd denied the warning.

tafsir.text: Thamūd denied the warnings nudhur is the plural of nadhīr with the sense of mundhir that is to say they denied those matters which their prophet Sālih warned them of if they refused to believe in him and to follow him

verses.ar: فَقَالُوٓا۟ أَبَشَرًا مِّنَّا وَٰحِدًا نَّتَّبِعُهُۥٓ إِنَّآ إِذًا لَّفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.en: And said, "Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.

tafsir.text: and they said ‘Is it a mortal basharan is in the accusative because it is governed by a succeeding verb alone among us minnā wāhidan are both adjectives of basharan that we are to follow? nattabi‘uhu this explains the verb which renders it basharan ‘mortal’ accusative;

verses.ar: أَءُلْقِىَ ٱلذِّكْرُ عَلَيْهِ مِنۢ بَيْنِنَا بَلْ هُوَ كَذَّابٌ أَشِرٌ
verses.en: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar."

tafsir.text: Has the Reminder the revelation been cast read a-ulqiya pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second one but in both cases inserting an intervening alif or leaving this insertion out upon him alone from among us? in other words nothing has been revealed to him.

verses.ar: سَيَعْلَمُونَ غَدًا مَّنِ ٱلْكَذَّابُ ٱلْأَشِرُ
verses.en: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.

tafsir.text: ‘They will know tomorrow in the Hereafter who is the conceited liar and it is them for they will be chastised for having denied their prophet Sālih.

verses.ar: إِنَّا مُرْسِلُوا۟ ٱلنَّاقَةِ فِتْنَةً لَّهُمْ فَٱرْتَقِبْهُمْ وَٱصْطَبِرْ
verses.en: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.

tafsir.text: Lo! We are sending the She-camel We will bring it forth out of the mountain the rock as they demanded as a trial a test for them that We may try them. So watch them O Sālih await to see what they will do and what will be done with them and remain patient istabir the tā’ here has replaced the tā’ of the 8th form

verses.ar: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ أَنَّ ٱلْمَآءَ قِسْمَةٌۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۖ كُلُّ شِرْبٍ مُّحْتَضَرٌ
verses.en: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].

tafsir.text: And inform them that the water is to be divided between them and the She-camel one day for them and the next for it every drinking every portion of water will be attended’ by the people drawing water on their designated day and by the She-camel on its day.

verses.ar: فَنَادَوْا۟ صَاحِبَهُمْ فَتَعَاطَىٰ فَعَقَرَ
verses.en: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].

tafsir.text: But they called their companion Qudār to slay it so he took he drew his sword and he hamstrung with it the She-camel in other words he slew her in compliance with their wish.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.

tafsir.text: How then were My chastisement and My warnings? My warning them of chastisement before it was sent down? In other words it was justified. He explains it their chastisement by saying

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ صَيْحَةً وَٰحِدَةً فَكَانُوا۟ كَهَشِيمِ ٱلْمُحْتَظِرِ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.

tafsir.text: Indeed We unleashed upon them a single Cry and they became like the chaff of a corral builder al-muhtazir is one who makes a pen from dried tree-branches and thorns for his sheep to protect them from wolves and beasts of prey; the fallen parts which they tread are called hashīm.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

tafsir.text: And verily We have made the Qur’ān easy to remember. So is there anyone who will remember?

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَوْمُ لُوطٍۭ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: The people of Lot denied the warning.

tafsir.text: The people of Lot denied the warnings they denied those issues of which they were warned by his Lot’s tongue.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حَاصِبًا إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ۖ نَّجَّيْنَـٰهُم بِسَحَرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn.

tafsir.text: Indeed We unleashed upon them a squall of pebbles a wind hurling at them pebbles namely small stones a single one of these being no larger than the palm of the hand and they were destroyed;

verses.ar: نِّعْمَةً مِّنْ عِندِنَا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَن شَكَرَ
verses.en: As favor from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.

tafsir.text: as a grace ni‘matan is a verbal noun that is to say in‘āman ‘an act of grace’ from Us. So like that requital do We requite him who gives thanks for Our graces and is a believer or it means him who is a believer in God and His messenger and is obedient to both.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَنذَرَهُم بَطْشَتَنَا فَتَمَارَوْا۟ بِٱلنُّذُرِ
verses.en: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.

tafsir.text: And verily he had warned them Lot had threatened them of Our strike Our seizing them with chastisement but they disputed they contested and denied the warnings his warning.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَٰوَدُوهُ عَن ضَيْفِهِۦ فَطَمَسْنَآ أَعْيُنَهُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], "Taste My punishment and warning."

tafsir.text: And they had even solicited of him his guests that he should let them have their own way with those who had come to him as guests that they may do wicked things with them — and these guests were angels.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ صَبَّحَهُم بُكْرَةً عَذَابٌ مُّسْتَقِرٌّ
verses.en: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.

tafsir.text: And verily there greeted them in the early morning the morning time of an unspecified day an abiding chastisement a permanent chastisement continuous with the chastisement of the Hereafter.

verses.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابِى وَنُذُرِ
verses.en: So taste My punishment and warning.

tafsir.text: ‘So taste now My chastisement and My warnings!’

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ يَسَّرْنَا ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِلذِّكْرِ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?

tafsir.text: And verily We have made the Qur’ān easy to remember. So is there anyone who will remember?

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ ٱلنُّذُرُ
verses.en: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.

tafsir.text: And verily there came to Pharaoh’s folk his people together with him the warnings the warning by the tongue of Moses and Aaron but they did not believe.

verses.ar: كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كُلِّهَا فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُمْ أَخْذَ عَزِيزٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍ
verses.en: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.

tafsir.text: Rather They denied Our signs all nine of them which were given to Moses. So We seized them by way of chastisement with the seizing of One Who is Mighty Strong Omnipotent Powerful Whom nothing can thwart.

verses.ar: أَكُفَّارُكُمْ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكُمْ أَمْ لَكُم بَرَآءَةٌ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.en: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?

tafsir.text: Are your disbelievers O Quraysh better than those? mentioned beginning from the people of Noah to those of Pharaoh which is why they have not been chastised?
