Or have you O disbelievers of Quraysh been granted some immunity from chastisement in the Scriptures? the Books? the interrogative in both instances is meant as

verses.ar: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ نَحْنُ جَمِيعٌ مُّنتَصِرٌ
verses.en: Or do they say, "We are an assembly supporting [each other]"?

tafsir.text: Or do they the disbelievers of Quraysh say ‘We are a host that will be helped to victory’? against Muhammad (s)? When Abū Jahl on the day of Badr said ‘We are a host that will be helped to victory’ the following was revealed

verses.ar: سَيُهْزَمُ ٱلْجَمْعُ وَيُوَلُّونَ ٱلدُّبُرَ
verses.en: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].

tafsir.text: The host will truly be routed and turn its back to flee and so they were defeated at Badr and God’s Messenger s was granted victory over them.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ مَوْعِدُهُمْ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْهَىٰ وَأَمَرُّ
verses.en: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.

tafsir.text: Nay but the Hour is their tryst for chastisement and the Hour that is the chastisement thereat will be more calamitous greater in affliction and more bitter than the chastisement of this world.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ وَسُعُرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness..

tafsir.text: Indeed the guilty are in error in the destruction of being killed in this world and in a blazing fire a fire that has been set ablaze musa‘‘ara that is fiercely ignited in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُسْحَبُونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ عَلَىٰ وُجُوهِهِمْ ذُوقُوا۟ مَسَّ سَقَرَ
verses.en: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], "Taste the touch of Saqar."

tafsir.text: The day when they are dragged into the Fire on their faces in the Hereafter and it is said to them ‘Taste now the touch of Saqar’ Hell’s affliction of you.

verses.ar: إِنَّا كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ بِقَدَرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.

tafsir.text: Truly everything read inna kulla shay’in is in the accusative as a dependent clause because of a verb governing it have We created in a measure by ordainment bi-qadarin ‘in a measure’ is a circumstantial qualifier referring to kulla ‘every’ in other words ‘already predetermined’;

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَمْرُنَآ إِلَّا وَٰحِدَةٌ كَلَمْحٍۭ بِٱلْبَصَرِ
verses.en: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.

tafsir.text: And Our command for a thing which We want to bring into existence is but a single word like the twinkling of an eye in terms of speed and this is the saying of kun ‘Be’ whereat it comes into existence. His command when He wills a thing is just to say to it ‘Be’ and it is Q. 3682.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَهْلَكْنَآ أَشْيَاعَكُمْ فَهَلْ مِن مُّدَّكِرٍ
verses.en: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?

tafsir.text: And verily We have destroyed the likes of you the likes of you in terms of disbelief from among past communities. So is there anyone who will remember? this is an interrogative meant as an imperative that is to say ‘Remember and be admonished!’.

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ شَىْءٍ فَعَلُوهُ فِى ٱلزُّبُرِ
verses.en: And everything they did is in written records.

tafsir.text: And everything they that is servants have done is recorded in the scrolls the books of the Guardian Angels al-hafaza

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٍ وَكَبِيرٍ مُّسْتَطَرٌ
verses.en: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.

tafsir.text: and every small and great sin or deed is inscribed is recorded in the Preserved Tablet al-lawh al-mahfūz.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَنَهَرٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,

tafsir.text: Assuredly the God-fearing will be amid gardens orchards and rivers the collective noun is meant here; a variant reading for nahar has the plural nuhur similar in form to asad ‘lion’ plural usud the meaning being that they will drink from its rivers water milk honey and wine;

verses.ar: فِى مَقْعَدِ صِدْقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٍ مُّقْتَدِرٍۭ
verses.en: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.

tafsir.text: in an abode of truth a place of truth wherein there is no idle talk or cause for sin — the collective noun maq‘ad is meant here; a variant reading has maqā‘id ‘abodes’ in other words they are in congregations in Paradise that are free from idle talk and cause for sin in contrast to the congregations of this world

verses.ar: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ
verses.en: The Most Merciful

tafsir.text: The Compassionate One God exalted be He

verses.ar: عَلَّمَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ
verses.en: Taught the Qur’ān,

tafsir.text: has taught whomever He will the Qur’ān.

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ
verses.en: Created man,

tafsir.text: He created man the species mankind

verses.ar: عَلَّمَهُ ٱلْبَيَانَ
verses.en: [And] taught him eloquence.

tafsir.text: teaching him the coherent speech utterance.

verses.ar: ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ بِحُسْبَانٍ
verses.en: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,

tafsir.text: The sun and the moon follow a reckoning they move according to a strict calculation

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّجْمُ وَٱلشَّجَرُ يَسْجُدَانِ
verses.en: And the stars and trees prostrate.

tafsir.text: and the grass all stalkless vegetation and the trees that vegetation which possesses stalk prostrate comply with what is required of them.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءَ رَفَعَهَا وَوَضَعَ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.en: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance

tafsir.text: And He has raised the heaven and set up the balance He has established justice

verses.ar: أَلَّا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْمِيزَانِ
verses.en: That you not transgress within the balance.

tafsir.text: declaring that you should not contravene that is to say so that you may not do wrong with regard to the balance that instrument with which one weighs.

verses.ar: وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلْوَزْنَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ وَلَا تُخْسِرُوا۟ ٱلْمِيزَانَ
verses.en: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.

tafsir.text: And observe the weights with justice fairly and do not skimp the balance do not decrease the value of what is being weighed.

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلْأَنَامِ
verses.en: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.

tafsir.text: And the earth He placed it He fixed it in place for all creatures man jinn and others.

verses.ar: فِيهَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَٱلنَّخْلُ ذَاتُ ٱلْأَكْمَامِ
verses.en: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]

tafsir.text: In it are fruits and the familiar date-palms with sheaths the spathes containing its flowers

verses.ar: وَٱلْحَبُّ ذُو ٱلْعَصْفِ وَٱلرَّيْحَانُ
verses.en: And grain having husks and scented plants.

tafsir.text: and grain such as wheat and barley with husk and fragrant herb.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours graces will you deny? tukadhdhibān is mentioned thirty one times; the interrogative is meant to be understood as an affirmative judging by what al-Hākim al-Naysābūrī reported by way of an isnād from Jābir b.

verses.ar: خَلَقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ كَٱلْفَخَّارِ
verses.en: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.

tafsir.text: He created man Adam of dry clay salsāl a dry hollow mud producing an echo if tapped resembling the potter’s fakhkhār clay that has been baked

verses.ar: وَخَلَقَ ٱلْجَآنَّ مِن مَّارِجٍ مِّن نَّارٍ
verses.en: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.

tafsir.text: and He created the Jann the father of the jinn namely Iblīs of a smokeless flame of fire.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقَيْنِ وَرَبُّ ٱلْمَغْرِبَيْنِ
verses.en: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.

tafsir.text: Lord of the two Easts the points of the winter sunrise and the summer sunrise and Lord of the two Wests likewise the two points of sunset.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: مَرَجَ ٱلْبَحْرَيْنِ يَلْتَقِيَانِ
verses.en: He released the two seas, meeting [one another];

tafsir.text: He has loosed the two waters the sweet and the salty; and so they meet in the perception of the eye.

verses.ar: بَيْنَهُمَا بَرْزَخٌ لَّا يَبْغِيَانِ
verses.en: Between them is a barrier so neither of them transgresses.

tafsir.text: Between them there is a barrier by His power exalted be He. They do not overstep neither of the two encroaches upon the other to become mixed with it.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنْهُمَا ٱللُّؤْلُؤُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
verses.en: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.

tafsir.text: From both of them from the point at which they seem to meet — but which is actually from only one of the two and that is the salt water — is brought forth yukhraju passive may also be read as active yakhruju ‘emerge’ the pearl and the coral marjān these are red pieces of shell or small pearls.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: وَلَهُ ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْمُنشَـَٔاتُ فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ كَٱلْأَعْلَـٰمِ
verses.en: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.

tafsir.text: His are the crafted ships that sail in the sea appearing like landmarks like mountains in their tremendous size and height.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: كُلُّ مَنْ عَلَيْهَا فَانٍ
verses.en: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,

tafsir.text: Everyone who is on it that is on the earth of animal beings will perish man ‘who’ is used to indicate predominance of rational beings;

verses.ar: وَيَبْقَىٰ وَجْهُ رَبِّكَ ذُو ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.en: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

tafsir.text: yet there will remain the countenance of your Lord His Essence the countenance of majesty magnificence and munificence towards believers through His graces to them.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُهُۥ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ هُوَ فِى شَأْنٍ
verses.en: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.

tafsir.text: All that is in the heavens and the earth implore Him either by way of speech or by their very state of dependence on Him for the strength which they require for worship for provision forgiveness and other things.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: سَنَفْرُغُ لَكُمْ أَيُّهَ ٱلثَّقَلَانِ
verses.en: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.

tafsir.text: We will attend to you We shall turn to reckon with you O you two heavy ones! mankind and jinn.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: يَـٰمَعْشَرَ ٱلْجِنِّ وَٱلْإِنسِ إِنِ ٱسْتَطَعْتُمْ أَن تَنفُذُوا۟ مِنْ أَقْطَارِ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنفُذُوا۟ ۚ لَا تَنفُذُونَ إِلَّا بِسُلْطَـٰنٍ
verses.en: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from Allāh].

tafsir.text: O company of jinn and humans if you are able to pass through to exit from the confines the regions of the heavens and the earth then pass through! — a command meant to challenge them to what they are incapable of doing.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: يُرْسَلُ عَلَيْكُمَا شُوَاظٌ مِّن نَّارٍ وَنُحَاسٌ فَلَا تَنتَصِرَانِ
verses.en: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.

tafsir.text: Against you will be unleashed a heat of fire shuwāz can either mean that the flame thereof has no smoke or that it does have it with it and a flash of brass without any flame and you will not be able to seek help you will not be able to defend yourselves against this nay it will drive you to the site of the Gathering.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: فَإِذَا ٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ وَرْدَةً كَٱلدِّهَانِ
verses.en: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-colored like oil -

tafsir.text: And when the heaven is split open when it becomes open with many gates in preparation for the descent of the angels and it turns crimson wardatan literally ‘a rose’ in other words red like this rose like tanned leather red skins in contrast to its the heaven’s usual appearance the response to idhā ‘when’ is along the

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُسْـَٔلُ عَن ذَنۢبِهِۦٓ إِنسٌ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.en: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.

tafsir.text: Thus on that day no man will be questioned about his sin nor any jinn about his sin; but they are questioned on some other occasion By your Lord We shall question them all Q.1592 al-jānn in this instance and in what will follow denotes the jinn and also in both cases al-ins denotes human beings.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: يُعْرَفُ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ بِسِيمَـٰهُمْ فَيُؤْخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِى وَٱلْأَقْدَامِ
verses.en: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

tafsir.text: The guilty will be recognised by their mark blackened faces and bruised eyes; so they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: هَـٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِى يُكَذِّبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.

tafsir.text: ‘This is Hell which the guilty were wont to deny!’

verses.ar: يَطُوفُونَ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَ حَمِيمٍ ءَانٍ
verses.en: They will circulate between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].

tafsir.text: They shall pass round they shall pace between it and boiling hot water water of extreme temperature which they are given to drink every time they call to be rescued from the heat of the Fire ānin is defective like qādin.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: وَلِمَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ جَنَّتَانِ
verses.en: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -

tafsir.text: But for those who feared that is for every one of them or for all of them together the station of their Lord the standing before Him for the Reckoning and therefore refrained from being disobedient to Him there will be two gardens.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: ذَوَاتَآ أَفْنَانٍ
verses.en: Having [spreading] branches.

tafsir.text: Both with dhawātā the dual form of the regular form dhawāt with its lām its third consonant is changed into a yā’ abundant branches afnān is the plural of fanan similar in pattern to talal atlāl.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ تَجْرِيَانِ
verses.en: In both of them are two springs, flowing.

tafsir.text: In both of them there are two flowing springs.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِمَا مِن كُلِّ فَـٰكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ
verses.en: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.

tafsir.text: In both of them of every fruit fākiha of the fruits of this world — or it fākiha means all those things in which one delights yutafakkahu bihi — there are two kinds two varieties one juicy one dried and those which in this world are bitter like colocynth will be sweet therein.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشٍۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنْ إِسْتَبْرَقٍ ۚ وَجَنَى ٱلْجَنَّتَيْنِ دَانٍ
verses.en: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.

tafsir.text: They will be reclining muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier operated by an omitted verb that is to say yatana‘‘amūna they will enjoy bliss while reclining’ upon couches lined with heavy silk brocade istabraq thick or coarse silk the outer lining being of fine silk sundus.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِنَّ قَـٰصِرَٰتُ ٱلطَّرْفِ لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.en: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -

tafsir.text: In them in the two gardens and what they comprise of upper chambers and palaces are maidens of restrained glances restricting their eyes to those spouses of theirs from among either the men or the jinn who are reclining maidens who have not been touched who have not been deflowered — and these maidens are either

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُنَّ ٱلْيَاقُوتُ وَٱلْمَرْجَانُ
verses.en: As if they were rubies and coral.

tafsir.text: It is as though they are rubies in their purity and pearls in their fairness.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: هَلْ جَزَآءُ ٱلْإِحْسَـٰنِ إِلَّا ٱلْإِحْسَـٰنُ
verses.en: Is the reward for good [anything] but good?

tafsir.text: Is the reward of goodness manifested through obedience anything but goodness? granted through bliss?

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: وَمِن دُونِهِمَا جَنَّتَانِ
verses.en: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -

tafsir.text: And beside these two mentioned gardens there will be two other gardens in addition for those who feared the standing before their Lord.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: مُدْهَآمَّتَانِ
verses.en: Dark green [in color].

tafsir.text: Deep green mudhāmmatān this means that they are almost black on account of the intensity of their greenness.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِمَا عَيْنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
verses.en: In both of them are two springs, spouting.

tafsir.text: In both of them will be two gushing fountains rushing with water unceasing.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِمَا فَـٰكِهَةٌ وَنَخْلٌ وَرُمَّانٌ
verses.en: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.

tafsir.text: In both of them will be fruits and date-palms and pomegranates the latter two fruits being from among these fruits of the two gardens; but it is also said that they belong to the fruits of some other garden.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: فِيهِنَّ خَيْرَٰتٌ حِسَانٌ
verses.en: In them are good and beautiful women -

tafsir.text: In them that is in the two gardens and their palaces and what they comprise are maidens who are good in nature and with beautiful faces.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: حُورٌ مَّقْصُورَٰتٌ فِى ٱلْخِيَامِ
verses.en: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -

tafsir.text: Houris hur this means maidens with intense black eyes set against the intense whiteness of the iris secluded concealed in pavilions made of studded gems annexed to the palaces like boudoirs.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: لَمْ يَطْمِثْهُنَّ إِنسٌ قَبْلَهُمْ وَلَا جَآنٌّ
verses.en: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -

tafsir.text: Untouched by any man before them before these soon-to-be spouses of theirs or jinn.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny? -

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ رَفْرَفٍ خُضْرٍ وَعَبْقَرِىٍّ حِسَانٍ
verses.en: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.

tafsir.text: Reclining namely their spouses muttaki’īna syntactically it is as described above upon green cushions rafraf is the plural of rafrafa which can mean either ‘carpets’ or ‘cushions’ and lovely druggets ‘abqariyyin the plural of ‘abqariyya which are velvet carpets.

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
verses.en: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?

tafsir.text: So which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?

verses.ar: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱسْمُ رَبِّكَ ذِى ٱلْجَلَـٰلِ وَٱلْإِكْرَامِ
verses.en: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.

tafsir.text: Blessed be the Name of your Lord He of Majesty and Munificence as explained above; the word ism is extra.

verses.ar: إِذَا وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
verses.en: When the Occurrence occurs,

tafsir.text: When the imminent Event comes to pass when the Resurrection takes place

verses.ar: لَيْسَ لِوَقْعَتِهَا كَاذِبَةٌ
verses.en: There is, at its occurrence, no denial.

tafsir.text: there will be no denying its coming to pass there is no soul to deny it by repudiating it as it did in this world

verses.ar: خَافِضَةٌ رَّافِعَةٌ
verses.en: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].

tafsir.text: it will be abasing some exalting others that is it will manifest the abasing of some people by virtue of their admission into the Fire and manifest the exalting of others by their admission into Paradise.

verses.ar: إِذَا رُجَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ رَجًّا
verses.en: When the earth is shaken with convulsion

tafsir.text: When the earth is shaken with a violent shock

verses.ar: وَبُسَّتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ بَسًّا
verses.en: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling

tafsir.text: and the mountains are pulverised to tiny pieces

verses.ar: فَكَانَتْ هَبَآءً مُّنۢبَثًّا
verses.en: And become dust dispersing,

tafsir.text: so that they become a scattered dust the second idh ‘when’ is a substitution for the first idh

verses.ar: وَكُنتُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا ثَلَـٰثَةً
verses.en: And you become [of] three kinds:

tafsir.text: and you will be at the Resurrection three kinds categories

verses.ar: فَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
verses.en: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

tafsir.text: Those of the right hand those who are given their record of deeds in their right hand fa-ashābu’l-maymanati is the subject the predicate of which is the following mā ashābu’l-maymanati — what of those of the right hand? — a glorification of their status on account of their admittance into Paradise.

verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verses.en: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?

tafsir.text: And those of the left hand al-mash’ama means al-shimāl ‘left’ each of whom is given his record of deeds in their left hands — what of those of the left hand? — an expression of contempt for their status on account of their admittance into the Fire.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ ٱلسَّـٰبِقُونَ
verses.en: And the forerunners, the forerunners -

tafsir.text: And the foremost in the race to do good namely the prophets al-sābiqūna is a subject the foremost this repetition is to emphasise their exalted status; the predicate is the following ūlā’ika’l-muqarrabūna

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.en: Those are the ones brought near [to Allāh]

tafsir.text: they are the ones brought near to God

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: In the Gardens of Pleasure,

tafsir.text: in the Gardens of Bliss

verses.ar: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: A [large] company of the former peoples

tafsir.text: a multitude from the former generations thullatun mina’l-awwalīna the subject that is to say a group of individuals from communities of old

verses.ar: وَقَلِيلٌ مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And a few of the later peoples,

tafsir.text: and a few from the later ones from among the community of Muhammad (s) being the foremost from among the communities of old and this community the predicate is the following ‘alā sururin mawdūnatin

verses.ar: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مَّوْضُونَةٍ
verses.en: On thrones woven [with ornament],

tafsir.text: will be upon encrusted couches their linings woven onto rods of gold and jewels

verses.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَيْهَا مُتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
verses.en: Reclining on them, facing each other.

tafsir.text: reclining on them face to face muttaki’īna ‘alayhā mutaqābilīna constitute two circumstantial qualifiers referring to the subject person of the predicate ‘they’.

verses.ar: يَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ
verses.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal.

tafsir.text: They will be waited on by immortal youths resembling young boys never ageing;

verses.ar: بِأَكْوَابٍ وَأَبَارِيقَ وَكَأْسٍ مِّن مَّعِينٍ
verses.en: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -

tafsir.text: with goblets akwāb are drinking-vessels without handles and ewers abārīq are vessels that have handles and spouts and a cup ka’s is the vessel for drinking wine from a flowing spring in other words wine flowing from a spring that never runs out

verses.ar: لَّا يُصَدَّعُونَ عَنْهَا وَلَا يُنزِفُونَ
verses.en: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -

tafsir.text: wherefrom they suffer no headache nor any stupefaction read yanzafūna or yanzifūna respectively derived from nazafa or anzafa al-shāribu ‘the drinker became inebriated’ in other words they do not get a headache from it nor do they lose their senses in contrast to the case with the wine of this world;

verses.ar: وَفَـٰكِهَةٍ مِّمَّا يَتَخَيَّرُونَ
verses.en: And fruit of what they select

tafsir.text: and such fruits as they prefer

verses.ar: وَلَحْمِ طَيْرٍ مِّمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.en: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.

tafsir.text: and such flesh of fowls as they desire for themselves to enjoy

verses.ar: وَحُورٌ عِينٌ
verses.en: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,

tafsir.text: and houris maidens with intensely black eyes set against the whiteness of their irises with wide eyes ‘īn the ‘ayn here is inflected with a kasra instead of a damma because it the kasra better harmonises with the yā’; the singular is ‘aynā’ similar in pattern to hamrā’;

verses.ar: كَأَمْثَـٰلِ ٱللُّؤْلُؤِ ٱلْمَكْنُونِ
verses.en: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,

tafsir.text: resembling hidden guarded pearls

verses.ar: جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: As reward for what they used to do.

tafsir.text: a reward jazā’an is an object denoting reason or a verbal noun with the operator being an implicit verb in other words ‘We have appointed for them the mentioned as a reward’ or ‘We have rewarded them this’ for what they used to do.

verses.ar: لَا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا تَأْثِيمًا
verses.en: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -

tafsir.text: They will not hear therein in Paradise any vain talk any lewd words or any sinful words

verses.ar: إِلَّا قِيلًا سَلَـٰمًا سَلَـٰمًا
verses.en: Only a saying [of] peace, peace.

tafsir.text: but only the saying ‘Peace!’ ‘Peace!’ salāman salāman substitutes for qīlan ‘the saying’ which they will hear.

verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?

tafsir.text: And those of the right hand — what of those of the right hand?

verses.ar: فِى سِدْرٍ مَّخْضُودٍ
verses.en: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed.

tafsir.text: Amid thornless lote-trees nabk trees

verses.ar: وَطَلْحٍ مَّنضُودٍ
verses.en: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit].

tafsir.text: and clustered plantains banana trees weighed down with its load of fruit from top to bottom

verses.ar: وَظِلٍّ مَّمْدُودٍ
verses.en: And shade extended.

tafsir.text: and extended shade one that is permanent

verses.ar: وَمَآءٍ مَّسْكُوبٍ
verses.en: And water poured out

tafsir.text: and cascading water running continuously

verses.ar: وَفَـٰكِهَةٍ كَثِيرَةٍ
verses.en: And fruit, abundant [and varied],

tafsir.text: and abundant fruit

verses.ar: لَّا مَقْطُوعَةٍ وَلَا مَمْنُوعَةٍ
verses.en: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,

tafsir.text: neither unavailable during certain times nor forbidden because of its cost

verses.ar: وَفُرُشٍ مَّرْفُوعَةٍ
verses.en: And [upon] beds raised high.

tafsir.text: and mattresses that are raised on top of couches.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنشَأْنَـٰهُنَّ إِنشَآءً
verses.en: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation

tafsir.text: Verily We have created them with an unmediated creation namely the wide-eyed houris We created them without the process of birth

verses.ar: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُنَّ أَبْكَارًا
verses.en: And made them virgins,

tafsir.text: and made them virgins immaculate — every time their spouses enter them they find them virgins nor is there any pain of defloration —

verses.ar: عُرُبًا أَتْرَابًا
verses.en: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,

tafsir.text: amorous read ‘uruban or ‘urban plural of ‘arūb meaning ‘a woman passionately enamoured of her spouse’ of equal age atrāb is the plural of tirb

verses.ar: لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: For the companions of the right [who are]

tafsir.text: for those of the right hand li-ashābi’l-yamīni is the relative clause of either ansha’nāhunna ‘We have created them’ or ja‘alnāhunna ‘We made them’ who are

verses.ar: ثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: A company of the former peoples

tafsir.text: A multitude from the former generations

verses.ar: وَثُلَّةٌ مِّنَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: And a company of the later peoples.

tafsir.text: and a multitude of the later ones.

verses.ar: وَأَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ مَآ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلشِّمَالِ
verses.en: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?

tafsir.text: And those of the left hand — what of those of the left hand?

verses.ar: فِى سَمُومٍ وَحَمِيمٍ
verses.en: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water

tafsir.text: Amid a scorching wind an infernal wind permeating the pores of skins and scalding water water of extreme temperatures

verses.ar: وَظِلٍّ مِّن يَحْمُومٍ
verses.en: And a shade of black smoke,

tafsir.text: and the shade of pitch-black smoke

verses.ar: لَّا بَارِدٍ وَلَا كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: Neither cool nor beneficial.

tafsir.text: neither cool like all other shade nor pleasant nor agreeable in its appearance.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ قَبْلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتْرَفِينَ
verses.en: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,

tafsir.text: Indeed before that in the world they used to live at ease enjoying life’s comforts never wearying themselves with an act of obedience

verses.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يُصِرُّونَ عَلَى ٱلْحِنثِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: And they used to persist in the great violation,

tafsir.text: and they used to persist in the great sin namely idolatry.

verses.ar: وَكَانُوا۟ يَقُولُونَ أَئِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًا وَعِظَـٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبْعُوثُونَ
verses.en: And they used to say, "When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

tafsir.text: And they used to say ‘What! When we are dead and have become dust and bones shall we indeed be resurrected? in both instances a-idhā and a-innā the two hamzas may be read either by pronouncing them fully or by not pronouncing the second and in either case inserting an intervening alif.

verses.ar: أَوَءَابَآؤُنَا ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ
verses.en: And our forefathers [as well]?"

tafsir.text: What! And our forefathers too?’ read a-wa-ābā’unā with the wa- being for supplement the hamza a- for the interrogative; here and in the previous instance it is used to express ‘remoteness of probability’;

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, the former and later peoples

tafsir.text: Say ‘Truly the former and the later generations

verses.ar: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ إِلَىٰ مِيقَـٰتِ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day."

tafsir.text: will be gathered for the tryst the time of a known day that is the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,

tafsir.text: Then indeed you the erring the deniers

verses.ar: لَـَٔاكِلُونَ مِن شَجَرٍ مِّن زَقُّومٍ
verses.en: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm

tafsir.text: will assuredly eat from a Zaqqūm tree min zaqqūm the explication of shajar ‘tree’

verses.ar: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنْهَا ٱلْبُطُونَ
verses.en: And filling with it your bellies

tafsir.text: and fill therewith with the tree your bellies

verses.ar: فَشَـٰرِبُونَ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلْحَمِيمِ
verses.en: And drinking on top of it from scalding water.

tafsir.text: and drink on top of that the consumed Zaqqūm boiling water

verses.ar: فَشَـٰرِبُونَ شُرْبَ ٱلْهِيمِ
verses.en: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.

tafsir.text: drinking like the drinking read sharba or shurba verbal noun of thirsty camels’ hīm is the plural of masculine haymān and feminine haymā similar in pattern to ‘atshān ‘atshā ‘thirsty’.

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

tafsir.text: This will be the hospitality for them what has been prepared for them on the Day of Judgement the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ فَلَوْلَا تُصَدِّقُونَ
verses.en: We have created you, so why do you not believe?

tafsir.text: We created you We brought you into existence from nothing. Will you not then affirm this truth? in resurrection? For the One able to create from nothing is also able to repeat this creation.

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تُمْنُونَ
verses.en: Have you seen that which you emit?

tafsir.text: Have you considered the sperm that you emit? the sperm you spill in the wombs of women?

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ تَخْلُقُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْخَـٰلِقُونَ
verses.en: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?

tafsir.text: Is it you a-antum read by pronouncing both hamzas fully or by replacing the second one with an alif or not pronouncing it but inserting an alif between the one not pronounced and the other one or without this insertion in the four instances here and below who create it that is the sperm making it into a human being or

verses.ar: نَحْنُ قَدَّرْنَا بَيْنَكُمُ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.en: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone

tafsir.text: We have ordained read qaddarnā or qadarnā death among you and We are not to be outmanoeuvred from We are not incapable of

verses.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ أَمْثَـٰلَكُمْ وَنُنشِئَكُمْ فِى مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.

tafsir.text: replacing you with We are not incapable of appointing your likes in your place and making you creating you in what you do not know in the way of forms such as apes or swine.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْتُمُ ٱلنَّشْأَةَ ٱلْأُولَىٰ فَلَوْلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?

tafsir.text: For verily you have known the first creation al-nashā’ata a variant reading has al-nash’ata why then will you not remember? tadhakkarūna the original second tā’ of tatadhakkarūna has been assimilated with the dhāl.

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُم مَّا تَحْرُثُونَ
verses.en: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?

tafsir.text: Have you considered what you sow? what you stir of the earth to place seeds therein?

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ تَزْرَعُونَهُۥٓ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلزَّٰرِعُونَ
verses.en: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?

tafsir.text: Is it you who make it grow or are We the Grower?

verses.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ لَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ حُطَـٰمًا فَظَلْتُمْ تَفَكَّهُونَ
verses.en: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,

tafsir.text: If We will We could surely turn it into chaff dried vegetation producing no seed and you would remain zaltum is actually zaliltum the lām having a kasra inflection;

verses.ar: إِنَّا لَمُغْرَمُونَ
verses.en: [Saying], "Indeed, we are [now] in debt;

tafsir.text: ‘We have indeed suffered loss! losing what we expended on the cultivation.

verses.ar: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
verses.en: Rather, we have been deprived."

tafsir.text: Nay but we are deprived!’ prevented from reaping our provision.

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلْمَآءَ ٱلَّذِى تَشْرَبُونَ
verses.en: And have you seen the water that you drink?

tafsir.text: Have you considered the water you drink?

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنزَلْتُمُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُزْنِ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنزِلُونَ
verses.en: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?

tafsir.text: Is it you who cause it to come down from the rain clouds muzn is the plural of muzna or are We the Causer of its coming down?

verses.ar: لَوْ نَشَآءُ جَعَلْنَـٰهُ أُجَاجًا فَلَوْلَا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?

tafsir.text: If We willed We could make it bitter salty undrinkable — why then will you not give thanks?

verses.ar: أَفَرَءَيْتُمُ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِى تُورُونَ
verses.en: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?

tafsir.text: Have you considered the fire that you kindle? the fire which you produce out of the oil of green trees?

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَنشَأْتُمْ شَجَرَتَهَآ أَمْ نَحْنُ ٱلْمُنشِـُٔونَ
verses.en: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?

tafsir.text: Was it you who created the tree thereof trees such as the markh the ‘afār or the kalkh ‘fennel’ or were We the Creator?

verses.ar: نَحْنُ جَعَلْنَـٰهَا تَذْكِرَةً وَمَتَـٰعًا لِّلْمُقْوِينَ
verses.en: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travelers,

tafsir.text: We made it a reminder of the fire of Hell and a boon a provision for the desert-travellers al-muqwīn derives from the expression aqwā al-qawmu ‘they have reached al-qawā or al-qawā’ that is al-qafr ‘desolate land’ which is a wilderness mafāza that has neither vegetation nor water.

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

tafsir.text: So glorify exalt the transcendence of the Name ism is extra of your Lord the Tremendous God.

verses.ar: ۞ فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَوَٰقِعِ ٱلنُّجُومِ
verses.en: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,

tafsir.text: Nay I swear fa-lā uqsimu lā is extra by the setting-places of the stars!

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَقَسَمٌ لَّوْ تَعْلَمُونَ عَظِيمٌ
verses.en: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.

tafsir.text: And indeed it the swearing by these setting-places of stars is a tremendous oath if you only knew — if you were people of deep knowledge you would realise the magnitude of this oath.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقُرْءَانٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān.

tafsir.text: This namely what is being recited to you is indeed a noble Qur’ān

verses.ar: فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مَّكْنُونٍ
verses.en: In a Register well-protected;.

tafsir.text: in a Book inscribed guarded preserved and this is the Mushaf;

verses.ar: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْمُطَهَّرُونَ
verses.en: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].

tafsir.text: which none touch lā yamassuhu is a predicate functioning as a prohibitive command except the purified those who have purified themselves of ritual impurities 5680 a revelation revealed by the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

tafsir.text: Do you then belittle do you take lightly and deny this discourse? the Qur’ān.

verses.ar: أَفَبِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ أَنتُم مُّدْهِنُونَ
verses.en: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent

tafsir.text: And for your livelihood in the way of rain that is to say the thanks for it you offer your denial? of God’s granting it to you by saying ‘We have rain because of this or that storm’?

verses.ar: وَتَجْعَلُونَ رِزْقَكُمْ أَنَّكُمْ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?

tafsir.text: And for your livelihood in the way of rain that is to say the thanks for it you offer your denial? of God’s granting it to you by saying ‘We have rain because of this or that storm’?

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلْحُلْقُومَ
verses.en: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat

tafsir.text: Why then when it the spirit during the throes of death reaches the dying person’s throat hulqūm is the passage for food

verses.ar: وَأَنتُمْ حِينَئِذٍ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: And you are at that time looking on -

tafsir.text: and you are O you attending the dying person at that moment looking at him —

verses.ar: وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنكُمْ وَلَـٰكِن لَّا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And We [i.e., Our angels] are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -

tafsir.text: and We are nearer to him than you are to know of his state but you do not perceive tubsirūna derives from al-basīra ‘perception’ that is to say you do not realise this —

verses.ar: فَلَوْلَآ إِن كُنتُمْ غَيْرَ مَدِينِينَ
verses.en: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,

tafsir.text: why then if you are not going to face a reckoning if you are not going to be requited by your being resurrected in other words why then if you are not going to be resurrected as you claim

verses.ar: تَرْجِعُونَهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?

tafsir.text: do you not bring it back why do you not restore the spirit to the body after it has reached the throat if you are truthful? in what you claim the second law-lā ‘why … if’ is repeated to emphasise the first one;

verses.ar: فَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.en: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to Allāh],

tafsir.text: Thus if he the dead person be of those brought near

verses.ar: فَرَوْحٌ وَرَيْحَانٌ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.

tafsir.text: then repose that is there will be for him relief and a goodly provision and a garden of Bliss does this response belong to the ammā ‘thus’ or to in ‘if’ or to both? Different opinions are given regarding this.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: And if he was of the companions of the right,

tafsir.text: And if he be of those of the right hand

verses.ar: فَسَلَـٰمٌ لَّكَ مِنْ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: Then [the angels will say], "Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right."

tafsir.text: then ‘Peace be to you’ that is then for him there will be peace by way of security salām from chastisement a greeting from those of the right hand arising from the fact that he is one of them.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِن كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
verses.en: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,

tafsir.text: But if he be of the deniers the erring

verses.ar: فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ
verses.en: Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

tafsir.text: then a welcome of boiling water

verses.ar: وَتَصْلِيَةُ جَحِيمٍ
verses.en: And burning in Hellfire.

tafsir.text: and a roasting in Hell-fire.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ حَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.en: Indeed, this is the true certainty,

tafsir.text: This indeed is the certain truth haqqu’l-yaqīn an example of an adjectivally qualified noun being annexed to its adjective.

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

tafsir.text: So glorify the Name of your Lord the Tremendous as explained above in verse 74.

verses.ar: سَبَّحَ لِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.en: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts Allāh, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.

tafsir.text: All that is in the heavens and the earth glorifies God that is to say all things exalt Him as being transcendent thus the lām of li’Llāhi is extra; mā ‘all that’ is used instead of min ‘all who’ in order to indicate what is the predominant sc. non-rational beings;

verses.ar: لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۖ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.

tafsir.text: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth; He gives life through His act of creation and He brings death thereafter and He has power over all things.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلْأَوَّلُ وَٱلْـَٔاخِرُ وَٱلظَّـٰهِرُ وَٱلْبَاطِنُ ۖ وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: He is the First and the Last, the Ascendant and the Intimate, and He is, of all things, Knowing.

tafsir.text: He is the First preceding everything but without His having any beginning and the Last succeeding everything but without His having any end and the Manifest through the proofs for Him and the Hidden from the perception of the senses and He has knowledge of all things.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا يَلِجُ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا يَخْرُجُ مِنْهَا وَمَا يَنزِلُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا يَعْرُجُ فِيهَا ۖ وَهُوَ مَعَكُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And Allāh, of what you do, is Seeing.

tafsir.text: It is He Who created the heavens and the earth in six days of the days of this world the first of which being Sunday and the last of which Friday then presided upon the Throne ‘arsh denotes the kursī a presiding that was befitting of Him.

verses.ar: لَّهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.en: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to Allāh are returned [all] matters.

tafsir.text: To Him belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and to Him all matters all existents are returned.

verses.ar: يُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَيُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۚ وَهُوَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

tafsir.text: He makes the night pass into He makes it enter the day so that it increases while the night diminishes and makes the day pass into the night so that it increases while the day diminishes. And He is Knower of what is in the breasts of what it contains of secrets and convictions.

verses.ar: ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَأَنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا جَعَلَكُم مُّسْتَخْلَفِينَ فِيهِ ۖ فَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَأَنفَقُوا۟ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.en: Believe in Allāh and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successive inheritors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.

tafsir.text: Believe adhere to belief in God and His Messenger and expend in the way of God out of that over which He has made you successors out of the wealth of those mentioned whom you have succeeded for you will be succeeded in this wealth by those who will come after you this was revealed at the time of the ‘hardship’

verses.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ لَا تُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۙ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِرَبِّكُمْ وَقَدْ أَخَذَ مِيثَـٰقَكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.en: And why do you not believe in Allāh while the Messenger invites you to believe in your Lord and He has taken your covenant, if you should [truly] be believers?

tafsir.text: And why should you not believe — an address to the disbelievers — in other words there is nothing to prevent you from believing in God when the Messenger is calling you to believe in your Lord and a pledge has been taken from you reading it as ukhidha mīthāqukum;

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُنَزِّلُ عَلَىٰ عَبْدِهِۦٓ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ لِّيُخْرِجَكُم مِّنَ ٱلظُّلُمَـٰتِ إِلَى ٱلنُّورِ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُمْ لَرَءُوفٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muḥammad (ﷺ)] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, Allāh is to you Kind and Merciful.

tafsir.text: It is He Who sends down upon His servant clear signs the signs of the Qur’ān that He may bring you forth from the darkness from disbelief to the light to faith. For truly God is Kind Merciful to you in bringing you forth from disbelief to faith.

verses.ar: وَمَا لَكُمْ أَلَّا تُنفِقُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِلَّهِ مِيرَٰثُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ لَا يَسْتَوِى مِنكُم مَّنْ أَنفَقَ مِن قَبْلِ ٱلْفَتْحِ وَقَـٰتَلَ ۚ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَعْظَمُ دَرَجَةً مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنفَقُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدُ وَقَـٰتَلُوا۟ ۚ وَكُلًّا وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: And why do you not spend in the cause of Allāh while to Allāh belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all Allāh has promised the best [reward]. And Allāh, of what you do, is Aware.

tafsir.text: And why should you after having embraced faith not allā the nūn of an an-lā has been assimilated here with the lām of lā expend in the way of God when to God belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth with all that they comprise so that He will eventually receive all your wealth but without the reward for

verses.ar: مَّن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يُقْرِضُ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا فَيُضَـٰعِفَهُۥ لَهُۥ وَلَهُۥٓ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Who is it that would loan Allāh a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?

tafsir.text: Who is it that will lend God by expending his wealth in the way of God a goodly loan goodly by virtue of his expending it for God’s sake so that He may multiply it fa-yudā‘ifahu may also be read fa-yuda‘‘ifahu for him from tenfold up to more than seven hundredfold —as stated in sūrat al-Baqara Q.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَرَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ يَسْعَىٰ نُورُهُم بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَبِأَيْمَـٰنِهِم بُشْرَىٰكُمُ ٱلْيَوْمَ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
verses.en: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], "Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally." That is what is the great attainment.

tafsir.text: Mention the day when you will see the believing men and believing women with their light shining forth before them in front of them and it will also be on their right and it will be said to them ‘Good tidings for you on this day Gardens that is to say enter them underneath which rivers flow wherein you will abide.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُولُ ٱلْمُنَـٰفِقُونَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقَـٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقْتَبِسْ مِن نُّورِكُمْ قِيلَ ٱرْجِعُوا۟ وَرَآءَكُمْ فَٱلْتَمِسُوا۟ نُورًا فَضُرِبَ بَيْنَهُم بِسُورٍ لَّهُۥ بَابٌۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحْمَةُ وَظَـٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلْعَذَابُ
verses.en: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.

tafsir.text: The day when the hypocrites men and women will say to those who believe ‘Look at us unzurūnā a variant reading has anzirūnā meaning ‘Give us a chance’ that we may glean something of your light!’ It will be said to them in mockery of them ‘Step back and seek light!’ So they step back then there will be set up between

verses.ar: يُنَادُونَهُمْ أَلَمْ نَكُن مَّعَكُمْ ۖ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ وَلَـٰكِنَّكُمْ فَتَنتُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ وَتَرَبَّصْتُمْ وَٱرْتَبْتُمْ وَغَرَّتْكُمُ ٱلْأَمَانِىُّ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ وَغَرَّكُم بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْغَرُورُ
verses.en: They [i.e., the hypocrites] will call to them [i.e., the believers], "Were we not with you?" They will say, "Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of Allāh. And the Deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning Allāh.

tafsir.text: They will call out to them ‘Did we not use to be with you?’ upon the path of obedience. They will say ‘Yes indeed! But you caused your souls to fall into temptation by engaging in hypocrisy and you awaited reversals of fortune for the believers and you doubted you were uncertain about the religion of Islam and false

verses.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ لَا يُؤْخَذُ مِنكُمْ فِدْيَةٌ وَلَا مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ۚ مَأْوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ هِىَ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination."

tafsir.text: So on this day no ransom will be taken from you read tu’khadhu or yu’khadhu nor from those who disbelieved. Your abode will be the Fire it will be your guardian it is the place truly deserving of you and an evil destination!’ it is.

verses.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ يَأْنِ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ أَن تَخْشَعَ قُلُوبُهُمْ لِذِكْرِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا نَزَلَ مِنَ ٱلْحَقِّ وَلَا يَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِن قَبْلُ فَطَالَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْأَمَدُ فَقَسَتْ قُلُوبُهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of Allāh and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Scripture before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.

tafsir.text: Is it not time for those who believe — this was revealed concerning the matter of the Companions of the Prophet who had been overindulging in jest that their hearts should be humbled to the remembrance of God and to what has been revealed read as nuzzila;

verses.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحْىِ ٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.en: Know that Allāh gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.

tafsir.text: Know — an address to the believers just mentioned — that God revives the earth after its death by bringing forth vegetation and likewise He is able to do with your hearts restoring them to humbleness.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُصَّدِّقِينَ وَٱلْمُصَّدِّقَـٰتِ وَأَقْرَضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا يُضَـٰعَفُ لَهُمْ وَلَهُمْ أَجْرٌ كَرِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned Allāh a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.

tafsir.text: Indeed men who give voluntary alms al-mussaddiqīna derives from the infinitive al-tasadduq ‘to give voluntary alms’; the tā’ of the original mutasaddiqīna has been assimilated with the sād and women who give voluntary alms a variant reading for both has the softened form with a single sād musaddiqīna and musaddiqāti

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦٓ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلصِّدِّيقُونَ ۖ وَٱلشُّهَدَآءُ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ أَجْرُهُمْ وَنُورُهُمْ ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: And those who have believed in Allāh and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.

tafsir.text: And those who believe in God and His messengers — they are the truthful al-siddīqūna those who go to the greatest lengths to be truthful and the witnesses with their Lord against the deniers of all communities; they will have their reward and their light.

verses.ar: ٱعْلَمُوٓا۟ أَنَّمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا لَعِبٌ وَلَهْوٌ وَزِينَةٌ وَتَفَاخُرٌۢ بَيْنَكُمْ وَتَكَاثُرٌ فِى ٱلْأَمْوَٰلِ وَٱلْأَوْلَـٰدِ ۖ كَمَثَلِ غَيْثٍ أَعْجَبَ ٱلْكُفَّارَ نَبَاتُهُۥ ثُمَّ يَهِيجُ فَتَرَىٰهُ مُصْفَرًّا ثُمَّ يَكُونُ حُطَـٰمًا ۖ وَفِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ ۚ وَمَا ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَآ إِلَّا مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْغُرُورِ
verses.en: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from Allāh and approval. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.

tafsir.text: Know that the life of this world is merely play and diversion and glitter the frequent adornment of oneself and mutual vainglory in respect of wealth and children that is preoccupation with such things — but as for acts of obedience and incentives thereto these are the concerns of the Hereafter;

verses.ar: سَابِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا كَعَرْضِ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أُعِدَّتْ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرُسُلِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ فَضْلُ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: Race [i.e., compete] toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in Allāh and His messengers. That is the bounty of Allāh which He gives to whom He wills, and Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

tafsir.text: Vie with one another for forgiveness from your Lord and a garden the breadth of which is as the breadth of the heaven and the earth if one were placed at the end of the other prepared for those who believe in God and His messengers.

verses.ar: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٍ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِىٓ أَنفُسِكُمْ إِلَّا فِى كِتَـٰبٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن نَّبْرَأَهَآ ۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٌ
verses.en: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allāh, is easy -

tafsir.text: No affliction befalls in the earth by way of drought for example or in yourselves such as illness or the loss of a child but it is in a Book meaning the Preserved Tablet al-lawh al-mahfūz before We bring it about before We create it — the same is said to be true of God’s graces — that is indeed easy for God

verses.ar: لِّكَيْلَا تَأْسَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا تَفْرَحُوا۟ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ كُلَّ مُخْتَالٍ فَخُورٍ
verses.en: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And Allāh does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -

tafsir.text: so that you may not kay-lā kay makes a verb subjunctive with the same sense as an as in an-lā ‘so that … not’ that is to say God informs you of this so that you may not grieve for what escapes you nor exult with a wanton exultation rather an exultation that is followed by a thanksgiving for the grace at what He has

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَبْخَلُونَ وَيَأْمُرُونَ ٱلنَّاسَ بِٱلْبُخْلِ ۗ وَمَن يَتَوَلَّ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلْغَنِىُّ ٱلْحَمِيدُ
verses.en: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, Allāh is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.

tafsir.text: such as are niggardly in their duties and bid people to be niggardly in these too against such there is a severe threat of chastisement. And whoever turns away from what is his duty still God He is indeed huwa ‘He’ is a separating pronoun;

verses.ar: لَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلَنَا بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَأَنزَلْنَا مَعَهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمِيزَانَ لِيَقُومَ ٱلنَّاسُ بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۖ وَأَنزَلْنَا ٱلْحَدِيدَ فِيهِ بَأْسٌ شَدِيدٌ وَمَنَـٰفِعُ لِلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَنصُرُهُۥ وَرُسُلَهُۥ بِٱلْغَيْبِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَوِىٌّ عَزِيزٌ
verses.en: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Scripture and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that Allāh may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, Allāh is Powerful and Exalted in Might.

tafsir.text: We have verily sent Our messengers the angels to prophets with clear signs with the definitive proofs and We revealed with them the Scripture and the Balance justice so that mankind may uphold justice.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا وَإِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا ٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَٱلْكِتَـٰبَ ۖ فَمِنْهُم مُّهْتَدٍ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and scripture; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.

tafsir.text: And verily We sent Noah and Abraham and We ordained among their seed prophethood and the Scripture meaning the four Books the Torah the Gospel the Psalms and the Furqān all of which have been revealed among the seed of Abraham; and some of them are rightly guided and many of them are immoral.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قَفَّيْنَا عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَـٰرِهِم بِرُسُلِنَا وَقَفَّيْنَا بِعِيسَى ٱبْنِ مَرْيَمَ وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلْإِنجِيلَ وَجَعَلْنَا فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ رَأْفَةً وَرَحْمَةً وَرَهْبَانِيَّةً ٱبْتَدَعُوهَا مَا كَتَبْنَـٰهَا عَلَيْهِمْ إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ رِضْوَٰنِ ٱللَّهِ فَمَا رَعَوْهَا حَقَّ رِعَايَتِهَا ۖ فَـَٔاتَيْنَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ أَجْرَهُمْ ۖ وَكَثِيرٌ مِّنْهُمْ فَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.en: Then We sent following their footsteps [i.e., traditions] Our messengers and followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the approval of Allāh. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.

tafsir.text: Then We sent to follow in their footsteps Our messengers and We sent to follow Jesus son of Mary and We gave him the Gospel and We placed in the hearts of those who followed him kindness and mercy.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَءَامِنُوا۟ بِرَسُولِهِۦ يُؤْتِكُمْ كِفْلَيْنِ مِن رَّحْمَتِهِۦ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ نُورًا تَمْشُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, fear Allāh and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

tafsir.text: O you who believe in Jesus fear God and believe in His Messenger Muhammad (s) and Jesus and He will give you a twofold portion share of His mercy for your belief in both prophets; and He will assign for you a light by which you will walk across the Path over Hell and into Paradise and forgive you;

verses.ar: لِّئَلَّا يَعْلَمَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أَلَّا يَقْدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍ مِّن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَأَنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allāh and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allāh; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allāh is the possessor of great bounty.

tafsir.text: So that the People of the Scripture the Torah — those who did not believe in Muhammad (s) — may know in other words I inform you of this so that they the People of the Scripture may know that a of a-llā is softened in place of the hardened form an-lā its subject being the pronoun of the matter that is to say

verses.ar: قَدْ سَمِعَ ٱللَّهُ قَوْلَ ٱلَّتِى تُجَـٰدِلُكَ فِى زَوْجِهَا وَتَشْتَكِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ يَسْمَعُ تَحَاوُرَكُمَآ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌۢ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Certainly has Allāh heard the speech of the one who argues [i.e., pleads] with you, [O Muḥammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to Allāh. And Allāh hears your dialogue; indeed, Allāh is Hearing and Seeing.

tafsir.text: God has certainly heard the words of her who disputes with you her who consults you O Prophet concerning her husband who has repudiated her by zihār — he had said to her ‘You are to me as untouchable as the back of my mother’.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِنكُم مِّن نِّسَآئِهِم مَّا هُنَّ أُمَّهَـٰتِهِمْ ۖ إِنْ أُمَّهَـٰتُهُمْ إِلَّا ٱلَّـٰٓـِٔى وَلَدْنَهُمْ ۚ وَإِنَّهُمْ لَيَقُولُونَ مُنكَرًا مِّنَ ٱلْقَوْلِ وَزُورًا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَفُوٌّ غَفُورٌ
verses.en: Those who pronounce ẓihār among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, they are saying an objectionable statement and a falsehood. But indeed, Allāh is Pardoning and Forgiving.

tafsir.text: Those of you who repudiate their wives by zihār yazzahharūna is actually yatazahharūna in which the tā’ has been assimilated with the zā’; a variant reading has yazzāharūna and still another has yuzāhirūna similar in form to yuqātilūna;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُظَـٰهِرُونَ مِن نِّسَآئِهِمْ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا قَالُوا۟ فَتَحْرِيرُ رَقَبَةٍ مِّن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۚ ذَٰلِكُمْ تُوعَظُونَ بِهِۦ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: And those who pronounce ẓihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and Allāh is Aware of what you do.

tafsir.text: And those who repudiate their wives by zihār and then go back on what they have said instead doing the opposite of this and retaining the woman divorced by zihār that which is contrary to the purpose of zihār in which a woman is characterised as being forbidden — then the penalty for them is the setting free of a

verses.ar: فَمَن لَّمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَتَمَآسَّا ۖ فَمَن لَّمْ يَسْتَطِعْ فَإِطْعَامُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ لِتُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ ۚ وَتِلْكَ حُدُودُ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: And he who does not find [a slave] - then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. That is for you to believe [completely] in Allāh and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] Allāh. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.

tafsir.text: And he who cannot find the wherewithal to set free a slave then his redemption shall be the fasting of two successive months before they touch one another. And if he is unable to fast then the redemption shall be the feeding of sixty needy persons as an obligation upon him that is before they touch one another

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُحَآدُّونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ كُبِتُوا۟ كَمَا كُبِتَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ وَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ ءَايَـٰتٍۭ بَيِّنَـٰتٍ ۚ وَلِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who oppose Allāh and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment

tafsir.text: Indeed those who oppose God and His Messenger will be abased humiliated just as those before them were abased for opposing their messengers. And verily We have revealed clear signs indicating the truthfulness of the Messenger and for those who disbelieve in the signs there is a humiliating chastisement.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَبْعَثُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ جَمِيعًا فَيُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوٓا۟ ۚ أَحْصَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ وَنَسُوهُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: On the Day when Allāh will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. Allāh had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and Allāh is, over all things, Witness.

tafsir.text: The day when God will raise them all together He will then inform them of what they did. God has kept count of it while they forgot it. And God is Witness to all things.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ مَا يَكُونُ مِن نَّجْوَىٰ ثَلَـٰثَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ رَابِعُهُمْ وَلَا خَمْسَةٍ إِلَّا هُوَ سَادِسُهُمْ وَلَآ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ذَٰلِكَ وَلَآ أَكْثَرَ إِلَّا هُوَ مَعَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كَانُوا۟ ۖ ثُمَّ يُنَبِّئُهُم بِمَا عَمِلُوا۟ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍ عَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Have you not considered that Allāh knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There are not three in a private conversation but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed Allāh is, of all things, Knowing.

tafsir.text: Have you not seen have you not realised that God knows all that is in the heavens and all that is in the earth? Not secret conversation of three takes place but He is their fourth companion by virtue of His omniscience nor of five but He is their sixth nor of fewer than that or more but He is with them wherever they

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ نُهُوا۟ عَنِ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ ثُمَّ يَعُودُونَ لِمَا نُهُوا۟ عَنْهُ وَيَتَنَـٰجَوْنَ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَإِذَا جَآءُوكَ حَيَّوْكَ بِمَا لَمْ يُحَيِّكَ بِهِ ٱللَّهُ وَيَقُولُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِمْ لَوْلَا يُعَذِّبُنَا ٱللَّهُ بِمَا نَقُولُ ۚ حَسْبُهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ يَصْلَوْنَهَا ۖ فَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from private conversation [i.e., ridicule and conspiracy] and then return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which Allāh does not greet you and say among themselves, "Why does Allāh not punish us for what we say?" Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.

tafsir.text: Have you not seen have you not observed those who were forbidden from conversing in secret but then returned to that they had been forbidden and all the while hold secret conversations tainted with sin and plans for enmity and disobedience to the Messenger? These were the Jews whom the Prophet s had forbidden them

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا تَنَـٰجَيْتُمْ فَلَا تَتَنَـٰجَوْا۟ بِٱلْإِثْمِ وَٱلْعُدْوَٰنِ وَمَعْصِيَتِ ٱلرَّسُولِ وَتَنَـٰجَوْا۟ بِٱلْبِرِّ وَٱلتَّقْوَىٰ ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ٱلَّذِىٓ إِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you converse privately, do not converse about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear Allāh, to whom you will be gathered.

tafsir.text: O you who believe if you do talk in secret then do not talk in secret sinfully and in enmity and disobedience to the Messenger but talk secretly in piety and fear of God. And fear God to Whom you will be gathered.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ لِيَحْزُنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَلَيْسَ بِضَآرِّهِمْ شَيْـًٔا إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Private conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of Allāh. And upon Allāh let the believers rely.

tafsir.text: Secret conversations tainted with sin and the like are of the work of Satan a result of his deception that those who believe may end up grieving; but he cannot harm them in any way except God’s leave that is except by His will. And in God let the believers put all their trust.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا قِيلَ لَكُمْ تَفَسَّحُوا۟ فِى ٱلْمَجَـٰلِسِ فَٱفْسَحُوا۟ يَفْسَحِ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا قِيلَ ٱنشُزُوا۟ فَٱنشُزُوا۟ يَرْفَعِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمَ دَرَجَـٰتٍ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ خَبِيرٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you are told, "Space yourselves" in assemblies, then make space; Allāh will make space for you. And when you are told, "Arise," then arise; Allāh will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

tafsir.text: O you who believe when it is said to you ‘Make room’ during the assembly during the assembly convened with the Prophet s or for remembrance so that those arriving to join you may find room to sit al-majlis ‘assembly’ may also be read in the plural al-majālis then make room; God will make room for you in Paradise.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِذَا نَـٰجَيْتُمُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَةً ۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ لَّكُمْ وَأَطْهَرُ ۚ فَإِن لَّمْ تَجِدُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.en: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

tafsir.text: O you who believe when you converse in secret with the Messenger when you wish to converse with him privately offer some voluntary alms before your secret talk. That is better for you and purer for your sins.

verses.ar: ءَأَشْفَقْتُمْ أَن تُقَدِّمُوا۟ بَيْنَ يَدَىْ نَجْوَىٰكُمْ صَدَقَـٰتٍ ۚ فَإِذْ لَمْ تَفْعَلُوا۟ وَتَابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْكُمْ فَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Have you feared to present before your consultation charities? Then when you do not and Allāh has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakāh and obey Allāh and His Messenger. And Allāh is Aware of what you do.

tafsir.text: Do you fear read a-ashfaqtum either pronouncing both hamzas fully or by replacing the second one with an alif or not pronouncing it but inserting an alif between the one not unpronounced and the other one or without this insertion poverty when you fear to offer voluntary alms before your secret talks.

verses.ar: ۞ أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ قَوْمًا غَضِبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيْهِم مَّا هُم مِّنكُمْ وَلَا مِنْهُمْ وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى ٱلْكَذِبِ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom Allāh has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].

tafsir.text: Have you not regarded have you not seen those who — these being the hypocrites — fraternise with a folk — these being the Jews — at whom God is wrathful? They the hypocrites neither belong with you the believers nor with them the Jews but are suspended in between and they swear falsely in other words saying that they

verses.ar: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا ۖ إِنَّهُمْ سَآءَ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: Allāh has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.

tafsir.text: God has prepared for them a severe chastisement. Evil indeed is that which they are wont to do in the way of acts of disobedience.

verses.ar: ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ أَيْمَـٰنَهُمْ جُنَّةً فَصَدُّوا۟ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِينٌ
verses.en: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they averted [people] from the way of Allāh, and for them is a humiliating punishment.

tafsir.text: They have taken their oaths as a shield a means of protection for themselves and their possessions and so they bar thereby the believers from the way of God that is from engaging in a struggle against them thereby slaying them and seizing their possessions.
