tafsir.text: O you who believe! Repent to God with sincere repentance read nasūhan or nusūhan a truthful repentance so that one does not return to committing that sin again nor have the desire to return to it.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ جَـٰهِدِ ٱلْكُفَّارَ وَٱلْمُنَـٰفِقِينَ وَٱغْلُظْ عَلَيْهِمْ ۚ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.

tafsir.text: O Prophet! Struggle against the disbelievers with the sword and the hypocrites by the tongue and with argument and be stern with them in rebuke and hatred. For their abode will be Hell — and what an evil journey’s end! it is.

verses.ar: ضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ نُوحٍ وَٱمْرَأَتَ لُوطٍ ۖ كَانَتَا تَحْتَ عَبْدَيْنِ مِنْ عِبَادِنَا صَـٰلِحَيْنِ فَخَانَتَاهُمَا فَلَمْ يُغْنِيَا عَنْهُمَا مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا وَقِيلَ ٱدْخُلَا ٱلنَّارَ مَعَ ٱلدَّٰخِلِينَ
verses.en: Allāh presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from Allāh at all, and it was said, "Enter the Fire with those who enter."

tafsir.text: God has struck a similitude for those who disbelieve the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants yet they betrayed them in their religion for they both disbelieved — Noah’s wife called Wāhila used to say to his people that he was a madman while Lot’s wife called Wā‘ila used to

verses.ar: وَضَرَبَ ٱللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱمْرَأَتَ فِرْعَوْنَ إِذْ قَالَتْ رَبِّ ٱبْنِ لِى عِندَكَ بَيْتًا فِى ٱلْجَنَّةِ وَنَجِّنِى مِن فِرْعَوْنَ وَعَمَلِهِۦ وَنَجِّنِى مِنَ ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: And Allāh presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, "My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people."

tafsir.text: And God has struck a similitude for those who believe the wife of Pharaoh — she believed in Moses her name was Āsiya; Pharaoh chastised her by tying her hands and feet to pegs and placing a huge millstone on her chest and having her laid out in the sun;

verses.ar: وَمَرْيَمَ ٱبْنَتَ عِمْرَٰنَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أَحْصَنَتْ فَرْجَهَا فَنَفَخْنَا فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِنَا وَصَدَّقَتْ بِكَلِمَـٰتِ رَبِّهَا وَكُتُبِهِۦ وَكَانَتْ مِنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ
verses.en: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ʿImrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His scriptures and was of the devoutly obedient.

tafsir.text: And Mary wa-Maryama is a supplement to imra’ata Fir‘awna daughter of ‘Imrān who preserved the chastity of her womb so We breathed into it of Our Spirit namely Gabriel — when he breathed into the opening of her shirt by God’s creation of this action of his which reached her womb thus conceiving Jesus — and she

verses.ar: تَبَـٰرَكَ ٱلَّذِى بِيَدِهِ ٱلْمُلْكُ وَهُوَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.en: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -

tafsir.text: Blessed exalted above the attributes of created beings is He in Whose hand at Whose disposal is all sovereignty all authority and power and He has power over all things.

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلْمَوْتَ وَٱلْحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبْلُوَكُمْ أَيُّكُمْ أَحْسَنُ عَمَلًا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْغَفُورُ
verses.en: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -

tafsir.text: He Who created death in this world and life in the Hereafter — or both of them in this world since the sperm-drop is imbued with life life being that power by which sensation becomes possible death being the opposite of this or the non-existence of it — these being two alternative opinions;

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا ۖ مَّا تَرَىٰ فِى خَلْقِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مِن تَفَـٰوُتٍ ۖ فَٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ هَلْ تَرَىٰ مِن فُطُورٍ
verses.en: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?

tafsir.text: Who created seven heavens in layers one above the other without any contact between them. You do not see in the Compassionate One’s creation of these or of other things any irregularity any disparity or discordance.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱرْجِعِ ٱلْبَصَرَ كَرَّتَيْنِ يَنقَلِبْ إِلَيْكَ ٱلْبَصَرُ خَاسِئًا وَهُوَ حَسِيرٌ
verses.en: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.

tafsir.text: Then cast your eyes yet again once and then twice and your sight will return to you humbled abject on account of it not perceiving any fissure and wearied unable to see any fissure.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ زَيَّنَّا ٱلسَّمَآءَ ٱلدُّنْيَا بِمَصَـٰبِيحَ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهَا رُجُومًا لِّلشَّيَـٰطِينِ ۖ وَأَعْتَدْنَا لَهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.

tafsir.text: And verily We have adorned the lowest heaven the one closest to the earth with lamps with stars and made them missiles against the devils should they attempt to listen by stealth in which case a meteor of fire detaches itself from the star just like a brand is taken from a fire and either kills that jinn or deprives

verses.ar: وَلِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِرَبِّهِمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ ۖ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.en: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.

tafsir.text: And for those who disbelieve in their Lord there is the chastisement of Hell and what an evil journey’s end! it is.

verses.ar: إِذَآ أُلْقُوا۟ فِيهَا سَمِعُوا۟ لَهَا شَهِيقًا وَهِىَ تَفُورُ
verses.en: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.

tafsir.text: When they are flung into it they hear it blaring producing a horrid sound like that of an ass as it seethes

verses.ar: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلْقِىَ فِيهَا فَوْجٌ سَأَلَهُمْ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمْ يَأْتِكُمْ نَذِيرٌ
verses.en: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"

tafsir.text: almost exploding tamayyazu a variant reading has the original form tatamayyazu ripped apart with rage in wrath against the disbelievers. Whenever a host a group of them is flung into it its keepers ask them an interrogation of rebuke ‘Did there not come to you a warner?’ a messenger to warn you of God’s chastisement.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَدْ جَآءَنَا نَذِيرٌ فَكَذَّبْنَا وَقُلْنَا مَا نَزَّلَ ٱللَّهُ مِن شَىْءٍ إِنْ أَنتُمْ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ كَبِيرٍ
verses.en: They will say, "Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, 'Allāh has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.'"

tafsir.text: They will say ‘Yes a warner did indeed come to us but we denied and said “God has not revealed anything; you are assuredly in great error”’ this last words may be the words of the angels spoken to the disbelievers when they are told of the denial or they may belong to the words of the disbelievers spoken to the

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْ كُنَّا نَسْمَعُ أَوْ نَعْقِلُ مَا كُنَّا فِىٓ أَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And they will say, "If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze."

tafsir.text: And they will say ‘Had we listened that is listening so as to understand or comprehended that is comprehension entailing reflection upon the truth we would not have been among the inhabitants of the Blaze’.

verses.ar: فَٱعْتَرَفُوا۟ بِذَنۢبِهِمْ فَسُحْقًا لِّأَصْحَـٰبِ ٱلسَّعِيرِ
verses.en: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.

tafsir.text: Thus they will confess when confession is of no avail their sin which was their denial of the warners. So away suhqan or suhuqan with the inhabitants of the Blaze! so far away may they be from God’s mercy.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَخْشَوْنَ رَبَّهُم بِٱلْغَيْبِ لَهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ وَأَجْرٌ كَبِيرٌ
verses.en: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.

tafsir.text: Assuredly those who fear their Lord in secret while they are absent from people’s eyes being obedient to Him in secret such that openly before people it is all the more likely that they fear their Lord — there will be for them forgiveness and a great reward namely Paradise.

verses.ar: وَأَسِرُّوا۟ قَوْلَكُمْ أَوِ ٱجْهَرُوا۟ بِهِۦٓ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.en: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.

tafsir.text: And whether you keep secret O people your speech or proclaim it He indeed exalted be He is Knower of what is in the breasts of what they contain so how much more so is He Knower in the case of what you utter openly — the reason for the revelation of this verse was that the idolaters said to one another ‘Speak secretly

verses.ar: أَلَا يَعْلَمُ مَنْ خَلَقَ وَهُوَ ٱللَّطِيفُ ٱلْخَبِيرُ
verses.en: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Aware?

tafsir.text: Will He Who has created not know? what you keep secret in other words will His knowledge of things be precluded by such secret speech? And He is the Subtle in His knowledge the Aware therein.

verses.ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ ذَلُولًا فَٱمْشُوا۟ فِى مَنَاكِبِهَا وَكُلُوا۟ مِن رِّزْقِهِۦ ۖ وَإِلَيْهِ ٱلنُّشُورُ
verses.en: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.

tafsir.text: It is He Who made the earth tractable for you easy for you to walk on; so walk in its flanks and eat of His provision that has been created for you; and to Him is the resurrection from the graves for the Requital.

verses.ar: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخْسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَمُورُ
verses.en: Do you feel secure that He who is above would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?

tafsir.text: Are you secure read a-amintum pronouncing both hamzas fully or by not pronouncing the second one inserting an alif between it and the other one or without the insertion but replacing it with an alif instead in thinking that He Who is in the heaven that He Whose authority and power is in the heaven will not cause the

verses.ar: أَمْ أَمِنتُم مَّن فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يُرْسِلَ عَلَيْكُمْ حَاصِبًا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ كَيْفَ نَذِيرِ
verses.en: Or do you feel secure that He who is above would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.

tafsir.text: Are you secure in thinking that He Who is in the heaven will not unleash an yursila substitutes for man ‘He Who’ upon you a squall of pebbles? a wind hurling pebbles at you.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
verses.en: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.

tafsir.text: And verily those communities who were before them denied then see how was My rebuttal! how was My rebuttal of them in destroying them when they denied in other words how it was true.

verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلطَّيْرِ فَوْقَهُمْ صَـٰٓفَّـٰتٍ وَيَقْبِضْنَ ۚ مَا يُمْسِكُهُنَّ إِلَّا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَىْءٍۭ بَصِيرٌ
verses.en: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.

tafsir.text: Or have they not seen the birds above them in the air spreading their wings and closing? their wings after spreading them? in other words read wa-yaqbidna as wa-qābidātin similar to sāffātin ‘spreading’.

verses.ar: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى هُوَ جُندٌ لَّكُمْ يَنصُرُكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۚ إِنِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ إِلَّا فِى غُرُورٍ
verses.en: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.

tafsir.text: Or who am-man the subject is it hādhā its predicate that alladhī a substitution for hādhā ‘is it’ will be an army supporters for you lakum belongs to the relative clause of alladhī ‘that’ to help you yansurukum is an adjectival qualification of jundun ‘an army’ besides the Compassionate One? that is to say other than

verses.ar: أَمَّنْ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى يَرْزُقُكُمْ إِنْ أَمْسَكَ رِزْقَهُۥ ۚ بَل لَّجُّوا۟ فِى عُتُوٍّ وَنُفُورٍ
verses.en: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.

tafsir.text: Or who is it that will provide for you if He the Compassionate One withholds His provision? that is to say if He withholds the rain from you the response to the conditional has been omitted but is indicated by what preceded it namely the statement to the effect ‘who will provide for you?’ and so the response would be

verses.ar: أَفَمَن يَمْشِى مُكِبًّا عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦٓ أَهْدَىٰٓ أَمَّن يَمْشِى سَوِيًّا عَلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.en: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?

tafsir.text: Is he who walks cast down fallen on his face more rightly guided or he who walks upright on a straight path? the predicate of the second man ‘who’ has been omitted but is indicated by the predicate of the first namely ahdā ‘more rightly guided’;

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنشَأَكُمْ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۖ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful."

tafsir.text: Say ‘It is He Who created you and endowed you with hearing and sight and hearts. Little do you thank!’ mā tashkurūna mā is extra; the sentence itself is a new independent one informing of how extremely little they give thanks for these graces.

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلَّذِى ذَرَأَكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَإِلَيْهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.en: Say, "It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered."

tafsir.text: Say ‘It is He Who multiplied you created you on earth and to Him you will be gathered’ for the Reckoning.

verses.ar: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْوَعْدُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: And they say, "When is this promise, if you should be truthful?"

tafsir.text: And they say to the believers ‘When will this promise be fulfilled the promise of the gathering if you are truthful?’ about it.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَا ٱلْعِلْمُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَإِنَّمَآ أَنَا۠ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: Say, "The knowledge is only with Allāh, and I am only a clear warner."

tafsir.text: Say ‘The knowledge of its coming is only with God and I am but a plain warner’ one whose warning is plain.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهُ زُلْفَةً سِيٓـَٔتْ وُجُوهُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقِيلَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تَدَّعُونَ
verses.en: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, "This is that for which you used to call."

tafsir.text: But when they see it that is the chastisement after the gathering near at hand the faces of those who disbelieved will be awry blackened and it will be said that is the keepers of Hell will say to them ‘This is that chastisement which the warning of which you used to make claims about’ claims to the effect that you

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَهْلَكَنِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَمَن مَّعِىَ أَوْ رَحِمَنَا فَمَن يُجِيرُ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "Have you considered: whether Allāh should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?"

tafsir.text: Say ‘Have you considered If God destroys me and those with me of believers by His chastisement as you would have it or has mercy on us and does not chastise us who then will protect the disbelievers from a painful chastisement?’ in other words they will have no protector from it.

verses.ar: قُلْ هُوَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَعَلَيْهِ تَوَكَّلْنَا ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ هُوَ فِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.en: Say, "He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error."

tafsir.text: Say ‘He is the Compassionate One; we believe in Him and in Him we put our trust. And assuredly you will soon know sa-ta‘lamūna is also read sa-ya‘lamūna ‘they will know’ upon seeing the chastisement with your own eyes who is in manifest error’ is it us or yourselves or them?

verses.ar: قُلْ أَرَءَيْتُمْ إِنْ أَصْبَحَ مَآؤُكُمْ غَوْرًا فَمَن يَأْتِيكُم بِمَآءٍ مَّعِينٍۭ
verses.en: Say, "Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?"

tafsir.text: Say ‘Have you considered If your water were to sink deep into the earth who then will bring you running water?’ which hands and buckets would be able to reach like they do your water in other words none but God exalted be He would be able to bring it so how can you reject that He will resurrect you? It is commendable

verses.ar: نٓ ۚ وَٱلْقَلَمِ وَمَا يَسْطُرُونَ
verses.en: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,

tafsir.text: Nūn one of the letters of the alphabet God knows best what He means by it. By the Pen with which He has inscribed the records of all creatures in the Preserved Tablet and what they inscribe that is the angels of good and righteousness.

verses.ar: مَآ أَنتَ بِنِعْمَةِ رَبِّكَ بِمَجْنُونٍ
verses.en: You are not, [O Muḥammad], by the favor of your Lord, a madman.

tafsir.text: You are not O Muhammad (s) by the grace of your Lord a madman that is to say madness is precluded in your case on account of your Lord’s grace to you by way of His assigning to you prophethood and in other ways — this was a refutation of their saying that he was a madman.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ لَكَ لَأَجْرًا غَيْرَ مَمْنُونٍ
verses.en: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.

tafsir.text: And assuredly you will have an unfailing reward.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّكَ لَعَلَىٰ خُلُقٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.

tafsir.text: And assuredly you possess a magnificent nature a magnificent religion.

verses.ar: فَسَتُبْصِرُ وَيُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: So you will see and they will see.

tafsir.text: Then you will see and they will see

verses.ar: بِأَييِّكُمُ ٱلْمَفْتُونُ
verses.en: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].

tafsir.text: which of you is demented al-maftūn is a verbal noun similar in expressional form to al-ma‘qūl ‘intelligible’; al-futūn meaning al-junūn ‘insanity’ in other words is it this insanity in you or in them?

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِمَن ضَلَّ عَن سَبِيلِهِۦ وَهُوَ أَعْلَمُ بِٱلْمُهْتَدِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.

tafsir.text: Assuredly your Lord knows best those who stray from His way and He knows best those who are guided to Him.

verses.ar: فَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Then do not obey the deniers.

tafsir.text: So do not obey the deniers.

verses.ar: وَدُّوا۟ لَوْ تُدْهِنُ فَيُدْهِنُونَ
verses.en: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].

tafsir.text: They desire they yearn that law relates to the verbal action you should be pliable that you should yield to them so that they may be pliable towards you so that they may yield to you fa-yudhinūna is a supplement to tudhinu ‘you should be pliable’ but if it is understood to be the response to the optative clause of

verses.ar: وَلَا تُطِعْ كُلَّ حَلَّافٍ مَّهِينٍ
verses.en: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer

tafsir.text: And do not obey any mean despicable oath-monger given to frequent swearing by falsehood

verses.ar: هَمَّازٍ مَّشَّآءٍۭ بِنَمِيمٍ
verses.en: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -

tafsir.text: backbiting faultfinder that is to say calumniator scandal-monger spreading evil talk among people in order to sow dissension between them

verses.ar: مَّنَّاعٍ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.en: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,

tafsir.text: hinderer of good niggardly with his wealth against deserving causes sinful transgressor wrongdoer

verses.ar: عُتُلٍّۭ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ زَنِيمٍ
verses.en: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.

tafsir.text: coarse-grained crude moreover ignoble an adopted son of Quraysh — namely al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra whose father claimed him after eighteen years; Ibn ‘Abbās said ‘We know of no one whom God has described in the derogatory way in which He describes him blighting him with ignominy that will never leave him the adverbial

verses.ar: أَن كَانَ ذَا مَالٍ وَبَنِينَ
verses.en: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,

tafsir.text: only because an should be understood as li-an ‘because’ and it is semantically connected to that meaning which it is indicating he has wealth and sons.

verses.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

tafsir.text: When Our signs — the Qur’ān — are recited to him he says that they are merely ‘Fables of the ancients!’ in other words he denies them in arrogance on account of the mentioned things which We have bestowed on him out of Our grace a variant reading for an of the previous verse has the interrogative a-an.

verses.ar: سَنَسِمُهُۥ عَلَى ٱلْخُرْطُومِ
verses.en: We will brand him upon the snout.

tafsir.text: We shall brand him on the snout We shall leave a distinguishing mark upon his nose one by which he will be reviled for as long as he lives; and so his nose was chopped off by a sword at Badr.

verses.ar: إِنَّا بَلَوْنَـٰهُمْ كَمَا بَلَوْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ إِذْ أَقْسَمُوا۟ لَيَصْرِمُنَّهَا مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning

tafsir.text: Indeed We have tried them We have tested the people of Mecca with drought and famine just as We tried the owners of the garden the orchard when they vowed that they would pluck that they would pick its fruits in the morning so that the poor folk would not notice them and so that they would not then have to give them

verses.ar: وَلَا يَسْتَثْنُونَ
verses.en: Without making exception.

tafsir.text: And they did not make any exception to their vow for God’s will the sentence is a new syntactically independent one in other words and that was their condition.

verses.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَيْهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمْ نَآئِمُونَ
verses.en: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.

tafsir.text: Then a visitation from your Lord visited it that is a fire consumed it during the night while they slept.

verses.ar: فَأَصْبَحَتْ كَٱلصَّرِيمِ
verses.en: And it became as though reaped.

tafsir.text: So by the morning it was like the darkness of night in other words black.

verses.ar: فَتَنَادَوْا۟ مُصْبِحِينَ
verses.en: And they called one another at morning,

tafsir.text: They then called out to one another in the morning

verses.ar: أَنِ ٱغْدُوا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْثِكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰرِمِينَ
verses.en: [Saying], "Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit."

tafsir.text: saying ‘Go forth early to your tillage your produce ani’ghdū ‘alā harthikum constitutes an explication of the import of tanādaw ‘they called out to one another’; otherwise an relates to the verbal action to be understood as being bi-an if you are going to pluck’ if your intention is to pick the fruits the response to

verses.ar: فَٱنطَلَقُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ
verses.en: So they set out, while lowering their voices,

tafsir.text: So off they went whispering to one another talking secretly

verses.ar: أَن لَّا يَدْخُلَنَّهَا ٱلْيَوْمَ عَلَيْكُم مِّسْكِينٌ
verses.en: [Saying], "There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person."

tafsir.text: ‘No needy person shall today come to you in it’ this constitutes the explication of the preceding verse; or else an relates to the verbal action to be understood to mean bi-an.

verses.ar: وَغَدَوْا۟ عَلَىٰ حَرْدٍ قَـٰدِرِينَ
verses.en: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.

tafsir.text: And they went forth early supposing themselves able to prohibit to prevent the poor folk from enjoying the fruit.

verses.ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْهَا قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.en: But when they saw it, they said, "Indeed, we are lost;

tafsir.text: But when they saw it blackened and charred they said ‘Assuredly we have strayed!’ from it that is to say this is not the one. Then when they recognised it they said

verses.ar: بَلْ نَحْنُ مَحْرُومُونَ
verses.en: Rather, we have been deprived."

tafsir.text: ‘Nay but we have been deprived!’ of its fruits by our denying it to the poor folk.

verses.ar: قَالَ أَوْسَطُهُمْ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ لَوْلَا تُسَبِّحُونَ
verses.en: The most moderate of them said, "Did I not say to you, 'Why do you not exalt [Allāh]?'"

tafsir.text: The most moderate the best one among them said ‘Did I not say to you “Why do you not glorify?” ’ God repenting to Him.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سُبْحَـٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا ظَـٰلِمِينَ
verses.en: They said, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

tafsir.text: They said ‘Glory be to God our Lord. Verily we have been wrongdoers’ by denying the poor folk what is their due.

verses.ar: فَأَقْبَلَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَىٰ بَعْضٍ يَتَلَـٰوَمُونَ
verses.en: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.

tafsir.text: They then turned to one another blaming each other.

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰوَيْلَنَآ إِنَّا كُنَّا طَـٰغِينَ
verses.en: They said, "O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.

tafsir.text: They said ‘O yā is for calling attention to something woe to us! O destruction of ours. We have indeed been unjust.

verses.ar: عَسَىٰ رَبُّنَآ أَن يُبْدِلَنَا خَيْرًا مِّنْهَآ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا رَٰغِبُونَ
verses.en: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous."

tafsir.text: It may be that our Lord will give us in its place read yubaddilanā or yubdilanā one that is better than it. Truly we turn humbly to our Lord’ that He might accept our repentance and give us back a garden that is better than our garden — it is reported that they were indeed given a better one in its place.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَكْبَرُ ۚ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.

tafsir.text: Such that is to say like the chastisement for these people will be the chastisement for those disbelievers of Mecca and others who contravene Our command; and the chastisement of the Hereafter is assuredly greater did they but know its chastisement they would not have contavened Our command.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.

tafsir.text: Verily for the God-fearing there will be the Gardens of Bliss near their Lord.

verses.ar: أَفَنَجْعَلُ ٱلْمُسْلِمِينَ كَٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?

tafsir.text: Are We then to treat those who submit to Us as We treat the sinners? that is to say as belonging with them in terms of reward?

verses.ar: مَا لَكُمْ كَيْفَ تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?

tafsir.text: What is wrong with you? How do you judge? with such corrupt judgement?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ كِتَـٰبٌ فِيهِ تَدْرُسُونَ
verses.en: Or do you have a scripture in which you learn

tafsir.text: Or am lakum means a-lakum do you have a Scripture revealed wherein you learn wherein you read

verses.ar: إِنَّ لَكُمْ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
verses.en: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?

tafsir.text: that you will indeed have in it whatever you choose?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَكُمْ أَيْمَـٰنٌ عَلَيْنَا بَـٰلِغَةٌ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۙ إِنَّ لَكُمْ لَمَا تَحْكُمُونَ
verses.en: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?

tafsir.text: Or do you have oaths pledges binding secured on Us until the Day of Resurrection ilā yawmi’l-qiyāmati is semantically connected to ‘alaynā ‘on Us’; these words ‘alaynā bālighatun ‘binding on Us’ contain the sense of an oath given in other words ‘Did We swear to you?’ the response to which is what follows that you will

verses.ar: سَلْهُمْ أَيُّهُم بِذَٰلِكَ زَعِيمٌ
verses.en: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.

tafsir.text: Ask them which of them will aver will guarantee for them that? that decision which they have made for themselves namely that they will be given better reward than the believers in the Hereafter?

verses.ar: أَمْ لَهُمْ شُرَكَآءُ فَلْيَأْتُوا۟ بِشُرَكَآئِهِمْ إِن كَانُوا۟ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.en: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.

tafsir.text: Or do they have partners? who agree with them in this claim of theirs and able to guarantee it for them; if that is the case Then let them produce their partners those who will guarantee this for them if they are truthful.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُكْشَفُ عَن سَاقٍ وَيُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ فَلَا يَسْتَطِيعُونَ
verses.en: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,

tafsir.text: Mention the day when the shank is bared an expression denoting the severity of the predicament during the reckoning and the requital on the Day of Resurrection one says kashafati’l-harbu ‘an sāqin ‘the war has bared its shank’ to mean that it has intensified and they are summoned to prostrate themselves as a test of

verses.ar: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۖ وَقَدْ كَانُوا۟ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمْ سَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.

tafsir.text: With humbled khāshi‘atan is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the person of the verb yud‘awna ‘they are summoned’ that is to say with abject gazes which they do not raise they will be overcast enveloped by abasement;

verses.ar: فَذَرْنِى وَمَن يُكَذِّبُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْحَدِيثِ ۖ سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُم مِّنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: So leave Me, [O Muḥammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.

tafsir.text: So leave Me to deal with those who deny this discourse — the Qur’ān. We will draw them on by degrees We will seize them little by little whence they do not know.

verses.ar: وَأُمْلِى لَهُمْ ۚ إِنَّ كَيْدِى مَتِينٌ
verses.en: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.

tafsir.text: And I will grant them respite; for assuredly My devising is firm My devising is severe and cannot be withstood.

verses.ar: أَمْ تَسْـَٔلُهُمْ أَجْرًا فَهُم مِّن مَّغْرَمٍ مُّثْقَلُونَ
verses.en: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?

tafsir.text: Or are you asking them a fee in return for delivering the Message so that they are weighed down with debt? so that they are weighed down with what they will have to give you and that is why they do not believe.

verses.ar: أَمْ عِندَهُمُ ٱلْغَيْبُ فَهُمْ يَكْتُبُونَ
verses.en: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?

tafsir.text: Or do they possess access to the Unseen that is access to the Preserved Tablet which contains knowledge of the Unseen so that they are writing down? from it what they say.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلْحُوتِ إِذْ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكْظُومٌ
verses.en: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muḥammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.

tafsir.text: So await patiently the judgement of your Lord regarding them in the way that He wills and do not be like the one of the whale in terms of impatience and haste — this is Jonah peace be upon him — who called out who supplicated his Lord choking with grief filled with anguish inside the belly of the whale.

verses.ar: لَّوْلَآ أَن تَدَٰرَكَهُۥ نِعْمَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ لَنُبِذَ بِٱلْعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذْمُومٌ
verses.en: If not that a favor [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.

tafsir.text: Had it not been for a grace a mercy from his Lord that reached him he would have surely been cast out of the belly of the whale onto a wilderness a desolate land while he was blameworthy — but he was shown mercy and was therefore cast out blameless.

verses.ar: فَٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَجَعَلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.en: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.

tafsir.text: But his Lord chose him for prophethood and made him one of the righteous the prophets.

verses.ar: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَيُزْلِقُونَكَ بِأَبْصَـٰرِهِمْ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا۟ ٱلذِّكْرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجْنُونٌ
verses.en: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."

tafsir.text: Indeed those who disbelieve would almost throw you down to the ground read la-yuzliqūnaka or la-yazliqūnaka with their looks looking at you in a severe way almost hurling you to the ground or making you fall from your place when they hear the Reminder the Qur’ān and they say out of envy ‘He is truly a madman!’ on

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.

tafsir.text: Yet it namely the Qur’ān is just a Reminder an admonition for all the worlds of both humans and jinn and cannot be the cause of any dementia.

verses.ar: ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.en: The Inevitable Reality -

tafsir.text: The Reality the Resurrection in which is realised the truth of all that was rejected in the way of the raising from the graves the reckoning and the requital or it means the Resurrection which will manifest all of that.

verses.ar: مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.en: What is the Inevitable Reality?

tafsir.text: What is the Reality? ma’l-hāqqa an interrogative to emphasise its enormity; this is the subject as well as the predicate of the previous al-hāqqa ‘the Reality’.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْحَآقَّةُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?

tafsir.text: And how would you know what the Reality is? repeated as an extra emphasis of its enormity; the first mā of the previous verse is the subject the second one its predicate; the second mā and its predicate also function as the second direct object of the verb ‘knowing’.

verses.ar: كَذَّبَتْ ثَمُودُ وَعَادٌۢ بِٱلْقَارِعَةِ
verses.en: Thamūd and ʿAad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].

tafsir.text: Thamūd and ‘Ād denied the Clatterer the Resurrection because its terrors cause the hearts to clatter.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ثَمُودُ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِٱلطَّاغِيَةِ
verses.en: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].

tafsir.text: As for Thamūd they were destroyed by the overwhelming Roar an excessively severe cry.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا عَادٌ فَأُهْلِكُوا۟ بِرِيحٍ صَرْصَرٍ عَاتِيَةٍ
verses.en: And as for ʿAad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind

tafsir.text: And as for ‘Ād they were destroyed by a deafening intensely clamorous violent wind that was powerful and severe in its assault upon ‘Ād despite their power and might.

verses.ar: سَخَّرَهَا عَلَيْهِمْ سَبْعَ لَيَالٍ وَثَمَـٰنِيَةَ أَيَّامٍ حُسُومًا فَتَرَى ٱلْقَوْمَ فِيهَا صَرْعَىٰ كَأَنَّهُمْ أَعْجَازُ نَخْلٍ خَاوِيَةٍ
verses.en: Which He [i.e., Allāh] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.

tafsir.text: He forced it upon them for seven nights and eight days the first of which was the morning of Wednesday eight days before the end of the month of Shawwāl and this was at the height of winter successively one after the next husūman it the action of the wind is likened to the repeated actions of a hāsim ‘one cauterizing

verses.ar: فَهَلْ تَرَىٰ لَهُم مِّنۢ بَاقِيَةٍ
verses.en: Then do you see of them any remains?

tafsir.text: So do you see any remnant of them? min bāqiyatin this is either the adjectival qualification of an implicit nafs ‘soul’ or the final suffixed tā’ is for hyperbole in other words understand it as fa-hal tarā lahum min bāqin ‘any one remaining?’ No!.

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَمَن قَبْلَهُۥ وَٱلْمُؤْتَفِكَـٰتُ بِٱلْخَاطِئَةِ
verses.en: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.

tafsir.text: And Pharaoh and those of his followers man qibalahu a variant reading has man qablahu that is to say those disbelieving communities who came before him and the Deviant cities that is their inhabitants — these being the cities of the people of Lot — brought iniquity they committed deeds that were iniquitous.

verses.ar: فَعَصَوْا۟ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمْ فَأَخَذَهُمْ أَخْذَةً رَّابِيَةً
verses.en: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].

tafsir.text: Then they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord namely Lot and others so He seized them with a devastating blow one surpassing others in its severity.

verses.ar: إِنَّا لَمَّا طَغَا ٱلْمَآءُ حَمَلْنَـٰكُمْ فِى ٱلْجَارِيَةِ
verses.en: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship

tafsir.text: Truly when the waters rose high when they rose above all things including mountains and otherwise at the time of the Flood We carried you meaning your forefathers you being in their loins in the sailing vessel the ark which Noah built and by which he and those with him were saved while all the others drowned

verses.ar: لِنَجْعَلَهَا لَكُمْ تَذْكِرَةً وَتَعِيَهَآ أُذُنٌ وَٰعِيَةٌ
verses.en: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.

tafsir.text: so that We might make it namely this act the saving of the believers and the destruction of the disbelievers a reminder a lesson for you and that receptive ears ears which remember what they hear might remember it.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا نُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ نَفْخَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verses.en: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast

tafsir.text: Thus when the Trumpet is blown with a single blast to announce the passing of judgement upon all creatures — this being the second blast —

verses.ar: وَحُمِلَتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ فَدُكَّتَا دَكَّةً وَٰحِدَةً
verses.en: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and leveled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -

tafsir.text: and the earth and the mountains are lifted and levelled with a single levelling

verses.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ وَقَعَتِ ٱلْوَاقِعَةُ
verses.en: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,

tafsir.text: then on that day the imminent Event will come to pass the Resurrection will take place

verses.ar: وَٱنشَقَّتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَهِىَ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاهِيَةٌ
verses.en: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.

tafsir.text: and the heaven will be rent asunder — for it will be very frail on that day —

verses.ar: وَٱلْمَلَكُ عَلَىٰٓ أَرْجَآئِهَا ۚ وَيَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ ثَمَـٰنِيَةٌ
verses.en: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].

tafsir.text: and the angels will be all over its borders the edges of the heavens and above them — the angels that have been mentioned — on that day eight angels or eight files of them will carry the Throne of your Lord.

verses.ar: يَوْمَئِذٍ تُعْرَضُونَ لَا تَخْفَىٰ مِنكُمْ خَافِيَةٌ
verses.en: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.

tafsir.text: On that day you will be exposed before the Reckoning. No hidden thing of yours in the way of secrets will remain hidden read feminine person takhfā or masculine person yakhfā.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقْرَءُوا۟ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
verses.en: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!

tafsir.text: As for him who is given his book in his right hand he will say addressing those around him on account of the joy that has come to him ‘Here take and read my book! kitābiyah both hā’ūmu ‘here is’ and iqra’ū ‘read’ compete for government of this direct object.

verses.ar: إِنِّى ظَنَنتُ أَنِّى مُلَـٰقٍ حِسَابِيَهْ
verses.en: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account."

tafsir.text: I was truly certain that I would encounter my account’.

verses.ar: فَهُوَ فِى عِيشَةٍ رَّاضِيَةٍ
verses.en: So he will be in a pleasant life -

tafsir.text: So he will enjoy a pleasant living

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
verses.en: In an elevated garden,

tafsir.text: in a lofty Garden

verses.ar: قُطُوفُهَا دَانِيَةٌ
verses.en: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.

tafsir.text: whose clusters whose fruits are in easy reach nearby reached easily by one who may be standing or sitting or reclining.

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَآ أَسْلَفْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَيَّامِ ٱلْخَالِيَةِ
verses.en: [They will be told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past."

tafsir.text: And so it will be said to them ‘Eat and drink in enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier that is to say mutahanni’īna ‘while you are enjoying them’ for what you did in advance in former days’ in days that have passed during the life of the world.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِشِمَالِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى لَمْ أُوتَ كِتَـٰبِيَهْ
verses.en: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, "Oh, I wish I had not been given my record

tafsir.text: But as for him who is given his book in his left hand he will say ‘O yā is for calling attention to something would that I had not been given my book

verses.ar: وَلَمْ أَدْرِ مَا حِسَابِيَهْ
verses.en: And had not known what is my account.

tafsir.text: and not known what my account were!

verses.ar: يَـٰلَيْتَهَا كَانَتِ ٱلْقَاضِيَةَ
verses.en: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.

tafsir.text: O would that it namely death in the life of this world had been the final end that had terminated my life so that I am not resurrected.

verses.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنِّى مَالِيَهْ ۜ
verses.en: My wealth has not availed me.

tafsir.text: My wealth has not availed me.

verses.ar: هَلَكَ عَنِّى سُلْطَـٰنِيَهْ
verses.en: Gone from me is my authority."

tafsir.text: My authority my strength my argument has gone from me’ the final hā’ in kitābiyah ‘my book’ hisābiyah ‘my account’ and sultāniyah ‘my authority’ is for consonantal quiescence;

verses.ar: خُذُوهُ فَغُلُّوهُ
verses.en: [Allāh will say], "Seize him and shackle him.

tafsir.text: ‘Seize him — addressing the keepers of Hell — then fetter him bind his hands to his necks in fetters

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ صَلُّوهُ
verses.en: Then into Hellfire drive him.

tafsir.text: then admit him into Hell-fire into the scorching Fire

verses.ar: ثُمَّ فِى سِلْسِلَةٍ ذَرْعُهَا سَبْعُونَ ذِرَاعًا فَٱسْلُكُوهُ
verses.en: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him."

tafsir.text: then in a chain whose length is seventy cubits — each cubit being that of an angel’s forearm — insert him after admitting him into the Fire the fā’ of fa’slukūhu does not prevent the verb from being semantically connected to the preceding adverbial clause.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لَا يُؤْمِنُ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: Indeed, he did not used to believe in Allāh, the Most Great,

tafsir.text: Lo! he never believed in God the Tremendous

verses.ar: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verses.en: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.

tafsir.text: and never urged the feeding of the needy;

verses.ar: فَلَيْسَ لَهُ ٱلْيَوْمَ هَـٰهُنَا حَمِيمٌ
verses.en: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend

tafsir.text: therefore here today he has no loyal friend no relative to avail him

verses.ar: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنْ غِسْلِينٍ
verses.en: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;

tafsir.text: nor any food except pus the vile excretions of the inhabitants of the Fire — or it ghislīn may denote certain trees therein —

verses.ar: لَّا يَأْكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلْخَـٰطِـُٔونَ
verses.en: None will eat it except the sinners.

tafsir.text: which none shall eat but the sinners’ the disbelievers.

verses.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِمَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: So I swear by what you see

tafsir.text: So indeed fa-lā lā is extra I swear by all that you see of creatures

verses.ar: وَمَا لَا تُبْصِرُونَ
verses.en: And what you do not see

tafsir.text: and all that you do not see of them in other words I swear by all creatures

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.

tafsir.text: it that is to say the Qur’ān is indeed the speech of a noble messenger in other words he has spoken it as a message from God exalted be He.

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَاعِرٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.

tafsir.text: And it is not the speech of a poet. Little do you believe!

verses.ar: وَلَا بِقَوْلِ كَاهِنٍ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.en: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.

tafsir.text: Nor is it the speech of a soothsayer. Little do you remember! read both verbs either in the second person plural or in the third person plural; the mā preceding both verbs is extra intended for emphasis.

verses.ar: تَنزِيلٌ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

tafsir.text: Rather it is a revelation from the Lord of the Worlds.

verses.ar: وَلَوْ تَقَوَّلَ عَلَيْنَا بَعْضَ ٱلْأَقَاوِيلِ
verses.en: And if he [i.e., Muḥammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,

tafsir.text: And had he namely the Prophet s fabricated any lies against Us by communicating from Us that which We have not said

verses.ar: لَأَخَذْنَا مِنْهُ بِٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: We would have seized him by the right hand;

tafsir.text: We would have assuredly seized him We would have exacted vengeance against him as punishment by the Right Hand by Our strength and power;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَقَطَعْنَا مِنْهُ ٱلْوَتِينَ
verses.en: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.

tafsir.text: then We would have assuredly severed his life-artery the aorta of the heart a vein that connects with it and which if severed results in that person’s death

verses.ar: فَمَا مِنكُم مِّنْ أَحَدٍ عَنْهُ حَـٰجِزِينَ
verses.en: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.

tafsir.text: and not one of you ahadin is the subject of mā min being extra used to emphasise the negation; minkum is a circumstantial qualifier referring to ahadin could have defended him hājizīna is the predicate of the preceding mā and it is used in the plural because ahad when employed in a negatory context denotes a plural

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذْكِرَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.

tafsir.text: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a reminder for the God-fearing.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّا لَنَعْلَمُ أَنَّ مِنكُم مُّكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.

tafsir.text: And assuredly We know that some of you O people are deniers of the Qur’ān and some of you are believers in it.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسْرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.

tafsir.text: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a cause of anguish for the disbelievers when they see the reward of those who affirmed its truth and the punishment of those who denied it.

verses.ar: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَقُّ ٱلْيَقِينِ
verses.en: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.

tafsir.text: And assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is the certain truth.

verses.ar: فَسَبِّحْ بِٱسْمِ رَبِّكَ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.

tafsir.text: So glorify exalt as transcendent the Name bi’smi the bā’ bi- is extra of your Lord the Tremendous glory be to Him.

verses.ar: سَأَلَ سَآئِلٌۢ بِعَذَابٍ وَاقِعٍ
verses.en: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen

tafsir.text: A petitioner petitioned a supplicator supplicated for an impending chastisement

verses.ar: لِّلْكَـٰفِرِينَ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَافِعٌ
verses.en: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.

tafsir.text: — which in the case of the disbelievers none can avert this was al-Nadr b. al-Hārith who said ‘O God if this be indeed the truth from You … then rain down upon us stones from the heaven’ Q. 832

verses.ar: مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ذِى ٱلْمَعَارِجِ
verses.en: [It is] from Allāh, owner of the ways of ascent.

tafsir.text: from God mina’Llāhi is semantically connected to wāqi‘in ‘impending’ Lord of the Ascensions the ascension routes of the angels which are the heavens.

verses.ar: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ
verses.en: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.

tafsir.text: To Him to the place in the heaven to which His command descends ascend read feminine person ta‘ruju or masculine person ya‘ruju the angels and the Spirit Gabriel in a day fī yawmin is semantically connected to an omitted clause that is to say ‘in a day in which the chastisement befalls them’ on the Day of Resurrection

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ صَبْرًا جَمِيلًا
verses.en: So be patient with gracious patience.

tafsir.text: So be patient — this was revealed before he the Prophet was commanded to fight — with a graceful patience that is one in which there is no anguish.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَرَوْنَهُۥ بَعِيدًا
verses.en: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,

tafsir.text: Lo! they see it that is the chastisement as being far off as never taking place;

verses.ar: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبًا
verses.en: But We see it [as] near.

tafsir.text: while We see it to be near taking place without a doubt.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَكُونُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ كَٱلْمُهْلِ
verses.en: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,

tafsir.text: The day when the heaven will be yawma takūnu’l-samā’u is semantically connected to an omitted clause implicitly taken to be yaqa‘u ‘it will take place’ as molten silver

verses.ar: وَتَكُونُ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَٱلْعِهْنِ
verses.en: And the mountains will be like wool,

tafsir.text: and the mountains will be as flakes of wool in terms of their lightness and their floating about in the wind.

verses.ar: وَلَا يَسْـَٔلُ حَمِيمٌ حَمِيمًا
verses.en: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,

tafsir.text: And no friend will inquire about his friend no relative will inquire about his relative each being preoccupied with his own predicament.

verses.ar: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
verses.en: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children.

tafsir.text: They will however be made to see them that is friends will catch sight of one another recognising one another but refraining from speaking to one another the sentence yubassarūnahum is a new independent one.

verses.ar: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَأَخِيهِ
verses.en: And his wife and his brother

tafsir.text: and his companion his wife and his brother

verses.ar: وَفَصِيلَتِهِ ٱلَّتِى تُـْٔوِيهِ
verses.en: And his nearest kindred who shelter him.

tafsir.text: and his kin his clan expressed as fasīla because he is a detached part fasl of it that had sheltered him embraced him

verses.ar: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
verses.en: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.

tafsir.text: and all who are on earth if it that ransom might then deliver him thumma yunjīhi is a supplement to yaftadī ‘to ransom himself’.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهَا لَظَىٰ
verses.en: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],

tafsir.text: Nay! — a refutation of his wish. Lo! for him it namely the Fire will be the Churning Fire lazā — a name for Hell so called because it churns its flames tatalazzā against the disbelievers

verses.ar: نَزَّاعَةً لِّلشَّوَىٰ
verses.en: A remover of exteriors.

tafsir.text: ripping out the scalp shawā is the plural of shawāt the skin of the head;

verses.ar: تَدْعُوا۟ مَنْ أَدْبَرَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.en: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]

tafsir.text: it will call him who turned his back and ignored faith saying to him ‘To me! to me come hither!’

verses.ar: وَجَمَعَ فَأَوْعَىٰٓ
verses.en: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.

tafsir.text: and amassed wealth then hoarded keeping it in containers and refraining from paying from it what is God’s due.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
verses.en: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:

tafsir.text: Indeed man was created restless halū‘an is an implied circumstantial qualifier the explanation of which follows

verses.ar: إِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ جَزُوعًا
verses.en: When evil touches him, impatient,

tafsir.text: when evil befalls him he is anxious at the point of that evil befalling him

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَسَّهُ ٱلْخَيْرُ مَنُوعًا
verses.en: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],

tafsir.text: and when good befalls him he is grudging at the point of that good befalling him that is to say when wealth befalls him he is grudging to give of it what is due to God;

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
verses.en: Except the observers of prayer -

tafsir.text: except those who perform prayers that is the believers

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ دَآئِمُونَ
verses.en: Those who are constant in their prayer

tafsir.text: those who maintain those who regularly observe their prayers

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ فِىٓ أَمْوَٰلِهِمْ حَقٌّ مَّعْلُومٌ
verses.en: And those within whose wealth is a known right

tafsir.text: and in whose wealth there is an acknowledged due namely alms

verses.ar: لِّلسَّآئِلِ وَٱلْمَحْرُومِ
verses.en: For the petitioner and the deprived -

tafsir.text: for the beggar and the deprived the latter being the one who refrains from begging and thus becomes deprived

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُصَدِّقُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense

tafsir.text: and who affirm the truth of the Day of Judgement of Requital

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.en: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -

tafsir.text: and who are apprehensive of the chastisement of their Lord —

verses.ar: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمْ غَيْرُ مَأْمُونٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -

tafsir.text: lo! there is no security from the chastisement of their Lord from its being sent down —

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِفُرُوجِهِمْ حَـٰفِظُونَ
verses.en: And those who guard their private parts

tafsir.text: and those who guard their private parts

verses.ar: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.en: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -

tafsir.text: except from their wives and those whom their right hands own in the way of slavegirls for in that case they are not blameworthy;

verses.ar: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.en: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -

tafsir.text: but whoever seeks beyond that those are the infringers who transgress the bounds of what is lawful stepping into what is unlawful;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ لِأَمَـٰنَـٰتِهِمْ وَعَهْدِهِمْ رَٰعُونَ
verses.en: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive.

tafsir.text: and those who are keepers faithful guardians of their trusts amānātihim a variant reading has the singular amānatihim that to which they are entrusted of religion and the affairs of this world and their covenant the one taken from them regarding such things

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم بِشَهَـٰدَٰتِهِمْ قَآئِمُونَ
verses.en: And those who are in their testimonies upright

tafsir.text: and who are forthwith with their testimony bi-shahādatihim a variant reading has the plural bi-shahādātihim ‘their testimonies’ those who offer them and do not withhold them

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمْ عَلَىٰ صَلَاتِهِمْ يُحَافِظُونَ
verses.en: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:

tafsir.text: and who preserve their prayers by observing them in their appointed times.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ مُّكْرَمُونَ
verses.en: They will be in gardens, honored.

tafsir.text: Those will be in Gardens honoured.

verses.ar: فَمَالِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ قِبَلَكَ مُهْطِعِينَ
verses.en: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muḥammad],

tafsir.text: So what is wrong with those who disbelieve that they keep staring towards you muhti‘īna is a circumstantial qualifier

verses.ar: عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ عِزِينَ
verses.en: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?

tafsir.text: to the right and to the left of you in droves? ‘izīna is also a circumstantial qualifier in other words in groups standing in circles one next to the other saying in mockery of the believers ‘Verily if the likes of these are to enter Paradise we shall enter it before them’. God exalted be He says

verses.ar: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?

tafsir.text: Does each one of them hope to be admitted into a Garden of Bliss?

verses.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّا خَلَقْنَـٰهُم مِّمَّا يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.

tafsir.text: Nay! — meant to thwart their hopes of entering Paradise. Indeed We created them as others from what they know from drops of sperm and so one cannot hope for Paradise merely on account of this one hopes for it by being God-fearing.

verses.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.en: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able

tafsir.text: For verily fa-lā lā is extra I swear by the Lord of the rising-places and the setting-places of the sun the moon and all the stars that We are able

verses.ar: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.en: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.

tafsir.text: to replace them to bring in their place with others better than them and We are not to be outmanoeuvred We will not be frustrated in this.

verses.ar: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised -

tafsir.text: So leave them to indulge in their falsehoods and to play in this world of theirs until they encounter that day of theirs in which they are promised chastisement;

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍ يُوفِضُونَ
verses.en: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, hastening.

tafsir.text: the day when they will come forth from the graves hastening to the site of the Gathering as if racing to a standing target nasbin a variant reading has nusubin meaning something that has been erected mansūb such as a flag or a banner

verses.ar: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.en: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.

tafsir.text: with their eyes humbled abject overcast by abasement shrouded in it. Such is the day which they are promised dhālika is the subject and what follows it is the predicate meaning the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦٓ أَنْ أَنذِرْ قَوْمَكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يَأْتِيَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.en: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], "Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment."

tafsir.text: Verily We sent Noah to his people saying ‘Warn your people before there come on them — should they not believe — a painful chastisement’ in this world and in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنِّى لَكُمْ نَذِيرٌ مُّبِينٌ
verses.en: He said, "O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner -

tafsir.text: He said ‘O my people I am indeed a plain warner to you one whose warning is plain

verses.ar: أَنِ ٱعْبُدُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱتَّقُوهُ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.en: To worship Allāh, fear Him and obey me.

tafsir.text: to tell you that you should worship God and fear Him and obey me

verses.ar: يَغْفِرْ لَكُم مِّن ذُنُوبِكُمْ وَيُؤَخِّرْكُمْ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّى ۚ إِنَّ أَجَلَ ٱللَّهِ إِذَا جَآءَ لَا يُؤَخَّرُ ۖ لَوْ كُنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: He [i.e., Allāh] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] Allāh, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew."

tafsir.text: that He may forgive you some of your sins min dhunūbikum ‘some of your sins’ min may be taken as extra because submission to God islām expunges everything of sin that was committed previous to it;

verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُ قَوْمِى لَيْلًا وَنَهَارًا
verses.en: He said, "My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.

tafsir.text: He said ‘My Lord I have summoned my people night and day that is to say continuously without interruption

verses.ar: فَلَمْ يَزِدْهُمْ دُعَآءِىٓ إِلَّا فِرَارًا
verses.en: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].

tafsir.text: but my summon has only increased their evasion of faith.

verses.ar: وَإِنِّى كُلَّمَا دَعَوْتُهُمْ لِتَغْفِرَ لَهُمْ جَعَلُوٓا۟ أَصَـٰبِعَهُمْ فِىٓ ءَاذَانِهِمْ وَٱسْتَغْشَوْا۟ ثِيَابَهُمْ وَأَصَرُّوا۟ وَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ ٱسْتِكْبَارًا
verses.en: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.

tafsir.text: And indeed whenever I summoned them so that You might forgive them they put their fingers in their ears in order not to hear what I say and draw their cloaks over themselves they cover their heads with them in order not to catch sight of me and they persist in their disbelief and act in great arrogance disdaining

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّى دَعَوْتُهُمْ جِهَارًا
verses.en: Then I invited them publicly.

tafsir.text: Then indeed I summoned them aloud that is to say at the top of my voice;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَنتُ لَهُمْ وَأَسْرَرْتُ لَهُمْ إِسْرَارًا
verses.en: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly

tafsir.text: then assuredly I proclaimed to them with my voice and I confided my words to them secretly

verses.ar: فَقُلْتُ ٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارًا
verses.en: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.

tafsir.text: saying “Ask your Lord for forgiveness from idolatry. Assuredly He is ever Forgiving.

verses.ar: يُرْسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيْكُم مِّدْرَارًا
verses.en: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers

tafsir.text: He will release the heaven the rain — for they had been deprived of it — for you in torrents in plenteous showers

verses.ar: وَيُمْدِدْكُم بِأَمْوَٰلٍ وَبَنِينَ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ جَنَّـٰتٍ وَيَجْعَل لَّكُمْ أَنْهَـٰرًا
verses.en: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.

tafsir.text: and furnish you with wealth and sons and assign to you gardens orchards and assign to you running rivers.

verses.ar: مَّا لَكُمْ لَا تَرْجُونَ لِلَّهِ وَقَارًا
verses.en: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to Allāh [due] grandeur

tafsir.text: What is wrong with you that you do not hope for dignity from God that is to say that you do not hope that God will dignify you by becoming believers

verses.ar: وَقَدْ خَلَقَكُمْ أَطْوَارًا
verses.en: While He has created you in stages?

tafsir.text: when verily He created you in stages? atwār is the plural of tūr which means a state. Thus the sperm-drop is one state the blood clot is another state and so on until the creation of the human being is complete reflecting on the manner of his creation necessarily leads to belief in his Creator.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَوْا۟ كَيْفَ خَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ سَبْعَ سَمَـٰوَٰتٍ طِبَاقًا
verses.en: Do you not consider how Allāh has created seven heavens in layers

tafsir.text: Have you not seen how God created seven heavens in layers one on top of the other

verses.ar: وَجَعَلَ ٱلْقَمَرَ فِيهِنَّ نُورًا وَجَعَلَ ٱلشَّمْسَ سِرَاجًا
verses.en: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?

tafsir.text: and made the moon therein — that is to say within their totality but which is effectively true in the case of the heaven of this world — as a light and made the sun as a lamp? as an illuminating lantern more powerful than the light of the moon.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَنۢبَتَكُم مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ نَبَاتًا
verses.en: And Allāh has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.

tafsir.text: And God has caused you to grow He has created you from the earth for He created your father Adam from it.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُعِيدُكُمْ فِيهَا وَيُخْرِجُكُمْ إِخْرَاجًا
verses.en: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.

tafsir.text: Then He will make you return into it entombed in your graves and bring you forth for the resurrection with a veritable bringing forth.

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ بِسَاطًا
verses.en: And Allāh has made for you the earth an expanse

tafsir.text: And God has made the earth a flat open expanse for you

verses.ar: لِّتَسْلُكُوا۟ مِنْهَا سُبُلًا فِجَاجًا
verses.en: That you may follow therein roads of passage.'"

tafsir.text: so that you may follow throughout it spacious routes.” ’

verses.ar: قَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ إِنَّهُمْ عَصَوْنِى وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ مَن لَّمْ يَزِدْهُ مَالُهُۥ وَوَلَدُهُۥٓ إِلَّا خَسَارًا
verses.en: Noah said, "My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.

tafsir.text: Noah said ‘My Lord they have disobeyed me and followed that is the riffraff and the paupers among them have followed those whose wealth and children namely their leaders who have been blessed with such things read wulduhu or waladuhu ‘whose children’ the first of which is said to be the plural of walad similar in

verses.ar: وَمَكَرُوا۟ مَكْرًا كُبَّارًا
verses.en: And they conspired an immense conspiracy

tafsir.text: And they have devised namely the leaders a mighty plot extremely outrageous by denying Noah and harming him as well as his followers

verses.ar: وَقَالُوا۟ لَا تَذَرُنَّ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ وَلَا تَذَرُنَّ وَدًّا وَلَا سُوَاعًا وَلَا يَغُوثَ وَيَعُوقَ وَنَسْرًا
verses.en: And said, 'Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwāʿ or Yaghūth and Yaʿūq and Nasr.'

tafsir.text: and have said to the riffraff “Do not abandon your gods and do not abandon Wadd read Wadd or Wudd nor Suwā‘ nor Yaghūth and Ya‘ūq and Nasr” — these being the names of their idols.

verses.ar: وَقَدْ أَضَلُّوا۟ كَثِيرًا ۖ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا ضَلَـٰلًا
verses.en: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error."

tafsir.text: And they have certainly led astray by these gods many people by commanding them to worship them. And do not O God increase the evildoers except in error!’ wa-lā tazidi’l-zālimīna illā dalālan is a supplement to qad adallū ‘they have certainly led astray’ He Noah invoked God against them when it was revealed to him

verses.ar: مِّمَّا خَطِيٓـَٔـٰتِهِمْ أُغْرِقُوا۟ فَأُدْخِلُوا۟ نَارًا فَلَمْ يَجِدُوا۟ لَهُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَنصَارًا
verses.en: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides Allāh [any] helpers.

tafsir.text: Because of mimmā mā indicates a relative clause their iniquities khatāyāhum a variant reading has khatī’ātihim they were drowned by the Flood then made to enter the Fire with which they were punished underwater after drowning.

verses.ar: وَقَالَ نُوحٌ رَّبِّ لَا تَذَرْ عَلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ دَيَّارًا
verses.en: And Noah said, "My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.

tafsir.text: And Noah said ‘My Lord do not leave from among the disbelievers a single dweller upon the earth dayyār means ‘one who inhabits a dwelling dār’ in other words not one.

verses.ar: إِنَّكَ إِن تَذَرْهُمْ يُضِلُّوا۟ عِبَادَكَ وَلَا يَلِدُوٓا۟ إِلَّا فَاجِرًا كَفَّارًا
verses.en: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.

tafsir.text: Assuredly if You leave them they will lead Your servants astray and will beget only disbelieving profligates fājir and kaffār derive respectively from yafjuru and yakfuru he said this on account of the mentioned revelation that had been given to him.

verses.ar: رَّبِّ ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِمَن دَخَلَ بَيْتِىَ مُؤْمِنًا وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ وَلَا تَزِدِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ إِلَّا تَبَارًۢا
verses.en: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction."

tafsir.text: My Lord forgive me and my parents — both of whom were believers — and whoever enters my house my dwelling or my place of worship as a believer and believing men and believing women to the Day of Resurrection and do not increase the evildoers except in ruin’ in destruction — and thus they were destroyed.

verses.ar: قُلْ أُوحِىَ إِلَىَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسْتَمَعَ نَفَرٌ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّا سَمِعْنَا قُرْءَانًا عَجَبًا
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

tafsir.text: Say O Muhammad (s) to people ‘It has been revealed to me that is to say I have been informed by way of revelation from God exalted be He that annahu the suffixed pronoun is that of the matter a company of the jinn the jinn of Nasībīn.

verses.ar: يَهْدِىٓ إِلَى ٱلرُّشْدِ فَـَٔامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ وَلَن نُّشْرِكَ بِرَبِّنَآ أَحَدًا
verses.en: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.

tafsir.text: which guides to rectitude to faith and propriety. Therefore we believe in it and we will never after this day associate anyone with our Lord.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ تَعَـٰلَىٰ جَدُّ رَبِّنَا مَا ٱتَّخَذَ صَـٰحِبَةً وَلَا وَلَدًا
verses.en: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son

tafsir.text: And we believe that annahu the pronoun in this and in the next two instances is that of the matter — exalted be the majesty of our Lord transcendent is His majesty and magnificence above what is ascribed to Him — He has taken neither spouse nor son.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ يَقُولُ سَفِيهُنَا عَلَى ٱللَّهِ شَطَطًا
verses.en: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about Allāh an excessive transgression.

tafsir.text: And that the fool among us the ignorant one among us used to utter atrocious lies against God extreme calumny by attributing to Him a spouse and a son.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن تَقُولَ ٱلْإِنسُ وَٱلْجِنُّ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا
verses.en: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about Allāh a lie.

tafsir.text: And we thought that an softened that is to say annahu humans and jinn would never utter a lie against God by attributing such things to Him until we discovered their mendacity thereby. God exalted be He says

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ كَانَ رِجَالٌ مِّنَ ٱلْإِنسِ يَعُوذُونَ بِرِجَالٍ مِّنَ ٱلْجِنِّ فَزَادُوهُمْ رَهَقًا
verses.en: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].

tafsir.text: And that certain individuals of mankind used to seek the protection of certain individuals of the jinn when they stopped over in dangerous places during their journeys — whereat every man would say ‘I seek the protection of the lord of this place against the evil of the insolent ones in it’ — so that they increased

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُمْ ظَنُّوا۟ كَمَا ظَنَنتُمْ أَن لَّن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدًا
verses.en: And they had thought, as you thought, that Allāh would never send anyone [as a messenger].

tafsir.text: And they namely the jinn thought just as you O humans thought that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu God would never raise anyone after his death.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَسْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ فَوَجَدْنَـٰهَا مُلِئَتْ حَرَسًا شَدِيدًا وَشُهُبًا
verses.en: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.

tafsir.text: The jinn say And we made for the heaven we desired to listen by stealth but we found it filled with mighty guards from among the angels and meteors scorching stars this was at the time of the sending of the Prophet s.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا كُنَّا نَقْعُدُ مِنْهَا مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلسَّمْعِ ۖ فَمَن يَسْتَمِعِ ٱلْـَٔانَ يَجِدْ لَهُۥ شِهَابًا رَّصَدًا
verses.en: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.

tafsir.text: And we used to that is to say before his Mission sit in certain places therein to listen in; but anyone listening now will find a meteor lying in wait for him aimed at him ready to strike him.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَا نَدْرِىٓ أَشَرٌّ أُرِيدَ بِمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَمْ أَرَادَ بِهِمْ رَبُّهُمْ رَشَدًا
verses.en: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.

tafsir.text: And we do not know by not being able to eavesdrop by stealth whether ill is intended for those who are in the earth or whether their Lord intends for them good.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلصَّـٰلِحُونَ وَمِنَّا دُونَ ذَٰلِكَ ۖ كُنَّا طَرَآئِقَ قِدَدًا
verses.en: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.

tafsir.text: And that among us some have become righteous after having listened to the Qur’ān and some of us are otherwise that is to say a folk who are unrighteous; we are made up of different sects opposing groups some submitters to God and others disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعْجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَن نُّعْجِزَهُۥ هَرَبًا
verses.en: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allāh upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.

tafsir.text: And we assume that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu we will never be able to elude God in the earth nor will we be able to elude Him by fleeing — we will not be able to escape Him whether we are on earth or fleeing from it in the heavens.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا لَمَّا سَمِعْنَا ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ ۖ فَمَن يُؤْمِنۢ بِرَبِّهِۦ فَلَا يَخَافُ بَخْسًا وَلَا رَهَقًا
verses.en: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.

tafsir.text: And that when we heard the guidance the Qur’ān we believed in it. For whoever believes in his Lord read an implied huwa ‘he’ before fa-lā yakhāfu shall fear neither loss a diminishing of his good deeds nor oppression nor injustice by having his evil deeds increased.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلْمُسْلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ ۖ فَمَنْ أَسْلَمَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوْا۟ رَشَدًا
verses.en: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allāh], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.

tafsir.text: And that among us some have submitted to God while some of us are unjust tyrants — on account of their disbelief. So whoever has submitted to God those are the ones who seek right guidance.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا ٱلْقَـٰسِطُونَ فَكَانُوا۟ لِجَهَنَّمَ حَطَبًا
verses.en: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.'

tafsir.text: And as for those are unjust they will be firewood fuel for Hell!” ’ annā annahum and annahu totalling all twelve instances above including innahu ta‘ālā and annā minnā’l-muslimūna and what comes in between them may be read with a kasra sc. innā innahum etc. indicating a new sentence every time or with a fatha sc.

verses.ar: وَأَلَّوِ ٱسْتَقَـٰمُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلطَّرِيقَةِ لَأَسْقَيْنَـٰهُم مَّآءً غَدَقًا
verses.en: And [Allāh revealed] that if they had remained straight on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision].

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says the following about the Meccan disbelievers And it has been revealed to me that if they allaw softened in place of the hardened form its subject having been omitted that is to say annahum law which is a supplement to annahu istama‘a ‘that a company of jinn listened’ adopt the right path the path

verses.ar: لِّنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَمَن يُعْرِضْ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّهِۦ يَسْلُكْهُ عَذَابًا صَعَدًا
verses.en: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.

tafsir.text: so that We may try them test them therein and so know through knowledge outwardly manifested the nature of their gratitude. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord from the Qur’ān We will admit him naslukhu or read first person yaslukhu ‘He will admit him’ into a tortuous chastisement.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّ ٱلْمَسَـٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدْعُوا۟ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدًا
verses.en: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allāh, so do not invoke with Allāh anyone.

tafsir.text: And it has been revealed to me that the places of prayer belong to God so do not invoke in them anyone along with God by associating others with Him like the Jews and Christians do who when they enter their churches and temples they ascribe partners to God.

verses.ar: وَأَنَّهُۥ لَمَّا قَامَ عَبْدُ ٱللَّهِ يَدْعُوهُ كَادُوا۟ يَكُونُونَ عَلَيْهِ لِبَدًا
