verses.en: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of Allāh stood up supplicating Him, they almost became about him a compacted mass."

tafsir.text: And that annahu; or innahu as a new sentence the pronoun being that of the matter when the servant of God the Prophet Muhammad (s) rose to invoke Him to worship Him at Batn Nakhla they that is the jinn listening to his recitation were almost upon him in heaps libadan or lubadan the plural of libda or lubda like felt

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنَّمَآ أَدْعُوا۟ رَبِّى وَلَآ أُشْرِكُ بِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.en: Say, [O Muḥammad], "I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone."

tafsir.text: He said in response to the disbelievers saying ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’ a variant reading for qāla ‘he said’ has qul ‘Say’ ‘I invoke only my Lord as God and I do not associate anyone with Him’.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَآ أَمْلِكُ لَكُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا رَشَدًا
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, I do not possess for you [the power of] harm or right direction."

tafsir.text: Say ‘I truly have no power to bring you any harm to lead you astray or any guidance’ any good.

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنِّى لَن يُجِيرَنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٌ وَلَنْ أَجِدَ مِن دُونِهِۦ مُلْتَحَدًا
verses.en: Say, "Indeed, there will never protect me from Allāh anyone [if I should disobey], nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.

tafsir.text: Say ‘Indeed none shall protect me from God from His chastisement were I to disobey Him and I shall never find besides Him that is other than Him any refuge.

verses.ar: إِلَّا بَلَـٰغًا مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرِسَـٰلَـٰتِهِۦ ۚ وَمَن يَعْصِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدًا
verses.en: But [I have for you] only notification from Allāh, and His messages." And whoever disobeys Allāh and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.

tafsir.text: I have power to bring you only a communication illā balāghan is excepted from the direct object clause of amliku ‘I have power to bring’ that is to say I have power only to communicate the Message to you from God that is on His behalf and His Messages wa-risālātihi is a supplement to balāghan ‘a communication’;

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوْا۟ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَضْعَفُ نَاصِرًا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدًا
verses.en: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.

tafsir.text: Such that when they see hattā is for inceptiveness but also entailing a purposive sense to an implied preceding clause that is to say they persist in their disbelief until they come to see … what they are promised of chastisement they will then know at the moment that it befalls them either on the day of Badr or on

verses.ar: قُلْ إِنْ أَدْرِىٓ أَقَرِيبٌ مَّا تُوعَدُونَ أَمْ يَجْعَلُ لَهُۥ رَبِّىٓ أَمَدًا
verses.en: Say, "I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period."

tafsir.text: Say ‘I do not know if what you are promised of chastisement is near or if my Lord has set a distant length for it an extent and a term which only He knows.

verses.ar: عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ فَلَا يُظْهِرُ عَلَىٰ غَيْبِهِۦٓ أَحَدًا
verses.en: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone

tafsir.text: Knower He is of the Unseen what is hidden from servants and He does not disclose He does not reveal His Unseen to anyone from mankind

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ مِن رَّسُولٍ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَسْلُكُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ يَدَيْهِ وَمِنْ خَلْفِهِۦ رَصَدًا
verses.en: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers

tafsir.text: except to a messenger of whom He approves. Then in addition to disclosing to him what He will to disclose of it by way of making it a miracle for him He despatches He appoints and sends forth before him namely the Messenger and behind him watchers angels to preserve him until He has conveyed it to him as part of the

verses.ar: لِّيَعْلَمَ أَن قَدْ أَبْلَغُوا۟ رِسَـٰلَـٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ وَأَحَاطَ بِمَا لَدَيْهِمْ وَأَحْصَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عَدَدًۢا
verses.en: That he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and has enumerated all things in number.

tafsir.text: so that He God may know by knowledge outwardly manifested that an softened in place of the hardened form that is to say annahu they that is the messengers have conveyed the Messages of their Lord the plural person of the verb ablaghū ‘they have conveyed’ takes into account the plural implication of man ‘whom’ and He

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُزَّمِّلُ
verses.en: O you who wraps himself [in clothing]

tafsir.text: O you enwrapped in your garment! the Prophet al-muzzammil is actually al-mutazammil but the tā’ has been assimilated with the zāy that is to say the one who wraps himself up in his clothes when the Revelation Gabriel comes to him in fear of him because of his awe-inspiring presence.

verses.ar: قُمِ ٱلَّيْلَ إِلَّا قَلِيلًا
verses.en: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -

tafsir.text: Stand vigil perform prayer through the night except a little

verses.ar: نِّصْفَهُۥٓ أَوِ ٱنقُصْ مِنْهُ قَلِيلًا
verses.en: Half of it - or subtract from it a little

tafsir.text: a half of it nisfahu substitutes for qalīlan with ‘little’ being little by taking into account the whole night or reduce of it of the half a little up to a third

verses.ar: أَوْ زِدْ عَلَيْهِ وَرَتِّلِ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَرْتِيلًا
verses.en: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.

tafsir.text: or add to it up to two thirds aw implies free choice and recite the Qur’ān recite it carefully in a measured tone.

verses.ar: إِنَّا سَنُلْقِى عَلَيْكَ قَوْلًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.

tafsir.text: Verily soon We shall cast on you a weighty an awe-inspiring or stern word a weighty Qur’ān because of the prescriptions imposed in it.

verses.ar: إِنَّ نَاشِئَةَ ٱلَّيْلِ هِىَ أَشَدُّ وَطْـًٔا وَأَقْوَمُ قِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.

tafsir.text: Assuredly rising in the night to wake up after having been in sleep is firmer in tread more conducive to establishing harmony between the hearing and the heart for the purpose of comprehending the Qur’ān and more upright in respect to speech clearer for utterance of devotions.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبْحًا طَوِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.

tafsir.text: For assuredly during the day you have extended engagements administering your affairs and you do not have the time to recite Qur’ān.

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلْ إِلَيْهِ تَبْتِيلًا
verses.en: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.

tafsir.text: And mention the Name of your Lord that is say bi’smi’Llāhi’l-rahmāni’l-rahīm ‘In the Name of God the Compassionate the Merciful’ to begin your recitation and devote yourself exclusively to Him with complete devotion tabtīlan is the verbal noun from batala used here instead of tabattulan in order to concord with the

verses.ar: رَّبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذْهُ وَكِيلًا
verses.en: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.

tafsir.text: He is Lord of the east and the west; there is no god except Him so take Him for a Guardian entrusting your affairs to Him

verses.ar: وَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَٱهْجُرْهُمْ هَجْرًا جَمِيلًا
verses.en: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.

tafsir.text: and bear patiently what they say that is the disbelievers of Mecca in the way of their maltreatment of you and part with them in a gracious manner without any anguish — this was revealed before the command to fight them.

verses.ar: وَذَرْنِى وَٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ أُو۟لِى ٱلنَّعْمَةِ وَمَهِّلْهُمْ قَلِيلًا
verses.en: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.

tafsir.text: And leave Me to deal with the deniers wa’l-mukadhdhibīna is a supplement to the direct object or it is an object of accompaniment; the meaning is ‘I will avail you of them’ they being the doughty leaders of Quraysh those enjoying affluence and respite them a little while — they were killed soon afterwards at Badr.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لَدَيْنَآ أَنكَالًا وَجَحِيمًا
verses.en: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire.

tafsir.text: For indeed with Us are heavy fetters ankāl is the plural of nikl heavy shackles and a hell-fire a scorching Fire

verses.ar: وَطَعَامًا ذَا غُصَّةٍ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمًا
verses.en: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -

tafsir.text: and a food that chokes one that causes the throat to choke and this is either zaqqūm cf. Q. 4443 darī‘ cf. Q. 886 ghislīn cf. Q. 6936 or thorns of fire which can neither be vomited nor ingested and a painful chastisement in addition to the punishment mentioned for those who deny the Prophet s

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلْأَرْضُ وَٱلْجِبَالُ وَكَانَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ كَثِيبًا مَّهِيلًا
verses.en: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.

tafsir.text: on the day when the earth and the mountains will quake and the mountains will be like heaps of shifting sand mahīl derives from hāla yahīlu; it is actually mahyūl but the damma sound is considered too heavy for the yā’ and is therefore transposed onto the hā’ while the wāw the second of two unvocalised consonants is

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ رَسُولًا شَـٰهِدًا عَلَيْكُمْ كَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ رَسُولًا
verses.en: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.

tafsir.text: We have indeed sent to you O people of Mecca a Messenger namely Muhammad (s) to be a witness against you on the Day of Resurrection to any disobedience that you engage in just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger namely Moses peace be upon him.

verses.ar: فَعَصَىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَأَخَذْنَـٰهُ أَخْذًا وَبِيلًا
verses.en: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.

tafsir.text: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger so We seized him with a severe seizing.

verses.ar: فَكَيْفَ تَتَّقُونَ إِن كَفَرْتُمْ يَوْمًا يَجْعَلُ ٱلْوِلْدَٰنَ شِيبًا
verses.en: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?

tafsir.text: So if you disbelieve in this world how will you guard against a day yawman is the direct object of tattaqūna ‘you guard against’ that is against the chastisement thereof by what defence will you defend yourselves against the chastisement of a day that will make the children grey-haired shīb is the plural of ashyab by

verses.ar: ٱلسَّمَآءُ مُنفَطِرٌۢ بِهِۦ ۚ كَانَ وَعْدُهُۥ مَفْعُولًا
verses.en: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.

tafsir.text: with the heaven being rent asunder thereon on that Day because of its severity. His promise exalted be He of the coming of that Day shall be fulfilled that is to say it will come to pass without doubt.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.

tafsir.text: Indeed these threatening verses are a reminder an admonition for all creatures. Let him who will then choose a way to his Lord a path to Him through faith and obedience.

verses.ar: ۞ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ تَقُومُ أَدْنَىٰ مِن ثُلُثَىِ ٱلَّيْلِ وَنِصْفَهُۥ وَثُلُثَهُۥ وَطَآئِفَةٌ مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ مَعَكَ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُقَدِّرُ ٱلَّيْلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن لَّن تُحْصُوهُ فَتَابَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنَ ٱلْقُرْءَانِ ۚ عَلِمَ أَن سَيَكُونُ مِنكُم مَّرْضَىٰ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يَضْرِبُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ يَبْتَغُونَ مِن فَضْلِ ٱللَّهِ ۙ وَءَاخَرُونَ يُقَـٰتِلُونَ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ فَٱقْرَءُوا۟ مَا تَيَسَّرَ مِنْهُ ۚ وَأَقِيمُوا۟ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ وَءَاتُوا۟ ٱلزَّكَوٰةَ وَأَقْرِضُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ قَرْضًا حَسَنًا ۚ وَمَا تُقَدِّمُوا۟ لِأَنفُسِكُم مِّنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ هُوَ خَيْرًا وَأَعْظَمَ أَجْرًا ۚ وَٱسْتَغْفِرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌۢ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muḥammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And Allāh determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of Allāh and others fighting for the cause of Allāh. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan Allāh a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with Allāh. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Forgiving and Merciful.

tafsir.text: Assuredly your Lord knows that you stand vigil less than two thirds of the night or at times a half of it or a third of it if read wa-nisfihi wa-thuluthihi then these constitute a supplement to thuluthay ‘two thirds’;

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْمُدَّثِّرُ
verses.en: O you who covers himself [with a garment],

tafsir.text: O you enveloped in your mantle the Prophet s al-muddaththir is actually al-mutadaththir but the tā’ has been assimilated with the dāl that is to say the one who is enwrapped in his clothes when the Revelation Gabriel comes down on him

verses.ar: قُمْ فَأَنذِرْ
verses.en: Arise and warn.

tafsir.text: arise and warn threaten the people of Mecca with punishment in the Fire should they refuse to believe;

verses.ar: وَرَبَّكَ فَكَبِّرْ
verses.en: And your Lord glorify.

tafsir.text: and magnify your Lord exalt Him above what is ascribed to Him by the idolaters;

verses.ar: وَثِيَابَكَ فَطَهِّرْ
verses.en: And your clothing purify.

tafsir.text: and purify your clothes from impurity or it means shorten them instead of imitating the way in which the Arabs are wont to let their robes drag behind them out of vanity for perhaps they will be sullied by some impurity;

verses.ar: وَٱلرُّجْزَ فَٱهْجُرْ
verses.en: And uncleanliness avoid.

tafsir.text: and shun all defilement this rijz was explained by the Prophet s to be the graven images; in other words persist in shunning them.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَمْنُن تَسْتَكْثِرُ
verses.en: And do not confer favor to acquire more.

tafsir.text: And do not grant a favour seeking greater gain read tastakthiru as a circumstantial qualifier in other words do not give something in order to demand more in return this stipulation is specific to the Prophet s since he is enjoined to adopt the fairest traits and the noblest of manners;

verses.ar: وَلِرَبِّكَ فَٱصْبِرْ
verses.en: But for your Lord be patient.

tafsir.text: and endure patiently for the sake of your Lord all His commands and prohibitions.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِى ٱلنَّاقُورِ
verses.en: And when the trumpet is blown,

tafsir.text: For when the trumpet is sounded when the trumpet is blown that is the Horn qarn at the second blast

verses.ar: فَذَٰلِكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَوْمٌ عَسِيرٌ
verses.en: That Day will be a difficult day

tafsir.text: that day that is to say the time of the sounding yawma’idhin is a substitution for the preceding subject and is not declined because it is annexed to something that cannot be declined;

verses.ar: عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ غَيْرُ يَسِيرٍ
verses.en: For the disbelievers - not easy.

tafsir.text: for the disbelievers not at all easy herein is an indication that it will be easy for believers despite its harshness.

verses.ar: ذَرْنِى وَمَنْ خَلَقْتُ وَحِيدًا
verses.en: Leave Me with the one I created alone

tafsir.text: Leave Me to deal with him whom I created wa-man khalaqtu is a supplement to the direct object or it is an object of accompaniment lonely wahīdan is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the man ‘whom’ or to the pronoun referring to it but omitted from khalaqtu sc.

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْتُ لَهُۥ مَالًا مَّمْدُودًا
verses.en: And to whom I granted extensive wealth

tafsir.text: and then assigned him ample means abundant and continuous generated from his crops livestock and commerce

verses.ar: وَبَنِينَ شُهُودًا
verses.en: And children present [with him]

tafsir.text: and sons ten or more present by his side present at social gatherings and whose testimonies are listened to

verses.ar: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمْهِيدًا
verses.en: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].

tafsir.text: and facilitated extended for him greatly his livelihood duration of life and children.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يَطْمَعُ أَنْ أَزِيدَ
verses.en: Then he desires that I should add more.

tafsir.text: Still he is eager that I should give him more.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا عَنِيدًا
verses.en: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.

tafsir.text: Nay! I shall not give him more than that. He is indeed stubborn to Our signs to the Qur’ān.

verses.ar: سَأُرْهِقُهُۥ صَعُودًا
verses.en: I will cover him with arduous torment.

tafsir.text: Soon I shall burden him with a trying chastisement; alternatively sa‘ūdan means a mountain of fire which he will be made to ascend and then fall down from forever.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ فَكَّرَ وَقَدَّرَ
verses.en: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.

tafsir.text: Indeed he pondered what to say about the Qur’ān which he heard from the Prophet s and decided this in his mind.

verses.ar: فَقُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
verses.en: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

tafsir.text: Perish he may he be cursed and chastised how he decided! perish he whatever the nature of his decision may have been.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ قُتِلَ كَيْفَ قَدَّرَ
verses.en: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.

tafsir.text: Again perish he how he decided!

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نَظَرَ
verses.en: Then he considered [again];

tafsir.text: Then he contemplated the faces of his people; or he contemplated with what words he might cast aspersions upon it.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ عَبَسَ وَبَسَرَ
verses.en: Then he frowned and scowled;

tafsir.text: Then he frowned he contracted his face and glowered anguished by what he wanted to say and scowled increasing the contracting and the glowering in his face.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ وَٱسْتَكْبَرَ
verses.en: Then he turned back and was arrogant

tafsir.text: Then he turned his back to faith in disdain scornful of following the Prophet s

verses.ar: فَقَالَ إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا سِحْرٌ يُؤْثَرُ
verses.en: And said, "This is not but magic imitated [from others].

tafsir.text: and said of what he the Prophet had brought ‘This is nothing but handed-down sorcery learnt from sorcerers;

verses.ar: إِنْ هَـٰذَآ إِلَّا قَوْلُ ٱلْبَشَرِ
verses.en: This is not but the word of a human being."

tafsir.text: this is nothing but the speech of humans’ similar to what they the idolaters had said ‘It is only a human that is teaching him’ Q. 16103.

verses.ar: سَأُصْلِيهِ سَقَرَ
verses.en: I will drive him into Saqar.

tafsir.text: I shall soon admit him into Saqar! — Hell.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سَقَرُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is Saqar?

tafsir.text: And how would you know what is Saqar? — this interrogative is intended to emphasise its enormity.

verses.ar: لَا تُبْقِى وَلَا تَذَرُ
verses.en: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],

tafsir.text: It neither spares nor leaves behind anything of flesh or nerve but destroys it all after which he is restored to his former state.

verses.ar: لَوَّاحَةٌ لِّلْبَشَرِ
verses.en: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.

tafsir.text: It burns away the flesh scorching the surface of skin.

verses.ar: عَلَيْهَا تِسْعَةَ عَشَرَ
verses.en: Over it are nineteen [angels].

tafsir.text: There are nineteen keepers standing over it angels its keepers; a certain disbeliever who was a mighty stalwart said ‘I will avail you seventeen of them if you avail me just two’. God exalted be He says

verses.ar: وَمَا جَعَلْنَآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلنَّارِ إِلَّا مَلَـٰٓئِكَةً ۙ وَمَا جَعَلْنَا عِدَّتَهُمْ إِلَّا فِتْنَةً لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لِيَسْتَيْقِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَيَزْدَادَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنًا ۙ وَلَا يَرْتَابَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ۙ وَلِيَقُولَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ وَٱلْكَـٰفِرُونَ مَاذَآ أَرَادَ ٱللَّهُ بِهَـٰذَا مَثَلًا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِى مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ جُنُودَ رَبِّكَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَمَا هِىَ إِلَّا ذِكْرَىٰ لِلْبَشَرِ
verses.en: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Scripture will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Scripture and the believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, "What does Allāh intend by this as an example?" Thus does Allāh send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.

tafsir.text: And We have appointed only angels as wardens of the Fire in other words and so they cannot be withstood as these disbelievers are wont to imagine; and We have made their number so only as a stumbling-block a cause for error for those who disbelieve when they then say ‘Why are there nineteen of them?’ so that those who

verses.ar: كَلَّا وَٱلْقَمَرِ
verses.en: No! By the moon.

tafsir.text: Nay kallā denoting a commencement of a new sentence to be understood as alā by the moon!

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذْ أَدْبَرَ
verses.en: And [by] the night when it departs.

tafsir.text: And by the night when it returns! if read as idhā dabara when it comes back after day a variant reading has idh adbara meaning ‘when it has receded’.

verses.ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَآ أَسْفَرَ
verses.en: And [by] the morning when it brightens,

tafsir.text: And by the dawn when it appears!

verses.ar: إِنَّهَا لَإِحْدَى ٱلْكُبَرِ
verses.en: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions].

tafsir.text: Verily it that is Saqar is one of the enormities one of the greatest calamities —

verses.ar: نَذِيرًا لِّلْبَشَرِ
verses.en: As a warning to humanity -

tafsir.text: a warning nadhīran is a circumstantial qualifier referring to ihdā ‘one of’ and it is masculine because it denotes masculine ‘adhāb ‘chastisement’ to all humans;

verses.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَتَقَدَّمَ أَوْ يَتَأَخَّرَ
verses.en: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.

tafsir.text: alike to those of you who wish li-man shā’a minkum is a substitution for li’l-bashar ‘to all humans’ to advance towards good or towards Paradise by means of faith or linger behind in evil or in Hell because of their disbelief.

verses.ar: كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ رَهِينَةٌ
verses.en: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained.

tafsir.text: Every soul is held to ransom by what it earns it is ransomed and requited for its deeds with the Fire

verses.ar: إِلَّآ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْيَمِينِ
verses.en: Except the companions of the right,.

tafsir.text: except those of the right hand namely the believers who will be saved from it and who will be

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other

tafsir.text: in gardens questioning one another

verses.ar: عَنِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: About the criminals,

tafsir.text: about the guilty and their predicament; and they will say to them after all those who believed in the One God muwahhidūn are brought out of the Fire

verses.ar: مَا سَلَكَكُمْ فِى سَقَرَ
verses.en: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"

tafsir.text: ‘What has landed you in what has made you enter Saqar?’

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَمْ نَكُ مِنَ ٱلْمُصَلِّينَ
verses.en: They will say, "We were not of those who prayed,

tafsir.text: They will say ‘We were not of those who prayed.

verses.ar: وَلَمْ نَكُ نُطْعِمُ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ
verses.en: Nor did we used to feed the poor.

tafsir.text: Nor did we ever feed the needy.

verses.ar: وَكُنَّا نَخُوضُ مَعَ ٱلْخَآئِضِينَ
verses.en: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],

tafsir.text: And we used to delve into falsehood along with those who delved

verses.ar: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense

tafsir.text: and we used to deny the Day of Judgement the Day of Resurrection and Requital

verses.ar: حَتَّىٰٓ أَتَىٰنَا ٱلْيَقِينُ
verses.en: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death]."

tafsir.text: until finally the inevitable came to us’ — death.

verses.ar: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمْ شَفَـٰعَةُ ٱلشَّـٰفِعِينَ
verses.en: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.

tafsir.text: Thus the intercession of the intercessors from among the angels the prophets and the righteous will not avail them in other words there will be no intercession for them.

verses.ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ عَنِ ٱلتَّذْكِرَةِ مُعْرِضِينَ
verses.en: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away.

tafsir.text: So what fa-mā the subject is wrong with them lahum the predicate thereof semantically connected to an omitted clause the person of which has been transposed onto it that they turn away mu‘ridīna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the suffixed pronoun in lahum ‘them’ from the Reminder — in other words ‘what has

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ حُمُرٌ مُّسْتَنفِرَةٌ
verses.en: As if they were alarmed donkeys.

tafsir.text: as if they were wild asses

verses.ar: فَرَّتْ مِن قَسْوَرَةٍۭ
verses.en: Fleeing from a lion?

tafsir.text: fleeing from a lion? that is to say fleeing from it with absolute fright.

verses.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُؤْتَىٰ صُحُفًا مُّنَشَّرَةً
verses.en: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.

tafsir.text: Nay but everyone of them desires to be given unrolled scrolls from God exalted be He enjoining them to follow the Prophet s as they said before ‘And even then we will not believe your ascension until you bring down for us a book that we may read’ Q. 1793.

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا يَخَافُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
verses.en: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.

tafsir.text: No indeed! kallā a deterrent of what they desire. Rather they do not fear the Hereafter that is the chastisement thereof.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُۥ تَذْكِرَةٌ
verses.en: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder.

tafsir.text: No indeed! kallā a commencement of a new sentence Assuredly it that is the Qur’ān is a Reminder an admonition.

verses.ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
verses.en: Then whoever wills will remember it.

tafsir.text: So whoever wills shall remember it he shall read it and be admonished by it.

verses.ar: وَمَا يَذْكُرُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ هُوَ أَهْلُ ٱلتَّقْوَىٰ وَأَهْلُ ٱلْمَغْفِرَةِ
verses.en: And they will not remember except that Allāh wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.

tafsir.text: And they will not remember yadhkurūna or read second person plural tadhkurūna unless God wills it. He is the One worthy of your fear and the One worthy to forgive by forgiving those who fear Him.

verses.ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
verses.en: I swear by the Day of Resurrection

tafsir.text: Nay! the lā is extra in both instances I swear by the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: وَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلنَّفْسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
verses.en: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].

tafsir.text: And nay I swear by the self-reproaching soul the one that reproaches itself even if it should expend great effort in being virtuous the response to the oath has been omitted that is to say la-tub‘athunna ‘you shall indeed be resurrected!’ as indicated by what follows

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَلَّن نَّجْمَعَ عِظَامَهُۥ
verses.en: Does man think that We will not assemble his bones?

tafsir.text: Does man that is does the disbeliever suppose that We shall not assemble his bones? for the raising from the graves and for the bringing back to life.

verses.ar: بَلَىٰ قَـٰدِرِينَ عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّسَوِّىَ بَنَانَهُۥ
verses.en: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.

tafsir.text: Yes indeed! We shall assemble them. We are able in addition to assembling them to reshape even his fingers that is to say to restore their bones just as they had been despite their smallness so how much more so are We able to restore the larger ones!

verses.ar: بَلْ يُرِيدُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ لِيَفْجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
verses.en: But man desires to continue in sin.

tafsir.text: Nay but man desires to deny li-yafjura the lām is extra and the subjunctive mood is because of an implied preceding an ‘that’ what lies ahead of him namely the Day of Resurrection as is indicated by

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوْمُ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ
verses.en: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"

tafsir.text: He asks ‘When is the Day of Resurrection?’ — the question is meant in mockery and denial.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلْبَصَرُ
verses.en: So when vision is dazzled.

tafsir.text: But when the eyes are dazzled read bariqa or baraqa startled and perplexed upon seeing some of those things which it used to deny;

verses.ar: وَخَسَفَ ٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.en: And the moon darkens.

tafsir.text: and the moon is eclipsed darkening its light disappearing

verses.ar: وَجُمِعَ ٱلشَّمْسُ وَٱلْقَمَرُ
verses.en: And the sun and the moon are joined,

tafsir.text: and the sun and the moon are brought together so that both of them will rise from the west; or it means when the light of both of them disappears — and this will be on the Day of Resurrection —

verses.ar: يَقُولُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَيْنَ ٱلْمَفَرُّ
verses.en: Man will say on that Day, "Where is the [place of] escape?"

tafsir.text: on that day man will say ‘Where is the escape?’

verses.ar: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
verses.en: No! There is no refuge.

tafsir.text: No indeed! — a deterrent against seeking to escape — There is no refuge no shelter to seek protection in.

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمُسْتَقَرُّ
verses.en: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.

tafsir.text: On that day the recourse will be to your Lord the final recourse of all creatures whereupon they will be reckoned with and requited.

verses.ar: يُنَبَّؤُا۟ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِمَا قَدَّمَ وَأَخَّرَ
verses.en: Man will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.

tafsir.text: On that day man will be informed of what he has sent ahead and left behind he will be informed of the his first and last deeds.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٌ
verses.en: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,

tafsir.text: Rather man has insight into his own soul for his limbs will speak of his deeds the hā’ sc. the tā’ marbūta in basīratun is for hyperbole and so he must be requited

verses.ar: وَلَوْ أَلْقَىٰ مَعَاذِيرَهُۥ
verses.en: Even if he presents his excuses.

tafsir.text: though he should offer his excuses ma‘ādhīr is the plural of ma‘dhira but following a different pattern from the usual ma‘dhira ma‘ādhir that is to say whatever excuse he offers will not be accepted from him.

verses.ar: لَا تُحَرِّكْ بِهِۦ لِسَانَكَ لِتَعْجَلَ بِهِۦٓ
verses.en: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muḥammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says to His Prophet Do not move your tongue with it with the Qur’ān before Gabriel is through with reciting it to hasten it fearing to lose it.

verses.ar: إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا جَمْعَهُۥ وَقُرْءَانَهُۥ
verses.en: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.

tafsir.text: Assuredly it is for Us to bring it together in your breast and to recite it your reciting of it that is its flowing off your tongue.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا قَرَأْنَـٰهُ فَٱتَّبِعْ قُرْءَانَهُۥ
verses.en: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.

tafsir.text: So when We recite it to you by means of Gabriel’s recital follow its recitation listen to its recitation thus the Prophet s would listen to it and then repeat it.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا بَيَانَهُۥ
verses.en: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].

tafsir.text: Then it is for Us to explain it by making you comprehend it the connection between this verse and what preceded it is that those verses before imply turning away from God’s signs whereas this one implies applying oneself to them by memorising them.

verses.ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ
verses.en: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate

tafsir.text: No indeed! kallā is for commencement with the sense of alā Rather you love the transitory life this world both verbs here and below may be read in the second or third person plural

verses.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ
verses.en: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.

tafsir.text: and forsake the Hereafter thus neglecting to work towards attaining bliss in it.

verses.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاضِرَةٌ
verses.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,

tafsir.text: Some faces on that day that is on the Day of Resurrection will be radiant fair and resplendent

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّهَا نَاظِرَةٌ
verses.en: Looking at their Lord.

tafsir.text: looking upon their Lord in other words they will see God glorified and exalted be He in the Hereafter.

verses.ar: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بَاسِرَةٌ
verses.en: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,

tafsir.text: And other faces on that day will be scowling glowering frowning terribly

verses.ar: تَظُنُّ أَن يُفْعَلَ بِهَا فَاقِرَةٌ
verses.en: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.

tafsir.text: certain that a spine-crushing calamity will fall on them a great catastrophe one that ‘crushes the spine’ fiqār.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلتَّرَاقِىَ
verses.en: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones

tafsir.text: No indeed! kallā in the sense of alā When it the soul reaches up to the collar bones

verses.ar: وَقِيلَ مَنْ ۜ رَاقٍ
verses.en: And it is said, "Who will cure [him]?"

tafsir.text: and it is said and those around him the dying one say ‘Where is the enchanter?’ to perform incantations on him and cure him

verses.ar: وَظَنَّ أَنَّهُ ٱلْفِرَاقُ
verses.en: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation

tafsir.text: and he suspects he the one whose soul has reached this stage that it is the time of parting the parting with this world

verses.ar: وَٱلْتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
verses.en: And the leg is wound about the leg,

tafsir.text: and the shank is intertwined with the other shank that is one of his shanks will be intertwined with his other shank at the moment of death; or it means the distress of parting with this world is intertwined with the distress of the arrival of the Hereafter;

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ يَوْمَئِذٍ ٱلْمَسَاقُ
verses.en: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.

tafsir.text: on that day to your Lord will be the driving of the souls al-masāq means al-sawq; this indicates the operator of the above idhā ‘when’ the meaning being ‘when the soul reaches the throat it will be driven towards the judgement of its Lord’.

verses.ar: فَلَا صَدَّقَ وَلَا صَلَّىٰ
verses.en: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.

tafsir.text: For he man neither affirmed the truth nor prayed

verses.ar: وَلَـٰكِن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.en: But [instead], he denied and turned away.

tafsir.text: but he denied the Qur’ān and he turned away from faith

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ذَهَبَ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ يَتَمَطَّىٰٓ
verses.en: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].

tafsir.text: then went off to his family swaggering strutting about in self-conceit.

verses.ar: أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰ
verses.en: Woe to you, and woe!

tafsir.text: Woe be nearer to you there is a shift from the third to the second person address here; the term awlā is a noun of action with the following lām being explicative in other words ‘what you are averse to is now near to you’ and nearer that is because you are more deserving of it woe than anyone else

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَوْلَىٰ لَكَ فَأَوْلَىٰٓ
verses.en: Then woe to you, and woe!

tafsir.text: then may woe be nearer to you and nearer! — repeated for emphasis.

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ أَن يُتْرَكَ سُدًى
verses.en: Does man think that he will be left neglected?

tafsir.text: Does man suppose that he is to be left aimless? left to his own devices without being obligated to the prescribed laws let him not suppose that!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ يَكُ نُطْفَةً مِّن مَّنِىٍّ يُمْنَىٰ
verses.en: Had he not been a sperm from semen emitted?

tafsir.text: Was he not — that is indeed he was — a drop of emitted semen? read yumnā or tumnā deposited into the womb.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ عَلَقَةً فَخَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verses.en: Then he was a clinging clot, and [Allāh] created [his form] and proportioned [him]

tafsir.text: Then it the drop of semen became a clot; then He God created from it man and proportioned him making the parts of his body upright

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَ مِنْهُ ٱلزَّوْجَيْنِ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ
verses.en: And made of him two mates, the male and the female.

tafsir.text: and made of it of the drop of semen that became a blood-clot then an embryo a small mass of flesh the two sexes the two kinds the male and the female at times coming together and at times each being on their own.

verses.ar: أَلَيْسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَـٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحْـِۧىَ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ
verses.en: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?

tafsir.text: Is not such a Doer of all these things able to revive the dead? — the Prophet s would say ‘Yes indeed!’

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا
verses.en: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?

tafsir.text: Has there ever been — there has indeed been — for man Adam a period of time forty years in which he was a thing unmentioned? — he was during this period a fashioned in clay and not mentioned; alternatively what is meant by insān ‘man’ is the generic noun and by hīn ‘a period of time’ the period of gestation.

verses.ar: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.

tafsir.text: Verily We created man the species from a drop of mixed fluid from a mixture that is from the seminal fluid of the man and the ovarian fluid of the woman that have mixed and blended so that We may test him trying him with the moral obligations of religion nabtalīhi is either a new sentence ‘We will test him’ or an

verses.ar: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا
verses.en: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.

tafsir.text: Verily We have guided him to the way We have pointed out to him the path of guidance by sending messengers to mankind whether he be grateful that is to say whether he be a believer or ungrateful both shākiran and kafūran are circumstantial qualifiers referring to the direct object;

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.

tafsir.text: We have assuredly prepared for the disbelievers chains with which they are dragged through the Fire and fetters around their necks to which the chains will be attached and a hell-fire a fire set ablaze burning fiercely in which they shall be chastised.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,

tafsir.text: Truly the righteous abrār is the plural of barr or bārr namely the obedient ones will drink from a cup ka’s is a vessel for drinking wine and this wine will be in it; what is meant is that they will drink from ‘wine’ a case where the actuality is referred to by the name of the locus in which it is found;

verses.ar: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا
verses.en: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].

tafsir.text: a spring ‘aynan substitutes for kāfūran containing the scent thereof from which the servants of God His friends drink making it gush forth plenteously directing it to wherever they wish of their dwellings.

verses.ar: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا
verses.en: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.

tafsir.text: They fulfil their vows pledged in obedience to God and fear a day the evil of which will be widespread.

verses.ar: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا
verses.en: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,

tafsir.text: And they give food despite their love of it that is to say despite their love of food and their craving for it to the needy the poor and the orphan who does not have a father and the prisoner meaning the one who has been rightly imprisoned.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا
verses.en: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.

tafsir.text: ‘We feed you only for the sake of God seeking His reward. We do not desire any reward from you nor any thanks this contains the reason for the giving of the food.

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا
verses.en: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."

tafsir.text: Indeed we fear from our Lord a day of frowning one in which faces scowl in other words a horrid day to observe on account of its severity calamitous’ severe in that respect.

verses.ar: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا
verses.en: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness

tafsir.text: God has therefore shielded them from the evil of that day and has granted them radiance fairness and resplendence in their faces and joy.

verses.ar: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا
verses.en: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].

tafsir.text: And He has rewarded them for their patience for their steadfastness in refraining from disobedience with a Garden into which they are admitted and silk which they are given to wear;

verses.ar: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا
verses.en: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.

tafsir.text: reclining muttaki’īna is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the implicit verb udkhilūhā ‘they are admitted into it’ therein upon couches arā’ik are beds inside canopies. They will not find lā yarawna is a second circumstantial qualifier therein either sun or bitter cold neither heat nor cold;

verses.ar: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا
verses.en: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.

tafsir.text: And close dāniyatan is a supplement to the syntactical locus of the clause lā yarawna in other words it is a supplement to the import ghayra rā’īna over them will be its shades its trees and its clusters of fruits will hang low its fruits will brought close so that they are reached by the one standing the one sitting

verses.ar: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠
verses.en: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],

tafsir.text: And they will be waited upon from all around them in it with vessels of silver and goblets akwāb are cups without handles of crystal —

verses.ar: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا
verses.en: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.

tafsir.text: crystal of silver that is they are made of silver which is transparent like crystal — which they that is the ones passing around them in service have measured in a precise measure according to the measure required by the one drinking it neither more nor less which makes for a most delightful drink.

verses.ar: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا
verses.en: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger

tafsir.text: And they will be given to drink therein a cup wine whose mixture that with which it is mixed is ginger

verses.ar: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا
verses.en: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.

tafsir.text: a spring ‘aynan substitutes for zanjabīlan ‘ginger’ therein named Salsabīl meaning that its water is like ginger which the Arabs find very tasteful and which is very palatable for the throat.

verses.ar: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا
verses.en: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.

tafsir.text: And they will be waited upon by immortal youths immortally in the form of youths never ageing whom when you see them you will suppose them because of their beauty and the way in which they are scattered about offering service to be scattered pearls strewn from their string or from their shells in which they are fairer

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا
verses.en: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.

tafsir.text: And when you look there that is to say when you begin to look about in Paradise you will see ra’ayta is the response to idhā ‘when’ bliss that is indescribable and a great kingdom vast without limit.

verses.ar: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا
verses.en: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.

tafsir.text: Upon them ‘āliyahum is in the accusative as an adverbial clause and constitutes the predicate of a subject that will follow; a variant reading has ‘ālīhim as a subject with what follows as its predicate;

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا
verses.en: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."

tafsir.text: ‘Verily this bliss is a reward for you and your endeavour has been appreciated’.

verses.ar: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.

tafsir.text: Assuredly We nahnu reiterates the subject of innā ‘assuredly for the purpose of emphasis; alternatively it is a separating pronoun have revealed the Qur’ān to you as a gradual revelation tanzīlan is the predicate of inna ‘assuredly’ in other words We have divided it into parts instead of not revealing it all at once.

verses.ar: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا
verses.en: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].

tafsir.text: So submit patiently to your Lord’s decree to you to deliver His Message and do not obey of them that is of the disbelievers any sinner or disbeliever namely ‘Utba b. Rabī‘a and al-Walīd b. al-Mughīra — both of whom said to the Prophet s ‘Abandon this affair of yours!’;

verses.ar: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا
verses.en: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening

tafsir.text: And mention the Name of your Lord during prayer at dawn and with the declining of the sun that is at dawn fajr noon zuhr and in the afternoon ‘asr;

verses.ar: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا
verses.en: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.

tafsir.text: and prostrate to Him for a portion of the night that is at after sunset maghrib and at night ‘ishā’ and glorify Him the length of the night perform supererogatory prayers during it as mentioned above for either two thirds a half or a third of it.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.

tafsir.text: Assuredly these love the transitory life this world and leave behind them a burdensome day an awful one namely the Day of Resurrection not working towards it.

verses.ar: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا
verses.en: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.

tafsir.text: We created them and made firm their frames their limbs and their joints and whenever We will We can completely replace them with others like them in terms of their created form in place of them by destroying them tabdīlan ‘completely’ is for emphasis;

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا
verses.en: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.

tafsir.text: This sūra is indeed a reminder an admonition for all creatures. Let him who will then choose a way to his Lord a path through obedience.

verses.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا
verses.en: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.

tafsir.text: But you will not tashā’ūna may also be read yashā’ūna ‘they will’ choose a way through obedience unless God wills this. Assuredly God is ever Knower of His creatures Wise in what He does.

verses.ar: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا
verses.en: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.

tafsir.text: He admits whomever He will into His mercy His Paradise namely the believers; and as for the evildoers al-zālimīna is in the accusative because of an implied verb that is to say a‘adda ‘He has prepared’ as explained by what follows He has prepared for them a painful chastisement — these are the disbelievers.

verses.ar: وَٱلْمُرْسَلَـٰتِ عُرْفًا
verses.en: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts

tafsir.text: By those sent in succession ‘urfan that is by the winds that follow one another in succession like the mane ‘urf of a horse one part of hair coming after the other ‘urfan is in the accusative because it is a circumstantial qualifier;

verses.ar: فَٱلْعَـٰصِفَـٰتِ عَصْفًا
verses.en: And the winds that blow violently

tafsir.text: by the raging hurricanes the violent winds;

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّـٰشِرَٰتِ نَشْرًا
verses.en: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]

tafsir.text: by the sweeping spreaders by the winds that scatter the rains;

verses.ar: فَٱلْفَـٰرِقَـٰتِ فَرْقًا
verses.en: And those [angels] who bring criterion

tafsir.text: by the decisive discriminators that is by the verses of the Qur’ān which discriminate between truth and falsehood and between what is lawful and what is unlawful;

verses.ar: فَٱلْمُلْقِيَـٰتِ ذِكْرًا
verses.en: And those [angels] who deliver a message.

tafsir.text: by the casters of the remembrance that is by angels that descend with the revelation upon the prophets and messengers casting the revelation onto the various communities of mankind

verses.ar: عُذْرًا أَوْ نُذْرًا
verses.en: As justification or warning,

tafsir.text: to excuse or to warn that is to say in order to excuse or to warn on behalf of God exalted be He a variant reading for nudhran and ‘udhran has nudhuran and ‘udhuran.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَا تُوعَدُونَ لَوَٰقِعٌ
verses.en: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.

tafsir.text: Surely that which you are promised O disbelievers of Mecca in the way of resurrection and chastisement will befall it will be without any doubt.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتْ
verses.en: So when the stars are obliterated

tafsir.text: So when the stars are obliterated when their light is extinguished

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ فُرِجَتْ
verses.en: And when the heaven is opened

tafsir.text: and when the heaven is rent asunder

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ نُسِفَتْ
verses.en: And when the mountains are blown away

tafsir.text: and when the mountains are blown away crushed to pieces and blown in the air

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلرُّسُلُ أُقِّتَتْ
verses.en: And when the messengers' time has come...

tafsir.text: and when the time is set for the testimony of the messengers read uqqitat or wuqqitat that is to say when they are gathered to an appointed time

verses.ar: لِأَىِّ يَوْمٍ أُجِّلَتْ
verses.en: For what Day was it postponed?

tafsir.text: For what day — for a tremendous day — has it been appointed? it has been appointed for witnessing of the messengers against their communities to the effect that they delivered their messages from God.

verses.ar: لِيَوْمِ ٱلْفَصْلِ
verses.en: For the Day of Judgement.

tafsir.text: For the Day of Decision for creatures from this one may infer the response to the clauses beginning with idhā ‘when’ in other words ‘when … the decision will be made for all creatures’.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?

tafsir.text: And how would you know what the Day of Decision is? — emphasising the enormity of its terror.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day! — a threat of chastisement for them.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نُهْلِكِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: Did We not destroy the former peoples?

tafsir.text: Did We not destroy the ancients for their denial in other words We certainly destroyed them

verses.ar: ثُمَّ نُتْبِعُهُمُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ
verses.en: Then We will follow them with the later ones.

tafsir.text: then made the latter folk follow them? the latter folk of those who denied such as the disbelievers of Mecca whom We will destroy.

verses.ar: كَذَٰلِكَ نَفْعَلُ بِٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
verses.en: Thus do We deal with the criminals.

tafsir.text: So just as We dealt with those who denied will We deal with the guilty with every individual who will be guilty in the future and destroy them.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day! — reiterated for emphasis.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَخْلُقكُّم مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
verses.en: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?

tafsir.text: Did We not create you from a base fluid one that is delicate — and this is semen

verses.ar: فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ فِى قَرَارٍ مَّكِينٍ
verses.en: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]

tafsir.text: then lodged it in a secure abode that is the womb

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ قَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
verses.en: For a known extent.

tafsir.text: for a known span? namely the time for delivery.

verses.ar: فَقَدَرْنَا فَنِعْمَ ٱلْقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.en: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.

tafsir.text: Thus We were able to do this; so how excellent able ones We are!

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ كِفَاتًا
verses.en: Have We not made the earth a container

tafsir.text: Have We not made the earth a receptacle kifātan is a verbal noun from kafata meaning damma ‘enclosed’ that is an enclosure

verses.ar: أَحْيَآءً وَأَمْوَٰتًا
verses.en: Of the living and the dead?

tafsir.text: for the living on its surface and the dead inside it

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ شَـٰمِخَـٰتٍ وَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُم مَّآءً فُرَاتًا
verses.en: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.

tafsir.text: and set therein soaring mountains and give you sweet water to drink?

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَا كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: [They will be told], "Proceed to that which you used to deny.

tafsir.text: And on the Day of Resurrection it will be said to the deniers Depart to that chastisement which you used to deny!

verses.ar: ٱنطَلِقُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ ظِلٍّ ذِى ثَلَـٰثِ شُعَبٍ
verses.en: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns.

tafsir.text: Depart to a triple-forked shadow — this is the smoke of Hell which as it rises splits into three parts because of its magnitude —

verses.ar: لَّا ظَلِيلٍ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
verses.en: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."

tafsir.text: which is neither shady neither protective unable to shade them from the heat of that Day nor of any avail against nor wards off from them anything of the flame the Fire.

verses.ar: إِنَّهَا تَرْمِى بِشَرَرٍ كَٱلْقَصْرِ
verses.en: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,

tafsir.text: Indeed it that is the Fire throws up sparks namely those flame that are thrown by it into the air huge like palace edifices in terms of their enormity and vertical extension

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُۥ جِمَـٰلَتٌ صُفْرٌ
verses.en: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.

tafsir.text: as if they were dark yellow camels jimālātun is the plural of jimalatun the plural of jamalun; a variant reading has jimālatun in terms of their shape and colour. In hadīth it is stated ‘The sparks of humans thrown into the air by the Fire are black as pitch qīr’;

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ لَا يَنطِقُونَ
verses.en: This is a Day they will not speak,

tafsir.text: This namely the Day of Resurrection is the day in which they will not utter anything

verses.ar: وَلَا يُؤْذَنُ لَهُمْ فَيَعْتَذِرُونَ
verses.en: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.

tafsir.text: nor will they be given permission to offer excuses and so offer excuses fa-ya‘tadhirūna is a supplement to yu’dhanu ‘given permission’ but without being a direct result of it since it belongs within the confines of the general denial of permission in other words ‘there will be no permission hence no excuses’.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.ar: هَـٰذَا يَوْمُ ٱلْفَصْلِ ۖ جَمَعْنَـٰكُمْ وَٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.

tafsir.text: ‘This is the Day of Decision. We have brought you O deniers from this community and the ancients together the ancients from among the deniers before you so that you will all be reckoned with and chastised together;

verses.ar: فَإِن كَانَ لَكُمْ كَيْدٌ فَكِيدُونِ
verses.en: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.

tafsir.text: So if you have any stratagems any ploy to ward off your chastisement try your strategems against Me!’ — put them into effect!

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى ظِلَـٰلٍ وَعُيُونٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs

tafsir.text: Truly the God-fearing will be amid shades that is amid clusters of trees since there is no sun therein from whose heat to seek shade and springs issuing forth with water

verses.ar: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشْتَهُونَ
verses.en: And fruits from whatever they desire,

tafsir.text: and fruits such as they desire this is meant to point out that eating and drinking in Paradise is done according to their desires in contrast to the case in this world where it is predominantly determined by what people are able to procure. It will also be said to them

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَٱشْرَبُوا۟ هَنِيٓـًٔۢا بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.en: [Being told], "Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do."

tafsir.text: ‘Eat and drink in full enjoyment hanī’an is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mutahanni’īna for what you used to do’ in the way of obedience.

verses.ar: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.en: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

tafsir.text: Indeed so in the same way that We reward the God-fearing do We reward the virtuous.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.ar: كُلُوا۟ وَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ قَلِيلًا إِنَّكُم مُّجْرِمُونَ
verses.en: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.

tafsir.text: ‘Eat and enjoy — addressing the disbelievers in this world — for a little time at the end of which comes death — this is meant as a threat for them. Indeed you are guilty!’

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمُ ٱرْكَعُوا۟ لَا يَرْكَعُونَ
verses.en: And when it is said to them, "Bow [in prayer]," they do not bow.

tafsir.text: For when it is said to them ‘Bow down!’ perform prayer they do not bow down they do not perform prayer.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day!

verses.ar: فَبِأَىِّ حَدِيثٍۭ بَعْدَهُۥ يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?

tafsir.text: In what discourse then after this namely the Qur’ān will they believe? In other words they cannot believe in any other of God’s Scriptures after having denied this Qur’ān since it comprises that inimitability i‘jāz which none of the others do.

verses.ar: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
verses.en: About what are they asking one another?

tafsir.text: About what about what thing are they the people of Quraysh questioning one another?

verses.ar: عَنِ ٱلنَّبَإِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.en: About the great news -

tafsir.text: About the awesome tiding this is the explication of that ‘thing’; the interrogative is meant to emphasise its magnitude — this awesome tiding is the Qur’ān comprising news of the Resurrection and so on which the Prophet s brought —

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى هُمْ فِيهِ مُخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.en: That over which they are in disagreement.

tafsir.text: concerning which they are at variance for the believers affirm it while the disbelievers repudiate it.

verses.ar: كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: No! They are going to know.

tafsir.text: No indeed! — a disavowal — they will come to know what will befall them for their rejection of it.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَلَّا سَيَعْلَمُونَ
verses.en: Then, no! They are going to know.

tafsir.text: Again no indeed! They will come to know! reiterated for emphasis; thumma is added here to declare that the second threat of chastisement is more severe than the first. God exalted be He then alludes to His power to resurrect saying

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَلِ ٱلْأَرْضَ مِهَـٰدًا
verses.en: Have We not made the earth a resting place?

tafsir.text: Have We not made the earth a cradle a bed like a cradle

verses.ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَوْتَادًا
verses.en: And the mountains as stakes?

tafsir.text: and the mountains pegs? with which the earth is tied down like tents are tied down with pegs the interrogative is meant as an affirmative.

verses.ar: وَخَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا
verses.en: And We created you in pairs.

tafsir.text: And created you in pairs? males and females

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا نَوْمَكُمْ سُبَاتًا
verses.en: And made your sleep [a means for] rest

tafsir.text: and made your sleep for rest? repose for your bodies

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلَّيْلَ لِبَاسًا
verses.en: And made the night as clothing.

tafsir.text: and made the night a cloak? to cover you with its darkness

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا ٱلنَّهَارَ مَعَاشًا
verses.en: And made the day for livelihood.

tafsir.text: and made the day for livelihood? a time for seeking livelihood

verses.ar: وَبَنَيْنَا فَوْقَكُمْ سَبْعًا شِدَادًا
verses.en: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens].

tafsir.text: and built above you seven mighty ones? seven heavens shidād is the plural of shadīda that is to say strong and sturdy unaffected by the passage of time

verses.ar: وَجَعَلْنَا سِرَاجًا وَهَّاجًا
verses.en: And made [therein] a burning lamp

tafsir.text: and set a radiant lamp? namely the sun

verses.ar: وَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمُعْصِرَٰتِ مَآءً ثَجَّاجًا
verses.en: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water.

tafsir.text: and sent down from the rain-clouds mu‘sirāt the clouds due to give rain similar to the term mu‘sir which denotes a girl nearing menstruation cascading water? pouring forth

verses.ar: لِّنُخْرِجَ بِهِۦ حَبًّا وَنَبَاتًا
verses.en: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation.

tafsir.text: that with it We may bring forth grains such as wheat and plants such as figs

verses.ar: وَجَنَّـٰتٍ أَلْفَافًا
verses.en: And gardens of entwined growth.

tafsir.text: and gardens orchards of intertwining foliage? alfāf is the plural of lafīf similar in pattern to sharīf ‘noble’ plural ashrāf.

verses.ar: إِنَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ كَانَ مِيقَـٰتًا
verses.en: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -

tafsir.text: Verily the Day of Decision for creatures is the tryst a time fixed for reward and punishment

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ فَتَأْتُونَ أَفْوَاجًا
verses.en: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes

tafsir.text: the day the Trumpet the Horn is blown yawma yunfakhu fī’l-sūri is either a substitution for or an explication of yawma’l-fasli ‘the Day of Decision’ the blower being Isrāfīl and you come forth from your graves to the site of the Resurrection in droves in diverse groups

verses.ar: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتْ أَبْوَٰبًا
verses.en: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways.

tafsir.text: and the heaven is opened read futtihat or futihat sundered for the descent of the angels and becomes as gates it becomes a heaven with gates

verses.ar: وَسُيِّرَتِ ٱلْجِبَالُ فَكَانَتْ سَرَابًا
verses.en: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.

tafsir.text: and the mountains are set in motion dislocated from their positions and become as a mirage as fine dust that is to say like it in terms of its levity when in motion.

verses.ar: إِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ كَانَتْ مِرْصَادًا
verses.en: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait

tafsir.text: Verily Hell lurks in ambush mirsādan in the sense of rāsidatan or mursidatan ‘lying in wait’

verses.ar: لِّلطَّـٰغِينَ مَـَٔابًا
verses.en: For the transgressors, a place of return,

tafsir.text: for the rebellious the disbelievers who will not be able to avoid it it is a resort a retreat for them and so they will enter it

verses.ar: لَّـٰبِثِينَ فِيهَآ أَحْقَابًا
verses.en: In which they will remain for ages [unending].

tafsir.text: to remain lābithīna is an implied circumstantial qualifier in other words their remaining therein will be decreed to be therein for ages for endless epochs ahqāb is the plural of huqb

verses.ar: لَّا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا بَرْدًا وَلَا شَرَابًا
verses.en: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink.

tafsir.text: tasting in it neither coolness neither sleep something which they will not taste therein nor drink nor anything that is imbibed for the sake of its delightful taste

verses.ar: إِلَّا حَمِيمًا وَغَسَّاقًا
verses.en: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -

tafsir.text: except boiling water of extreme temperatures and pus read ghasāqan or ghassāqan which is the vile matter that is emitted by the bodies of the inhabitants of the Fire which is what they will indeed taste. They are given this pair of tortures

verses.ar: جَزَآءً وِفَاقًا
verses.en: An appropriate recompense.

tafsir.text: as a fitting requital one that accords with the nature of their deeds for there is no sin greater than disbelief and no chastisement greater than the Fire.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ لَا يَرْجُونَ حِسَابًا
verses.en: Indeed, they were not expecting an account

tafsir.text: Indeed they never feared any reckoning given their rejection of the Resurrection

verses.ar: وَكَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا كِذَّابًا
verses.en: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.

tafsir.text: and they denied Our signs the Qur’ān mendaciously

verses.ar: وَكُلَّ شَىْءٍ أَحْصَيْنَـٰهُ كِتَـٰبًا
verses.en: But all things We have enumerated in writing.

tafsir.text: and everything in the way of deeds have We kept count of have We recorded precisely in a Book as individual written records in the Preserved Tablet in order to requite creatures in accordance with them including the record of their denial of the Qur’ān.

verses.ar: فَذُوقُوا۟ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمْ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
verses.en: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."

tafsir.text: ‘So now taste! — in other words it will be said to them in the Hereafter when the chastisement has befallen them taste now your requital! For We will increase you in nothing but chastisement’ in addition to your due chastisement.

verses.ar: إِنَّ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ مَفَازًا
verses.en: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -

tafsir.text: Truly for the God-fearing there will be a triumph a place of triumph in Paradise

verses.ar: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعْنَـٰبًا
verses.en: Gardens and grapevines.

tafsir.text: gardens orchards hadā’iqa is either a substitution for or an explication of mafāzan ‘a triumph’ and vineyards wa-a‘nāban is a supplement to mafāzan ‘a triumph’

verses.ar: وَكَوَاعِبَ أَتْرَابًا
verses.en: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age.

tafsir.text: and buxom maidens kawā‘ib is the plural of kā‘ib of equal age atrāb is the plural of tirb

verses.ar: وَكَأْسًا دِهَاقًا
verses.en: And a full cup.

tafsir.text: and a brimming cup wine filling the vessels in which it is in; in sūrat al-Qitāl it is said and rivers of wine Q. 4715.

verses.ar: لَّا يَسْمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغْوًا وَلَا كِذَّٰبًا
verses.en: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -

tafsir.text: They will not hear in it that is in Paradise when they drink wine and in other situations any vain talk any words of falsehood or lies between one another read kidhāban to mean kadhiban ‘lies’ or kidhdhāban to mean takdhīban ‘lying’ in contrast to what happens in this world when wine is drunk

verses.ar: جَزَآءً مِّن رَّبِّكَ عَطَآءً حِسَابًا
verses.en: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,

tafsir.text: this will be a reward from your Lord in other words God has rewarded them with this reward as a gift ‘atā’an substitutes for jazā’an ‘reward’ that is sufficing that is abundant hisāban as meaning ‘abundant’ derives from their saying a‘tānī fa-ahsabanī ‘he gave me so abundantly that I said “that is enough for me”’ hasbī

verses.ar: رَّبِّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ۖ لَا يَمْلِكُونَ مِنْهُ خِطَابًا
verses.en: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.

tafsir.text: from the Lord of the heavens and the earth read rabbi ‘from the Lord of’ or rabbu ‘He is the Lord of’ and all that is between them the Compassionate One likewise read rahmāni or rahmānu or read rahmānu with rabbi for the preceding Whom exalted be He they that is creatures will not be able to address that is to say not

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلرُّوحُ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ صَفًّا ۖ لَّا يَتَكَلَّمُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَقَالَ صَوَابًا
verses.en: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.

tafsir.text: on the day yawma is the adverbial qualifier for lā yamlikūna ‘they will not be able to’ when the Spirit Gabriel or God’s hosts and the angels stand arrayed saffan is a circumstantial qualifier in other words mustaffīna.

verses.ar: ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ مَـَٔابًا
verses.en: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.

tafsir.text: That is the True Day whose coming to pass is definite namely the Day of Resurrection. So whoever wishes to let him seek resort with his Lord a return to Him that is to say let him return to God by being obedient to Him so that he may be secure from chastisement in it.

verses.ar: إِنَّآ أَنذَرْنَـٰكُمْ عَذَابًا قَرِيبًا يَوْمَ يَنظُرُ ٱلْمَرْءُ مَا قَدَّمَتْ يَدَاهُ وَيَقُولُ ٱلْكَافِرُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى كُنتُ تُرَٰبًۢا
verses.en: Indeed, We have warned you of an impending punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, "Oh, I wish that I were dust!"

tafsir.text: Lo! We have warned you O disbelievers of Mecca of a chastisement that is near the chastisement of the impending Day of Resurrection — for anything that is impending is also near — the day yawma adverbially qualifies ‘adhāban ‘a chastisement’ by describing it when a person when every person will behold what his hands

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّـٰزِعَـٰتِ غَرْقًا
verses.en: By those [angels] who extract with violence

tafsir.text: By those that wrest by the angels who wrest the souls of disbelievers violently;

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّـٰشِطَـٰتِ نَشْطًا
verses.en: And [by] those who remove with ease

tafsir.text: by those that draw out by the angels who draw out the souls of believers gently;

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّـٰبِحَـٰتِ سَبْحًا
verses.en: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming

tafsir.text: by those that glide serenely by the angels who descend from the heavens with His command exalted be He;

verses.ar: فَٱلسَّـٰبِقَـٰتِ سَبْقًا
verses.en: And those who race each other in a race

tafsir.text: by those that race forward by the angels who race forward to Paradise with the souls of believers;

verses.ar: فَٱلْمُدَبِّرَٰتِ أَمْرًا
verses.en: And those who arrange [each] matter,

tafsir.text: and by those that direct the affair by the angels who direct the affairs of this world that is to say they descend with the directions for it from God the response to all of these oath clauses has been omitted understood to be something like la-tub‘athunna yā kuffāra Makka ‘you shall certainly be resurrected O

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تَرْجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
verses.en: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],

tafsir.text: the day when the Tremor quakes that is to say the first blast as a result of which everything will be shaken violently thus it the subject has been described in terms of the effect it produces

verses.ar: تَتْبَعُهَا ٱلرَّادِفَةُ
verses.en: There will follow it the subsequent [one].

tafsir.text: and is followed by the Aftershock the second blast; between the two blasts is a span of forty years the sentence tatba‘uhā’l-rādifatu is a circumstantial qualifier referring to al-rājifa ‘the Tremor’ in other words the ‘day’ can adverbially accommodate both blasts and other events and so for this reason it can also

verses.ar: قُلُوبٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ وَاجِفَةٌ
verses.en: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,

tafsir.text: on that day hearts will be trembling frightened and anxious

verses.ar: أَبْصَـٰرُهَا خَـٰشِعَةٌ
verses.en: Their eyes humbled.

tafsir.text: their eyes humbled abject because of the terror that they see.

verses.ar: يَقُولُونَ أَءِنَّا لَمَرْدُودُونَ فِى ٱلْحَافِرَةِ
verses.en: They are [presently] saying, "Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?

tafsir.text: They those of the mentioned hearts and eyes will say mockingly and in rejection of the Resurrection ‘Are we indeed read a-innā pronouncing both hamzas or by not pronouncing the second and inserting an alif between them in both cases and in both instances being restored as before? Shall we be restored to life after

verses.ar: أَءِذَا كُنَّا عِظَـٰمًا نَّخِرَةً
verses.en: Even if we should be decayed bones?"

tafsir.text: What! When we have been decayed bones?’ nakhira a variant reading has nākhira ‘decayed and withered’ will we have life again?

verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ تِلْكَ إِذًا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٌ
verses.en: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."

tafsir.text: They will say ‘That return of ours to life then if it were true would be a ruinous return!’.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّمَا هِىَ زَجْرَةٌ وَٰحِدَةٌ
verses.en: Indeed, it will be but one shout,

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says But it the Aftershock which will be followed by the Resurrection will be only a single blast and so when it is blasted

verses.ar: فَإِذَا هُم بِٱلسَّاهِرَةِ
verses.en: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth's surface.

tafsir.text: behold then they all creatures will be upon the surface of the earth alive after having been dead inside it.

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.en: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -

tafsir.text: Have you O Muhammad (s) received the story of Moses hadīthu Mūsā operates the clause that follows

verses.ar: إِذْ نَادَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.en: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Ṭuwā,

tafsir.text: when his Lord called out to him in the holy valley of Tuwā? — this is the name of the valley it may be read with nunation Tuwan or without — and He said

verses.ar: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.en: "Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.

tafsir.text: ‘Go to Pharaoh; he has indeed become rebellious he has exceeded all bounds with his disbelief

verses.ar: فَقُلْ هَل لَّكَ إِلَىٰٓ أَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.en: And say to him, 'Would you [be willing to] purify yourself

tafsir.text: and say “Would you — I call you to — purify yourself tazakkā a variant reading has tazzakkā where the original second tā’ of tatazakkā has been assimilated with the zāy to purge yourself of idolatry by bearing witness that there is no god but God

verses.ar: وَأَهْدِيَكَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ فَتَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?'"

tafsir.text: and allow me to guide you to your Lord to show you how to know Him ma‘rifa by way of proofs so that you may have fear of Him?” ’

verses.ar: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلْـَٔايَةَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
