verses.en: And he showed him the greatest sign,

tafsir.text: So he showed him the greatest sign from among His nine signs namely the glowing hand or the slithering staff.

verses.ar: فَكَذَّبَ وَعَصَىٰ
verses.en: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.

tafsir.text: But he Pharaoh denied Moses and disobeyed God exalted be He.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَدْبَرَ يَسْعَىٰ
verses.en: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].

tafsir.text: Then he turned his back to faith going about in haste throughout the land causing corruption.

verses.ar: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
verses.en: And he gathered [his people] and called out.

tafsir.text: Then he gathered he assembled the sorcerers and his armies and proclaimed

verses.ar: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.en: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."

tafsir.text: and said ‘I am your most high lord!’ above whom is no other lord.

verses.ar: فَأَخَذَهُ ٱللَّهُ نَكَالَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَٱلْأُولَىٰٓ
verses.en: So Allāh seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression]..

tafsir.text: So God seized him He destroyed him by drowning him as punishment for the latter that is to say these last words of his and for the former that is to say his saying previously ‘I do not know of any god for you other than me’ Q. 2838 — and between the two claims made by Pharaoh was an interval of forty years.

verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰٓ
verses.en: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [Allāh].

tafsir.text: Assuredly in that which is mentioned there is a moral for him who fears God exalted be He.

verses.ar: ءَأَنتُمْ أَشَدُّ خَلْقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ ۚ بَنَىٰهَا
verses.en: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., Allāh] constructed it.

tafsir.text: Are you read a-antum pronouncing both hamzas or by substituting an alif for the second one not pronouncing it and inserting an alif between the one not pronounced and the former or without this insertion namely you the deniers of the Resurrection harder to create or the heaven which He has built? harder to create

verses.ar: رَفَعَ سَمْكَهَا فَسَوَّىٰهَا
verses.en: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.

tafsir.text: He made it rise high — an explication of the manner of its construction; in other words He made its vertical extension high; it is also said that samkahā means ‘its ceiling’ — and levelled it He made it even flawless

verses.ar: وَأَغْطَشَ لَيْلَهَا وَأَخْرَجَ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.en: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.

tafsir.text: and darkened its night and brought forth its day He exposed the light of its sun ‘night’ has been annexed to it the heaven because it represents its shade and likewise the ‘sun’ because it represents its light;

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضَ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ دَحَىٰهَآ
verses.en: And after that He spread the earth.

tafsir.text: and after that He spread out the earth He made it flat for it had been created before the heaven but without having been spread out;

verses.ar: أَخْرَجَ مِنْهَا مَآءَهَا وَمَرْعَىٰهَا
verses.en: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,

tafsir.text: from it He has brought forth akhraja a circumstantial qualifier with a suppressed preceding qad that is to say mukhrijan ‘bringing forth from it’ its waters by making its springs gush forth and its pastures what cattle graze of trees and herbage and what humans consume of foods and fruits the use of mar‘ā to express

verses.ar: وَٱلْجِبَالَ أَرْسَىٰهَا
verses.en: And the mountains He set firmly

tafsir.text: and has set firm the mountains on the face of the earth so that it stays still

verses.ar: مَتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
verses.en: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

tafsir.text: as a source of sustenance an object denoting reason for an implied verbal clause in other words fa‘ala dhālika mut‘atan or tamtī‘an ‘He did this to provide a source of sustenance’ for you and your flocks an‘ām is the plural of na‘am which are camels cows and sheep.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلطَّآمَّةُ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verses.en: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -

tafsir.text: So when the Greatest Catastrophe befalls — the second blast —

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا سَعَىٰ
verses.en: The Day when man will remember that for which he strove,

tafsir.text: the day when man will remember yawma yatadhakkaru’l-insānu substitutes for idhā ‘when’ his efforts in the life of the world in the way of good or evil

verses.ar: وَبُرِّزَتِ ٱلْجَحِيمُ لِمَن يَرَىٰ
verses.en: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -

tafsir.text: and the Hell-fire the consuming Fire is revealed for all to see for every on-looker the response to idhā ‘when’ is what follows

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَن طَغَىٰ
verses.en: So as for he who transgressed

tafsir.text: as for him who was rebellious who disbelieved

verses.ar: وَءَاثَرَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.en: And preferred the life of the world,

tafsir.text: and preferred the life of this world by pursuing carnal desires

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَحِيمَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
verses.en: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.

tafsir.text: Hell-fire will indeed be the abode his abode.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفْسَ عَنِ ٱلْهَوَىٰ
verses.en: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,

tafsir.text: But as for him who feared the stance before his Lord his standing before Him and forbade the evil-bidding soul from pursuing desire that leads to perdition as a result of that person’s lusting after carnal desires

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ ٱلْجَنَّةَ هِىَ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ
verses.en: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.

tafsir.text: Paradise will indeed be the abode in sum the response to idhā ‘when’ verse 34 is that the disobedient one will be in the Fire and the obedient one in Paradise.

verses.ar: يَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلسَّاعَةِ أَيَّانَ مُرْسَىٰهَا
verses.en: They ask you, [O Muḥammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?

tafsir.text: They that is the disbelievers of Mecca will ask you about the Hour when will it set in? when will it come to pass and when will it begin?

verses.ar: فِيمَ أَنتَ مِن ذِكْرَىٰهَآ
verses.en: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?

tafsir.text: What have you to do with the mention of it? in other words you have no knowledge of it in order to mention it.

verses.ar: إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ مُنتَهَىٰهَآ
verses.en: To your Lord is its finality.

tafsir.text: With your Lord it belongs ultimately ultimate knowledge of it lies with Him; none other than Him has any knowledge of it.

verses.ar: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰهَا
verses.en: You are only a warner for those who fear it.

tafsir.text: You are only a warner for your warning will only benefit the one who fears it.

verses.ar: كَأَنَّهُمْ يَوْمَ يَرَوْنَهَا لَمْ يَلْبَثُوٓا۟ إِلَّا عَشِيَّةً أَوْ ضُحَىٰهَا
verses.en: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.

tafsir.text: The day they see it it will be as if they had only tarried in their graves for an evening or the morning thereof that is to say as if only one evening of a day or its morning the annexation of duhā ‘morning’ to ‘ashiyya ‘evening’ is valid on the basis of their contiguity since both constitute either side of the day;

verses.ar: عَبَسَ وَتَوَلَّىٰٓ
verses.en: He [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ) ] frowned and turned away

tafsir.text: He the Prophet frowned glowered with his face and turned away

verses.ar: أَن جَآءَهُ ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ
verses.en: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].

tafsir.text: because the blind man came to him ‘Abd Allāh son of Umm Maktūm who interrupted him while he was busy with those notables of Quryash whose submission to God he was very eager for. The blind man was not aware that he was busy with these and so he called out to him ‘Teach me of what God has taught you’.

verses.ar: وَمَا يُدْرِيكَ لَعَلَّهُۥ يَزَّكَّىٰٓ
verses.en: But what would make you perceive, [O Muḥammad], that perhaps he might be purified

tafsir.text: And how would you know? Perhaps he would cleanse himself yazzakkā the original tā’ of yatazakkā has been assimilated with the zāy that is perhaps he would purge himself of sins by what he hears from you

verses.ar: أَوْ يَذَّكَّرُ فَتَنفَعَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰٓ
verses.en: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?

tafsir.text: or be admonished yadhdhakkar the original tā’ of yatadhakkar has been assimilated with the dhāl and so the reminder the admonition heard from you might benefit him a variant reading for tanfa‘uhu has tanfa‘ahu as the response to the optative statement.

verses.ar: أَمَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَغْنَىٰ
verses.en: As for he who thinks himself without need,

tafsir.text: But as for the one who thinks himself self-sufficient through wealth

verses.ar: فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ
verses.en: To him you give attention.

tafsir.text: to him you do attend tasaddā a variant reading has tassaddā where the original second tā’ of tatasaddā has been assimilated with the sād him you accept and turn your attention to;

verses.ar: وَمَا عَلَيْكَ أَلَّا يَزَّكَّىٰ
verses.en: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.

tafsir.text: yet it is not your concern if he does not cleanse himself if he does not believe.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَن جَآءَكَ يَسْعَىٰ
verses.en: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]

tafsir.text: But as for him who comes to you hurrying yas‘ā is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb jā’a ‘comes’

verses.ar: وَهُوَ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: While he fears [Allāh],

tafsir.text: fearful of God wa-huwa yakhshā is a circumstantial qualifier referring to the subject of the verb yas‘ā ‘hurrying’ — this being the blind man —

verses.ar: فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ
verses.en: From him you are distracted.

tafsir.text: to him you pay no heed talahhā the original second tā’ of tatalahhā has been omitted that is to say from him you are distracted by other things.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذْكِرَةٌ
verses.en: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;

tafsir.text: No indeed! do not behave like this. Truly it the sūra is or the verses are a reminder an admonition for all creatures —

verses.ar: فَمَن شَآءَ ذَكَرَهُۥ
verses.en: So whoever wills may remember it.

tafsir.text: so let whoever will remember it preserve it in his memory and thus be admonished by it —

verses.ar: فِى صُحُفٍ مُّكَرَّمَةٍ
verses.en: [It is recorded] in honored sheets,

tafsir.text: on leaves fī suhufin is the second predicate of innahā ‘truly it’ and what precedes it is a parenthetical statement that are honoured by God

verses.ar: مَّرْفُوعَةٍ مُّطَهَّرَةٍۭ
verses.en: Exalted and purified,

tafsir.text: elevated in the heavens purified exalted above the touch of devils

verses.ar: بِأَيْدِى سَفَرَةٍ
verses.en: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,

tafsir.text: in the hands of scribes who write it down from the Preserved Tablet

verses.ar: كِرَامٍۭ بَرَرَةٍ
verses.en: Noble and dutiful.

tafsir.text: noble pious obedient to God exalted be He these being the angels.

verses.ar: قُتِلَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَآ أَكْفَرَهُۥ
verses.en: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is man; how disbelieving is he.

tafsir.text: Perish man! accursed be the disbeliever! What has made him ungrateful? an interrogative statement meant as a rebuke — what has driven him to disbelief?

verses.ar: مِنْ أَىِّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ
verses.en: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?

tafsir.text: From what thing has He created him? an interrogative meant as an affirmative which He then explains by saying

verses.ar: مِن نُّطْفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
verses.en: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;

tafsir.text: From a drop of sperm did He create him then proportion him in stages as a blood-clot then an embryo up to the last stage of his creation.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ ٱلسَّبِيلَ يَسَّرَهُۥ
verses.en: Then He eased the way for him;

tafsir.text: Then He made the way his exit from his mother’s belly easy for him;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ أَمَاتَهُۥ فَأَقْبَرَهُۥ
verses.en: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.

tafsir.text: then He makes him die and buries him He places him in a grave that hides him;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِذَا شَآءَ أَنشَرَهُۥ
verses.en: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.

tafsir.text: then when He wills He will raise him for the Resurrection.

verses.ar: كَلَّا لَمَّا يَقْضِ مَآ أَمَرَهُۥ
verses.en: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.

tafsir.text: No indeed! Verily he has not accomplished he has not done what He his Lord commanded him to do.

verses.ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
verses.en: Then let mankind look at his food -

tafsir.text: So let man consider in reflection his source of food how it is determined and procured for him

verses.ar: أَنَّا صَبَبْنَا ٱلْمَآءَ صَبًّا
verses.en: How We poured down water in torrents,

tafsir.text: that We pour down water from the clouds plenteously;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ شَقَقْنَا ٱلْأَرْضَ شَقًّا
verses.en: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],

tafsir.text: then We split the earth into fissures with vegetation

verses.ar: فَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا حَبًّا
verses.en: And caused to grow within it grain

tafsir.text: and cause the grains such as wheat and barley to grow therein

verses.ar: وَعِنَبًا وَقَضْبًا
verses.en: And grapes and herbage

tafsir.text: and vines and herbs qadb is moist qatt

verses.ar: وَزَيْتُونًا وَنَخْلًا
verses.en: And olive and palm trees

tafsir.text: and olives and date-palms

verses.ar: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلْبًا
verses.en: And gardens of dense shrubbery

tafsir.text: and gardens of dense foliage orchards teeming with trees

verses.ar: وَفَـٰكِهَةً وَأَبًّا
verses.en: And fruit and grass -

tafsir.text: and fruits and pastures abb is what cattle graze; it is also said to be ‘straw’

verses.ar: مَّتَـٰعًا لَّكُمْ وَلِأَنْعَـٰمِكُمْ
verses.en: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.

tafsir.text: as sustenance understand matā‘an as mut‘atan or tamtī‘an as explained above in the previous sūra for you and your flocks also as explained above.

verses.ar: فَإِذَا جَآءَتِ ٱلصَّآخَّةُ
verses.en: But when there comes the Deafening Blast

tafsir.text: So when the deafening Cry the second blast comes —

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلْمَرْءُ مِنْ أَخِيهِ
verses.en: On the Day a man will flee from his brother

tafsir.text: the day when a man will flee from his own brother

verses.ar: وَأُمِّهِۦ وَأَبِيهِ
verses.en: And his mother and his father

tafsir.text: and his mother and his father

verses.ar: وَصَـٰحِبَتِهِۦ وَبَنِيهِ
verses.en: And his wife and his children,

tafsir.text: and his wife and his sons yawma ‘the day when’ is a substitution for idhā ‘when’ the response to which is indicated by what follows —

verses.ar: لِكُلِّ ٱمْرِئٍ مِّنْهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ شَأْنٌ يُغْنِيهِ
verses.en: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.

tafsir.text: every person that day will have a matter to preoccupy him a predicament to distract him from the affairs of others in other words every person will be preoccupied with his own self.

verses.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ مُّسْفِرَةٌ
verses.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -

tafsir.text: On that day some faces will be shining radiant

verses.ar: ضَاحِكَةٌ مُّسْتَبْشِرَةٌ
verses.en: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.

tafsir.text: laughing joyous happy — these are the believers.

verses.ar: وَوُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ عَلَيْهَا غَبَرَةٌ
verses.en: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.

tafsir.text: And some faces on that day will be covered with dust

verses.ar: تَرْهَقُهَا قَتَرَةٌ
verses.en: Blackness will cover them.

tafsir.text: overcast covered with gloom darkness and blackness.

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ
verses.en: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.

tafsir.text: Those the people of this predicament are the disbelievers the profligates those who have combined disbelief with profligacy.

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
verses.en: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

tafsir.text: When the sun is folded away enfolded and stripped of its light

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ
verses.en: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

tafsir.text: and when the stars scatter when they are extinguished and hurtle down towards the earth

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ
verses.en: And when the mountains are removed

tafsir.text: and when the mountains are set in motion when they are blown away from the face of the earth becoming as scattered dust

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ
verses.en: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

tafsir.text: and when the pregnant camels are neglected abandoned without a herdsman or anyone to milk them on account of the matter that has come over them — even though previously no wealth was dearer to them than these pregnant camels;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ
verses.en: And when the wild beasts are gathered

tafsir.text: and when the wild beasts are mustered when they are brought together after being resurrected so that each of them may retaliate against the other before becoming dust;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ
verses.en: And when the seas are filled with flame

tafsir.text: and when the seas are set afire read sujirat or sujjirat when they are set alight and become a mass of fire;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ
verses.en: And when the souls are paired

tafsir.text: and when the souls are coupled when they are paired up with their bodies;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ
verses.en: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

tafsir.text: and when the girl buried-alive the young girl buried alive for fear of shame and impoverishment asks — in rebuke of its slayer —

verses.ar: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ
verses.en: For what sin she was killed

tafsir.text: for what sin she was slain sa’alat ‘asks’ a variant reading has su’ilat ‘she is asked’ narrating the address directed to her to which she then responds by saying ‘I was slain without having committed any sin’;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ
verses.en: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]

tafsir.text: and when the scrolls the scrolls containing the deeds are unrolled read nushirat or nushshirat when they are unfolded and spread out;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ
verses.en: And when the sky is stripped away

tafsir.text: and when the heaven is stripped off torn away from its place just as the skin of a sheep is stripped off;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ
verses.en: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

tafsir.text: and when the Hell-fire is set ablaze read su‘irat or su‘‘irat when it is set alight;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ
verses.en: And when Paradise is brought near,

tafsir.text: and when Paradise is brought near when it is brought close to those who have merited it that they may enter it the response to idhā ‘when’ at the beginning of the sūra and all that has been supplemented thereto is the following

verses.ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ
verses.en: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

tafsir.text: then a soul every soul at the time of the occurrence of the things mentioned which is the Day of Resurrection will know what it has presented of good or evil.

verses.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ
verses.en: So I swear by the retreating stars -

tafsir.text: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the receding planets

verses.ar: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ
verses.en: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set]

tafsir.text: the movers the setters that is the five planets Saturn Jupiter Mars Venus and Mercury takhnusu means ‘they sink away’ during their orbit whereas we see stars at the end of their zodiacal course return to the start;

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ
verses.en: And by the night as it closes in

tafsir.text: and by the night as it approaches as it falls with its darkness or it means as it recedes;

verses.ar: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
verses.en: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]

tafsir.text: and by the dawn as it breathes as it extends until it becomes broad daylight

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ
verses.en: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]

tafsir.text: truly this Qur’ān is the word of a messenger who is noble in the sight of God exalted be He — this being the messenger Gabriel it qawl ‘word’ has been annexed to him because he descends with it

verses.ar: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ
verses.en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

tafsir.text: powerful one of mighty powers eminent one of eminent status makīnin is semantically connected ‘inda ‘in the presence of’ in the presence of the Lord of the Throne that is God exalted be He;

verses.ar: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ
verses.en: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

tafsir.text: obeyed there the angels obey him in the heavens trustworthy with the Revelation.

verses.ar: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ
verses.en: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muḥammad (ﷺ) ] is not [at all] mad.

tafsir.text: And your companion Muhammad (s) wa-mā sāhibukum a supplement to the clause from innahu ‘truly this is’ up to the last of the oath clauses is not a madman as you claim.

verses.ar: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ
verses.en: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.

tafsir.text: For verily he Muhammad (s) saw him Gabriel in the form in which he was created on the clear horizon the highest one towards the east;

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ
verses.en: And he [i.e., Muḥammad (ﷺ)] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

tafsir.text: and he Muhammad (s) is not to be accused of knowing the Unseen what is hidden of the revelation and the tidings of the heaven a variant reading for bi-zanīnin has bi-danīnin meaning that he is not ‘niggardly’ with the Unseen so as to reduce something of it and not disclose it.

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
verses.en: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

tafsir.text: And it that is the Qur’ān is not the word of an accursed satan eavesdropping stealthily.

verses.ar: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ
verses.en: So where are you going?

tafsir.text: So where are you going? So what path are you going to follow in repudiating the Qur’ān and turning away from it?

verses.ar: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

tafsir.text: It is only a reminder an admonition for all worlds those of mankind and jinn

verses.ar: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ
verses.en: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

tafsir.text: for those of you who li-man shā’a minkum is a substitution for li’l-‘ālamīna ‘for all worlds’ using the same preposition wish to go straight by following the truth;

verses.ar: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: And you do not will except that Allāh wills - Lord of the worlds.

tafsir.text: but you will not wish to go straight along the path of truth unless God the Lord of the Worlds of all creatures wills that you should go straight along it.

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنفَطَرَتْ
verses.en: When the sky breaks apart

tafsir.text: When the heaven is split open when it is rent asunder

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْكَوَاكِبُ ٱنتَثَرَتْ
verses.en: And when the stars fall, scattering,

tafsir.text: and when the stars are dispersed when they expire and begin to fall

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتْ
verses.en: And when the seas are erupted

tafsir.text: and when the seas are burst forth released one upon the other forming one mass of water so that the sweet water mixes with the salty;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْقُبُورُ بُعْثِرَتْ
verses.en: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],

tafsir.text: and when the tombs are overturned when their earth above them is dug up and its dead are raised the response to idhā ‘when’ and all that is supplemented thereto is the following

verses.ar: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّا قَدَّمَتْ وَأَخَّرَتْ
verses.en: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.

tafsir.text: a soul every soul will know at the time of the occurrence of the things mentioned which is the Day of Resurrection what it has sent ahead in the way of deeds and what it has left behind of these and did not do.

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
verses.en: O mankind, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,

tafsir.text: O disbelieving man! What has deceived you with regard to your generous Lord? so that you have disobeyed Him

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكَ فَسَوَّىٰكَ فَعَدَلَكَ
verses.en: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?

tafsir.text: Who created you when you were not then made you upright in your created form with sound limbs then proportioned you read fa-‘adalak or fa-‘addalak making you symmetrical in shape with well-proportioned parts so that no hand or leg is longer than the other

verses.ar: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
verses.en: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.

tafsir.text: assembling you in whatever mā is a relative form He will?

verses.ar: كَلَّا بَلْ تُكَذِّبُونَ بِٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: No! But you deny the Recompense.

tafsir.text: No indeed! — a deterrent against letting oneself be misled by the generosity of God exalted be He. Rather you that is disbelievers of Mecca deny Judgement requital for deeds;

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكُمْ لَحَـٰفِظِينَ
verses.en: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,

tafsir.text: Yet lo! there are above you watchers from among the angels over your deeds

verses.ar: كِرَامًا كَـٰتِبِينَ
verses.en: Noble and recording;

tafsir.text: noble in God’s sight writers of these deeds

verses.ar: يَعْلَمُونَ مَا تَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: They know whatever you do.

tafsir.text: who know whatever you do all of it.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,

tafsir.text: Indeed the pious the believers who are sincere in their faith shall be amid bliss in Paradise

verses.ar: وَإِنَّ ٱلْفُجَّارَ لَفِى جَحِيمٍ
verses.en: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.

tafsir.text: and indeed the profligates the disbelievers shall be in Hell-fire a scorching fire

verses.ar: يَصْلَوْنَهَا يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,

tafsir.text: entering it to suffer its heat on the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital

verses.ar: وَمَا هُمْ عَنْهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
verses.en: And never therefrom will they be absent.

tafsir.text: and they shall not be absent from it they shall not be taken out of it.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

tafsir.text: And what would show you what would inform you what the Day of Judgement is?

verses.ar: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?

tafsir.text: Again what would show you what the Day of Judgement is? — repeated to emphasise its enormity.

verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
verses.en: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with Allāh.

tafsir.text: It is a day read yawmu when no soul will be of any avail any use to another soul and the absolute command on that day will be God’s there will be no power of command for anyone other than Him thereat in other words none has been given the power to mediate thereupon in contrast to situations in this world.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ لِّلْمُطَفِّفِينَ
verses.en: Woe to those who give less [than due],

tafsir.text: Woe waylun a term entailing chastisement; or it is the name of a valley in Hell to the defrauders

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ٱكْتَالُوا۟ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ يَسْتَوْفُونَ
verses.en: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.

tafsir.text: those who when they take measure from people demand it in full the measure;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا كَالُوهُمْ أَو وَّزَنُوهُمْ يُخْسِرُونَ
verses.en: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.

tafsir.text: but who when they measure for them or weigh for them they cause them loss they diminish for them the measure or the weight.

verses.ar: أَلَا يَظُنُّ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَنَّهُم مَّبْعُوثُونَ
verses.en: Do they not think that they will be resurrected

tafsir.text: Do such individuals not know for certain alā indicates an interrogative of rebuke that they will be resurrected

verses.ar: لِيَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ
verses.en: For a tremendous Day -

tafsir.text: for an awful day that is to say on it and this is the Day of Resurrection

verses.ar: يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلنَّاسُ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.en: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?

tafsir.text: a day when yawma is a substitution for the syntactical locus of li-yawmin ‘to an awful day’ and as such is in the accusative because of the verb mab‘ūthūna ‘will be resurrected’ mankind will rise from their graves before the Lord of the Worlds? the Lord of all creatures for His affair His reckoning and His requital.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْفُجَّارِ لَفِى سِجِّينٍ
verses.en: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.

tafsir.text: Nay! verily the record of the profligates that is to say the record of the deeds of the disbelievers is in Sijjīn — this is said to be a book containing the record of all the deeds of the devils and the disbelievers;

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا سِجِّينٌ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?

tafsir.text: And what would tell you what Sijjīn is? what the book of Sijjīn is.

verses.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
verses.en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.

tafsir.text: It is a sealed book.

verses.ar: وَيْلٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.en: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,

tafsir.text: Woe to the deniers on that day

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُكَذِّبُونَ بِيَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
verses.en: Who deny the Day of Recompense.

tafsir.text: who deny the Day of Judgement the Day of Requital alladhīna yukadhdhibūna bi-yawmi’l-dīn either a substitution for or an explication of al-mukadhdhibīna ‘the deniers’;

verses.ar: وَمَا يُكَذِّبُ بِهِۦٓ إِلَّا كُلُّ مُعْتَدٍ أَثِيمٍ
verses.en: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.

tafsir.text: and none deny it but every sinful the form athīm is hyperbolic transgressor overstepping the bounds.

verses.ar: إِذَا تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَـٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَـٰطِيرُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
verses.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."

tafsir.text: When Our signs of the Qur’ān are recited to him he says ‘Mere fables asātīr of the ancients!’ mere tales that were written down sutirat in ancient times asātīr is the plural of ustūra or istāra.

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَلْ ۜ رَانَ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
verses.en: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.

tafsir.text: No indeed! — a deterrent and a warning against saying such things. Rather there has slayed engulfed their hearts covering them like rust that which they earned of acts of disobedience.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمْ عَن رَّبِّهِمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّمَحْجُوبُونَ
verses.en: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.

tafsir.text: Nay! verily they on that day the Day of Resurrection will be screened off from their Lord and so they will not see Him.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمْ لَصَالُوا۟ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
verses.en: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.

tafsir.text: Then they will be exposed to Hell-fire then they will enter the scorching Fire;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ يُقَالُ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: Then it will be said [to them], "This is what you used to deny."

tafsir.text: then it will be said to them ‘This that is the chastisement is that which you used to deny!’

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِنَّ كِتَـٰبَ ٱلْأَبْرَارِ لَفِى عِلِّيِّينَ
verses.en: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ʿilliyyūn.

tafsir.text: Nay! verily the record of the pious that is the record of the deeds of the believers who were sincere in their faith is in ‘Illiyyūn — this is said to be the book containing all the good deeds of the angels and the believers from among the two heavy ones sc. mankind and jinn;

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا عِلِّيُّونَ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is ʿilliyyūn?

tafsir.text: and what will tell you what will inform you what ‘Illiyyūn is? what the book of ‘Illiyyūn is.

verses.ar: كِتَـٰبٌ مَّرْقُومٌ
verses.en: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed

tafsir.text: It is a sealed book

verses.ar: يَشْهَدُهُ ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.en: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to Allāh].

tafsir.text: witnessed by those brought near from among the angels.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ لَفِى نَعِيمٍ
verses.en: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure

tafsir.text: Assuredly the pious will be amid bliss in Paradise

verses.ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: On adorned couches, observing.

tafsir.text: upon couches upon beds beneath canopies gazing at the bliss which they have been given.

verses.ar: تَعْرِفُ فِى وُجُوهِهِمْ نَضْرَةَ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
verses.en: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.

tafsir.text: You will perceive in their faces the radiancy of bliss the splendour and beauty of blissfulness

verses.ar: يُسْقَوْنَ مِن رَّحِيقٍ مَّخْتُومٍ
verses.en: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.

tafsir.text: as they are given to drink a nectar a wine free of any impurities that is sealed in its vessel none other than them breaking its seal

verses.ar: خِتَـٰمُهُۥ مِسْكٌ ۚ وَفِى ذَٰلِكَ فَلْيَتَنَافَسِ ٱلْمُتَنَـٰفِسُونَ
verses.en: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.

tafsir.text: whose seal is musk that is whose final sip is followed by an emanating scent of musk — so for such bliss let the viers vie let them desire to apply themselves to obedience of God —

verses.ar: وَمِزَاجُهُۥ مِن تَسْنِيمٍ
verses.en: And its mixture is of Tasneem,

tafsir.text: and whose mixture that is to say that with which it is mixed is of Tasnīm which is explained by His following words

verses.ar: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا ٱلْمُقَرَّبُونَ
verses.en: A spring from which those near [to Allāh] drink.

tafsir.text: a spring ‘aynan is in the accusative because of an implicit prefatory amdahu ‘I extol this spring’ from which those brought near will drink yashrabu bihā should be yashrabu minhā or it may be that bihā is used because yashrabu is meant to imply the sense of yaltadhdhu bihā ‘in which they delight’.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجْرَمُوا۟ كَانُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.en: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.

tafsir.text: Verily the guilty like Abū Jahl and his ilk used to laugh at the believers such as ‘Ammār b. Yāsir and Bilāl the Ethiopian and those like them in mockery of them;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا مَرُّوا۟ بِهِمْ يَتَغَامَزُونَ
verses.en: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.

tafsir.text: and when they the believers passed them by they would wink at one another the guilty beckoned with their eyebrows and eyelids towards the believers in mockery;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱنقَلَبُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِمُ ٱنقَلَبُوا۟ فَكِهِينَ
verses.en: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.

tafsir.text: and when they returned to their folks they would return blithely fākihīna a variant reading has fakihīna rejoicing in their disparaging mention of the believers;

verses.ar: وَإِذَا رَأَوْهُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ لَضَآلُّونَ
verses.en: And when they saw them, they would say, "Indeed, those are truly lost."

tafsir.text: and when they see them that is the believers they say ‘Lo! these men are astray!’ on account of their belief in Muhammad (s).

verses.ar: وَمَآ أُرْسِلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ حَـٰفِظِينَ
verses.en: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.

tafsir.text: God exalted be He says Yet they that is the disbelievers were not sent as watchers over them over the believers to preserve them or to keep a record of their deeds and thus guide them back to what is best for them.

verses.ar: فَٱلْيَوْمَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْكُفَّارِ يَضْحَكُونَ
verses.en: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,

tafsir.text: So today that is the Day of Resurrection the believers will be laughing at the disbelievers

verses.ar: عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ يَنظُرُونَ
verses.en: On adorned couches, observing.

tafsir.text: upon couches in Paradise gazing out from their dwellings at the disbelievers while they are being tortured; and they will laugh at them just as they the disbelievers had laughed at them in the world.

verses.ar: هَلْ ثُوِّبَ ٱلْكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُوا۟ يَفْعَلُونَ
verses.en: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?

tafsir.text: Have the disbelievers been requited for what they used to do? Yes indeed!

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ ٱنشَقَّتْ
verses.en: When the sky has split [open]

tafsir.text: When the heaven is rent asunder

verses.ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
verses.en: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]

tafsir.text: and heeds gives ear to and in rending itself asunder obeys its Lord as it should that is as its duty is to heed and obey

verses.ar: وَإِذَا ٱلْأَرْضُ مُدَّتْ
verses.en: And when the earth has been extended

tafsir.text: and when the earth is stretched out when its width is increased just as a piece of leather is stretched so that no edifice or mountain remains upon it

verses.ar: وَأَلْقَتْ مَا فِيهَا وَتَخَلَّتْ
verses.en: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it].

tafsir.text: and casts out all that is in it of the dead onto its surface and empties itself thereof

verses.ar: وَأَذِنَتْ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتْ
verses.en: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -

tafsir.text: and heeds and in this respect gives ear to and obeys its Lord as it should all of this will be on the Day of Resurrection the response to idhā ‘when’ and to all that is supplemented thereto has been omitted;

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِنَّكَ كَادِحٌ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكَ كَدْحًا فَمُلَـٰقِيهِ
verses.en: O mankind, indeed you are laboring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.

tafsir.text: O man! Verily you are labouring exerting your efforts toward the encounter with your Lord that is death laboriously and you will encounter it that is you will encounter your mentioned good or evil deeds on the Day of Resurrection.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ
verses.en: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,

tafsir.text: Then as for him who is given his book the record of his deeds in his right hand — and this is the believer —

verses.ar: فَسَوْفَ يُحَاسَبُ حِسَابًا يَسِيرًا
verses.en: He will be judged with an easy account

tafsir.text: he will receive an easy reckoning which simply entails the presentation of his deeds to him as in the hadīth of the two Sahīhs of Bukhārī and Muslim — in which there is also a hadīth saying ‘He who is reckoned with at length will be destined for perdition’ — and after this presentation of his deeds to the believer he

verses.ar: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
verses.en: And return to his people in happiness.

tafsir.text: and return to his family in Paradise joyful because of it.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّا مَنْ أُوتِىَ كِتَـٰبَهُۥ وَرَآءَ ظَهْرِهِۦ
verses.en: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,

tafsir.text: But as for him who is given his book from behind his back — and this is the disbeliever whose right hand is chained to his neck and whose left hand by which he is given the book is placed behind his back

verses.ar: فَسَوْفَ يَدْعُوا۟ ثُبُورًا
verses.en: He will cry out for destruction

tafsir.text: he will pray upon seeing what is in it for annihilation he will invoke destruction against himself by saying yā thabūrāh ‘O annihilation of mine!’

verses.ar: وَيَصْلَىٰ سَعِيرًا
verses.en: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.

tafsir.text: and he will enter the Blaze an intense fire a variant reading for yaslā ‘he will enter’ has yusallā ‘he will be admitted’.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ فِىٓ أَهْلِهِۦ مَسْرُورًا
verses.en: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;

tafsir.text: Indeed among his folk his clan in the world he used to be joyful wanton lusting after his desires;

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ ظَنَّ أَن لَّن يَحُورَ
verses.en: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to Allāh].

tafsir.text: indeed he thought that an softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted that is to say annahu he would never return to his Lord.

verses.ar: بَلَىٰٓ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرًا
verses.en: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.

tafsir.text: Nay! he will return to Him; indeed his Lord is ever Seer of him knowing that he would return to Him.

verses.ar: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلشَّفَقِ
verses.en: So I swear by the twilight glow

tafsir.text: So I swear fa-lā lā is extra by the twilight al-shafaq the reddishness visible in the horizon after the sunset

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ وَمَا وَسَقَ
verses.en: And [by] the night and what it envelops

tafsir.text: and by the night and what it envelops what it brings together of creatures and otherwise that have entered into it

verses.ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا ٱتَّسَقَ
verses.en: And [by] the moon when it becomes full

tafsir.text: and by the moon when it is at the full and its light is complete and this happens during the nights of the full moon

verses.ar: لَتَرْكَبُنَّ طَبَقًا عَن طَبَقٍ
verses.en: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.

tafsir.text: you will surely journey tarkabunna is actually tarkabūnanna but the nūn of the indicative has been omitted because of two identical letters following one another and the wāw is omitted because of two unvocalised consonants coming together from stage to stage state after state namely death then life then what comes

verses.ar: فَمَا لَهُمْ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.en: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,

tafsir.text: So what is wrong with them that is the disbelievers that they do not have faith that is to say what is there to prevent them from embracing faith; or what argument do they have for neglecting it despite the existence of proofs for it

verses.ar: وَإِذَا قُرِئَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقُرْءَانُ لَا يَسْجُدُونَ ۩
verses.en: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to Allāh]?

tafsir.text: and what is wrong with them that when the Qur’ān is recited to them they do not prostrate? they do not submit by believing in it given its inimitability?

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُكَذِّبُونَ
verses.en: But those who have disbelieved deny,

tafsir.text: Nay but the disbelievers deny resurrection and other matters

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
verses.en: And Allāh is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.

tafsir.text: and God knows best what they are amassing accumulating in their scrolls in the way of disbelief denial and evil deeds.

verses.ar: فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.en: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,

tafsir.text: So give them good tidings inform them of a painful chastisement

verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ أَجْرٌ غَيْرُ مَمْنُونٍۭ
verses.en: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.

tafsir.text: except those who believe and perform righteous deeds theirs will be an unfailing reward one that is unending undiminished and not given to them in expectance of anything in return.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلْبُرُوجِ
verses.en: By the sky containing great stars

tafsir.text: By the heaven of the constellations the twelve constellations of the planets — as explained in sūrat al-Furqān Q. 2561;

verses.ar: وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْمَوْعُودِ
verses.en: And [by] the promised Day

tafsir.text: and by the promised day the Day of Resurrection;

verses.ar: وَشَاهِدٍ وَمَشْهُودٍ
verses.en: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,

tafsir.text: and by the witness Friday and the witnessed the day of ‘Arafa — that is how these three elements have been explained in hadīth for the first one is ‘promised’ the second one is ‘a witness’ that testifies to deeds performed in it while the third is ‘witnessed’ by mankind and angels the introductory particle of the

verses.ar: قُتِلَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأُخْدُودِ
verses.en: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench

tafsir.text: perish accursed be the men of the ditch! the pit in the ground

verses.ar: ٱلنَّارِ ذَاتِ ٱلْوَقُودِ
verses.en: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,

tafsir.text: of the fire al-nāri is an inclusive substitution of it al-ukhdūdi ‘of the ditch’ abounding in fuel by which it was fuelled

verses.ar: إِذْ هُمْ عَلَيْهَا قُعُودٌ
verses.en: When they were sitting near it.

tafsir.text: when they sat by it around the edge of the ditch on chairs

verses.ar: وَهُمْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَفْعَلُونَ بِٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ شُهُودٌ
verses.en: And they, to what they were doing against the believers, were witnesses.

tafsir.text: and they themselves to what they did to those who believed in God in the way of torturing them by hurling them into the fire when they did not recant their faith were witnesses they were themselves present thereat.

verses.ar: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verses.en: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,

tafsir.text: And all that they were vindicative towards them of was that they believed in God the Mighty in His kingdom the Praised

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى لَهُۥ مُلْكُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ شَهِيدٌ
verses.en: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And Allāh, over all things, is Witness.

tafsir.text: to Whom belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and God is Witness to all things in other words all that the disbelievers disavowed of the believers was their faith.

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا۟ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ وَٱلْمُؤْمِنَـٰتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَتُوبُوا۟ فَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ جَهَنَّمَ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابُ ٱلْحَرِيقِ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.

tafsir.text: Indeed those who persecute believing men and believing women by having them burnt then do not repent there will be for them the chastisement of Hell in return for their disbelief and there will also be for them the chastisement of burning that is to say the chastisement for their having had the believers burnt in the

verses.ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْكَبِيرُ
verses.en: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.

tafsir.text: Indeed those who believe and perform righteous deeds for them there will be gardens underneath which rivers flow that is the supreme triumph.

verses.ar: إِنَّ بَطْشَ رَبِّكَ لَشَدِيدٌ
verses.en: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.

tafsir.text: Assuredly your Lord’s assault against the disbelievers is severe as severe as He will it to be.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ يُبْدِئُ وَيُعِيدُ
verses.en: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.

tafsir.text: Assuredly it is He Who originates creation and restores and is never thwarted in what He wills

verses.ar: وَهُوَ ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلْوَدُودُ
verses.en: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,

tafsir.text: and He is the Forgiving to sinning believers the Loving the One Who shows love to His friends through His acts of generosity

verses.ar: ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱلْمَجِيدُ
verses.en: Honorable Owner of the Throne,

tafsir.text: Lord of the Throne its Creator and Possessor the Glorious read nominative al-majīdu the One deserving of the perfect attributes of sublimity

verses.ar: فَعَّالٌ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
verses.en: Effecter of what He intends.

tafsir.text: Doer of what He desires nothing able to thwart Him.

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْجُنُودِ
verses.en: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -

tafsir.text: Have you O Muhammad (s) received the story of the hosts

verses.ar: فِرْعَوْنَ وَثَمُودَ
verses.en: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?

tafsir.text: Pharaoh and Thamūd? Fir‘awna wa-Thamūda substitutes for al-junūdi — the mention of ‘Pharaoh’ suffices to also include his followers; their ‘story’ is that they were destroyed for their disbelief and this is meant as a warning for those who deny the Prophet s and the Qur’ān that they may be admonished thereby.

verses.ar: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فِى تَكْذِيبٍ
verses.en: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,

tafsir.text: Nay but the disbelievers are engrossed in denial of the mentioned;

verses.ar: وَٱللَّهُ مِن وَرَآئِهِم مُّحِيطٌۢ
verses.en: While Allāh encompasses them from behind.

tafsir.text: and God is behind them All-Encompassing — they have no protector against Him.

verses.ar: بَلْ هُوَ قُرْءَانٌ مَّجِيدٌ
verses.en: But this is an honored Qur’ān

tafsir.text: Nay but it is a glorious a magnificent Qur’ān

verses.ar: فِى لَوْحٍ مَّحْفُوظٍۭ
verses.en: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.

tafsir.text: in a tablet suspended above the seventh heaven preserved read mahfūzin from all devils and from having any of its contents altered; it is a high as the distance between the earth and the heaven and as wide as the distance between the east and the west made of white pearls — as stated by Ibn ‘Abbās may God be pleased

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلطَّارِقِ
verses.en: By the sky and the night comer

tafsir.text: By the heaven and the night-visitor! al-tāriq actually denotes any thing that comes by night including stars because they come out at night.

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلطَّارِقُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is the night comer?

tafsir.text: And what will tell you what the night-visitor is? mā’l-tāriq is a subject and predicate standing as the second object of the verb adrā ‘tell’; and what comes after the first mā ‘what’ is the predicate thereof of this first mā — this statement emphasises the magnificence of the ‘night-visitor’ which is explained in

verses.ar: ٱلنَّجْمُ ٱلثَّاقِبُ
verses.en: It is the piercing star

tafsir.text: The piercing the brilliant because of its piercing the darkness with its light star! meaning the constellation Pleiades; or it refers to all stars the response to the oath follows

verses.ar: إِن كُلُّ نَفْسٍ لَّمَّا عَلَيْهَا حَافِظٌ
verses.en: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.

tafsir.text: Over every soul there is a keeper if read la-mā then mā is extra and in is softened in place of the hardened form with its subject omitted that is to say innahu; the lām is a particle for separation;

verses.ar: فَلْيَنظُرِ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ مِمَّ خُلِقَ
verses.en: So let man observe from what he was created.

tafsir.text: So let man consider by way of reflection from what he was created from what thing

verses.ar: خُلِقَ مِن مَّآءٍ دَافِقٍ
verses.en: He was created from a fluid, ejected,

tafsir.text: the response is He was created from a gushing fluid gushing forth from the man and the woman into the womb

verses.ar: يَخْرُجُ مِنۢ بَيْنِ ٱلصُّلْبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
verses.en: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.

tafsir.text: issuing from between the loins of the man and the breast-bones of the woman.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجْعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٌ
verses.en: Indeed, He [i.e., Allāh], to return him [to life], is Able.

tafsir.text: Assuredly He exalted be He is able to bring him back to resurrect man after his death; and so when he reflects on his origins he will realise that the One who was able to do this is also able to resurrect him

verses.ar: يَوْمَ تُبْلَى ٱلسَّرَآئِرُ
verses.en: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,

tafsir.text: on the day when all secrets the hidden convictions and intentions of the hearts are inspected when they are examined and revealed

verses.ar: فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن قُوَّةٍ وَلَا نَاصِرٍ
verses.en: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.

tafsir.text: whereat he the one who denies resurrection will have neither strength to defend himself against chastisement nor any helper to avert it from him.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ ذَاتِ ٱلرَّجْعِ
verses.en: By the sky which sends back

tafsir.text: By the heaven of returns of the rain that returns time and again

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ ذَاتِ ٱلصَّدْعِ
verses.en: And [by] the earth which splits,

tafsir.text: and by the earth of fissures splitting with the growth of vegetation

verses.ar: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلٌ فَصْلٌ
verses.en: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,

tafsir.text: assuredly it the Qur’ān is a decisive word distinguishing between truth and falsehood

verses.ar: وَمَا هُوَ بِٱلْهَزْلِ
verses.en: And it is not amusement.

tafsir.text: and it is not a jest frivolity or falsehood.

verses.ar: إِنَّهُمْ يَكِيدُونَ كَيْدًا
verses.en: Indeed, they are planning a plan,

tafsir.text: Indeed they that is the disbelievers are devising a plot they are preparing plots against the Prophet s

verses.ar: وَأَكِيدُ كَيْدًا
verses.en: But I am planning a plan.

tafsir.text: and I too am devising a plot drawing them by degrees towards destruction from whence they know not.

verses.ar: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَمْهِلْهُمْ رُوَيْدًۢا
verses.en: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.

tafsir.text: So respite O Muhammad (s) the disbelievers; grant them respite reiterated as an emphasis one enhanced by the use of a different form mahhil amhil that is to say put them off for a little ruwaydā is a verbal noun emphasising the import of the operator and is the diminutive form of rūd or irwad with shortening of final

verses.ar: سَبِّحِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ ٱلْأَعْلَى
verses.en: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,

tafsir.text: Glorify the Name of your Lord that is exalt your Lord above what does not befit Him ism in isma rabbika ‘the Name of your Lord’ is extra the Most High an adjective qualifying rabbika ‘your Lord’

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ فَسَوَّىٰ
verses.en: Who created and proportioned

tafsir.text: Who created and proportioned His creature making it of well-proportioned parts without irregularities

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِى قَدَّرَ فَهَدَىٰ
verses.en: And who destined and [then] guided

tafsir.text: and Who determined what He wants and guided to what He had determined of good or evil

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَخْرَجَ ٱلْمَرْعَىٰ
verses.en: And who brings out the pasture

tafsir.text: and Who brought forth the pasture Who caused herbage to grow

verses.ar: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحْوَىٰ
verses.en: And [then] makes it black stubble.

tafsir.text: then made it after verdancy blackened stubble desiccated broken chaff.

verses.ar: سَنُقْرِئُكَ فَلَا تَنسَىٰٓ
verses.en: We will make you recite, [O Muḥammad], and you will not forget,

tafsir.text: We will have you recite the Qur’ān so that you will not forget what you recite

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلْجَهْرَ وَمَا يَخْفَىٰ
verses.en: Except what Allāh should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.

tafsir.text: except what God may will that you forget by abrogating its recitation and its ruling — the Prophet s used to recite aloud while Gabriel recited fearing to forget and so it is as though it was said to him ‘Do not hasten in it; you will not forget and so do not weary yourself by reciting it aloud’;

verses.ar: وَنُيَسِّرُكَ لِلْيُسْرَىٰ
verses.en: And We will ease you toward ease.

tafsir.text: And We will ease your way to the easy way the uncomplicated Law namely Islam.

verses.ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verses.en: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;

tafsir.text: So remind admonish by the Qur’ān in case the reminder should be of benefit to the one whom you might remind the one mentioned in the following verse ‘he who fears will be reminded’ in other words even if it might not be of benefit for it is of benefit to some but of no benefit to others.

verses.ar: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.en: He who fears [Allāh] will be reminded.

tafsir.text: He who fears God exalted be He will be reminded by it as in the verse So admonish by the Qur’ān him who fears My threat Q. 5045;

verses.ar: وَيَتَجَنَّبُهَا ٱلْأَشْقَى
verses.en: But the wretched one will avoid it

tafsir.text: but the wretched one al-ashqā means al-shaqī that is to say the disbeliever will shun it that is the reminder in other words he will leave it aside not looking at it

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِى يَصْلَى ٱلنَّارَ ٱلْكُبْرَىٰ
verses.en: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,

tafsir.text: he who will be roasted in the greater Fire the Fire of the Hereafter the lesser fire being that of this world;

verses.ar: ثُمَّ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.en: Neither dying therein nor living.

tafsir.text: then he will neither die therein and find rest nor live a enjoyable life.

verses.ar: قَدْ أَفْلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.en: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself

tafsir.text: Successful winner indeed is he who purifies himself who cleanses himself by means of his adherence to faith

verses.ar: وَذَكَرَ ٱسْمَ رَبِّهِۦ فَصَلَّىٰ
verses.en: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.

tafsir.text: and mentions the Name of his Lord saying Allāhu akbar ‘God is Great’ and prays the five prayers — and such are the concerns of one working towards the Hereafter concerns which the Meccan disbelievers shun.

verses.ar: بَلْ تُؤْثِرُونَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَا
verses.en: But you prefer the worldly life,

tafsir.text: Nay but you prefer or read yu’thirūna ‘they prefer’ the life of this world to the Hereafter

verses.ar: وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.en: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.

tafsir.text: whereas the Hereafter and the Paradise it entails is better and more lasting.

verses.ar: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَفِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.en: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,

tafsir.text: Truly this the success of those who purify themselves and the Hereafter being better is in the former scrolls the ones revealed before the Qur’ān

verses.ar: صُحُفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.en: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.

tafsir.text: the scrolls of Abraham and Moses the ten scrolls of Abraham and the Torah of Moses.

verses.ar: هَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ ٱلْغَـٰشِيَةِ
verses.en: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?

tafsir.text: Has there — there has indeed — come to you the tiding of the Enveloper? the Resurrection so called because it ‘envelops’ creatures with its terrors.

verses.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ خَـٰشِعَةٌ
verses.en: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,

tafsir.text: Some faces on that day — they faces are used to represent the individuals in both instances — will be humbled abject

verses.ar: عَامِلَةٌ نَّاصِبَةٌ
verses.en: Working [hard] and exhausted.

tafsir.text: toiling weary tired and exhausted from the chains and fetters

verses.ar: تَصْلَىٰ نَارًا حَامِيَةً
verses.en: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.

tafsir.text: roasting read taslā or tuslā in a scorching fire

verses.ar: تُسْقَىٰ مِنْ عَيْنٍ ءَانِيَةٍ
verses.en: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.

tafsir.text: made to drink from a boiling spring one of extremely hot temperatures.

verses.ar: لَّيْسَ لَهُمْ طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِن ضَرِيعٍ
verses.en: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant

tafsir.text: They will have no food except cactus darī‘ — a type of thorn plant which no animal grazes on because of its vileness —

verses.ar: لَّا يُسْمِنُ وَلَا يُغْنِى مِن جُوعٍ
verses.en: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.

tafsir.text: neither nourishing nor availing against hunger.

verses.ar: وُجُوهٌ يَوْمَئِذٍ نَّاعِمَةٌ
verses.en: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.

tafsir.text: Other faces on that day will be delicate fair

verses.ar: لِّسَعْيِهَا رَاضِيَةٌ
verses.en: With their effort [they are] satisfied

tafsir.text: pleased by their efforts in the life of the world expended in obedience pleased in the Hereafter upon seeing the reward thereof;

verses.ar: فِى جَنَّةٍ عَالِيَةٍ
verses.en: In an elevated garden,

tafsir.text: in a lofty Garden lofty in a physical as well as an abstract sense

verses.ar: لَّا تَسْمَعُ فِيهَا لَـٰغِيَةً
verses.en: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.

tafsir.text: in which they will not hear read lā yusma‘u ‘will not be heard’ or lā tasma‘u ‘they will not hear’ any vanity any inane soul speaking drivel;

verses.ar: فِيهَا عَيْنٌ جَارِيَةٌ
verses.en: Within it is a flowing spring.

tafsir.text: therein is a running spring of water meaning ‘springs’;

verses.ar: فِيهَا سُرُرٌ مَّرْفُوعَةٌ
verses.en: Within it are couches raised high

tafsir.text: therein are lofty couches lofty in terms of their essence their size and physical location

verses.ar: وَأَكْوَابٌ مَّوْضُوعَةٌ
verses.en: And cups put in place

tafsir.text: and goblets vessels without handles set around the edges of the springs prepared for them to drink with

verses.ar: وَنَمَارِقُ مَصْفُوفَةٌ
verses.en: And cushions lined up

tafsir.text: and cushions arrayed one next to the other against which they may lean

verses.ar: وَزَرَابِىُّ مَبْثُوثَةٌ
verses.en: And carpets spread around.

tafsir.text: and carpets rugs of velvet-hair spread out.

verses.ar: أَفَلَا يَنظُرُونَ إِلَى ٱلْإِبِلِ كَيْفَ خُلِقَتْ
verses.en: Then do they not look at the camels - how they are created?

tafsir.text: Will they the Meccan disbelievers not consider by way of reflection the camels how they are created?

verses.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ كَيْفَ رُفِعَتْ
verses.en: And at the sky - how it is raised?

tafsir.text: And the heaven how it was raised?

verses.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْجِبَالِ كَيْفَ نُصِبَتْ
verses.en: And at the mountains - how they are erected?

tafsir.text: And the mountains how they were set?

verses.ar: وَإِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَيْفَ سُطِحَتْ
verses.en: And at the earth - how it is spread out?

tafsir.text: And the earth how it was laid out flat? and thus infer from this the power of God exalted be He and His Oneness? The commencing with the mention of camels is because they are closer in contact with it the earth than any other animal.

verses.ar: فَذَكِّرْ إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُذَكِّرٌ
verses.en: So remind, [O Muḥammad]; you are only a reminder.

tafsir.text: So remind them of God’s graces and the proofs affirming His Oneness. For you are only an admonisher;

verses.ar: لَّسْتَ عَلَيْهِم بِمُصَيْطِرٍ
verses.en: You are not over them a controller.

tafsir.text: you are not a taskmaster over them a variant reading for musaytir has musaytir that is to say not one who has been given authority over them — this was revealed before the command to struggle against the disbelievers.

verses.ar: إِلَّا مَن تَوَلَّىٰ وَكَفَرَ
verses.en: However, he who turns away and disbelieves

tafsir.text: But he who turns away he who rejects faith and disbelieves in the Qur’ān

verses.ar: فَيُعَذِّبُهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَكْبَرَ
verses.en: Then Allāh will punish him with the greatest punishment.

tafsir.text: God will chastise him with the greater chastisement the chastisement of the Hereafter the lesser chastisement being that of this world that of being killed or taken captive.

verses.ar: إِنَّ إِلَيْنَآ إِيَابَهُمْ
verses.en: Indeed, to Us is their return.

tafsir.text: Truly to Us will be their return their coming back after death

verses.ar: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيْنَا حِسَابَهُم
verses.en: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.

tafsir.text: then truly with Us will lie their reckoning their requital which We will never abandon.

verses.ar: وَٱلْفَجْرِ
verses.en: By the dawn

tafsir.text: By the dawn that is to say by the dawn of each day

verses.ar: وَلَيَالٍ عَشْرٍ
verses.en: And [by] ten nights

tafsir.text: and by the ten nights the first ten nights of Dhū’l-Hijja

verses.ar: وَٱلشَّفْعِ وَٱلْوَتْرِ
verses.en: And [by] the even [number] and the odd

tafsir.text: and by the even the pair and the odd read watr or witr two alternative forms the single

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَسْرِ
verses.en: And [by] the night when it passes,

tafsir.text: and by the night in motion falling or receding

verses.ar: هَلْ فِى ذَٰلِكَ قَسَمٌ لِّذِى حِجْرٍ
verses.en: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?

tafsir.text: Is there in that oath an oath for one of sense? one of intellect the response to the oath has been omitted that is to say it is to be understood as something like la-tu‘adhdhabunna yā kuffāra Makka ‘you will assuredly be chastised O disbelievers of Mecca!’.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ كَيْفَ فَعَلَ رَبُّكَ بِعَادٍ
verses.en: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ʿAad -

tafsir.text: Have you not seen do you not know O Muhammad (s) how your Lord dealt with ‘Ād

verses.ar: إِرَمَ ذَاتِ ٱلْعِمَادِ
verses.en: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,

tafsir.text: Iram — these were the former people of ‘Ād Irama is an explicative supplement or a substitution and it is treated as a diptote because it is a proper noun and feminine — of the towering ones that is to say the tall ones — the tallest one among them would reach four hundred cubits —

verses.ar: ٱلَّتِى لَمْ يُخْلَقْ مِثْلُهَا فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
verses.en: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?

tafsir.text: the like of which was not created in the land in terms of their power of assault and strength

verses.ar: وَثَمُودَ ٱلَّذِينَ جَابُوا۟ ٱلصَّخْرَ بِٱلْوَادِ
verses.en: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?

tafsir.text: and Thamūd who hollowed hewed the rocks sakhr is the plural of sakhra in the valley the Wādī al-Qurā rocks which they used as dwellings

verses.ar: وَفِرْعَوْنَ ذِى ٱلْأَوْتَادِ
verses.en: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes?

tafsir.text: and Pharaoh the one of the tent-pegs he used to fasten four pegs and tie to these the hands and feet of those whom he tortured —

verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَـٰدِ
verses.en: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands

tafsir.text: those who were rebellious became tyrannical in the land

verses.ar: فَأَكْثَرُوا۟ فِيهَا ٱلْفَسَادَ
verses.en: And increased therein the corruption.

tafsir.text: and caused much corruption therein? by way of slaying and otherwise.

verses.ar: فَصَبَّ عَلَيْهِمْ رَبُّكَ سَوْطَ عَذَابٍ
verses.en: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.

tafsir.text: So your Lord poured on them a scourge of chastisement.

verses.ar: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلْمِرْصَادِ
verses.en: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.

tafsir.text: Assuredly your Lord is ever on the watch watching over the deeds of servants nothing of which escapes Him that He may then requite them for these deeds.

verses.ar: فَأَمَّا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَأَكْرَمَهُۥ وَنَعَّمَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَكْرَمَنِ
verses.en: And as for man, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favors him, he says, "My Lord has honored me."

tafsir.text: And as for man the disbeliever whenever his Lord tests him and honours him with wealth and other things and is gracious to him he says ‘My Lord has honoured me’.

verses.ar: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبْتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ رِزْقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّىٓ أَهَـٰنَنِ
verses.en: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."

tafsir.text: But when he tests him and restricts his provision for him he says ‘My Lord has humiliated me’.

verses.ar: كَلَّا ۖ بَل لَّا تُكْرِمُونَ ٱلْيَتِيمَ
verses.en: No! But you do not honor the orphan

tafsir.text: No indeed! — a disavowal of this notion in other words honour is not about wealth nor is there any humiliation in poverty rather it has to do with obedience and disobedience respectively; but the disbelievers of Mecca unmindful of this.

verses.ar: وَلَا تَحَـٰٓضُّونَ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلْمِسْكِينِ
verses.en: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.

tafsir.text: and they do not urge neither themselves nor others the feeding of the needy;

verses.ar: وَتَأْكُلُونَ ٱلتُّرَاثَ أَكْلًا لَّمًّا
verses.en: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,

tafsir.text: and they devour inheritance turāth means mīrāth greedily lamman that is to say voraciously when they appropriate lammuhum the women’s and the young ones’ share of the inheritance together with their own share of it or to their own wealth;

verses.ar: وَتُحِبُّونَ ٱلْمَالَ حُبًّا جَمًّا
verses.en: And you love wealth with immense love.

tafsir.text: and they love wealth with abounding love that is to say greatly and so they do not expend any of it a variant reading in the case of all four verbs has the second person plural.

verses.ar: كَلَّآ إِذَا دُكَّتِ ٱلْأَرْضُ دَكًّا دَكًّا
verses.en: No! When the earth has been leveled - pounded and crushed

tafsir.text: No indeed! — a deterrent for them from such conduct. When the earth is pulverised repeatedly when it is shaken until every edifice has collapsed and is destroyed

verses.ar: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلْمَلَكُ صَفًّا صَفًّا
verses.en: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,

tafsir.text: and your Lord that is to say His command and the angels arrive rank on rank saffan saffan is a circumstantial qualifier meaning ‘standing in rows’ or ‘made up of many ranks’

verses.ar: وَجِا۟ىٓءَ يَوْمَئِذٍۭ بِجَهَنَّمَ ۚ يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ
verses.en: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?

tafsir.text: and Hell on that day is brought near pulled by seventy thousand sets of reins each set of reins pulled by the hands of seventy thousand angels as it groans and seethes in fury;

verses.ar: يَقُولُ يَـٰلَيْتَنِى قَدَّمْتُ لِحَيَاتِى
verses.en: He will say, "Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life."

tafsir.text: He will say as he remembers ‘O yā is for calling attention to something would that I had sent ahead good deeds and faith for my life!’ for a good life in the Hereafter or it means ‘during my life’ in the world.

verses.ar: فَيَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,

tafsir.text: Then on that day none shall mete out read yu‘adhdhibu His God’s chastisement that is to say He shall not delegate it to any other;

verses.ar: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].

tafsir.text: and likewise none shall bind read yūthiqu His bind a variant reading has yu‘adhdhabu ‘none shall be chastised’ and yūthaqu ‘none shall be bound’ so that the suffixed pronoun of ‘adhābahu and wathāqahu refers to the chastisement and the binds of the disbeliever the meaning then being ‘none shall be chastised as he

verses.ar: يَـٰٓأَيَّتُهَا ٱلنَّفْسُ ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ
verses.en: [To the righteous it will be said], "O reassured soul,

tafsir.text: ‘O soul at peace! the one secure namely the believing one.

verses.ar: ٱرْجِعِىٓ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكِ رَاضِيَةً مَّرْضِيَّةً
verses.en: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],

tafsir.text: Return — this is said to it upon death — to your Lord that is to say return to His command and to His will pleased with the reward pleasing in God’s sight with your deeds; in other words return O soul combining both descriptions both of which are circumstantial qualifiers. And it will be said to it at the Resurrection

verses.ar: فَٱدْخُلِى فِى عِبَـٰدِى
verses.en: And enter among My [righteous] servants

tafsir.text: Then enter among My righteous servants!

verses.ar: وَٱدْخُلِى جَنَّتِى
verses.en: And enter My Paradise."

tafsir.text: And enter My Paradise!’ with them.

verses.ar: لَآ أُقْسِمُ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
verses.en: I swear by this city [i.e., Makkah]

tafsir.text: I swear lā is extra by this land of Mecca

verses.ar: وَأَنتَ حِلٌّۢ بِهَـٰذَا ٱلْبَلَدِ
verses.en: And you, [O Muḥammad], are free of restriction in this city

tafsir.text: and you O Muhammad (s) have free disposal of sanction for this land in that you will be given permission to fight in it — and indeed God fulfilled this promise to him on the day of the Conquest of Mecca thus this is a parenthetical statement intervening between that by which the oath has been sworn and that which is a

verses.ar: وَوَالِدٍ وَمَا وَلَدَ
verses.en: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],

tafsir.text: And by the begetter that is Adam and that which he begat that is his descendants mā ‘that which’ actually means man ‘whom’.

verses.ar: لَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ فِى كَبَدٍ
verses.en: We have certainly created man into hardship.

tafsir.text: We certainly created man al-insān the generic noun in travail in a state of toil and hardship struggling with the tribulations of this world and the calamities of the Hereafter.

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقْدِرَ عَلَيْهِ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?

tafsir.text: Does he suppose does the strong man of Quraysh namely Abū’l-Ashadd b. Kalada presume on account of his strength that an softened in place of the hardened form its subject omitted that is to say annahu no one will have power over him? Yet God has power over him.

verses.ar: يَقُولُ أَهْلَكْتُ مَالًا لُّبَدًا
verses.en: He says, "I have spent wealth in abundance."

tafsir.text: He says ‘I have exhausted in enmity of Muhammad (s) vast wealth!’ great wealth piles and piles of it.

verses.ar: أَيَحْسَبُ أَن لَّمْ يَرَهُۥٓ أَحَدٌ
verses.en: Does he think that no one has seen him?

tafsir.text: Does he suppose that an in other words annahu no one has seen him? with regard to what he has expended to know the quantity thereof; God knows the quantity thereof; but it is not in reality that much so as to be considered a great amount and in any case He will requite him for his evil conduct.

verses.ar: أَلَمْ نَجْعَل لَّهُۥ عَيْنَيْنِ
verses.en: Have We not made for him two eyes?

tafsir.text: Have We not given an interrogative meant as an affirmative in other words ‘We have certainly given’ him two eyes

verses.ar: وَلِسَانًا وَشَفَتَيْنِ
verses.en: And a tongue and two lips?

tafsir.text: and a tongue and two lips

verses.ar: وَهَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلنَّجْدَيْنِ
verses.en: And have shown him the two ways?

tafsir.text: and guided him to the two paths? did We not point out to him the path of good and that of evil?

verses.ar: فَلَا ٱقْتَحَمَ ٱلْعَقَبَةَ
verses.en: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.

tafsir.text: Yet why does he not assault the obstacle? why does he not surmount it?

verses.ar: وَمَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلْعَقَبَةُ
verses.en: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?

tafsir.text: And what will show you what will make known to you what the obstacle is? that he is to surmount — intended to emphasise its enormity this statement is a parenthetical one. He explains the way to surmount it by saying

verses.ar: فَكُّ رَقَبَةٍ
verses.en: It is the freeing of a slave

tafsir.text: the freeing of a slave from bondage

verses.ar: أَوْ إِطْعَـٰمٌ فِى يَوْمٍ ذِى مَسْغَبَةٍ
verses.en: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger

tafsir.text: or to give food on a day of hunger

verses.ar: يَتِيمًا ذَا مَقْرَبَةٍ
verses.en: An orphan of near relationship

tafsir.text: to an orphan near of kin maqraba means qarāba

verses.ar: أَوْ مِسْكِينًا ذَا مَتْرَبَةٍ
verses.en: Or a needy person in misery

tafsir.text: or a needy person in misery matraba literally means ‘clinging to the dust turāb’ because of his poverty; a variant reading has two verbal nouns in place of the two verbs fakka ‘he freed’ and at‘ama ‘he fed’ the first being in a genitive construction fakku raqabatin ‘the freeing of a slave’ and the second with nunation

verses.ar: ثُمَّ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلصَّبْرِ وَتَوَاصَوْا۟ بِٱلْمَرْحَمَةِ
verses.en: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.

tafsir.text: while being thumma kāna is a supplement to iqtahama ‘he assaulted’; thumma is for the ordering of things to be mentioned in other words what is meant is that at the point of the assault he was one of those who believe and enjoin one another to steadfastness in pursuing obedience and in refraining from disobedience and

verses.ar: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَيْمَنَةِ
verses.en: Those are the companions of the right.

tafsir.text: Those the ones described by the said attributes are the ones of the right side al-maymana means al-yamīn.

verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا هُمْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْمَشْـَٔمَةِ
verses.en: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.

tafsir.text: But those who disbelieve in Our signs they are the ones of the left side al-mash’ama means al-shimāl.

verses.ar: عَلَيْهِمْ نَارٌ مُّؤْصَدَةٌۢ
verses.en: Over them will be fire closed in.

tafsir.text: Over them will be an enclosing Fire read mu’sada or mūsada closed on top of them.

verses.ar: وَٱلشَّمْسِ وَضُحَىٰهَا
verses.en: By the sun and its brightness

tafsir.text: By the sun and her morning light

verses.ar: وَٱلْقَمَرِ إِذَا تَلَىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the moon when it follows it

tafsir.text: and by the moon when it follows her rising after she has set

verses.ar: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا جَلَّىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the day when it displays it

tafsir.text: and by the day when it reveals her as it rises high

verses.ar: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا يَغْشَىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it

tafsir.text: and by the night when it enshrouds her covering her up with its darkness idhā ‘when’ in all three instances is an absolute adverbial operated by the verbal action of the oath.

verses.ar: وَٱلسَّمَآءِ وَمَا بَنَىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it

tafsir.text: By the heaven and the One Who built it

verses.ar: وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا طَحَىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the earth and He who spread it

tafsir.text: and by the earth and the One Who spread it laid out flat.

verses.ar: وَنَفْسٍ وَمَا سَوَّىٰهَا
verses.en: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it

tafsir.text: and by the soul that is to say by all souls and the One Who proportioned it in its created form mā in all three instances relates to the verbal action or functions as man ‘the one who’

verses.ar: فَأَلْهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقْوَىٰهَا
